articleTitle: Action-on-Edge-Based Control Configuration Technology for Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Battery energy storage systems (BESS) have been widely applied in power system because of their ability to maximize self-consumption and energy arbitrage. However, few studies focus on the high-performance regulation and control of energy storage for distributed users, who typically have variable needs, and the budget of controllers is limited. To fill this gap, a new type of control method based on the action-on-edge (AOE) network is proposed for BESS in this paper. This control model is divided into a combination of several events and actions, which are then transformed into mathematical expressions and can be easily optimized to obtain the instructions. The proposed AOE-based strategy has two advantages: 1) low code complexity, easy to use and expand; 2) complex operations can be performed under the condition with limited communication and computing resources. Simulation results of a BESS for data center are presented to verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Recognition Method of Partial Discharge of Power Cables Based on Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The oscillating wave test to assess the insulation status of power cables and identify faults is widely used. In this paper, based on the periodic type of partial discharge (PD) data, an intelligent identification method of partial discharge of power cables based on data augmentation is proposed. The algorithm uses the empirical mode decomposition (EMD) to filter the original data, and then proposes a translation expansion method to augment the original data, which solves the overfitting problem caused by the insufficient amount of original data. The expanded data are fed into a neural network with convolutional neural network as the main structure for recognition, and finally a weighted composite judgment strategy is proposed. In order to evaluate the feasibility of the algorithm, the corresponding experiments are set up, which show that the recognition accuracy of the algorithm can reach 97%, which is much better than other conventional algorithms.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Port LVDC-SOP Based on Four-switch Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of distributed generation and energy storage which have DC characteristics., more attention was paid to the DC microgrid. But there are problems such as insufficient consumption and low energy utilization due to the randomness and intermittency of renewable energy. A wider range of resource integration after the interconnection of adjacent DC microgrids can solve this problem. For the interconnection and power scheduling among multiple DC microgrids., a multi-port low-voltage DC soft open point (LVDC-SOP) is designed in this paper. Operation mode of the multi-port LVDC-SOP can flexibly transfer among current control., voltage control and droop control modes. The four-switch buck-boost (FSBB) converter is adopted as port converter which is suitable for wide range voltage conversion and convenient to achieve the isolation of fault ports. The proposed topology and control strategy are verified through the simulation and experiments on a 48V/4 kW multi-port LVDC-SOP prototype.

articleTitle: Analysis of axial current of brushless doubly-fed motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: rushless doubly-fed motor is a new type of motor developed in recent years, which has been widely used in industry. Because of the frequency converter drive system of power semiconductor devices on and off frequently, in the motor winding between casing and generate a high frequency of common-mode voltage, and then through the stray capacitance formation in the motor coupling path of shaft current, lead to motor bearing electric erosion problems, seriously affecting the safe and stable operation of the motor system, so you need to study and analysis to the problem of shaft current. In this paper, the equivalent axial current model of brushless doubly-fed generator is established and the stray capacitance in the motor is calculated by analytical method. The shaft current of a 3kW brushless doubly-fed motor is simulated and analyzed, and the shaft current is predicted under the drive of frequency converter. It is found that the shaft current of the motor under the drive of high frequency can greatly affect the stability of the motor.

articleTitle: An Experimental Research on Temperature Accuracy Algorithm in Fan Coil Thermostat
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The efficient operation of HVAC&R systems are based on keeping indoor temperature and air quality at an optimum level without disturbing comfort. Starting from this point, in this experimental research, the factors affecting the measurement accuracy during the room temperature detection of a wall mount fan coil thermostat were examined. Among the external effects, the effect of the device components on the measurement was focused and the solution of the measurement deviations occurred in this extent was investigated. Based on the experiments, the algorithm that must be applied to reach the optimum temperature measurement of a room thermostat developed for Fan Coil systems was proposed.

articleTitle: Equivalence analysis of different sequence impedance modeling methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The sequence impedance has a clear physical meaning and can be directly measured by commercial equipment, so it is widely used for stability analysis in the field of electrical engineering. It can be transformed from dq impedance indirectly or calculated based on Harmonic State Space (HSS) theory directly. This paper analyzes the equivalence of the above two methods. Firstly, the dq impedance model of grid-connected converter is established, and the equivalence of impedance in dq domain and sequence domain is proved by mathematical transformation. Then, modified sequence impedance model of grid-connected converter is established considering the frequency coupling phenomenon. On the other hand, the impedance model can also be obtained from HSS modeling with h order harmonics. Subsequently, the relationship between the modified sequence impedance and HSS impedance can be found. The former is a special case when the latter takes h=2. When considering the coupling effect of higher harmonics, HSS impedance model has higher accuracy. Finally, the accuracy and the equivalence of the above-mentioned two methods are verified by frequency sweep.

articleTitle: Research on a New DC Link Single-phase Soft-switching Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a single-phase full-bridge resonant DC link soft-switching inverter is proposed. The auxiliary resonant circuit is controlled by a separate switch to make the DC link voltage drop to zero when the main switch of the inverter needs to be switched. All the main switches of the inverter can achieve zero voltage switching, and the auxiliary switches can also achieve zero voltage switching. Moreover, the DC link voltage of the inverter will not exceed the DC source voltage. Because the resonance process and zero voltage duration are short, the utilization rate of DC voltage can be improved. According to the circuit equivalent diagram of different working stages of the circuit, its working principle is analyzed., the realization conditions of soft switch are given., and its simulation verification is carried out. The simulation results show that the main switch and auxiliary switch of the inverter have achieved soft switching.

articleTitle: Pyrolysis characteristics and kinetic analysis of KI50X transformer oil
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Transformer oil is widely used as an insulating and cooling medium in electrical equipment, and Long-term work at high temperatures results in cracking, which generates many small molecule products that accumulate heat and cause fires, therefore, the study of pyrolysis related process and theory is of great significance to prevent and inhibit fire. Based on the kinetic theory of thermal analysis, this paper studied the pyrolysis process of KI50X transformer oil at different temperature rise rates (10, 20 and 40°C/min) using a simultaneous thermogravimetric analyzer, and found that the pyrolysis process mainly occurred at 200~350°C. As the temperature rise rate increased, the thermogravimetric curve and the micro-quotient thermogravimetric curve moved towards the high temperature side, and then the activation energy of transformer oil was calculated using the differential method and the integral method, the calculation results show that: the thermal decomposition process of transformer oil is a single-step reaction, the activation energy obtained by using different calculation methods is slightly different, and the activation energy of transformer oil is 42.19kJ/mol after averaging.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Particle Trap in Transmission Line for the CRAFT NNBI System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on the development of Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak (EAST) neutral beam injectors system (NBI), Institute of Plasma Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences (ASIPP) decided to establish a Negative-ion based Neutral Beam Injectors (NNBI) test-bed to meet the requirements of the Comprehensive Research fAcility for Fusion Technology (CRAFT), which is a largescale of R&D project for China Fusion Engineering Test Reactor (CFETR). The High Voltage Transmission Line (HVTL) is an important part of the NNBI system, which connects the ion source system and the power supply system. However, some metal particles will be produced in the production and operation of HVTL. The charged particles will move in HVTL or attach to the surface of insulators and electrodes, resulting in flashover or breakdown between internal and external electrodes, thus reducing the insulation performance of HVTL. Therefore, some restraining measures need to be taken to reduce the effect of metal particles on insulation performance, and particle trap is one of them. In this paper, the electric charge of particles and the force acting on them are analyzed, and the mechanism of the decrease of gap insulation strength of HVTL caused by the movement of metal particles is simply explained. Then the simulation model of particle trap is established, and the electric field distribution of particle trap and the working principle of trapping particles are analyzed. Finally, the design parameters of particle trap are optimized, which provides a reference basis for the engineering manufacture and experimental research of particle trap and also provides some guidance for the follow-up engineering design of HVTL.

articleTitle: A high-precision realization of online junction temperature estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The on-state voltage at high current is very suitable as a sensitive parameter for junction temperature monitoring. But there are still problems in applications, such as accuracy, noise, temperature drift, and verification. In this paper, an accurate online sampling module was designed. A compensation method was adopted to improve the sampling accuracy of the existing current sensor. With a novel sudden-stop control strategy, an offline junction temperature measurement is used to verify the online monitoring results. Finally, an experimental verification is carried out on a 600V/ 250kW three-phase inverter system.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Recognition in Real Switchgear Based on Soft Scoring Mechanism and Multi-Mode Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Partial discharge (PD) in switchgear is closely related to its premature insulation degradation, and accurate identification of PD types is an important means to improve its operation condition and to ensure safety of power system. In this paper, four typical PD types are designed in real switchgear: point discharge, suspension potential discharge, strong vertical component along the surface discharge and weak vertical component along the surface discharge. UHF sensor, TEV sensor, AE sensor and HFCT are combined for detection of switchgear PD, and the detection sensitivity of different sensors under the same defect and the spectral characteristics of different defect types are analyzed. Five characteristic parameters of discharge density distribution and correlation coefficient of contour of the extraction spectrum are combined to form a new feature system. A soft scoring method is proposed to identify the PD pattern of switchgear. This method solves the issues associated with traditional recognition methods that rely solely on single spectral characteristics, resulting in low recognition accuracy and inaccurate recognition types. Moreover, it offers a theoretical framework for online monitoring and fault diagnosis of switchgear equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage an Temperature Influence characteristics of Frequency Domain Dielectric Spectrum of Dry-type Epoxy Resin impregnated Paper Insulating Bushings
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper takes the dry-type epoxy resin impregnated paper (RIP) insulating bushings as research object, and builds a test platform of voltage and temperature influence characteristic. How voltage and temperature influence the Frequency Domain Spectroscopy (FDS) characteristics of the bushings was studied, and anti-electromagnetic interference method based on increasing test voltage and temperature correction method of the FDS characteristics based on the Arrhenius equation was proposed. The application in a converter station verifies the effectiveness of the anti-electromagnetic interference method and temperature correction method for the FDS characteristics of the RIP bushings.

articleTitle: Grid Voltage Synchronization Method Based on Adaptive Filter in Weak Grid Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Synchronization signal detection for Grid voltage is related to the operation performance and stability of grid-connected converter. Aiming at the problem of insufficient accuracy for traditional grid voltage synchronization signal detection methods in complex power grid conditions, this paper proposes a method based on the combination of complex decoupling filter and adaptive filter. The complex decoupling filter is used to separate the positive and negative sequence components, and then an adaptive filter algorithm is used to carry out secondary separation and harmonic suppression. At the same time, the influence of the DC component caused by the fault transient can be eliminated. The frequency adaptation link eliminates the detection deviation caused by the frequency fluctuation of the power grid. Simulation and experimental results show that the proposed method can achieve accurate detection of grid voltage synchronization signals in weak grid condition such as three-phase imbalance, harmonic distortion, DC disturbance, and voltage mutation, which verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation for fireproof sealing system of cable shaft in high-rise buildings
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The fire in the cable shaft has the characteristics of fast spread, great fire hazard, and high difficulty in extinguishing. And the fireproof sealing measures are often used in the cable shaft to slow down or even block the spread of the fire, but few scholars have evaluated the overall performance of the fireproof sealing system. Therefore, based on the entropy method, this paper proposes a performance evaluation system for the fireproof sealing system of cable shafts in high-rise buildings. Firstly, based on the composition of the fireproof sealing system of the cable shaft in high-rise buildings, a performance evaluation system is constructed. Secondly, the entropy method is used to calculate the entropy weight of each index of the evaluation system. Finally, the performance evaluation scores and rankings of the fireproof sealing system of cable shafts in high-rise buildings based on the entropy method are obtained. The result shows that the performance evaluation results of the fireproof sealing system calculated by the system are consistent with the field experimental results, which verifies the effectiveness of the evaluation system.

articleTitle: Multi-Energy Scheduling Strategy for Carbon Emissions-Constrained Enterprises Based on Model Predictive Control and Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on the carbon emissions requirements of global climate change for carbon emissions-constrained enterprises, this paper proposes a multi-energy scheduling strategy for carbon emissions-constrained enterprises. First, based on the production data of the enterprise, the energy-output model and the energy-carbon model can be established respectively by using the neural network. Then, based on the above two models, the model predictive control algorithm is used to predict the output and carbon emissions in the future, and establish an energy scheduling optimization function. Finally, use the particle swarm algorithm to solve the optimal energy scheduling scheme. The energy optimization scheduling strategy proposed in this paper can not only complete the production task, but also minimize carbon emissions and achieve the unification of economic and ecological benefits.

articleTitle: Numerical study of dissolved H2 migration in a 500 kV transformer ascending flanged base
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The ascending flanged base of the transformer is a so-called dead oil area with very low flow velocity, leading to possible delay of characteristic gas migration to the DGA sampling location. In this paper, the temperature-dependent diffusion coefficient of H2 in transformer oil is obtained via bubble dissolution method and molecular dynamics simulation, and then the migration of dissolved H2 in the ascending flanged base of a 500 kV transformer is numerically studied. It is found that the natural convection changes the original internal flow field of the ascending flanged base, and the characteristic gas diffuses faster than that under constant temperature. However, it is still difficult for the characteristic gases to diffuse into the transformer tank in time to reach the oil sampling point. The presented results can serve as reference for optimizing fluid design and oil chromatography detection.

articleTitle: A Novel Study on Microbubble Evolution in Oil-Paper Insulation Using Microfluidics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the temperature of the transformer winding rises, the bubbles will be evolved in the pores of the insulation paper with dampness, and emitted into the insulating oil, which will lead to partial discharge or even breakdown. However, a quantitative understanding of bubble evolution in insulating paper remains problematic, as the inaccessibility of any temperature or pressure controllable and measurable experiments in the situ microporosity of the insulation paper. To this end, a novel microfluidic approach is introduced, using a lab-on-a-chip where three transparent micro channels are designed with different widths to simulate the interfibrous capillary. Thereby the bubble evolution is directly observed in the pore scale. The present study underlies further explorations on numerical modeling of the bubble evolution and calculating the bubble's initial temperature.

articleTitle: Highly Sensitive Air Switch Cabinet Decomposition Gas Sensing Device And Monitoring Analysis Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The air switch cabinet plays an important role in the distribution network. The timely opening and closing of the air switch cabinet ensure the personal safety of the power equipment operators and the stable operation of the power system. Gas sensors are widely used in gas monitoring and disease because of their small size, low power consumption, and low cost. In areas such as diagnostics. Based on different sensing materials, preparation methods, and the diversity of detection gases, gas sensors have many types according to the detection requirements, which are classified from the response mechanism, including resistance gas sensors, optical gas sensors, electrochemical gas sensors, etc. It is classified from the aspect of sensor materials, mainly including metal semiconductor sensors, ceramic sensors, solid electrolyte sensors, etc. In the long-term operation of the air switch cabinet, the partial discharge caused by various defects in the air switch cabinet will cause the air in the switch cabinet to be ionized and decomposed to produce O<inf>3</inf>, CO, NO<inf>2</inf>and other decomposition products. Therefore, it is of great significance to detect the partial discharge of the air switch cabinet.

articleTitle: Dynamic Electric Vehicle Wireless Charging System Compatible with Unipolar and Bipolar Receiving Coils Based on Novel Decoupled Staggered Transmitting Coil Array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the popularity of electric vehicles, wireless charging technology has developed rapidly because of its safety, convenience and automation characteristics. Dynamic wireless charging has attracted widespread attention because it does not need large capacity energy storage batteries compared with static wireless charging. However, both dynamic wireless charging and static wireless charging have interoperability problems. This paper proposes a dynamic wireless charging system based on a new type of staggered transmitting coil array that is decoupled from each other. It can realize the compatibility of unipolar and bipolar receiving coils. Moreover, the proposed system can charge two different receivers simultaneously. The mathematical model is derived and the 1.2 kW simulation model is built, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed system. The maximum efficiency is 91.14% when the receiver is a unipolar coil, and 91.19% when the receiver is a bipolar coil.

articleTitle: Loss Imbalance in SiC Half-Bridge Power Module
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Capacitive parasitic couplings in power electronics systems are gaining increased attention due to the emergence of the wide bandgap devices, with the main challenges being faster switching speeds and increased operating voltage capabilities causing increased voltage slew rate (dv/dt). The high dv/dt induces capacitive displacement currents through the channel of the power semiconductor devices, effectively reducing the switching speed, resulting in an increase in the Volt-Ampere integral, incurring surplus switching energy dissipation. This paper highlights that the parasitic power module gate high side capacitance should be analyzed in parallel to the high-side gate-drain capacitance and thus contributing to the “equivalent” high-side Miller capacitance, slowing down the switching speed of the high-side device compared to the low-side device in the half-bridge power module. Effectively this causes an imbalance in switching energy dissipation between high-side and low-side devices. A combined physics based and behavioural based digital twin simulation is used to evaluate high-side and low-side switching energy dissipation through double pulse testing. Simulations identify a significant increase in turn-on energy on the high-side device compared to the low side device, due to the equivalent high-side Miller capacitance increase. Possible reasons for why such significant deviation in switching energy dissipation between the high-side and low-side devices is unprecedented, are shared from the authors perspectives.

articleTitle: Study on Removal of PCDD/Fs from Flue Gas Processed by Pulse Corona Discharge Composite Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this study, the pulse corona discharge composite technology is used to treat flue gas. The pulse corona discharge technology is the main technology, and the bag filter and activated carbon adsorption are the auxiliary processes. The pulse corona discharge adopts the nanosecond narrow pulse power supply to achieve the intense pulse electric field, the electric field intensity is adjustable, and the multi-level discharge ionization superposition is used to remove the dioxins (PCDD/Fs) in the flue gas step by step. Under the given electric field intensity, PCDD/Fs in flue gas will undergo material dissociation and free radical oxidation reaction. With the increase of electric field intensity, the removal efficiency of PCDD/Fs will be increased gradually, and the maximum comprehensive removal efficiency of more than 97% can be achieved. This study shows that the efficient removal of PCDD/Fs in incineration flue gas without secondary pollution can be successfully achieved via the pulsed corona discharge composite technology proposed, and this technology can also be extended to the removal of PCDD/Fs in similar flue gas. This study provides effective theoretical basis for the large-scale promotion and application of this technology.

articleTitle: A Portrait-Based Method for Constructing Multi-Time Scale Demand Response Resource Pools
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Demand response (DR) resources play a crucial role in enhancing the power system's flexibility and maintaining the real-time balance between supply and demand side. In order to unlock the potential of underutilized DR resources and achieve a “real-time, rapid, and accurate” regulation effect, it is imperative to study and construct DR resource pools. This paper introduces a multi-time scale DR resource pool construction method based on resource portrait, which takes into account the multi-time scale characteristics of DR resources. First, we categorize the basic indicators that characterize the load regulation capability. Then, the DR resource portrait tags are obtained under the day-ahead, intra-day, and real-time time scales. Finally, using the hierarchical weight decision-making analysis method, we calculate the comprehensive index of load regulation capability for a reliable evaluation of resource response capability. The load aggregator (LA) conducts orderly scheduling of resources in the pool and accurately responds to the system scheduling requirements based on the resource pool call process. The proposed resource pool construction method has been verified from two aspects of response deviation rate and scheduling cost, and its technical and economic advantages have been proven.

articleTitle: A Three-level Coordinated Optimization Method to Regulate Voltage Variations in Distribution Networks with High Photovoltaic Power
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a three-level voltage regulation method to mitigate voltage variations of distribution networks caused by active power fluctuations of photovoltaic (PV). In the first level, the leader-follower consensus algorithm (LFCA) is used to control the charging and discharging power of battery energy storage systems (BESSs) and the active power reduction of PV plants to limit the real-time (1min) voltage variation. A reactive power optimization model is established in the second level to optimize the short-term (5min) reactive output of each PV plant, aiming at the minimization of nodal voltage deviations. Meanwhile, it also considers the state of charge (SOC) correction of BESSs. In the third level, a model predictive control (MPC) based integer nonlinear programming (INP) model is developed to optimize the tap of the on-load tap changer (OLTC) and the reactive output of capacitor banks (CBs), which aims to cope with the voltage fluctuations caused by the long-term (30min) power changes in loads and PV plants. Simulation results indicate that the proposed methods can effectively control nodal voltage variations of a feeder within the pre-defined range by coordinating an OLTC, CBs, PV plants, and BESSs.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Energy Flow Algorithm for Integrated Energy Systems Based on Fuzzy C-means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Integrated energy systems is an effective way to achieve carbon neutrality by improving the utilization of renewable energy through the synergistic complementation of multiple energy sources. At present, hard clustering algorithm such as K-means clustering is usually used for clustering in the probabilistic flow calculation of power system, but they will bring some error in the multi-energy coupling scenarios with multiple uncertain variables. Therefore, in this paper, we consider the uncertainty of renewable energy and multiple energy loads to model and apply the fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm in probabilistic energy flow calculation for the integrated energy systems of electricity, heat and gas. First, establish a hybrid energy flow model of the integrated energy systems considering the uncertainty and relevance of renewable energy and multiple energy loads. Then the cumulant method is used to solve the probabilistic energy flow and the fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm is used to cluster the scenarios and reduce the linearization error. Finally, the simulation analysis of the actual case shows the accuracy of the probabilistic energy flow calculation applying the fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of Breakdown Delay of Pseudospark Discharge Triggered from Anode Side
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper experimentally investigates formation processes of pseudospark discharge triggered from anode side. The modified Laue plots adopting Kolmogorov-Smirnov test method is used for statistical analysis. It is assumed that the statistical delay and formation delay of ignition process conforms to exponential distribution and normal distribution, respectively. The minimum voltage and pressure that the discharge can be triggered from anode side are significantly higher than those from cathode side. In most cases, the formation delay is larger than the statistical delay, and both rapidly decrease as gas pressure or applied voltage increases. It is inferred that the statistical delay corresponds to the formation of stable and intense ion flux towards the cathode; while the formation delay corresponds to a sequence of processes, including the formation of positive charge region in the hollow cathode and the formation and expansion of virtual anode in the main gap.

articleTitle: Residential Solar Panel Object Detection Based on Multi-combination Data Augmentation and YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The photovoltaic (PV) installation capacity is important for the planning and operation of the grid. Image recognition has been a new method to detect PV installation capacity. This paper proposes a residential solar panel (RSP) object detection model based on multi-combination data augmentation and YOLOv5. The RSP dataset is established through public satellite images. The multi-combination data augmentation method is proposed to deal with the small sample problem and the YOLOv5s is utilized as the detection algorithm. Several ablation experiments with conventional data augmentation methods are conducted. Compared to the standard yolov5-based benchmark test, our method can increase the overall average precision by 4%.

articleTitle: Evolution Behaviors and Properties of Power Compartment Fires in Underground Urban Utility Tunnels-A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this review, a comprehensive definition for an underground urban utility tunnel UUUT is given to reflect its inherent quality, unique features and latent fire safety issues. Following this, major fire hazards and high fire risks inside power compartments are analyzed. Based on this, international related reported fire accidents are counted and described. Such situation calls for special, systematic and deep researches of these fires. Typical international studies of power compartment fires are hereafter summarized in their main cases, contents, important results and conclusions. However, current researches are far from enough to understand power compartment fires fundamentally and practically. Therefore, seven primary future directions are proposed.

articleTitle: A Review on Defense Mechanism against the Denial of Service and False Data Injection in Cyber-Physical Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Cyber-physical power system (CPPS), with its bi-directional power and information flows, is considered as the next generation of widely distributed and automated electrical power network. However, CPPS is vulnerable to malicious cyberattacks that can cause significant operational risk and financial loss to stakeholders, such as electricity system operators. The complexity of vulnerabilities, which arises from the heterogeneity and interdependency of physical and cyber domains, will present substantial challenges for the detection and prevention of cyberattacks. This paper provides a comprehensive review of the defense mechanisms in CPPS against coordinated and widespread cyberattacks. The most prevalent cyberattacks in the CPPS are denial-of-service (DoS) and false data injection (FDI) attacks. This paper examines the state-of-the-art prevention, detection, and mitigation technologies for these major mainstreams and coordinated cyberattacks. In particular, the advantages and disadvantages of popular cyberattack prevention sciences such as Game Theory, Optimization, Control Theory, and Data-driven method are discussed. It reveals that cyberattack detection techniques have evolved from traditional state estimation to artificial intelligence-based methods. Finally, the challenges and opportunities for future research on cybersecurity in CPPS are identified.

articleTitle: Service Restoration with Voltage Control for Resilient Distribution Systems Incorporating Soft Open Points
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High penetration distributed renewable energy makes it increasingly important to integrate voltage management into resilience enhancement research of distribution systems. To this end, this paper investigates distribution service restoration problem with real-time voltage control in distribution systems incorporating soft open points (SOPs). A resilient service restoration framework is proposed integrating dynamic reconfiguration, SOP scheduling and voltage control for distribution systems to against disasters and faults. Therein, a SOP-assisted service restoration model is first formulated profit from the load transferring and voltage support of SOPs. Then, a two-timescale voltage control is further embedded in above restoration model without affecting the load restored. Numerical simulations verify the effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Harmonic Instability analysis using state-space modeling in Grid-Connected Inverter System with long transmission cable
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The distributed parasitic capacitance along the long transmission cable (LTC) may cause harmonic instability issues in grid-connected inverter system, this paper proposes a harmonic instability analysis method using state-space modeling and participation analysis for investigating the mechanism of harmonic instability and its key influencing factors. Firstly, the vector matching method is proposed to equivalent the AC system with frequency-dependent LTC, and the high-frequency state space model of the grid-connected inverter system in dq-frame system is established considering inner and outer control loop, phase-locked loop and control delay etc.; Secondly, the key influencing factors contributing to the harmonic oscillation are identified by the participation factor analysis method, moreover, the root locus method is used to study how the delay time, inner loop controller parameters, cable length and grid impedance affect the harmonic instability of the system. Finally, Based on RT-LAB hardware-in-loop experiment platform, the experimental results can verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis in this paper.

articleTitle: Comprehensive analysis of equivalent models of supercapacitor: Towards optimization and better application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of energy storage technology, new types of electrical energy storage components have received extensive attention. Among them, supercapacitor has become a hot research direction of energy storage technology because of its advantages such as high-power density, fast charging and discharging, long cycle life and so on. This paper summarizes the current application status of supercapacitors, the structural characteristics and reaction principles of different types of supercapacitors, respectively analyzes the characteristics and applicable scenarios of series equivalent circuit model, transmission line model and multi branch circuit model. After that, this paper introduces several methods of parameter extraction. Based on the constant current discharge method, this article introduces several methods of parameter extraction that are more accurate and suitable for different circuit models, and finally introduces the practical application of model parameters of supercapacitors, respectively introduce the application of state of charge (SOC), state of health (SOH) and optimization of charging strategy.

articleTitle: Capacity Compensation Mechanism of Independent Energy Storage Devices Considering Investment Recovery
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As important flexible resources, independent energy storage devices can be employed to maintain the long-term abundant capacity of the renewable-dominated power system. However, the investment recovery of independent energy storage devices is almost impossible to achieve, which limits their development and application. Therefore, this paper focuses on the capacity compensation mechanism of independent energy storage devices to achieve investment recovery. Firstly, different compensation mechanisms worldwide are compared. Secondly, the costs and incomes of independent energy storage devices are analyzed detailedly. Finally, according to the situation in China, suggestions about the capacity compensation mechanisms for independent energy storage devices are proposed to support the achievement of investment recovery.

articleTitle: Reinforcement learning-based optimal power flow of distribution networks with high permeation of distributed PVs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Owing to the large-scale integration of distributed generation units, traditional distribution networks are gradually turning to active distribution networks, which poses impacts on the distribution networks, including voltage violations, the degradation of power losses and the failures of relay protections. Therefore, higher requirements on the distribution network in terms of planning, control, power quality management, operation and maintenance have been put forward. The traditional OPF algorithms have drawbacks on solving large-scale non-linear problems with dispersiveness and randomness. In order to achieve real-time control of the active distribution network under more complicated network structure conditions, an optimization algorithm based on reinforcement learning is presented and applied to the real-time control processes of active distribution networks. The objective is to minimize power losses, considering some crucial constraints such as network voltages, line load rate and distributed power output. Reinforcement learning, as an artificial intelligence method that does not depend on mathematical models, has great advantages in solving large-scale complex mathematical models. In addition, the control effectiveness and convergences of the method are improved through the expansion of the knowledge matrix, and the adoption of imitative learning, migration learning and risk assessment mechanisms. Based on the test of an improved IEEE 33-bus system under MATLAB R2017a, this paper verifies that the reinforcement learning method has a better effect on the real-time control of the active distribution network in terms of node voltages and network losses. Simultaneously, the method significantly relieves over-limits of voltages, effectively reduces network losses, and has proper real-time characteristics.

articleTitle: Self-Tuning Sinusoidal Power Supply For Atmospheric Pressure Air Surface Dielectric Barrier Discharge
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Atmosphere pressure surface dielectric barrier discharge (SDBD) has shown promise in biomedical , bactericidal and aerospace applications. Dedicated power supplies are needed to provide the high-voltage (H.V.) waveforms to operate these nonlinear and time-dependent loads. The average SDBD power must be stable for reliable and reproducible treatments. That means the delivered power of the power supply must be stable in a needed timescale. However, existing approaches do not consider the turbulence of the initial surface temperature (IST) of SDBD devices to the SDBD power, which is unavoidable when SDBD devices are in repeated use or under changing environmental temperatures. We experimentally measure the evolution of SDBD power as a function of time at IST of 20 °C, 40 °C, and 60°C in constant amplitude voltage and open loop modes. The results show that the SDBD power, discharge area, equivalent capacitance, applied voltage, and surface temperature are all affected by IST in both modes. The mathematical relation between the power supply's duty cycle and SDBD power shows that the system has nonlinear time-varying characteristics. The RBF-PI controller is applied to control the system's power, and the real-time control experiments confirm its effectiveness. This controller could limit the system's settling time to 12 s or less at the IST of 20°C and 60°C and is more stable than the PI control strategy in this system. This work has great significance in maintaining reproducible and reliable treatments of SDBD.

articleTitle: Short-Term Electrical Load Forecasting Based on Attention-GRU Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Short-term electrical load forecasting (STELF) is the basis of power systems' planning and scheduling. Accurate STELF results can provide effective decision support for economic dispatch and unit commitment. However, the temporal correlations between different time steps are usually ignored by most existing STELF models, which will affect the forecast accuracy. Under this background, a novel short-term electrical load forecasting method based on Attention-GRU networks is proposed to solve the issues. First, the basic data structure and principles for STELF are developed and clarified. Then, the quantification of temporal correlation based on the Attention mechanism and extraction of long-term temporal dependencies based on GRU are proposed. On this basis, two integration methods (parallel and serial integration) are proposed to account for the effects of temporal features and external factors on the electrical load. Finally, numerical simulations are implemented to verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed methods. Simulation results demonstrate that STELF models based on Attention-GRU can effectively account for temporal correlation and extract hidden features, resulting in higher forecast accuracy and better generalization performance.

articleTitle: Planning and Deployment Method of Electric Vehicle Charging Facilities in a Self-consistent Highway Transportation Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the implementation of the national dual carbon goal, the prospect of self-consistent highway transportation energy system is huge. Under the new situation, the planning and deployment of highway electric vehicle charging facilities face both opportunities and challenges. In order to realize the deep coupling and coordinated operation of charging facilities and self-consistent energy system, a planning and deployment method of electric vehicle charging facilities in a self-consistent highway transportation energy system based on The Flow Refueling Location Model (FRLM) was proposed. Firstly, based on the characteristics of users' charging behaviors, a queuing charging model was constructed. Secondly, extending on the basis of FRLM, adding the queue constraint from the perspective of social travel users and the fund constraint from the perspective of operation and management users., a new model for the location and capacity of highway charging stations was established with the optimization target of maximum comprehensive annual benefit. Thirdly., an algorithm was designed to determine the preliminary selection of the charging stations combination, and the immune algorithm was used to further solve the optimization. Finally, the proposed method was simulated and verified in a highway network. The effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method are verified by the case study.

articleTitle: EEG-based Emotion Recognition Using Multi-Dimensional Convolutional Neural LSTM via Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For emotion recognition, firstly, we transform the differential entropy and power spectral density features extracted from different channels of EEG signals into a spatial representation with a multi-dimensional structure. Secondly, a convolutional neural network (CNN) and a neural network with bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) are combined together to form a deep learning model. Among them, CNN extracts the effective frequency and spatial information in each time segment of the input EEG signal, and the Bi-LSTM strengthens the temporal dependence of the output information from CNN. Further, the attention enhancement mechanism is fused into the Bi-LSTM module to extract more discriminative spatial-temporal features. The proposed model is extensively trained and tested on DEAP dataset to verify its advantages in different aspects. The experimental findings show that the accuracy of emotion recognition is also enhanced to some degree.

articleTitle: Health assessment of circuit breaker considering external environment factor based on three-stage extreme gradient boosting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to achieve the on-line evaluation of circuit breaker operation state accurately and quickly, a three-stage health assessment approach based on extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) is proposed in this paper. The presented method assesses the health condition of circuit breaker using data from its electrical, mechanical, insulation, temperature and external environmental characteristics in three stages. The first stage is applied to resolve if there is any equipment abnormality during the circuit breaker operation. Then, if there is an abnormality detected, the second stage is utilized to settle the category of the abnormality based on the multi-dimensional characteristic data. The third stage evaluates the degree of abnormality of the circuit breaker quantitatively. In the three-stage of health assessment, XGBoost algorithm is adopted to establish the health assessment model, and the optimal parameters of XGBoost model are obtained using both grid search method and cross validation method. In addition, to address the disadvantage of unbalanced sample data categories, Gaussian noise method are employed to enrich the operational database. The simulation result of l0kV circuit breakers shows that evaluation accuracy of the model in the paper is 92.9%, which can accurately evaluate the operational state of circuit breaker and facilitate the maintenance and early warning of the equipment.

articleTitle: A Review of Circuit Models for GaN Power Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: GaN devices offer superior performance over Si devices, such as higher mobility, breakdown voltage, switching speed and per-width power density. In the future, GaN devices are expected to surpass Si devices in almost all performance indicators, thereby achieving high-speed and efficient power electronic systems (PES). The model of GaN device is a useful and necessary tool to analyze and evaluate its impact on circuit and system performance, which can help researchers design new PES. This paper reviews latest advances on the models of GaN power devices, and discusses the working principles of GaN, the classification and contributions of GaN model, for understanding the significance of these recent developments. In addition, this paper also considers the challenges and problems encountered in the modeling and application of GaN devices, such as self-heating effect, trap effect and short channel effect, providing guidance for future modeling. This review helps readers understand and use the GaN model to achieve more effective design of GaN-based converters.

articleTitle: Optimal operation of electric–heat–hydrogen integrated energy system considering conditional value-at-risk
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The proliferation of load types and the widespread adoption of photovoltaic (PV) pose challenges for power prediction on both sides of the power grid. To address the problem of inaccurate PV and load forecasting, which can lead to fluctuating dispatch cost of the electric-heat-hydrogen integrated energy system (EIES), this work introduces the concept of risk management, and then formulates a model for the optimal operation of EIES considering conditional value-at-risk (CVaR). The objective function of the model includes day-ahead dispatch cost, expected real-time dispatch cost, and cost of risk. The day-ahead stage of operation seeks to determine the electricity purchased from the power grid and planned PV power output, whereas the real-time stage optimizes the operation of equipment under scenarios with different actual PV and load values. Furthermore, energy balance constraints, equipment operation constraints, and CVaR constraints are elaborated. The case study indicates that the weighted average dispatch cost for 135 actual PV and load scenarios is increased by 0.86% whereas the standard deviation of the 135-scenario dispatch cost is reduced by 8.47%, demonstrating that the fluctuation reduction for the dispatch cost comes at the expense of the increase of dispatch cost. This work investigates the relationship between the dispatch cost and risk level/cost fluctuation level, thus could offer valuable information to the operators of EIES.

articleTitle: Summary and prospect of power supply reliability in low voltage distribution network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The policies, regulations and administrative measures take the medium-voltage power supply system as statistical evaluation object and have not fully extended to the low-voltage uses, to further refine the power supply reliability management work, this paper firstly introduces statistical analysis status of user power supply reliability in low voltage distribution network. Then, the five kinds of identification methods are compared and analyzed. Various data collection methods and reliability index statistics methods are presented and dissected. Finally, the key work for the next step is described.

articleTitle: Business model based on bidding strategy for the Wind Power Plant and District Heating System portfolio considering ancillary services
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a business model based on bidding strategy for the wind power plant and district heating system (WPP-DHS) portfolio considering ancillary service of frequency regulation. Taking advantage of the flexibility of DHS, the combined entity of WPP and DHS can provide both energy and ancillary service. Since short-term reserves are significant to provide the security of the power system, they have a significant price tag. Tapping into that potential by providing short-term reserves to the IEHS can be an excellent business case for the WPP-DHS portfolio, especially because the flexibility of the HPs in the district heating system can be utilized to provide frequency regulation. Case studies verify the efficiency of the proposed models and methods.

articleTitle: Optimization Method for Energy Storage System Planning Based on Dispatchable Potential of 5G Base Station and Cluster Partition of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of economy, massive and dispersed 5G base stations (BSs) and distributed photovoltaics (DPVs) will be widely integrated into the grid. Considering the backup energy storage equipped with 5G BSs is a flexible resource with considerable capacity and great potential, a model to evaluate and quantify BS dispatchable capacity, and a cluster partition method to bundle BSs with DPVs are established. Based on these, a bi-layer optimization model of energy storage system (ESS) planning is proposed, which can simultaneously obtain the optimal ESS capacity, power and location determination scheme and scheduling schemes of ESSs and 5G BSs. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed planning method reduces the ESS investment, increasing the system economy and low carbon benefits.

articleTitle: Study on the application path and key points of International Standardization Organization for China Electric Power
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to accelerate the pace of “going global” of technical standards in China's power industry and implement the strategy of “going global” of standards, this paper conduct in-depth research from two dimensions of organization application landing and key points of application, provide the Working Group (WG), Technical Committee (TC), Sub-technical Committee (SC) and other specific application paths, and integrate relevant international standards organizations, technical management paths of domestic and international standardization organizations into the application process of ISO/IEC, so as to effectively guide the application work of ISO/IEC. To improve the success rate of our application to the International Organization for Standardization.

articleTitle: Wide-Area Control Strategy Based on Reference Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new generalized predictive control algorithm based on the recursive least squares of the reference model is proposed to solve the problem that traditional generalized predictive control cannot obtain state (internal) variables in model parameter identification. By selecting the state (internal) variables of the reference model, the output of the reference model is approximated to these unmeasurable variables and the consistent estimation of system parameters is obtained, which reduces the interference of noise to the forward channel. Simulation results show that the wide-area damping controller designed by this method can improve the damping of the interconnected power grid and suppress the low-frequency oscillation in the time-delay system with noise.

articleTitle: Unfolding the Effects of Energy Storages on System Frequency Response: Equivalence Principle and Trajectory Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Energy storage (ES) has been recognized as a kind of indispensable resource to maintain the frequency security of the future power system. As the ES owners should be paid for their contribution to frequency regulation, it is desired to reveal quantitively the effects of different ES individuals during the frequency response. To settle this issue, we prove that the complete response of the system can be decomposed into the superposition of the frequency trajectories caused by the independent action of the power from different sources so that we can quantify the effect of each ES by convolving its active power with the impulse response of the system excluding ESs. The linear computational complexity and the demand for power measurements other than dynamics lead to the high compatibility and scalability of the established method. Simulations on the modified WSCC 9-bus system verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the Solution of Voltage Stability in Shenzhen during the Asynchronous Interconnection Construction of Guangdong
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the mechanism of voltage stability in Shenzhen after Guangdong back-to-back flexible DC project operated in order to keep the voltage stability in Shenzhen during the Asynchronous Interconnection construction of Guangdong and improve the stability of Shenzhen power grid under serious AC fault. After that, the paper puts forward the adaptive switching VDCOL strategy and applies it to Xindong and Xing'an HVDC projects. At last, the paper verifies its effectiveness through RTDS simulation. The main conclusions are as follows: (1) The voltage stability problem in Shenzhen may be caused by the insufficient dynamic reactive power support capacity of the power grid and the rapid increase of reactive power consumption demand of HVDC system after AC fault; (2) The adaptive switching VDCOL strategy can switch the optimization parameters in the case of serious AC fault on the inverter side, which has a great influence on the power recovery characteristics of Xindong HVDC stations, while its slow power recovery characteristics will not cause the frequency of Yunnan power grid to exceed the limit; (3) After Xindong and Xing 'an HVDC implement the adaptive switching VDCOL strategy, there is rare voltage stability problems in Shenzhen power grid due to serious AC faults, which fully proving the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Wind and photovoltaic power consumption method based on data-model dual-driven
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With continuous increases in the proportion of renewable power, the pressure to consume wind and photovoltaic (PV) power will be greater. To formulate the optimal consumption scheme for wind and PV power, the uncertainty of the source side and demand side should be addressed. The demand side has strong daily regularity. Therefore, an optimization method using a data-model dual-driven considering the uncertainty of the source side and demand side is proposed. First, a load forecast method based on the long short-term memory model is established. This is characterized by using the observed load data of the same historical time section to improve the forecast accuracy. Second, a scenario clustering method of wind and PV power output based on historical forecast deviation is proposed. This is characterized by considering the time-varying forecast accuracy of renewable power output. Third, a linear optimization model of multitype power generation dispatching is established, and the optimal renewable power consumption scheme can be obtained quickly. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is proved by a case study.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Deep Offshore Wind Power Based on Load Similarity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Deep offshore wind power has the characteristics of high wind energy density, high power generation utilization hours, no land occupation, close to the power load center for local consumption, and a broad market prospect. However, the investment cost in the early stage is large, the subsidy intensity is gradually reduced, and it lacks the full life cycle economic analysis combined with various market policies. Therefore, this paper first proposes a systematic cost calculation method based on the comparative balance method, combined with the benefits of the wind's participation in the green electricity market and carbon trading market, considering the operating costs of thermal power, demand side response, and energy storage, a simulation model to maximize the benefit of deep offshore breeze and share the system cost of deep offshore wind power based on load similarity. Finally, through the case analysis of a 300MW wind farm, the system cost of the proposed model can be reduced by 0.41%, and electricity prices accounted for 93.4% of the total income of deep offshore wind electricity as a major supporting role. The static investment payback period of the wind farm at the current price level is about 20.1 years, which provides an important reference for the investment and construction of the profound sea breeze electric field.

articleTitle: Review on Partial Discharge Detection and Localization Technologies in Substations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Partial discharge (PD) is the main cause of electrical insulation failure. PD detection and localization are of great significance to evaluate the insulation status and service life of electrical equipment in substations. First, this paper reviews the detection technologies and localization methods of PD, and summarizes the important research achievements in recent years. Then, the advantages and limitations of different detection technology and localization methods are discussed. Finally, the problems in practical application are summarized, and the future research and application directions are put forward, which provide reference for the theoretical research and practical application of PD detection and localization.

articleTitle: Adaptability Enhancement of LCL-Type Grid-Connected Inverter with Single-Loop Inverter-Side Current Feedback to Complex Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Grid-connected Voltage Source Inverters (VSI) equipped with LCL filters are attractive in utility applications for their better power quality features. The single-loop inverter-side current feedback (ICF) control is often used due to its low cost in practice. A stable single-loop ICF-controlled grid-connected system designed under ideal power grid (i.e., grid impedance is 0) can still maintain stability under inductive power grid (i.e., grid impedance only contains inductance), but may be unstable under complex power grid (i.e., grid impedance contains inductance and capacitance simultaneously) when frequency responses of inverter output admittance and equivalent grid admittance intersect at non-passive frequency region of inverter output admittance. Literatures have revealed that non-passive region of inverter output admittance occurs above critical frequency f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cri</inf> due to digital control delay, and that f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cri</inf> is fs/6 considering typical delay of 1.5 times Ts. Various phase compensators proposed in literatures can help to improve f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cri</inf> for enhancing the adaptability of single-loop ICF-controlled grid-connected inverter to complex power grid by inserting them in series or parallel with current regulator. In this paper, a biquadratic compensator is inserted in series with current regulator and parameter design of biquadratic compensator is presented. The f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cri</inf> is improved to 0.407fs with the biquadratic compensator designed in this paper, which is higher than f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cri</inf> in literatures.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Control Strategy for Low Voltage Ride Through of Grid-connected VSCs Based on Fast Amplitude Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The grid code requires grid-connected voltage source converters (VSCs) to achieve low voltage ride through (LVRT) during grid faults. However, the existing LVRT strategy lacks the multi-objective optimization ability of simultaneous negative sequence current elimination and power fluctuation suppression, which limits the LVRT operation capability of VSC. Aiming at this problem, a multi-objective control strategy based on a fast amplitude estimation (FAE) method is proposed in this paper. The strategy detects the fault type and fault depth in real-time through the first-order differential operation of voltage and flexibly selects the weight coefficient corresponding to the optimization target according to different types of grid faults, which improves the LVRT control performance of VSC and meets the diversified LVRT requirements. Finally, simulation and experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Power Loss Assessment of Three-Level Neutral-Point-Clamped Inverter With DPWM Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The three-level neutral-point-clamped (3L NPC) inverter is widely employed for the renewable energy application. To achieve lower life cycle cost, the efficiency of 3L NPC inverter is highlighted. Compared to the continuous PWM (CPWM) modulation, the discontinuous PWM (DPWM) modulation is preferred to reduce switching and conduction losses. Nevertheless, the power loss assessment of the DPWM modulation is a remaining challenge for the 3L NPC inverter. In this paper, the general mathematical model of the DPWM modulations is created to quantify the power loss of the 3L NPC inverter. The duty cycles of the power device are modeled for the unipolar and bipolar CPWM modulations, even for the DPWM modulations of the 3L NPC inverter. Moreover, the switching and conduction losses of the 3L NPC inverter are analyzed, considering different CPWM and DPWM modulations. The experimental test rig and switching trajectory are presented to observe the specific loss of the commercial 3L NPC power module. Besides, comprehensive comparisons of the power loss dependent on PWM modulation are demonstrated for the 3L NPC inverter. It is found that the theoretical predictions of the proposed model are consistent with the simulated results of the PLCES tool. Due to the optimal power loss, the DPWM1 is recommended for the 3L NPC inverter application. The methodologies and findings in this paper are also helpful for the 3L T-type NPC (TNPC) and active NPC (ANPC) inverter application.

articleTitle: TSA based optimization to dc voltage and dc modulation for high-voltage ride-through (HVRT) of DFIG: School of Electrical Engineering and Automation, Hefei University of Technology, Hefei 230009, China
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: During the recovery process after the short fault at the grid side, the doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) may suffer from overvoltage of the dc-link and over-modulation of the grid-side converter (GSC). Increasing the dc voltage reference improves the modulation of the GSC, but increases the dc overvoltage. A larger dc capacitor suppresses the dc voltage, but deteriorates the dc modulation. The PI parameters of the DFIG may also be adjusted to suppress the dc overvoltage and improve the modulation. Coordinating the dc voltage reference, the dc capacitance, and/or the PI parameters may improve the high-voltage ride-through (HVRT) capability of the DFIG, which has not been studied yet. In this paper, the analytical expression of the trajectory sensitivities of the dc voltage with respect to above parameters is newly proposed, based on which an index of the dc voltage is newly defined to select the critical parameters. Change of dc voltage reference after the grid voltage recovery is included to damp the 2nd dc overvoltage, which adds the difficulty of solving the trajectory sensitivity. The objective function combining the areas about the dc overvoltage and over-modulation is newly proposed to optimize these parameters for the HVRT of the DFIG. The proposed model is solved with the interior point method. Numerical simulation validates the accuracy of the trajectory sensitivity. The proposed index selects the critical PI parameters which reduces the optimization time, and keeping desirable control effect. Coordination of dc capacitance and dc voltage reference is effective to suppress the dc overvoltage and improve dc modulation. Further including the PI parameters helps to damp the oscillation and reduce the recovery time of the dc voltage.

articleTitle: Amplitude/Phase Estimation Decoupling and Damping Improvment of Discrete-Time Three-phase Multi-Resonant Frequency-Locked-Loop
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Frequency-locked loops (FLLs) are widely used for the synchronization of the renewable energy generations (REGs). Despite the design concept, they can be broken down into a pre-filter and a frequency adaptive controller (FAC). The structure of the pre-filter determines the amplitude/phase estimation decoupling (APED) ability and the degree of freedom to adjust the damping property of the whole FLL system. This paper provides a new framework for pre-filter design to achieve a discrete-time multi-resonant FLL with the APED ability as well as a fast and well-damped dynamic response, which cannot be achieved simultaneously by the existing design. The proposed FLL can also operate stably under long-sampling-period condition, because the discrete-time design makes the resonant frequency realized accurately.

articleTitle: Multi-timescale optimal operation strategy of electric-hydrogen hybrid energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The renewable generation station is moving from traditional fossil fuels towards clean renewable energy. The demand for intra-day and seasonal peak shaving of the renewable energy system has become an urgent challenge. This paper proposes a new framework of energy storage systems that electric-hydrogen hybrid energy storage system (EH-HESS) to satisfy the needs of multiple scenarios, which improve grid stability and renewable energy utilization. In addition, an operation strategy considers the interaction between energy storage to improve the utilization of storage. To validate the approach, numerical tests were conducted, with the results showing that by proper the new energy storage structure and operation strategy resulting improve the utilization of energy storage by 63% and reduce the operating cost of the station by 52.2%.

articleTitle: Research on the framework and linking system of tradable green value warrant market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Currently, the domestic power market and carbon market are becoming increasingly diversified in terms of tradable varieties, and innovative mechanisms such as quota systems, green power trading, green warrant trading, carbon trading, and energy use rights trading are developing rapidly. This paper firstly compares the background, characteristics, principles, and market scale of various warrants. Then it discusses the green power trading mechanism in the power market, which proposes to adapt the mutual convergence mechanism among warrants and carry out the design of the green value capital management system to implement the effective convergence and mutual conversion among warrants, avoid the repeated measurement of green tenure, and support the practical unification of the electricity and carbon markets at the application side.

articleTitle: Technology Architecture and Key Technologies of Discrete Manufacturing Digital Workshop
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Digital workshop technology is the representative application of digitization, automation and IoT technology in the Manufacturing workshop. It integrates the information of flexible manufacturing technology, process design system, intelligent identification technology, production organization system and other management systems, constitute an integrated manufacturing system with integrated information flow and automation. Digital workshop is the core component of modern industry and the organic integration of information technology and intelligent manufacturing technology. This paper analyzed the characteristics of discrete manufacturing, and technology architecture of digital workshop, and information flow and data interaction of digital workshop are defined. The research provides a guidance and basis for the planning and construction of digital workshop for discrete manufacturing enterprises in China.

articleTitle: Integrated energy micro-grid capacity optimization allocation method considering electricity-thermal-gas coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to meet the economic index under the reliability of power supply, the capacity of each unit in the integrated energy micro-grid, the number of units, the equipment selection and the equipment operation mode need to be planned reasonably. Based on the conditions of integrated energy micro-grid, this paper focuses on the power supply and heat supply of gas boilers, electric boilers, storage batteries and combined heat and power units, and optimizes the equipment selection and capacity allocation problems in the micro-grid by considering various constraints in the integrated energy micro-grid as the objective function and adopting the mixed integer linear programming method. Finally, taking an integrated energy micro-grid in a region of northeast China as an example, the configuration results under different scenarios are given to verify the effectiveness and correctness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of PMLSM Based on Interval Analysis-Gravity Neighborhood Center Algorithm Considering Manufacturing Tolerances
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the process of optimization design for permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (PMLSM), the influences of manufacturing tolerances are generally ignored, which may lead to a variation of the optimal parameters. This will result in a large fluctuation for the reliability of PMLSM. To overcome the problem, this study presents a robust optimization model that considering the manufacturing tolerances and optimize the PMLSM by an interval analysis-gravity neighborhood center algorithm based on the robust optimization model. First., an analytical model is established based on equivalent magnetizing current method. Second, the robust optimization model, which manages the manufacturing tolerances of variable structure parameters as input factors and the thrust ripple as output factors, is established based on the analytical model. Third, interval analysis, which obtains the valid domain boxes that satisfy the thrust ripple requirements, is applied to ensure the reliability of optimization results. Furthermore, the gravity neighborhood center (GNC) algorithm, which is used for global search in solution space, is introduced to optimize the robust optimization model in the valid domain boxes, and the optimal parameters that have low thrust ripple and thrust ripple fluctuation within manufacturing tolerances ranges are obtained. Finally, finite element analysis confirm the robustness and validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Power Transformer Health State Prediction Based on Multi-attention Coupling Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Transformer is the key apparatus of the power system, and its operational reliability is directly related to the stability of the power grid. Accurately predicting the future health state of transformers can reserve enough time for formulating outage maintenance and power dispatching plans. The existing transformer health state prediction methods are based on the structure of “predict-diagnose”, which is the superposition of two local optimal methods, with error superposition. To fill this gap, a transformer health state prediction method based on multi-attention coupling learning is proposed in this paper. The “situational quantity” integrating the transformer operation state change relationship, the correlation relationship between state quantities, the mapping relationship between the state quantity and the state, the fuzzy relationship between the evaluation result and the actual state, and the traditional expert experience is proposed.
