Then, the structural optimization attention (SOA) model applicable to “situational quantity” is proposed, and various relationships are treated as individual attention. All kinds of attention are coupled and constrained in the SOA to realize the unification of the prediction process and diagnosis process, obtain the global optimization of prediction and diagnosis, and the problem of error superposition is solved. The actual fault case verification results show that the accuracy of the proposed SOA prediction model can reach 96.33%, which is significantly better than the traditional methods.

articleTitle: Fabrication of Graphite/Graphene Composite Coatings by Atmospheric Pressure Plasma Spraying
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Atmospheric pressure plasma spraying (APPS) for graphene/graphene composite coatings holds great potential for metal-based composite coatings, wear-resistant coatings, absorbing coatings, self-lubricating coatings, and more. In this review, recent progress in APPS technology is presented and key scientific and technological issues are discussed. The scope of our discussion includes the quality of prepared coating, coating porosity, the impact of equipment long-term service on coating performance, as well as graphene oxide coating material. Finally, a comprehensive analysis of the future development directions of APPS graphene/graphene composite technology is provided, to guide the multidisciplinary integration and utilization of plasma surface strengthening technology.

articleTitle: Research on mechanism and characteristics of harmonic resonance problem of independent energy storage grid-connected system based on time domain simulation method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Energy storage equipment is useful for stabilizing the fluctuation of new energy power, and is of great significance to help the development of new energy. Energy storage has been developed on a large scale. In recent years, when new energy equipment based on power electronic converters such as wind power, photovoltaic, and flexible direct is connected to the system, harmonic resonance is caused and brought harm to the system. As energy storage is also a grid-connected device based on power electronic converters. Therefore, it is necessary to pay attention to the harmonic characteristics of the energy storage power station after it is connected to the system. This paper studies the harmonic resonance problem of an actual independent energy storage grid-connected system. Firstly, the harmonic resonance simulation calculation model of the actual energy storage system is established in PSCAD/EMTDC. On this basis, the effects of energy storage charge and discharge, the changes of output, the changes of access system and the changes of system strength are analyzed. The research results have certain guiding significance for the design and grid-connected operation of energy storage power stations.

articleTitle: Summary of research on synchronous generator excitation system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the background of “double carbon” strategy including large-scale grid-connection of renewable energy and the power grid interconnection, new situations have put forward increasingly stringent requirements for the safety and stability of power systems in recent years. In this case, the excitation system plays an increasingly important role in the power system. The article summarizes the basic principle of the excitation system, discusses the current status and development tendency of excitation system from excitation mode and core parts of excitation system such as de-excitation device, rectifier device, excitation regulator. The article also discusses the basic theory and development direction of the excitation control strategy from the aspects of AVR and PSS.

articleTitle: Voltage control strategy of low voltage distribution network based on cloud edge - end collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a voltage control strategy of low-voltage distribution network is designed based on cloud edge and end collaboration based on the development trend of a large number of distributed PV connected to low-voltage distribution network. Firstly, the hierarchical control of voltage regulating equipment in distribution network is proposed, and the hierarchical control communication configuration and control architecture are designed. Secondly, based on the local control and voltage regulation of photovoltaic inverter, the sagging voltage regulation strategy is proposed, and the residual capacity of photovoltaic is used to output reactive power for voltage regulation. Finally, based on the centralized control and voltage regulation of the capacitor banks in the distribution network, a reconfiguration strategy with capacitors based on genetic algorithm is proposed. Hierarchical regulation is carried out for voltage regulating equipment in distribution network through cloud edge cooperation, and the voltage is kept stable within the normal range through mutual contact between intelligent voltage regulating equipment.

articleTitle: Real-time Optimal Energy Management of Combined Cooling, Heating and Power systems Based on Knowledge conlusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Combined Cooling, Heating and Power(CCHP) system is an important way to improve the efficiency of energy utilization and wind power consumption. In this case, increasing the operational flexibility of CCHP systems can help increase renewable energy consumption and reduce carbon emissions. So, it is necessary to provide real-time optimal energy management(OEM) for CCHP systems. In this paper. Firstly, a new training method is proposed for the LightGBM to improve the accuracy of real-time wind power prediction. In addition, to solve the nonlinear OEM of CCHP in real-time, a novel deep reinforcement learning algorithm-Soft Actor-Critic, is used in this paper. By combining the mechanism of CCHP with the reward function through knowledge fusion, the non-convex models can be translated into Markov Decision Processes(MDP), and then according to the Bellman optimal equation, the real-time optimized operation of the CCHP system is realized. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed policy is verified by the actual operation data of a CCHP system in Northwest China.

articleTitle: Comparison of the influence of traditional and advanced PLL on the stability of grid-connected inverter system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As a key link of the grid-connected inverter system to realize the synchronization of the current and the grid voltage, the phase-locked loop (PLL) can generate the current reference according to the phase of the grid voltage. SRF-PLL is often used as the research object in the field of power system research. But in the actual power system, advanced PLL structure has been widely used to improve the filtering ability and cope with grid disturbances and faults. Taking the grid-connected inverter system with frequency adaptive DSOGI-PLL as an example, this paper establishes the small-signal model of the system to compare it with the system which uses traditional SRF-PLL, and analyzes the stability of the system according to the impedance stability criterion. By analyzing the criterion, under the given parameter conditions, the grid-connected inverter system using SRF-PLL can maintain stability, while the system using frequency adaptive DSOGI-PLL has unstable oscillation mode, which indicates that the conclusion obtained by traditional SRF-PLL cannot be directly applied to the actual system using advanced PLL. Finally, the correctness of the theoretical analysis is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Frequency Modulation Strategy Based on Hierarchical Coordinated Control of Wind Power, Thermal Power and Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increase of wind power penetration, the active power balance and frequency stability of power grid are impacted. As an auxiliary measure of wind power and traditional power frequency modulation (FM), energy storage device can effectively suppress the frequency deviation and power fluctuation of the system, improve the stability of wind power integration, and realize the full accommodation by virtue of its quick and accurate power response function. Based on the double-layer control structure, this paper proposes a joint FM strategy of wind power-thermal power-battery energy storage. Additionally, to avoid frequent charging and discharging and reduce the life loss of energy storage, this paper introduces variable energy storage compensation in the upper control to improve the comprehensive efficiency of battery energy storage system (BESS). Then, the model predictive control (MPC) is introduced into the lower control to realize the rolling optimization of the active power of wind turbines. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified by simulation analysis of a typical grid-connected system.

articleTitle: Advanced Method of Pure Solder Layer Thermal Resistance Measurement in Power Cycling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Solder layer degradation is one of the typical failure modes of power electronics after power cycling and assessed by measuring the junction-to-case thermal resistance, with a 20% increase criterion. The degree of solder layer degradation at a 20% increase in thermal resistance varies considerably between devices in the power cycling., as the thermal resistance of devices themselves are different. An advanced method for accurately extracting the thermal resistance of pure solder layer based on the theory of thermal physics is proposed in this paper., which provides a more accurate representation of the solder layers degradation than traditional junction-to-case thermal resistance measurement. Firstly., this paper establishes the theoretical basis for the accurate extraction of solder layer thermal resistance in conjunction., and analyses the theoretical values of the monitoring windows selected in the proposed method. Then., Infineon's EasyPACK module (FS25R12W1T4) is selected to verify the feasibility of the method through power cycling tests. Finally., the effectiveness of this advanced method is well verified., even for different voltage classes.

articleTitle: A Distributed Secondary Cooperative Restoration Control Strategy for Islanded Interconnected AC Microgrids via Back-to-Back Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this article, an important interconnection mode of interconnected microgrids, called power electronic interconnection devices, also known as back-to-back converters, is presented to improve the whole system's power flow adjustment and fault recovery abilities. However, in this scenario, an inherent voltage magnitude or frequency deviation and mismatch among all the microgrid units are inevitable. In the proposed method of this article, the active power and reactive power are exchanged via an interlinking back-to-back converter (BTBC) and following the voltage, frequency, and active power sharing rates differences of individual MGs. At the primary control level, the frequency mismatch problem of individual microgrid units can be resolved without communication. The voltage/frequency restoration and active power sharing among all the microgrid units can be further achieved at the secondary control level in a distributed control manner. The effectiveness of the control methodology is verified by the simulation of an interconnected microgrid system in MATLAB/SimPowerSystems.

articleTitle: Double DQN-based Power System Transient Stability Emergency Control with Protection Coordinations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of modern power grid, the goal of achieving higher efficiency and profit, the power systems are operated near the stability and security boundaries more often than before. Under this background, the better emergency control methods need to be deployed to better protect the system. In this work, a deep reinforcement learning based power system transient stability emergency control method is proposed. The proposed method adopts the double deep Q network structure to prevent the over estimation of potential rewards to make the emergency control strategy more reliable. In order to further improve the performance, the protection system action information is used and coordinated with the emergency control action. In addition, to solve the curse of dimensionality issue for large systems, the curriculum learning framework is used to train the deep reinforcement learning algorithm. The proposed transient stability method is tested with a two area four machine system, and a benchmark IEEE 16 machine 68 bus systems.

articleTitle: Elastic clearing model of electricity spot market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The output of new energy has great uncertainty. With the development trend of new energy gradually participating in the spot power market, the safe dispatching space of power system under the traditional power market mechanism is gradually compressed, mainly due to the rigid declaration and system constraints of market members. At the same time, the traditional unit commitment scheme mainly relies on the power grid operators to designate unit startup and shutdown and undertake deep peak shaving and other auxiliary services. This mechanism is prone to the problem of scheduling fairness. For this reason, this paper first establishes the electricity spot market clearing model considering the constraints of price elasticity and system elasticity. Under this mechanism, market members, in addition to reporting conventional quotations and physical constraints to trading institutions, report to trading institutions the scope of relaxation of their constraints and their compensation quotations according to their own actual operation, fully tap the potential of unit constraint elasticity by using incentive mechanisms, and ensure the fairness and justice of dispatching by actively participating in the way of market members, so as to improve the safety and economy of power grid operation. Then it designs the spot market settlement mechanism with the participation of new energy; Study the way, object and proportion of unbalanced cost allocation, and realize reasonable rewards and punishments for market members' deviant behaviors. Finally, it is demonstrated that this mechanism can effectively stimulate the ability of market members to declare and relax constraints, and find a better unit combination scheme than the traditional mechanism in a wider feasible range, which will be conducive to promoting the consumption of new energy and improving the overall social welfare.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling and Identification of Arc Grounding Fault in Resonant Grounding System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When an arc grounding fault occurs in the medium voltage distribution network, the dynamic compensation of Petersen Coil will weaken the fault signal, making the fault transient characteristics weak and difficult to identify. This paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on convolutional neural network-long short term memory network (CNN-LSTM). The arc mathematical modeling method based on genetic algorithm can accurately simulate the arc model that fits different fault scenarios. The time-frequency spectrum fuses the compensation quantity of Petersen Coil and the transient characteristic quantity. The simulation is able to construct different fault scenario data sets, and the hybrid network then extracts arc grounding fault features to achieve reliable identification of different faults.<sup>1</sup>

articleTitle: Capacity optimization for shared energy storage among renewable generation stations to provide peaking and frequency regulation service
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy, it is critical to ensure that energy storage have the capability to perform peaking and frequency regulation service. The traditional energy storage operation mode may become impracticable due to conflicting interests, insufficient utilization, and poor interoperability. Riding on the wave of the proliferation of sharing economy, storage energy sharing expands application scenario of energy storage without requiring costly and time-consuming infrastructure investments. This paper proposes a framework for using a shared energy storage (SES) to undertake the primary frequency response (PFR) for multiple renewable generation stations and provide peaking and commercial automatic generation control (AGC) service simultaneously. Furthermore, a two-stage capacity optimization base on robust theory is proposed to minimize the investment cost of SES, considering peaking and frequency regulation performance, battery degradation cost and the state of charge (SOC) limits. The goal is to maximize social welfare and ensure the benefits of SES. The numerical simulation is carried out based on the data from northwest China to validate the result.

articleTitle: Promotion of Nitrate Concentration in Plasma Activated Water by Introducing Ultrasonic Treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As one of the applications of non-thermal plasma, plasma activated water (PAW) has compensated for the restriction of plasma in practical application. However, the restricted yield of PAW also limits its application. In this work, a novel method that the ultrasonic treatment was introduced into the preparations of PAW was reported to assist promoting the concentrations of reactive particles in PAW. Nitrate was chosen as the research target of reactive particles in this work, and ultrasound of 28 kHz and 46 W was introduced into pin-to-plate PAW reactor driven by self-made pulsed plasma source. In addition, the concentrations of nitrite, the values of electrical conductivity, and the characteristics of electrical process were compared. The result showed that ultrasonic treatment could significantly promote the concentrations of NO<inf>3</inf>- within a relatively short period of PAW preparations (p < 0.1), and the increase could reach 28.5 %, specifically. The application of ultrasound in PAW preparations within a short period of treatment to promote the concentrations of reactive particles has a certain practical value.

articleTitle: Voltage sag source identification method based on extreme learning machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A method of feature extraction and identification of voltage sag sources based on extreme learning machine is proposed. Improved S-transform is used to extract the time-domain and time-frequency-domain features of voltage sag waveform, 16 feature indicators is designed, and the identification indicator system of voltage sag source is constructed. Improved maximum correlation and minimum redundancy method is used to screen the features of the identification indicator system, and the input of the refined identification model is realized by using the calculation results of the operator of information difference and the operator of information entropy. Vertical and horizontal crossing algorithm is used to optimize extreme learning machine and realize the accurate identification of the voltage sag source. Finally, taking the simulation data as an example, the influence of different feature on identification accuracy results is analyzed, and the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed identification method is verified, which can quickly realize the accurate identification of voltage sag sources.

articleTitle: Superposition Effect of Overvoltage for Vacuum Circuit Breakers Simultaneously Switching Shunt Reactor Banks in Offshore Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The overvoltage caused by vacuum circuit breakers (VCBs) switching shunt reactors (SRs) simultaneously in offshore wind farm (OWF) would be superimposed. The interaction mechanism between the switched SR banks is analyzed. Three modes are presented, including reignition & reignition, reignition & preignition as well as preignition & preignition. The influence of some factors on superimposed overvoltage is discussed, such as switching time difference, cable length and feeder number of wind turbine generator (WTG), VCB installation position, etc. Finally, a switching strategy of VCB is proposed to prevent the superposition effect of overvoltage. The results indicate that the superposition of reignition & reignition is the most serious mode. The superposition of preignition & preignition would not lead to overvoltage. The superposition effect of reignition overvoltage can be eliminated by the proposed switching strategy. It combined with the surge arrector can limit the overvoltage peak at a low level.

articleTitle: Research on the model and path of regional carbon peaking at provincial and municipal levels under the dual carbon target
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Facing increasingly serious global environmental problems, China has proposed a dual carbon target of “2030 carbon peak and 2060 carbon neutralization”. Achieving effective prediction of regional carbon emissions is the foundation for China to accomplish its dual carbon goal. This paper started from the study of regional carbon peaking models at provincial and municipal levels, and studied the current situation of regional carbon peaking based on the improved STIRPAT model. We analyzed the indicators and factors that affect the regional carbon peak and derived the influence of different factors on carbon emissions under different sectors. Taking Hubei province as an example, a combination of top-down and bottom-up approaches are used to model and analyze the overall carbon emissions and the carbon emissions of each sector in Hubei province. The analysis of model prediction results will identify areas and sectors with high emissions and a high potential for carbon reduction. The model can deepen the low carbonization reform of both the sector and system and provide credible methods for carrying out research work on the implementation path of dual carbon targets.

articleTitle: Identification method of voltage sag source based on PSO algorithm with correlation analysis of multiple measures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An identification method for voltage sag source based on PSO algorithm with correlation analysis of multiple measures is proposed. Comprehensive methods of grey correlation analysis and dynamic time wrapping is respectively used to calculate the distance measure and trend measure between different voltage sag waveforms, and the average coefficient method is used to construct its comprehensive measure and collaborative parameters. In order to effectively balance the cooperative parameters of distance measure and trend measure, PSO optimization algorithm is introduced to solve the optimal solution, so as to obtain the comprehensive measure between the waveforms of different voltage sag sources and realize the accurate identification of voltage sag sources. Through simulation data and case analysis, it is found that the proposed identification method does not depend on data sequence processing, and has high identification accuracy and practicability.

articleTitle: Prediction and classification of voltage sag trend based on support vector machine with parameter optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper uses support vector machine with parameter optimization to predict the variation trend of voltage sag waveform, intensively extracts its features, and proposes a source identification method for voltage sag. Firstly, the time-domain and time-frequency-domain characteristics of voltage sag waveform is extracted by S-transform, and the initial indicators is formed. The correlation between different initial indicators is analyzed by Pearson correlation coefficient method. Random forest optimization algorithm is used to select the features of the initial indicators, and the subjective and objective weight coefficients is introduced to optimize the calculation results of the importance of the initial indicators, so as to solve the problem of the decline of identification accuracy caused by the wrong selection of features. The identification model of voltage sag source is improved by using support vector machine, and the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is introduced to determine the key parameters and of the identification model, so as to improve the accuracy of the identification model. The simulation results of an example show that the proposed method may effectively reduce the initial indicator system, and provide an effective idea for further improving the accuracy of source identification of voltage sag.

articleTitle: Catastrophe Risk Assessment for Power Distribution Systems under Urban Waterlogging Disasters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Frequent urban rainstorm and waterlogging disasters have seriously affected power distribution systems, and reasonable catastrophe risk assessment is the basis for disaster prevention and mitigation. A comprehensive assessment method based on scenario simulation is proposed in this paper, where the power restoration process considering urban road inundation is involved. Case studies are performed to illustrate the validity of the proposed method, and numerical results show that urban waterlogging causes road disruptions, resulting in the inability of emergency repair, seriously affecting the power restoration of distribution systems.

articleTitle: A capacitor commutated hybrid DC circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: DC circuit breaker is the core equipment for cutting out the short circuit fault of DC system. In this paper, a capacitor commutated hybrid DC circuit breaker is proposed that combines the commutation branch with the self-charging branch, reducing the number of branches while ensuring the performance of the circuit breaker. The circuit breaker takes advantage of the symmetry of the commutation branch to break fault currents in both directions, while having the reclosing function. Through the theoretical analysis of the topology structure, the working principle and mathematical model of the circuit breaker at different stages during breaking process are studied, the parameter of key components are designed. Also, a system simulation model is built using simulation software, and the breaking performance of the circuit breaker is verified. Finally, the performance and economy of the circuit breaker are compared with other topology schemes. The results show that the circuit breaker not only has a similar performance, but also can greatly reduce the cost of the equipment, with good economic and application prospects.

articleTitle: Identification method for complex voltage sag source using fuzzy grey relational analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A new method of voltage sag source identification based on improved grey correlation analysis is proposed. For the identification interval differentiation of RMS sequences of different voltage sag types, phase space reconstruction method is used to segment the voltage sag sequence rationally, and the starting point and duration of the identification interval is determined by using different voltage sag sequences; Secondly, from the two aspects of the distance difference and change trend of different voltage sag waveforms, the improved grey correlation analysis method is used to calculate the distance membership and trend membership of the sequence to be identified and the typical standard sequence of the voltage sag library, and the average coefficient method is used to combine the distance and trend sequence to build a comprehensive membership, so as to be used for accurate identification of the voltage sag sequence to be identified; Finally, the identification accuracy and robustness of the proposed method is verified by setting a variety of scenarios, which has practical engineering application value.

articleTitle: Preventive-emergency two-stage stochastic optimal dispatching of dense transmission channels based on lightning warning information
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to reduce the impact of dense transmission channel outages due to lightning strikes on the operational safety of the power system, this paper proposes a framework of active defense dispatching strategy for dense transmission channel based on lightning warning information. We first establish a comprehensive evaluation model of transmission line unexpected outages based on analytic hierarchy process, then rank the importance degree of the line according to the comprehensive impact index, and fuse it with lightning warning information to provide an essential basis for predicting the set of scenarios. Second, a preventive-emergency two-stage stochastic optimal dispatch model is established to carry out power flow transfer in the preventive dispatch stage and take load shedding to reduce outage losses in the emergency dispatch stage. Finally, a case study verifies that the proposed method is effective in reducing the total system losses in case of dense transmission channel outages due to lightning strikes.<sup>1</sup><sup>1</sup>Supported by Science and technology program of SGCC (State Grid Corporation of China): Research on intelligent monitoring and protection capability improvement technology of UHV dense channel to cope with extreme environmental conditions (524625210017).

articleTitle: Typical Capacity Remuneration Mechanisms and Enlightenment for an Imperfect Competition Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The capacity remuneration mechanism is an important part of the electricity market and a necessary complement to the spot market. An efficient design of a capacity remuneration mechanism is the key to ensuring a reliable power supply and stable revenue for power generators. Therefore, the current mainstream capacity remuneration mechanisms are first compared in this paper. Then, the benefits of the mechanism and its adaptability in China are analyzed. Finally, combined with the demand for developing the capacity market in China, suggestions are proposed for designing a capacity remuneration mechanism by stages, clarifying capacity cost allocation, improving assessment and penalty rules, and connecting capacity compensation with other markets, etc., to build capacity remuneration mechanism in China's electricity market.

articleTitle: Resistance Analysis and Structural Optimisation of The Flue System of A 150 t/h CFB Boiler
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to meet the pollutant emission standard of the power plant, the desulfurization system of # 5 and # 6 boilers in a power plant has been revamped, but after the revamping, the problem of insufficient output of induced draft fan in # 5 boiler has resulted in the boiler being loaded. Based on the flue system of two 150 t/h circulating fluidized bed boilers after transformation, the flue resistance characteristics are calculated and analyzed during single operation and joint operation, so as to optimize the structure of the boiler flue with large local resistance loss, and the flue before and after optimization is numerically simulated with Fluent software. Finally, the effectiveness of the flue optimization scheme is verified through thermal test. After optimization, the flue resistance of # 5 boiler is reduced by 568.93 Pa, the flue resistance of # 6 boiler is reduced by 635.76 Pa, the total pressure of the fan is not less than the total pressure drop of its flue, which can meet the output, and the boiler can operate stably at full load.

articleTitle: Capacity optimization allocation of electrothermal hydrogen integrated energy system considering start-stop characteristics of multiple electrolyzers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The existing model of electrolyzer hydrogen production ignores the start-stop control and excess heat utilization of multiple electrolyzers in the system, which leads to low efficiency of electrolyzer hydrogen production and high start-stop cost in the actual process, and the capacity allocation of the whole electric-heat-hydrogen integrated energy system (EHIES) cannot be optimized. Therefore, this paper puts forward a three-stage start-stop control strategy to improve the efficiency of hydrogen production and reduce the actual cost. Meanwhile, this paper calculates the excess heat generated during hydrogen production by combining the start-stop status of the electrolyzer and makes comprehensive use of it, and establishes an optimal capacity allocation model for the EHIES considering the start-stop characteristics of multiple electrolyzers with the objective of minimizing the cost of each type of system on a typical day. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the simulation of arithmetic cases, which is compared with the traditional IES optimization allocation model.

articleTitle: Case Report: Early Moisture and Heat Defect Condition Sensing and Risk Management for 500 kV MOA based on Total Life Cycle Management
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A “medical case” of MOA local heating defect in production practice is described in detail: through detailed data, maps and photos, the condition based maintenance theory based on equipment life cycle management is combined with engineering practice, and analyzed and studied from five links: condition perception, diagnosis and evaluation, strategy formulation, power outage maintenance and measure feedback. It can provide experience reference for MOA technical supervision of substation operation and maintenance management personnel and technical technicians, and improve MOA fault detection rate. It can also provide fresh expression samples of equipment state laws for scientific researchers such as MOA fault intelligent diagnosis, state evaluation method of multi information fusion big data analysis, machine deep learning algorithm or digital twin technology, which is conducive to the deep integration of expert experience and knowledge in the process of equipment design, manufacturing and operation and maintenance with digital twins.

articleTitle: Dynamic economic dispatch based on improve firefly optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In power systems, dynamic economic dispatch (DED) is one of the most significant non-linear problems showing nonconvex characteristic because of the valve-point effects. This paper firstly introduces the research status in this field. In then, an improve firefly algorithm (IFA) is proposed to solve the DED problem where the valve-point effects, ramp-rate limits and transmission power losses are considered. A mutation mechanism is introduced into the algorithm to improve the global search ability of the algorithm; A mechanism for dynamically adjusting the parameters according to the optimization process is designed, so the fireflies can search the space smartly for global optimum solution. Also, uses a dynamic tolerance mechanism to deal with equation constraints. The efficiency and feasibility of the proposed method is validated on three test systems.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Price Linkage Risk between Power and Natural Gas Markets Based on Volatility Spillover Effects
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the deepening of the worldwide energy transformation, gas-fired power generation plays a more important role in the power system. The behavior of market entities will strengthen the connection between power and gas markets, and affect the transmission of price information. In this paper, a method to evaluate the risk of linkage relationship between power price and gas price based on volatility spillover is proposed, which can provide the information about price volatility between power market and natural gas market for market entities. Firstly, the bivariate Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity model to evaluate the degree of volatility between the rate of change of power price and gas price is constructed. Then, the risk early warning levels of power price and gas price transmission based on value-at-risk are proposed. Finally, the case studies on the power and gas market in the United States are performed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results show that there is some short-term asymmetric price volatility transmission in both directions between the power market and natural gas market, and the price linkage risk can be evaluated by the model, which can provide references of early warning for market entities.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Prediction of Unit-level Power Scenarios in Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The majority of wind power prediction technologies currently available focus on predicting the total power output of wind farms, disregarding the prediction requirements of wind farm unit-level scenarios. To address this gap, this paper proposes a probabilistic prediction method for wind farm unit-level power scenarios, leveraging the convolutional neural network (CNN) and kernel density estimation techniques. Firstly, a CNN is utilized to establish a mapping model between the wind farm tower data and the unit-level power scenarios, enabling a deterministic prediction of unit-level power. Building on this, the power prediction error is calculated to construct an error dataset, which is stratified using the concept of a prediction box for reference. Subsequently, the kernel density estimation method is employed to derive the probability density function and cumulative distribution function of the power prediction error, resulting in the generation of wind farm unit-level power scenario intervals across various confidence levels, which facilitates the probability prediction of unit-level power. Finally, the proposed method's effectiveness is verified using one year's worth of operation data from a wind farm.

articleTitle: Research on the 14th Five-Year Plan Development Plan and Carbon Peak, Carbon Neutral Development Path of China's Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To achieve the goal of carbon peak and carbon neutral, the power industry is facing both great opportunities for transformation and development and daunting challenges. Through a comprehensive analysis of the power balance, the contribution rate of low-carbon power supply, considering the economy of scale development and technological progress, the study proposes to ensure the carbon peak in the power industry before 2030 and strive for 2028, and gradually transition to a stable stage with a decline. Firstly, on the basis of analyzing the development foundation and situation of the electric power industry, the main development goals of the electric power industry in seven fields are proposed. Secondly, it expounds the key tasks of electric power industry from seven aspects. Then, on the basis of ensuring the safe supply of electricity and taking low-carbon, electrification and digitalization as the basic direction, the paper focuses on the carbon peak timing, power supply and grid structure and power supply cost in the power industry. Finally, the implementation path and operational safeguard measures of carbon peaking carbon neutrality are proposed. The research results can be used as reference for decision-making by relevant government departments and enterprises and institutions in the industry.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Anomaly Detection in Fiber Optic Current Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As an important component for measuring direct current in converter stations, fiber optical current transformers (FOCT) are widely applied in the smart power grid to ensure the safety of AC/DC conversion processes by quantifying the polarization rotation when light passes through a magnetic field. Predicting the states of FOCTs is crucial for the security of smart power gird. However, the states of FOCTs are associated with many external factors, and it is challenging to predict the anomalies timely. To this end, in this paper we present an ensemble-based prediction model that leverages the strengths of XGBoost, LSTM, and Informer to predict the states of FOCTs in a multi-scale way. Our proposed model takes into account the influences of multiple variables on FOCT operation and considers the accuracy of long-sequence and short-sequence time-series forecasting while avoiding the randomness, nonlinearity, and instability of external factors. Finally, we evaluate our proposed ensemble model on a large-scale dataset collected from state grid corporation of China. Our experimental results demonstrate that our proposed fusion model has higher stability and generalization capability compared to traditional single models, and it performs well on both the short-term and long-term prediction tasks.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Hosting Capacity Evaluation Method for Distribution System with Battery Energy Storage System considering Rational Photovoltaic Curtailment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to effectively evaluate the maximum hosting capacity of distributed photovoltaic with battery energy storage systems in the distribution network under the premise of allowing rational photovoltaic curtailment, this paper constructs an evaluation model of the maximum hosting capacity of photovoltaic with battery energy storage systems in the distribution network, considering the constraints of photovoltaic curtailment rate. By linearizing power flow constraints and line capacity constraints, this model is constructed into a large-scale linear programming model with the scale of year and the granularity of hour as the scale. In order to effectively improve the solution efficiency, a scenario reduction strategy was proposed according to the model characteristics and the operation law of battery energy storage, which effectively reduced the size of the optimization model, and further ensured the optimality of understanding through the iterative update of the optimized scenario set. The numerical results show that the solution time can be reduced by 80% by using the proposed scenario reduction strategy, and the accuracy is basically unchanged.

articleTitle: An overview of electric vehicle charging guidance strategies in highway applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As electric vehicles become more popular on a large scale, the construction of fast charging stations along motorways will provide the conditions for electric vehicles to travel long distances, and at the identical time, the issue of the versatility of the charging needs of electric vehicles also arises. The very occasional access of electric vehicles to motorway charging stations turns to some extent into a kind of charging problem for electrical vehicles in the light of their natural driving attributes. In order to solve this solution, various orderly charging guidance strategies are needed to narrow down the variability of users' charging demands and make charging at highway charging stations more convenient and time-saving for users. This paper firstly analyses the charging scenarios in which no guidance mechanism is involved, secondly categorizes the existing strategies for electric vehicle charging guidance research and presents a comparative analysis of the achieved results, and finally, the inadequacies of existing research are put forward and future research into guiding strategies for electric vehicle charging at motorway charging stations is examined for refinement.

articleTitle: Fault traveling wave location method based on EMD and improvement threshold denoising
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of inaccurate location caused by noise interference in the existing distribution network fault transient traveling wave signal, thus a fault location method based on empirical mode decomposition (EMD) and improved threshold denoising is proposed. The EMD algorithm is used to decompose the fault traveling wave signal into Intrinsic mode function (IMF) components, filter out the noisy low frequency components. The IMF with noise is processed by the improved threshold method and reconstructed to realize the accurate calibration of fault traveling wave head. The experimental results show that the proposed method can have good denoising ability and accurately identify the noisy fault traveling wave head. Theoretical analysis and simulation results both show that the method can greatly improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis and location, possessing strong robustness and adaptability.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-source Data Fusion Standardization and User Electricity Knowledge Map Construction Technology of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Distribution network operation status awareness is the most critical part of the digital transformation of the power grid, which is related to the security of power supply and stable operation of the system. Due to its large number of points and large volume, it will bring huge construction and operation and maintenance costs if the state sensing is realized by adding new side nodes. In order to explore the value of tapping the massive external data resources on the load side and cooperate with the grid's own collection information to achieve the purpose of economically and efficiently improving the overall sensing level of the distribution network, we propose a large-scale heterogeneous data fusion and knowledge map construction model of the grid's power consumption state, which combines the external equipment data on the load side. By using different text characteristics to reduce the differences of heterogeneous data; by fusing features from static and time-series dynamic features to enhance the stability of system representation; and a smart grid knowledge map is constructed without increasing computational effort by using graph attention coding technology for finegrained interaction. Experiments show that the proposed method can enhance the real-time and accuracy of traditional grid system judgments and provide important support for relevant decisions and practices.

articleTitle: An Interval Optimization Based Two-stage Voltage Control Method for Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an interval optimization (IO) based two-stage voltage control method, fully considering the uncertainty and randomness of photovoltaic (PV) and load power. In the centralized stage, the coordinated optimization model of the on-load tap changer (OLTC) and multiple PVs based on the IO is established, to periodically (30 min) optimize the tap position of the OLTC and coefficients of the voltage-var droop control curve for each PV. In the local control stage, according to the measured voltage and the updated voltage-var droop control curves at PVs' connection nodes, the reactive power of each PV is adjusted in real time (1 min) to suppress voltage fluctuations. Furthermore, numerous simulations and comparisons are carried out on a modified IEEE 33-bus distribution network with high penetrations of PVs, and results show that the proposed method can not only effectively deal with the problem of node voltage violations, but also significantly reduce the power loss of distribution networks and the adjustments of the OLTC.

articleTitle: Coordinated Planning of Charging Swapping Stations and Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper investigates the coordinated planning of electric vehicle (EV) charging swapping stations (CSSs), also called charging and swapping facilities, together with the development of the active distribution network (ADN) that includes distributed generation. The coordinated planning approach is based on the application of a specifically developed spatial-temporal load forecasting analysis of both plug-in EVs (PEVs) and swapping EVs (SEVs). The coordinated planning approach is formulated as a mathematical programming optimization model that provides the location and sizing of new CSSs, the best AND topology, the required distributed generation and substation capacities. The model is solved by the CPLEX. The characteristics and performances of the proposed approach are tested with a reference to a realistic case study.

articleTitle: Deep Belief Network-Based Anomaly Recognition Method of Power Supply Service Work Orders
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The recognition of abnormal data from the power supply service work orders is a key issue to improve the processing efficiency of power supply work orders as well as the quality of power supply services. However, the existing abnormal work orders recognition mainly relies on manual screening methods, and the efficiency and accuracy of recognition depend on expert experience. Given this background, an anomaly recognition method of power supply service work orders based on deep belief network is proposed. First, a pre-processing method for power supply work orders based on non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is proposed to implement initial recognition of abnormal work orders from historical data, and reduce noise impact during the collection process of work orders. Second, with the crucial factors and characteristics that affect the number of power supply work orders considered, the multi-dimensional feature-based anomaly characteristic indices of work orders are presented to reflect features of abnormal work orders comprehensively. Then, an anomaly recognition model of power supply work orders based on deep belief network (DBN) is constructed. Finally, case studies on actual power supply work orders of power supply company in Zhejiang province, China are performed for verifying the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results show that the proposed method can accurately and efficiently recognize abnormal work orders.

articleTitle: Weather Sensitive Residential Load Forecasting Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Load forecasting is essential for power system planning and operation. Power utility relay on accurate load forecasting to commit generation, schedule outages, and predict potential operational risks. Short-term day-ahead and hour-ahead load forecasting are indispensable functions in energy management, marketing, and distribution systems. Improving load forecasting accuracy is challenging and crucial for power system planning and operation. This paper proposed a load forecasting model using a neural network. The data for the forecast model training was obtained from multiple data sources, including smart meters, week patterns, and weather information. The employed approach and the training model can be adapted to accurately predict the day-ahead and hour-ahead load consumption. In the neural network-based machine learning process, the prediction of the previous time point will be the input of the following forecast to improve the accuracy. The experimental results demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed method on daily, day-ahead, and hour-ahead load forecasting.

articleTitle: Capacity Coordinated Optimization of Battery, Thermal and Hydrogen Storage System for Multi-Energy Complementary Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For a multi-energy complementary power system containing wind power, photovoltaic, concentrating solar power and electric/thermal/hydrogen multi-type energy storage, the coordinated and optimal allocation of the capacity of various types of energy storage devices is important to improve the system operation economy and cleanliness. A coordinated and optimal allocation method of electric/thermal/hydrogen energy storage capacity for multi-energy complementary power system based on time-series production simulation is proposed. An electric/thermal/hydrogen storage capacity optimization model is established with the objective of maximizing the system's combined annual value gain and considering the system energy outgoing, renewable energy utilization rate and the operating constraints of various power sources and storage systems. Finally, based on the idea of time-series production simulation, the optimal configuration capacity of electric/thermal/hydrogen energy storage that takes into account economic, safety and cleanliness constraints is obtained by optimal solution with the theoretical output of 8760h of scenery for the whole year as input. The example is validated based on a multi-energy complementary power system in northwest China, and the impact of system operation mode, operation strategy, cost and tariff on the capacity allocation results is quantified and analyzed to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Hybrid Converter Cell-Based Buck-Type Bridgeless PFC Converters With Low THD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: AC-DC buck power factor correction (PFC) converters with relatively high efficiency are good candidates in low-voltage applications. However, they typically suffer from high input current total harmonics distortions (THD<inf>i</inf>) caused by the input current dead zones. Thus, this paper proposes four hybrid cell-based buck-type bridgeless PFC converters by using the buck and buck-boost or flyback converter cells. Thanks to the buck-boost/flyback operation in one half-line cycle, the dead zones can be minimized and thus the reduced THD<inf>i</inf>. The operation modes of one proposed bridgeless topology are introduced, followed by a theoretical analysis. Validations of the proposed converters are conducted in simulations, along with the comparison with other buck-type PFC converters.

articleTitle: Multi-attribute Research and Application of BIM Based Distribution Network Engineering Equipment Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the promotion of the construction of intelligent distribution network and the growth of power demand, the construction scale of distribution network projects has been expanded, and the quality management of the projects has become more severe and complex. The traditional two-dimensional modeling is difficult to meet the requirements of new distribution network construction. BIM technology is based on the relevant information data of construction engineering projects for modeling. The application of BIM technology to the construction of distribution network engineering can improve the accuracy and completeness of distribution network engineering modeling, and provide reliable guarantee for the implementation of construction projects and project management. In this paper, geometric attributes, engineering attributes and ontological attributes of distribution network engineering construction elements are used, and combined with the model classification and coding of the grid three-dimensional model in the enterprise standard of State Grid Corporation, the overall platform architecture of the application layer is built, and the model of distribution network engineering construction elements is further refined based on the difference information. In addition to improving the delivery quality of distribution network engineering models, the integrated architecture from design to construction and operation and maintenance stage in the planning and construction of distribution network engineering can be effectively covered.

articleTitle: Study on the Winding Switching Process of Pole Changing LSPMSM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Through adopting pole changing starting method, the starting capability of the line start permanent magnet synchronous motor (LSPMSM) can be significantly improved. However, the switching of the winding is inevitable and crucial. Adverse switching will produce large impulse current and torque, which will have adverse effects on the power grid, motor, permanent magnet and load, and also affect the subsequent pull-in synchronization process. In this paper, based on a 6/8 pole changing LSPMSM, the dynamic winding switching process is studied. The effects of the switching speed and switching phase difference between the 8-pole winding and the applied voltage on the speed, current, electromagnetic torque and the demagnetization of permanent magnet during winding switching process are analyzed, respectively. The results show that the switching phase difference (or voltage difference) should be as small as possible to reduce the impact on motor. Subsequently, a switching control strategy with small impact on power grid, motor and load, no irreversible demagnetizing of permanent magnet and favorable to pull in synchronization is proposed.

Author Keywords: Line start permanent magnet synchronous motor (LSPMSM)

articleTitle: Research on Power Transformer Fault Diagnosis Based on Improved Wavelet Packet Energy and Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to realize non-invasive fault detection of power transformer, an acoustic signal analysis method based on improved wavelet packet energy transform and hidden Markov model (HMM) is proposed to diagnose the fault situation of power transformer. Firstly, the principle of acoustic vibration and the characteristics of acoustic signal of power transformer are analyzed, and the feasibility of fault diagnosis through acoustic signal characteristic component analysis is proved. Secondly, through the improved wavelet packet energy transformation method, the acoustic signal after noise reduction is effectively extracted, and the feature vector of energy distribution percentage of each running state on different frequency band nodes is constructed. Finally, the generated feature vectors are input into the trained HMM for fault diagnosis. The simulation results show that this method can effectively evaluate the running state of power transformer and provide practical basis for the establishment of fault diagnosis system.

articleTitle: Short-term wind power prediction model based on PCA-GA-LSTM neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of short-term wind power, a PCA-GA-LSTM short-term wind power combination prediction algorithm based on NWP is proposed. First, principal component analysis is used to reduce the dimension and denoise NWP sample data, and then genetic algorithm is used to train and optimize the model parameters of short-term memory artificial neural network (LSTM), such as learning rate, number of hidden layer nodes, regularization coefficient, etc. Finally, NWP historical data after dimension reduction is used as learning samples to train the neural network, and real-time information is processed to obtain prediction results. The results show that the prediction accuracy based on PCA-GA-LSTM neural network model is good, which has certain reference value for short-term wind power prediction.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based EVs Charging Right Trading Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The traditional charging transaction model between electric vehicles (EVs) and the grid has low transparency and difficult settlement. To address this problem, this paper designs a demand-side response charging right transaction mechanism based on blockchain technology. First, a trinity of blockchain transaction system of power distribution network (PDN)-charging station (CS)-EVs is constructed. Second, a charging reservation mechanism and a creditworthiness evaluation mechanism is established to schedule the power quota of CS. Finally, the test results show the fairness and efficiency of the proposed charging right trading model.

articleTitle: PJM capacity market and Enlightenment to China's capacity market design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the proposal of the ‘Dual carbon’ goals, the rapid development of renewable energy has promoted the optimization and transformation of power supply structure, and at the same time, it has brought severe challenges to the reliable power supply of the grid and the generation capacity adequacy of the new power system. The PJM capacity market in the United States is an international model to ensure the adequacy of power generation capacity and grid construction. This paper studies the development origin and operation principle of the PJM capacity market, and designs a capacity market mechanism suitable for China's power development according to China's current installed load situation and policies, with a view to providing a useful reference for the subsequent construction of China's capacity market.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of Discharge Characteristics of a Sphere-plane Long Air Gap Under Switching Impulse Voltage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Previously, the research about the discharge characteristics of long air gaps mainly focused on the gaps with severely inhomogeneous electric fields such as rod-plane, and rod-rod, where the electrode size is generally small. The sphere-plane air gap exists in the valve hall of the converter station in ultra-high-voltage (UHV) direct-current power transmission projects, and fewer studies have been conducted on its discharge characteristics. In this paper, a sphere-plane long air gap discharge experimental platform containing a current measurement device and a high-speed camera is built. The breakdown characteristics of sphere-plane long air gaps with different spherical electrodes and different gap distances are studied by applying positive switching impulse, and the physical parameters of different discharge stages of 0.3 m spherical electrode are obtained by measuring the discharge current from the high voltage electrode and recoding the optical images. The experimental results obtained the breakdown voltage variation patterns of 0.05 m, 0.1 m, 0 15 m, 0 2 m, and 0.3 m spherical electrodes under 1 m to 2 m gap distance. Also, the discharge parameters of each stage of the streamer-leader discharge process of the 0.3 m-spherical-electrode under 1 m and 1.5 m gap are observed. The resultant observations show that the breakdown voltage gradually increases and tends to saturate as the radius and distance of the electrode increase; the leader inception time, leader inception voltage, and leader velocity increase with increasing distance.

articleTitle: Demagnetization Study of Permanent Magnet Machine Under Three Phase Short Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The influence factors of the demagnetization magnetic field of permanent magnet machine are complicated. This paper investigated the influence of rotor position and current angle on demagnetization by simulation. These two factors were introduced into the three-phase active short-circuit current mode, and then a more comprehensive demagnetization condition analysis method was proposed. The most severe DQ demagnetization combination under the three-phase short-circuit condition and the most severe demagnetization rotor position were calculated, and combined as the most severe demagnetization conditions. Based on the spatial magnetic density vector decomposition of the permanent magnet, the irreversible demagnetization rate of permanent magnet under the most severe demagnetization conditions were calculated more accurately. The rotor thermal test and motor demagnetization test were designed to measure the temperature rise and demagnetization rate of permanent magnet. The similarity between the experimental and simulation results fully shows the validation of this method.

articleTitle: A low turn-on voltage vertical GaN SBD with improved heat dissipation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, we investigated the vertical GaN Schottky Barrier Diode (SBD) with a high-low work function combined Schottky anode (hybrid anode) with reduced device turn-on voltage. The combination of low work function metal and high work function metal is responsible for the low turn-on voltage. An AIN barrier region is added to reduce the specific on-resistance and improve the heat dissipation performance of the device. In comparison with the conventional SBD, the turn-on voltage and specific on-resistance of this hybrid anode SBD diode are reduced from 0.50V to 0.23V and from <tex>$3.7 \mathrm{m} \Omega\cdot \text{cm}^{2}$</tex> to <tex>$2.5 \mathrm{m}\Omega\cdot \text{cm}^{2}$</tex>, respectively.

articleTitle: A GAN-based Adversarial Attack Method for Data-driven State Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of data science and technology, data-driven methods can provide support to real-time and accurate state estimation (SE) of power systems. However, the non-interpretability and poor robustness of data-driven algorithms also introduced new security risks to the power system. The risk transmitted to the related operations of state estimation can cause errors in system state perception, or even lead to more serious consequences. In this paper, an adversarial attack method for data-driven state estimation based on generative adversarial network (GAN) is proposed, which aims at revealing and uncovering the security risks of data-driven SE algorithms. Simulation results show that the GAN-based adversarial attack can cause significant deviations of power system state estimation, which can lead to subsequent security problems.

articleTitle: Study on Electrothermal Characteristics of Oil-Immersed Transformers in Incipient Stage of Inter-Turn Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The aging and deterioration of inter-turn insulation in oil-immersed transformers lead to a decrease in inter-turn insulation resistance, and an increase in current and heat generation on the faulty coils, resulting in the top oil and tank wall temperatures increase. Therefore, it is important to investigate the electrothermal characteristics of the transformer with incipient inter-turn faults, which can provide a theoretical basis for incipient fault detection. By analyzing the effect of inter-turn fault resistance on the transformer's equivalent circuit and winding losses, an inter-turn fault model coupling the electromagnetic and thermal-fluid fields is proposed in this paper. On this basis, a transformer high-fidelity simulation model, which has the same structure, size, and material parameters as the transformer entity, is established to simulate the winding currents and the temperatures of different components. The experimental and simulation analysis shows that the relative errors of the simulated winding currents are within ±2%. The errors of the simulated winding temperatures are not more than 3°C, thus verifying the effectiveness of the proposed simulation model. The electrothermal characteristics of the transformer with a 1% inter-turn fault in high voltage (HV) winding are studied by this simulation model. The results show that the top oil temperature increases by 9.4K., and the overall temperature of the tank wall rises by 10°C. In addition, the effect of the inter-turn fault resistance on the electrothermal characteristics is analyzed.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Stress Distribution of Cable Laid in the Bridge Offset
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to compensate the thermal expansion and contraction of the bridge, the cable is usually laid in the bridge offset device. Therefore, it is a necessity to calculate the stress distribution of the cable laid in the bridge offset. In this paper, a simulation model of a 220 kV XLPE cable laid in offset is built, and the distribution of stress under contraction and expansion are analyzed. Results show that the most of the stress distributes at the free end of cable, and the maximum stress of each layer decreases from outer layer to inner layer. Meanwhile, the maximum stress under expansion is larger than that of contraction.

articleTitle: Improving the Current Control Performances of LCL- Type Shunt Active Power Filters with High-Pass Inverter-Side Current Feedback Active Damping
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper is focused on the current control of LCL-type shunt active power filters (APFs). Grid current and inverter-side current are firstly selected for current control, and a high-pass inverter-side current feedback active damping loop is also introduced, which constitute the enhanced current control structure together. Damping characteristic analyses reveal that in comparison with proportional feedback, the proposed current control method can effectively attenuate the LCL-filter resonance and avoid the low-frequency gain attenuation phenomenon at the same time. Besides, the second-order generalized integrators are adopted for the current controllers to ensure a superior harmonic compensation performance. Finally, a 30 kVA APF test bench has been established to prove the feasibility of the enhanced current control method through experiments.

Author Keywords: high-pass inverter-side current feedback active damping

articleTitle: Analysis of the influence of voltage harmonics on the maximum load capacity of the power supply transformer for the LHCD system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To study the influence of the voltage total harmonic distortion (THDV) and its spectrum on the harmonic loss factor (FHL) and the maximum allowable load capacity ratio (Imax(pu)) for the transformer of the LHCD system, the LHCD system model is built through Simulink/MATLAB software. Based on this model, the winding loss and the maximum allowable load capacity of the transformer of the LHCD system are studied when the supply voltage source is sinusoidal and non-sinusoidal, respectively. The calculation is carried out by the method of IEEE standard C57.110 and the method of considering the skin effect. The calculation results of both methods clearly show that the THDV value of the supply voltage has a significant effect on the harmonic dissipation factor (FHL) and the maximum allowable load capacity ratio (Imax(pu)) of the transformer. And the calculation method considering the skin effect increases the maximum allowable load capacity ratio of the LHCD system transformer by about 2%. The research results have important reference value for the future retrofit design of LHCD system transformers.

articleTitle: Effect of Different Reactive Power Control Structures of Voltage Source Converters on Transient Stability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Virtual synchronous generator (VSG) is a widely used control strategy for grid-connected voltage source converters (VSCs). Although it has similar operating characteristics to a synchronous generator (SG), VSG also suffers from stability problems under grid disturbances. In this paper, a combination of linearized and nonlinearized models is used to reveal the mechanisms by which different reactive power control structures of VSG affect the transient stability of the system using phase portrait diagrams, showing that the introduction of an integral term in the reactive power loop can introduce a new closed-loop dominant pole for the original second-order system, thus suppressing the power angle overshoot and enhancing the transient stability of the system. The design criterion of the controller is further proposed, and the theoretical analysis and simulation verification shows that the flexible configuration of virtual inertia <tex>$J$</tex> and reactive power inertia coefficient <tex>$K$</tex> can make the VSG ensure both frequency stability and transient stability.

articleTitle: New Energy Cluster and Large-scale Power Grid Co-simulation Application based on RTLAB and CloudPSS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the need for stability analysis of large- scale new energy cluster connecting to large-scale power grid system, the existing electromagnetic transient simulation tools have certain limitations. At present, there is a lack of simulation platform that can uniformly establish large-scale new energy and large-scale power grid models. Based on two different simulation tools, RTLAB and CloudPSS, a large-scale new energy cluster and large-scale power grid electromagnetic transient co- simulation platform is built. A new energy station equivalence method based on single machine representation method is proposed, and the accuracy of the equivalence method is verified by comparing with detailed station model, which provides a basis for the modeling of large-scale new energy clusters. On the other hand, the electromechanical - electromagnetic model conversion tool based on CloudPSS is introduced, which provides a method for large-scale power grid modeling. At last, the decoupling principle and hardware implementation scheme of co-simulation model based on RTLAB and cloudPSS are presented and the comparison of simulation results verifies the accuracy of the simulation platform.

articleTitle: Online Monitoring of Converter Station Using an Acoustic Signal Analysis Method Based on The Mobile Microphone Array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An abundance of operational status signals can be found in the acoustic signals produced by power equipment in high-voltage converter stations. For the intelligent development of power grids, the use of acoustic signals for online monitoring of power equipment in converter stations to detect the location of faults has become crucial. A beamforming algorithm based on a mobile microphone array is suggested in this paper for high-voltage converter stations in order to quickly localize target acoustic sources. The algorithm links the movement of the microphone with the location of the sound source in the frequency domain by translating the short-time Fourier variation. As a result, the movement of the array element is one of the variables used in the localization algorithm, allowing the localization of the sound source with a minimal number of microphone array elements. Finally, simulation experiments using the results of field test data are used to show the efficacy and accuracy of the algorithm for locating the fault locations of significant power equipment in high-voltage converter stations.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Impedance Identification and Stability Online Assessment of DFIG-Based Wind Farm Integration with MMC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The impedance-based analysis method is an effective tool to study the small-signal stability of power electronic systems. The conventional impedance modeling method needs to know the internal control structure and parameters of power converters in advance, which is not suitable for black/grey-box equipment in practice. The existing data-driven methods have not been applied to impedance identification and online stability assessment of wind farm integration through modular multilevel converter-based high-voltage DC (MMC-HVDC) system. In order to address this issue, a back propagation (BP) neural network-based impedance identification method is proposed, and the stability of the interconnected system is evaluated online based on the identified impedances from the neural networks. Firstly, the methodology of the BP neural network-based impedance identification is introduced. On this basis, the online stability assessment method of wind farm integration through MMC-HVDC system is elaborated. Finally, a case study of online stability assessment is carried out on a practical DFIG-based wind farm integrated with an MMC-HVDC transmission system in China. The results show that the errors of the identified impedance are very small, and the proposed method has good reliability in the online stability assessment of wind farm integration via MMC-HVDC system.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategies of Interleaved Three-level Bidirectional Buck/Boost Converter for Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The soft switching, current balancing, voltage balancing, and energy management control strategies of interleaved three-level bidirectional DC-DC converter are investigated in the context of the supercapacitor energy storage system application.
