In this paper, firstly the process of soft switching is analyzed and the soft switching control strategy is proposed. Secondly, the corresponding balancing control methods are proposed to solve the problems of unbalanced interleaved inductor current and input side filter capacitor voltage. Then, the main parameters and control loop of the converter are designed and verified by simulation. Finally, a prototype is built for experimental verification, and the outcomes clearly attest to the effectiveness of the proposed control strategies. The efficiency of the prototype in charge and discharge mode raised to 96.3 % and 95.8 % respectively.

articleTitle: Faster RCNN for multi-class Foreign Objects detection of Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the long-term operation of power grids, foreign objects on transmission lines can affect the safe and stable operation of transmission lines and even lead to large-scale power outages, which bring incalculable losses to social and economic development. In this paper, based on the characteristics of the acquired transmission line images, we construct a transmission line foreign object dataset, improve the loss calculation and network structure of the basic Faster RCNN based on the RCNN network model target detection method, and detect foreign objects on transmission lines, such as plastic film, kites, bird nests, ice, etc., by training the model. The final experimental results show that compared with the traditional object recognition method, the improved Faster R-CNN not only overcomes the instability of manually extracted features, but also has the ability to resist complex environmental interference and improves the accuracy of foreign object detection on transmission lines.

articleTitle: A Novel Common-Ground Nine-Level Quadruple Boost Inverter Based on Switched-Capacitor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Multilevel inverters have been popular in photovoltaic applications because of lower total harmonic distortion, higher power quality and lower switching stress. This letter proposes a novel switched-capacitor common-ground nine-level inverter with quadruple voltage boosting ability and low voltage stress. Based on switched-capacitor charging in parallel/ discharging in series with the input voltage source, the capacitor voltage can be stabilized at desired value without additional control, allowing self-voltage balancing of capacitors. In addition, due to the boost ability of switched-capacitor structure, the inverter can achieve quadruple boost output. Since the neutral point of the grid is directly connected to the negative terminal of the photovoltaic panels, so the leakage current is eliminated completely. A comparison is also made in terms of the number of elements, voltage gain factor and capacitor voltage. Finally, a prototype is built and experimental results are presented to confirm the performance of the proposed topology.

articleTitle: Chinese named entity recognition of transformer bushing fault based on BiLSTM-CRF
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Bushing is an important part of transformer, which is often in the environment of high voltage and high current, and is prone to failure. The vast majority of transformer failures are caused by bushing failures, which will bring about serious economic losses. With the development of information technology, the power system is also moving towards digitalization. Knowledge graph plays an important role in the rapid processing of power information. For this technology, named entity recognition is the key step to build knowledge graph, which can extract power information entities and promote the process of power system digitalization. Therefore, this paper proposes a transformer bushing fault extraction method based on Chinese named entity recognition, and extracts the fault information from the bushing fault text based on the BiLSTM-CRF natural language processing model. First of all, according to the characteristics of transformer bushing fault text, the schema layer is constructed using the top-down entity extraction method, and its data layer is also constructed according to the attributes defined in the schema layer; Then, the mainstream machine learning models are compared with the model proposed in this paper, and the effectiveness of this method is evaluated by using precision, recall, F1 score, which reaches 92.91%, 91.89% and 92.40% respectively.

articleTitle: A Passive Fractional-Order Capacitor to Realize Zero Angle Phase Input for Wireless Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Zero phase angle (ZPA) input can minimize the apparent power and improve the power capacity in wireless power transfer (WPT) system, while reducing the line loss. Parameters deviation, parasitic parameter and active rectifier may lead to the loss of ZPA input. Fractional-order components are gradually implemented into the WPT system because of their more abundant degrees of freedom. In implementation, an external high-voltage auxiliary power supply is often required to construct the fractional-order capacitor (FOC), which brings inconvenience in practical operation. In this paper, a passive fractional-order capacitor (P-FOC) construction method is proposed and experimentally proved, which can realize adaptive variable capacitance with the order of 1 or −1. Compared with the traditional method for ZPA input, its control scheme is simpler and no feedback or communication is needed, while it has a full range of impedance matching.

articleTitle: Research on active equalization of lithium battery based on two-layer topology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems such as the service life reduction and safety reduction of lithium batteries caused by the inconsistency of the battery monomer in the lithium battery pack, a simple and efficient lithium battery equalization scheme is proposed. The scheme is based on a two-layer topology. The bottom layer uses the bidirectional Buck-Boost circuit equalization, and the top layer uses an improved centralized capacitive topology. Battery voltage is used as the equalization variable, and the balancing strategy of first inter-group equalization and then intra-group equalization is used to improve the balancing speed. The effectiveness of the proposed scheme is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: An Improved Fast Spectral Kurtosis Algorithm in Bearing Fault Diagnosis for a Motor Drive System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Bearing is one of the most easily damaged parts in the electric drive system of electric vehicles. With the silicon carbide motor controller put into use, higher switching frequency produces greater shaft current, which makes the bearing more prone to failure. The accurate diagnosis of initial bearing faults is of great significance for prolonging the service life of electric drive system and improving the operation reliability of equipment. The fast spectral kurtosis algorithm can screen out the center frequency and bandwidth to band-pass filter the bearing vibration signal, and then the envelope analysis technology can be used to identify the bearing fault characteristic frequency, so as to determine whether the bearing fault exists and the fault type. However, due to the presence of transient noise in the system, the fast spectral kurtosis algorithm can sometimes be affected by the transient noise and cannot identify the appropriate center frequency and bandwidth. An improved fast spectral kurtosis algorithm is proposed in this paper, that is, a pre-whitening process is added before the traditional fast spectral kurtosis algorithm, and this method is applied to the bearing public data set. The experimental results show that the improved fast spectral kurtosis algorithm is superior to the conventional spectral kurtosis algorithm and manual empirical method, and its diagnosis results are more robust.

articleTitle: A Method for Suppressing Core Eddy Current Loss Caused by Leakage Flux in Nanocrystalline High-frequency Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-frequency transformer is a crucial component in isolated DC/DC converters, and its stable operation has a decisive impact on the reliability, efficiency, and power density of power systems. Nanocrystalline material, as a magnetic core, has been widely used due to its excellent performance. However, nanocrystalline alloys have a high electrical conductivity, which may induce strong eddy currents when high-frequency leakage flux passes through the surface of the tape, resulting in potential heat problems. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a method to suppress core eddy current losses in nanocrystalline high-frequency transformers. First, the distribution characteristics of core eddy current losses in leakage flux are determined by finite element simulation. Then, in the area where eddy current losses are concentrated, slots are cut on the outer nanocrystalline tape to block the eddy current loop and increase the equivalent resistance. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by finite element simulation.

articleTitle: Voltage Control Strategy of Distribution Networks with Distributed Photovoltaic Based on Multi-agent Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It is of great significance to control the voltage fluctuation and network loss increase caused by the random fluctuation of photovoltaic equipment output for the stable operation of distribution network. In order to solve the distribution network, voltage fluctuation problem. Firstly, a model-free multi-agent reinforcement learning framework based on depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm is proposed. The method of centralized training and decentralized execution is adopted to solve the voltage fluctuation problem. Then, the reward function of the algorithm is adjusted to reduce reactive power loss under the premise of controlling voltage fluctuation. The adjustment can better meet the voltage control requirements of the distribution network. The deep reinforcement learning algorithm does not require accurate power flow modeling, nor does it depend on the prediction of the data before the day, so it is suitable for some observation distribution networks with weak communication capability. Finally, an example is given to verify that the algorithm has strong voltage control ability.

articleTitle: Analysis and Multi-Objective Optimization of the Hybrid Excitation Switched Flux Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a hybrid excitation switched flux (HESF) machine is analyzed and multi-objectively optimized to achieve a better overall performance by considering the torque density, torque ripple, flux regulation capability and the DC winding induced voltage. One optimum HESF machine design having high torque density and flux regulation capability is obtained through optimization. In order to suppress the DC winding induced voltage and torque ripple, the performance of the optimum HESF machine with and without five-step skewed rotor are analyzed and compared. It is found that the HESM machine having the skewed rotor can suppress the peak-to-peak value of the DC winding induced voltage by 35.96% from 163.67 V to 104.82 V and torque ripple from 19.66% to 8.55%, whilst the average torque can be maintained by >90%.

articleTitle: Variable inductance control of DAB converter to reduce reactive power
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A variable inductance (VI) structure for dual active bridge (DAB) DC-DC converter based on controllable switches is proposed in this work. First, this paper analyzes the difference in the efficiency of DAB converter in different power ranges, and proposes a method to make the converter work continuously in high efficient power range by changing the value of the inductor. Secondly, the VI structure is proposed to connect controllable switches and inductors of different values in series or parallel with each other, which is simple in structure and can achieve stable operation. Based on this VI structure, a control method combining the existing phase shift modulation optimization scheme is proposed. Finally, the proposed method is validated on the MATLAB/Simulink platform to efficiently reduce the reactive power of the existing phase shift modulation optimization schemes, which is practicable and superior.

articleTitle: Influences of Secondary Width on Traction Characteristics in Linear Induction Motors with Flatted Composite Secondary
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Since the linear induction motor works with a flatted secondary in the most of application especially in the urban transit, the transverse end effect is non-negligible and the secondary width is a key parameter to the effect. This paper investigates the influences of different values of secondary width, including the width of non-ferromagnetic and ferromagnetic layer, on traction characteristics, e.g., thrust, vertical force and secondary loss, in linear induction motors. First, a three-dimensional model used for the finite element method is established and the parametric setup for the analysis is determined. Second, the curves for traction characteristics versus secondary width are comprehensively analyzed and discussed. Finally, the relation between the optimal secondary width and geometric dimension of the motor is concluded by the calculation results.

articleTitle: Virtual DC Motor Control Based on Virtual Capacitor for DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the access of high-density distributed power supply, the inertia level of DC micro-grid continues to decline, especially under the condition of independent power supply of new energy, its inertia is far lower than the minimum inertia demand. In order to effectively improve the system inertia and enhance the dynamic stability of the power grid, a new virtual DC motor control based on virtual capacitance is proposed for the energy storage port converter. Firstly, according to the definition of inertia of DC microgrid, the main sources of inertia of DC microgrid are defined. Secondly, according to the small-signal model of the virtual capacitor, a first-order additional inertial loop is constructed, and the virtual DC motor control method based on the additional inertial loop is obtained, which realizes the improvement of the virtual DC motor control and further enhances the inertial support capability of the system. Then, the small-signal model of the new virtual DC motor control is established to explore the influence of virtual angular velocity on system stability, and the advantages of voltage dynamic performance and stability under this control method are analyzed. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy are verified by simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Overvoltage simulation study of 500kV pumped storage power station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Pumped storage power stations use GIS equipment in large numbers due to the constraints of their construction environment. Fully enclosed SF6 gas insulated substation (GIS) has the advantages of compact structure, small footprint, reliable operation, good closure and small maintenance workload. However, the compact structure of GIS equipment will expand the impact of overvoltage on the equipment, which in turn will endanger the safety of the equipment. In this paper, we use ATP-EMTP to simulate the 500kV pumped storage power station in the presence of lightning current and the generation of very fast transient overvoltage (VFTO). As a result, reference is provided for overvoltage suppression measures.

articleTitle: Analysis and suppression of low-frequency oscillation of photovoltaic cells with inertia control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low-frequency oscillation when photovoltaic power generation is connected to weak AC system, a linearization model of photovoltaic power generation is established, which ignores current inner loop and considers inertia control. The influence of various leading factors on low-frequency oscillation modes of photovoltaic power generation is analyzed. Finally, a low-frequency oscillation stabilizer (SSDC) is designed according to the phase compensation method to suppress the low-frequency oscillation of power system. The results show that the increase of input power of DC capacitor and the decrease of proportional control parameters of DC voltage loop and PLL will lead to the decrease of system damping and stability. Finally, the electromagnetic simulation model of weak AC system with photovoltaic power generation is built on PSCAD/EMTDC platform, which verifies the validity of eigenvalue analysis results and SSDC.

articleTitle: Speed Recovery Strategy of WTG Based on Variable Parameter PI Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As renewable energy generation continuously replaces the traditional synchronous machine, the inertia of power system decreases, the frequency regulation ability weakens, and the risk of frequency instability increases. Therefore, domestic and foreign scholars have proposed a variety of control strategies for renewable energy generation to active participate in frequency regulation. Due to the limitation of rotor speed, wind turbine generators(WTGs) need to quit frequency regulation to recover the speed after participating in frequency regulation for a period of time, which will lead to secondary frequency drop. However, the existing WTG rotor speed recovery strategies are mainly improved based on fixed conditions, and the actual wind speed changes are less considered. Therefore, a variable parameter PI control method considering wind speed and rotor speed offset is proposed, which can realize the smooth recovery of speed and reduce the influence on frequency secondary drop. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Modeling and Controller Design of Buck Converter Based on Fully Actuated System Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The method of turning the high-order mathematical models of power electronic converters into state space models described by first-order systems may cause the full-actuation property in the original high-order model not to be retained. In this paper, a modeling method based on the theory of fully actuated system for Buck converter is introduced, and an improved fully actuated system control strategy suitable for power electronic converters is proposed. A simulation and experimental evaluation were performed in this work, and the results show that the improved strategy for Buck converter has better dynamic response and steady-state characteristics than the traditional PI control.

articleTitle: Analysis of Subsynchronous Torsional Vibration of Wind-Thermal Bundling Delivery System via LCC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Recently, Wind-thermal bundled transmission via LCC-HVDC has become the main way of wind energy development and utilization in my country at present and in the future. The complex interaction between wind turbines, thermal power units, and LCC-HVDC needs to be further studied. In this paper, aiming at the direct-drive wind turbine group, thermal power unit and HVDC, the linearization model of the system is established, and the interactive coupling relationship between the connected equipment and the electrical damping of the thermal power unit is analyzed, and the mechanism of torsional vibration of thermal power unit shafting caused by wind-thermal bundling via LCC-HVDC is studied. mechanism. Based on the complex torque coefficient method, the influence of factors such as wind speed, control parameters, HVDC transmission power and control parameters on the electrical damping coefficient of thermal power units is studied. Finally, a time-domain simulation model is built in PSCAD/EMTDC, and the effectiveness of the electrical damping coefficient analysis results is verified through time-domain simulation and time-frequency analysis.

articleTitle: Cooperative Repair Scheduling Strategy of Distribution Systems and Traffic Roads
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Distribution system (DS) repair is an important process of DS restoration after a disastrous event, and its purpose is to quickly restore the power supply in the blackout areas by generating an optimal repair sequence for the faulted lines. However, an extreme disaster will not only damage the grid components, but also cause the road interruption and hinder the repair tasks. Therefore, this paper proposes a cooperative repair scheduling strategy of DS and the broken roads, taking the repair of the key roads by the broken road repair crews (BRRCs) into the route scheduling model of faulted line repair crews (FLRCs), and the impact of the road interruption on the DS emergency repair and load restoration is reduced by synergistically optimizing the repair routes of BRRCs and FLRCs. The proposed model is formulated as a mixed-integer linear program, which is verified on a PG&E69-bus power distribution system. The presented results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Path planning of power line inspection based on DDPG for obstacle avoidance with UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Obstacle avoidance is an important application in the path planning for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle power line inspections. Only by avoiding obstacles during the inspection process can the UAV complete the inspection task well. After analysis we propose to use reinforcement learning algorithms to solve the obstacle avoidance problem in UAV inspection. We use a depth-deterministic policy gradient algorithm to implement obstacle avoidance for UAV inspection and combine it with an artificial potential field method to speed up training. We validated the DDPG algorithm in a simulated environment with simulated obstacles, and the UAV was able to avoid the obstacles well and reach the target point.

articleTitle: Flow control of EHD fluids generated by SDBI actuators under square wave voltages
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The current research trend in the field of electrohydrodynamic (EHD) pumping is to find efficient control methods based on environmentally friendly fluids, which includes but is not limited to driving force strength, flow rate and control capability. In this study, we focus on exploring the ability of surface dielectric barrier injection (SDBI) actuators to control silicone oil jets under square wave signals. The 2D-PIV technique as well as the phase analysis method are applied to the flow fields produced by various SDBI actuators. By modifying previous actuators with polarity-dependent bi-directional jets, we have managed to design two additional types of actuators. The results show that they are suitable for small range of fixed-point impingement and large range of convective mixing, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on combined shielding layer and transmission efficiency of wireless charging system for EVs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The ferrite core plays an essential role in coupling enhancement and magnetic shielding for the wireless power transfer (WPT) of electric vehicles (EVs). However, with the charging power level rises, the single-layer ferrite acts as an electromagnetic shielding device for the system. Its working effect during the charging process is not in meeting the shielding requirements. In this paper, a composite shield consisting of ferrite and ultra-thin silicon steel (UTSS) is proposed, taking advantage of the excellent electromagnetic properties as well as the mechanical properties of UTSS. A numerical model was developed to compare and analyse the static parameters of the coil, the transmission efficiency of the system and the shielding effect when different shielding layers are added. Verification of the feasibility and advantages of composite shields. The final shield was fabricated and an experimental platform was built to verify it. Numerical calculations and experimental results show that the transmission efficiency of the composite shield can reach 92.25%, an improvement of 7.96<sup>%</sup> compared to the unshielded case. The structure also significantly suppresses electromagnetic field leakage, the maximum value of the field differs by 88.41% compared to unshielded.

articleTitle: Research on package corrosion weakness of IGBT module in high humidity application environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: IGBT modules have been widely used in many fields such as renewable energy generation and rail transportation because of their excellent switching performance. However, the application reliability of IGBT modules is affected by many factors, among which humidity is one of the most serious factors threatening the health of IGBT modules. In high humidity applications, moisture tends to penetrate inside the module, which lead to corrosion and degradation of the module. In this paper, finite element simulation reveals that the bonding line and the solder layer are the weak points of the IGBT module packaging corrosion in high humidity application environment, which provide guidance for improving IGBT module packaging and designing reliability enhancement scheme.

articleTitle: A Sensitivity-Based Exchange Model between L Index and Eigenvalues to Quantify Power System Static Voltage Stability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Interconnection of the regional power grids and insufficient ancillary services in the electricity market may reduce the static voltage stability (SVS) of the power system. The <tex>$L$</tex> index and the eigenvalue analysis are common methods to evaluate the SVS. The former describes the connectivity of power systems, i.e. the electrical connection between the generators and the loads, while the latter shows the singularity of the Jacobian matrix, i.e. the solvability of the power flow model. There is no study on the relation between both methods. In this paper, by combining the power flow equations, the sensitivity model of the <tex>$L$</tex> index with respect to the bus loads is proposed. With the loads as the bridge, the exchange relation between the <tex>$L$</tex> index and the eigenvalues is proposed. With the sensitivities, the load buses are ranked to find the load curtailment to improve the SVS. The simulation results verify the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis for Machine Learning-based Short-Term Load Forecasting Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Short-term utility grid planning and operation are based on projected future energy consumption and transmission/generation capacity. The industrial sector being a major influence on the total electrical power consumption. Despite its importance, industrial load forecasting (LF) is not a widely discussed topic in literature, despite the fact that it is influenced by a number of factors, such as planned operations and work shifts, that are unusual or unnecessary in conventional load forecasting models. Unlike time-series analysis, machine learning (ML) techniques are well-suited to the nature of the loads since they can simulate complex nonlinear relationships through a process that uses previous data patterns. In this paper, four data-driven machine learning strategies including Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree (DT), Artificial Neural Network (ANN), and Gaussian Process (GP), are compared to forecast an industrial load. These strategies can help in selecting the optimal model for load prediction. The results show that GP outperformed other ML techniques, thus yielding more accurate and reliable readings with lower estimation errors for electrical LF, but at the expense of higher computational time.

articleTitle: Weak link identification of distribution network based on power domain knowledge graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The complex network theory believes that there are some key links in every large-scale network, which are poor in damage resistance and easy to be attacked. In order to identify weak links in the distribution network and conduct reliability estimation for internal components of the system, a hierarchical knowledge map is established, and a weak link identification method based on Neo4j diagram database is proposed. Firstly, the reliability indexes of components, lines and systems in the distribution network are calculated. Secondly, various nodes and reliability index values are generated by graph database in the form of node-edge. At the same time, relevant information at all levels can be queried according to Cypher statement. Thirdly, based on the minimum spanning tree algorithm and the efficient query performance of Neo4j graph database, the weak link of distribution network was identified. Finally, the validity of the proposed method is verified by a real 10kV distribution network.

articleTitle: Effect of Blade Electrode Shape on Electrohydrodynamic Jets with Different Dielectric Properties in a Blade-Plane Configuration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The actuator structure of an electroconvective flow is one of the key factors affecting the efficiency of an EHD pump. This paper presents a computational simulation considering the effect of injection and field-enhanced dissociation in a blade-plane geometry simultaneously. Calculations based on the whole set of EHD equations are performed with the help of a finite element method-based software package. The coupling characteristics of flow and charge behavior are investigated in a system of semicircular-tip and needle-tip blade electrodes, and the effect of adjusting the mobility and inter-electrode gap length on the flow rate is demonstrated. The results show that an impinging jet generated from needle-tip blade electrode is superior to that from semicircular-tip blade electrode, and the maximum velocity can reach 0.97 m/s.

articleTitle: Harmonics Suppression for Dual Three-Phase Permanent Magnet motor With Multi-Subspace Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The conventional virtual voltage vector (VV) based model predictive control for dual three-phase permanent magnet motor is a harmonic subspace open-loop scheme. This paper proposes a remedy method to realize a closed-loop predictive control both in fundamental and harmonic subspace. The harmonic-free VVs are synthesized in the fundamental subspace while the torque-free VVs are synthesized in the harmonic subspace. The optimal VVs are selected in respective subspaces using the predefined cost functions. Then, the duty cycle of the optimal harmonic-free VV is calculated according to the deadbeat principle of dq-axes current. The remaining duty cycle is proportionally allocated to the optimal torque-free VV. In this case, both fundamental and harmonic subspace can be controlled in a closed-loop scheme. Therefore, the harmonic currents and torque ripple can be further suppressed. The simulation and experiments results show that the proposed method can significantly improve the operational performance of the motor.

articleTitle: Flashover strength improvement and particle suppression in vacuum using surface groove structure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Vacuum insulation equipment is facing the development requirements of higher voltage grade and miniaturization. However, vacuum flashover is prone to occur along the solid-vacuum interface, and the attached metal particle is considered to be one essential reason to trigger surface flashover. Therefore, it is important to study the method of improving flashover strength along vacuum surface and particle suppression for the development as well as application of vacuum equipment. This article starts from the surface groove structure, successfully constructs a groove structure on the surface of insulating material by 3D printing technology, and investigates the effect of groove structures on the flashover characteristics along the dielectric surface in vacuum through experiments. In addition, the effect of metal particles attached to the surface on the electric field distribution and the flashover strength are studied through simulations and experiments. Finally, the effect of the groove structure on the metal particle is investigated, the suppression effect of grooves on the metal particle is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Design of a High Power SiC MOSFET Parallel Active Current Sharing Method Based on di/dt Current Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Controlling the current balance of the parallel branch of SiC MOSFETs can effectively avoid their safety problems caused by parallel uneven current. In this paper, we analyze the influencing factors of parallel uneven current from device parameters, power loop parameters and drive loop parameters, and propose a parallel active current equalization method based on the combination of gate voltage delay compensation and dynamic voltage compensation with di/dt current detection from the drive circuit design of high-power SiC MOSFETs, and verify the proposed method by simulation software and double-pulse experiments, and the results show that the results show that the parallel active current sharing method can reduce the maximum current error in the turn-on process from 90A to about 20A and the current error in the turn-off process from 50A to about 25A under the condition that the output current of a single module is 160A, which provides a new method to improve the current balance in the module branches.

articleTitle: Analysis and Diagnosis of Irreversible Demagnetization Fault of Surface-Mounted PM Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel method to detect irreversible demagnetization fault (IDF) using the harmonic characteristics of the coil back electromotive force (BEMF) for surface-mounted permanent magnet (PM) synchronous motor. Firstly, an analytical method of IDF based on the subdomain method and PM subdivision model is proposed, which can simulate uniform demagnetization and partial demagnetization in tiny areas on a single PM. The model is verified by finite element analysis, which has high accuracy and computational efficiency. On this basis, the harmonic characteristics of the phase and coil BEMF of the integer-slot motor and fractional-slot motor under three IDF states are investigated. Finally, a diagnosis technique of IDF based on the harmonic characteristics of coil BEMF is presented.

articleTitle: Influence of Equivalent Impedance of Connecting Network on Stability Analysis For Renewable Energy Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Centralized penetration of large scale renewable energy brings great challenges to the safe and stable operation of modern power system. Exact equivalent model of renewable energy power plant (REPP) is the basis for analyzing the penetration stability, and connecting network equivalence is an important item in REPP dynamic equivalence process. In this paper, two equivalence rules for connecting network are introduced, namely consistent power loss rule (CPLR) and consistent impedance rule (CIR) originated from impedance analysis method for sub/super oscillation research. Then influence of equivalent impedance value of connecting network is discussed on stability analyses under large and small disturbances. Finally, the applicability of two equivalence rules to stability analyses are compared. Results show that for small disturbance stability analysis and phase locked loop (PLL) related transient synchronization instability, CPLR based simplified equivalent model may cause biased results or wrong conclusions, while CIR displays a better applicability.

articleTitle: Optimal allocation of energy storage participating in peak shaving based on improved hybrid particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing number of photovoltaic grid-connected in recent years, severe challenges are faced in the peak-shaving process of the power grid. Consequently, a rational optimization for allocating energy storage resources in the power grid has become a key and urgent issue to be studied. The economy and safety of energy storage involving in peak regulation is fully considered by this paper. Firstly, the objective function is obtained from the net income and average peak shaving difference function of the participating energy storages during peak shaving. The objective function is further normalized by combining the idea of matrix standardization using the Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to an Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) with the linear weighting method. Secondly, the objective function is functioned with the constraints under three aspects: power constraint, the capacity of storaging the energy, maximum and minimum power constraints and energy storage SOC constraint. Thirdly, using the genetic algorithm augments the particle swarm optimization algorithm to improve its optimization speed and convergence. Finally, the simulation is implemented in MATLAB software, which verifies the proposed improved hybrid particle swarm optimization algorithm. The proposed method benefits in fast convergence speed and strong global optimization ability.

Author Keywords: Distance method of superior and inferior solutions
Hybrid particle swarm optimization: Optimal configuration for energy storage and downpeak configuration

articleTitle: On-line monitoring method of UHV converter vacuum on-load tap changer based on acoustic and electrical combination
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The UHV converter transformer is the core equipment of the DC transmission system, and the safety and reliability of the OLTC is crucial to the DC transmission system. Once the OLTC breaks down, it can cause the line to trip and lose the transmission power, or it can cause the converter to burn, causing huge economic losses and adverse social impact. Therefore, this paper proposes an online monitoring method based on the combination of sound and electricity for the UHV converter vacuum on-load tap changer. The time-domain and frequency-domain characteristic signals of online monitoring signals are analyzed, and the OLTC vibration signal and motor current signal are separated by the differential endpoint detection method, and the field application is realized, which provides a basis for the fault warning of UHV converter vacuum on-load tap changer.

articleTitle: The International practice and enlightenment of capacity compensation mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the large-scale development of renewable energy and its integration into the power system, as well as the withdrawal of fossil energy units under the carbon neutral target, the issue of generating capacity adequacy has once again been widely concerned by the power market design. Based on the practice of electric power capacity adequacy mechanism in various countries, this paper compares the scarce electricity price mechanism, capacity subsidy mechanism and capacity market mechanism from the aspects of mechanism triggering, demand generation, trading products, trading volume, trading price, procurement responsibility subject, price stability, investment guidance, implementation difficulty, impact on the electric energy market and applicable scenarios. Finally, according to the current electricity market reform environment, the corresponding policy suggestions are put forward for the construction of power capacity compensation mechanism in China.

articleTitle: Fault line selection method of distribution network based on multi-information fusion of CNN-BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the protection is prone to misoperation and refuse to operate when the single-phase disconnection and grounding fault occurs in the parallel power supply line of the distribution network neutral ungrounded system, and it is difficult to determine which of the parallel lines is in fault, a line selection method based on multi-information fusion of CNN-BP neural network is proposed. This paper makes full use of the fault zero-sequence current and phase current waveform information, the fault line selection method based on multi-information fusion of CNN-BP neural network is applied to the parallel power supply line of distribution network.

articleTitle: Design and Development of New Solid-state DC Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Solid-state DC circuit breakers are key equipment for the protection of medium and low voltage DC systems and are the most effective means of isolating short-circuit faults. With the development of high-power power electronics, the performance of solid-state DC circuit breakers has also improved. In this paper, a new topology of anti-parallel connection is proposed based on the reverse blocking IGCT, which requires fewer switches, lower cost and smaller loss than the anti-series and diode-bridge structure. Besides, a snubber branch design method based on MOV-C is proposed, which can effectively suppress the breaking overvoltage and AC harmonics. Finally, a prototype of low-voltage solid-state DC circuit breaker with rated voltage of 750V was developed, and the breaking test and temperature test were carried out.

articleTitle: A Noval Calibration Based on Genetic Algorithm for Pipelined ADC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a multi-dimensional multiple digital-to-analog converter (MDAC) calibration for pipelined analog-to-digital converter (ADC). The proposed multi-dimensional MDAC digital domain compensation model can be compatible with pseudo-random number (PN) injection error compensation while realizing capacitance mismatch and static inter-stage gain error compensation, and can also be successfully connected with background calibration for dynamic inter-stage gain error. A multi-dimensional coefficient extraction based on genetic algorithm is also proposed, which can accurately extract the required compensation coefficient and avoid falling into local traps. The test results show that the signal-to-noise-and-distortion ratio (SNDR)/spurious-free dynamic range (SFDR) are increased by 7.24 dB/11.91 dB respectively with foreground calibration at 25°C; With the help of background calibration at 85°C, SNDR and SFDR are increased by 3.13 dB and 5.15 dB.

articleTitle: Harmonic current simulation and test based on synthetic circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The synthetic circuit test method has become an important method for the test of breaking performance of circuit breakers. As an effective breaking performance test platform, the synthetic test circuit can truly simulate the operating environment of circuit breakers, but also taking into account economic advantages. In order to accurately simulate the operating environment of circuit breaker under the conditions of the novel power system, the synthetic circuit parameter design of harmonic conditions was performed. Based on the Matlab/Simulink platform, the simulation model of the synthetic circuit has been built to verify the accuracy of parameters. And test verification in the synthetic circuit is performed to verify the feasibility. Finally, the Fourier transformation is used for analysis, and the results indicate that the designed cast parameters can accurately synthesize the harmonious wave shape, the results could meet expectations.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Mechanical Performance of 500kV Transformer Ascending Flanged Base Under Vibration Excitation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As an important outlet structure of the transformer, the ascending flanged base has the characteristics of large lead current, high electric field and complex distribution. Due to the electromagnetic force on the winding and the magnetostriction of the iron core, the transformer will vibrate during operation. In this paper, modal analysis is used to obtain the natural frequency and vibration mode of the ascending flanged base, and harmonic response analysis is used to obtain its frequency response. Finally, random vibration analysis is used to find that the weakest structure of the raised seat is the bolt connected to the pressure equalizing ball, and the life of the bolt was predicted to be about 35000 h. Through the simulation analysis, the mechanical properties of the ascending flanged base are obtained, which provides a reference for the fault detection and structural optimization.

articleTitle: Characterization of the structural vibration response of the driven motor used for propeller systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The propeller aerodynamic noise test platform puts forward strict requirements for propeller drive motors, and the motors featuring smaller diameters, higher torques as well as lower noise are highly desirable. Compared with the commonly used DC motor and induction motor, the permanent magnet motor posses a large number of merits, which can meet the above mentioned requirements exactly. First, the electromagnetic structure design of 180kW permanent magnet motor was carried out according to the requirements for the propeller drive motor; then, by resorting to the comprehensive analysis of the electromagnetic excitation characteristics and structural vibration characteristics of the permanent magnet motor, it was concluded that no resonance would occur under the working states of the motor; Besides, the structural modal tests verified the accuracy and effectiveness of the analysis for the vibration characteristics of the motor structure, which ensured the smooth operation of the propeller test platform. Finally, it is clearly shown that the simulation approach adopted in this paper is relatively accurate and reliable, which can lay the foundation for the development of low-noise drive motors for the propeller aerodynamic noise test platform. Moreover, it also implies that this kind of motor has engineering value for practical application.

articleTitle: Modeling and efficiency optimized control of DD Orthogonal wireless power transfer system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the harsh operating environment of deep sea, the underwater autonomous vehicle is affected by the seawater disturbance, and the magnetic coupling structure may have certain offset, causing the transmission power and transfer efficiency of the system to decrease. In this paper, an equivalent mathematical model of DD orthogonal wireless power transfer system is established to analyze the output characteristics of the system; the influence of the input voltage amplitude and phase difference of the resonant network on the transmission power and transfer efficiency is studied; an efficiency optimization control strategy is proposed to optimize the system efficiency and control the output power by controlling the ratio of the input voltage amplitude of the resonant network; Finally, it is experimentally verified that after using this control strategy, the efficiency of the magnetic coupling structure is improved by 1.7% under the case of 100mm x-axis offset, and the system can still maintain stable and efficient power transfer under the situation that the coupling coefficient changes in a wide range.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control for Conveyor Collision Servo by PMSM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing application of permanent magnet synchronous machines (PMSM), the instability of the sensor becomes an important factor that threatens the reliability of the servo system based on it. The research of the sensorless control has reached such a pitch, and the sharp change of load is one of the difficulties. This paper proposes a scheme based on the conservation of momentum to solve the problem. The rotor position is estimated by a convex optimization method during the whole process. With the help of the mechanical equation model, supplemented by the extended Kalman filter (EKF) for data fusion, the speed estimate is obtained. And the momentum conservation theorem is introduced to correct the estimation when the load changes dramatically. Finally, the technology is simulated and verified by taking conveyor as an example.

articleTitle: Networking scheme of regional medium/low voltage AC/DC hybrid distribution systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: AC/DC hybrid distribution systems have high controllability and flexibility, which can meet the requirements of topology construction in various scenarios. Especially for the distribution systems with the distributed generation, this hybrid distribution network can effectively realize the high-quality consumption of distributed generation and meet with the high reliability requirements of users. In this paper, the networking interconnection device is explored aiming at the analysis of AC/DC hybrid distribution demand based on the networking principle of AC/DC hybrid distribution system. The structure of AC/DC hybrid distribution system is designed based on DC line interconnection and the scenario-oriented AC/DC hybrid power distribution networking scheme is constructed.

articleTitle: Wind Farm Power Support based Transient Stability Collaborative Emergency Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a wind farm power support based collaborative emergency control strategy to guarantee the stability of the post-fault power systems. Firstly, the mathematical equation between the needed control quantity and the system parameters is deduced. Secondly, the analytical equation between the provided control quantity and the number of wind farms participating in the power support is derived, and the participation sequence is determined based on the post-fault unstable equilibrium points, while the participation sequence is further employed to form candidate control schemes. Finally, the test power system integrated with multiple wind farms is utilized to validate the effectiveness of the proposed collaborative emergency control strategy.

articleTitle: A Magnetic Coupling Structure Design of Wireless Charging UAVs with Multidirectional Misalignment Improvement and Output Fluctuation Suppression
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a design of a novel magnetic coupling structure, which is featured a strong anti-misalignment ability for reliable charging to unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The strong tolerance is not only limited to rotational misalignment but also to diagonal, lateral, and longitudinal offsets, thanks to the presented magnetic coupling structure. Specifically, the transmitter (Tx) consists of eight solenoid coils and one regular octagon coil, forming a magnetic field between the center and the periphery. To make use of this field, two rectangular coils are mounted on the landing gears with the consideration of the intrinsic shape and space of the landing gears of commercial UAVs. The air-core receivers also save valuable on-board weight. With the help of such a well-designed coupling mechanism, the presented system can tolerate all 360° rotational misalignments and large-distance horizontal offset, i.e., <tex>$(-50\ \text{mm}.-50\ \text{mm})\leq(x, y)\leq(50\ \text{mm},50\ \text{mm})$</tex>.

articleTitle: Complex vector decoupling and Delay compensation for PMSM at Low Carrier Ratio
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: PI current controller based on synchronous reference frame has been widely used in industry. It has high reliability and easy to use. However, when the permanent magnet synchronous motor(PMSM) operates at a higher speed, the ratio of the inverter switching frequency to the motor operating frequency(carrier ratio) is low, which intensifies the coupling between the <tex>$d$</tex>-axis current and the <tex>$q$</tex>-axis current of the PMSM. This will cause the current to oscillation, and even lead to the current out of control. In this paper, the complex vector decoupling method is used to control the motor current, which improves the current coupling and the dynamic performance of the system. In addition, the low carrier ratio will also aggravate the delay problem in the drive system. This paper analyzes this problem and adopts the phase compensation to solve it. Simulation and experiment verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Active Suppression Technology of Common-Mode Electromagnetic Interference in Three-Phase Two-Level Inverter Based on Four-Bridge Topology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper focus on the common mode (CM) electromagnetic interference (EMI) problem of three-phase two-level inverter. Firstly, the three-phase four-leg topology is analyzed. The analysis results point out that the output filter midpoint voltage can be used as the observation point of CM voltage. Then the actual suppression effect of CM voltage can be observed. Furthermore, an active suppression technology based on three-phase four-leg topology is proposed. The action delay of the semiconductor is analyzed by statistical method. It is pointed out that the action delay of the semiconductors is not related to the DC side voltage and the magnitude of the current flowing through the semiconductor, but only related to the direction of the current flowing through the semiconductor. Then, an optimization modulation algorithm for compensating the action delay of the semiconductor is proposed, which effectively improves the compensation effect of the fourth leg.

articleTitle: Analysis of armature current assisted suspension force control of EDS maglev
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In superconducting electrical Suspension (EDS) maglev., lack of suspension force at low speed is an important problem remaining to be solved. This paper presents a method to increase the suspension force at low speed by armature current control of linear motor. Firstly., the mathematical model of Superconducting linear motor and suspension system of EDS maglev is established by space harmonic method. Based on the model., suspension force control system is built. By controlling the armature d-axis current., linear motor generates electromagnetic force in the suspension direction., which realizes the control of the suspension height. Besides., the control system can provide auxiliary suspension force at low speed., and produce damping force to suppress the suspension force fluctuations during operation. At last., the finite element model of EDS vehicle is established., and the simulation results verify the correctness of mathematical model.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Capacity Configuration of Interconnected Regional Integrated Energy Systems Based on Markov Model and Cooperative Game
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the dual carbon goal, the regional integrated energy system of the distribution side where distributed generation source is widely connected should be reasonably planned and configured to realize the sharing of energy storage, which would promote the high consumption of renewable energy and improve the stability of the system. In this paper, considering the uncertainty of renewable energy output in the region, a stochastic planning model of energy storage capacity allocation is first established based on Markov model. Secondly, considering that the cooperation between regions in energy trading would reduce their own operating costs, an optimal allocation model of interconnected multi-region energy storage capacity based on Nash bargaining is developed. The nonlinear model is then transformed into two linear subproblems and solved by the alternating direction multiplier method. Finally, the decision results under different scenarios and schemes are analyzed by numerical examples to verify that the proposed model could reasonably configure the energy storage capacity, and effectively reduce the cost of each region, carbon emissions and photovoltaic curtailment.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Inductive Power Transfer for Unmanned Underwater Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV) is an important equipment for human exploration and the development of marine resources. UUV's long-term cruise relies on timely power replenishment, in which wireless charging is a feasible way. In some special cases, in addition to charging the UUVs by the charging base station, it is also necessary to exchange power among different UUVs. This paper initially analyzes a bidirectional inductive power transfer (B-IPT) system designed for UUVs and assesses the efficiency of both forward and reverse transmission using an equivalent mutual inductance network. Subsequently, the dependence of forward and reverse efficiency on mutual inductance and load variations is obtained; then, an integration structure of magnetic coupler and cabin is proposed. Finally, an 800W B-IPT system is implemented. The forward energy transfer efficiency is measured to be 82.18%, while the reverse efficiency is found to be 73.63%.

articleTitle: Position sensorless switching control strategy of SPMSMs based on fault tolerance of position sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a switching method based on model reference adaptive system (MRAS) from position sensor control strategy to sensorless control strategy for surface permanent magnet synchronous motor (SPMSM) drives operating in medium and high velocity regions. The proposed switching method can effectively deal with the fault of the position sensor in SPMSM system, so as to improve its safety and stability. The sensor setting of control strategy consists of an actual sensor (position sensor) and the virtual sensor (MRAS). When the system position sensor has no fault, the feedback value of the position sensor has a greater weight on the information of the rotor position and velocity of the closed-loop system, while the weight of the MRAS estimated value is lower. When the position sensor fails, the information of the rotor position and velocity of the closed-loop system is provided by MRAS algorithm. Also, a linear weighted switching method is proposed, which can effectively reduce the motor fluctuation during the switching process. The feasibility of the proposed strategy is confirmed via simulations of SPMSM drive model in MATLAB/Simulink software.

articleTitle: Study on Electromagnetic Shielding of Pulse Inductor in CFETR Quenching Protection System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The pulse inductor is one of the important components of the inductor cabinet in the quench protection system of the China Fusion Engineering Test Reactor (CFETR). In this paper, the shielding research on the pulse magnetic field of the inductor is carried out. Under extreme working conditions, the high-intensity magnetic field can generate electric sparks on the surface of the cabinet and has an adverse influence on the other internal equipment. The influence of different materials and sizes on the shielding effect is compared, and a feasible design scheme according to the limit of the actual cabinet is proposed. The new shielding device can effectively reduce the magnetic induction around the inductor.

articleTitle: Toward accurate online state of power estimation for lithium-ion batteries in electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: State of power (SOP) is a key index for the evaluation of lithium-ion battery peak power performance in electric vehicles. Battery SOP estimation highly relies on accurate battery modelling. However, most existing approaches employed a first-order resistor-capacitance model due to its simple structure, which will lead to biased SOP estimations for a relatively lengthy prediction window. In this paper, an online SOP estimation method is proposed based on a partial-adaptive fractional-order model (P A-FOM). First, this P A-FOM separately considers the time constants for battery transient responses under loads and during relaxations. Second, the parameterization of the P A-FOM combines both offline and online techniques to accommodate fast dynamics of a battery under changeable load conditions and relatively slow dynamics in a lengthy prediction window. Third, the proposed SOP estimation method linearizes the P A-FOM only at the beginning of a prediction window, thus retaining its nonlinear characteristic to the greatest extent. Experimental validations have demonstrated the promising performance of the proposed method under an EV driving profile.

articleTitle: Investigation of A Two-Dimensional Model for Cogging Torque Calculation in Homopolar Inductor Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Since homopolar inductor machines (HIMs) have a three-dimensional (3-D) magnetic circuit, the researchers usually build a 3-D finite element model (FEM) to accurately predict the HIM cogging torque, which is very time-consuming. To solve this problem, a two-dimensional (2-D) FEM is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the analytical expressions of the HIM cogging torque are derived. Based on the cogging torque expressions, the equivalent principles between 3-D and 2-D FEM are investigated. According to the equivalent principles, the 2-D FEM used for computing the HIM cogging torque can be obtained. To display the 2-D model more vividly, a 48-slot/4-tooth (48 <tex>$S\ 4T$</tex>) permanent magnet (PM) HIM is exampled and its 2-D FEM is proposed. The 2-D FEM of the 48S4T PM HIM is excited by a field winding. The structure, turn number of field winding and field current amplitude of the 2-D model are illustrated in detail. Furthermore, the differences between the existing 2-D and the proposed 2-D FEM are analyzed. Finally, the cogging torque in the 48 <tex>$S\ 4T$</tex> PM HIMs with different rotor tooth-arc to tooth-pitch ratios is computed by their 3-D, existing 2-D and proposed 2-D FEMs, respectively. The results indicate that, compared with the existing 2-D FEM, the proposed 2-D FEM can effectively save the computation time and has the similar computation accuracy as the 3-D FEM. The experimental verification is also carried out on a prototype of the 48 <tex>$S\ 4T$</tex> PM HIM. The error between the maximum cogging torque obtained by the proposed 2-D FEM and the experiments is only 2.12%

articleTitle: Surrogate Model Based on POD-Kriging for Fast Analysis of Electrical Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Finite Element (FE) analysis is widely employed to analyze electrical devices due to its remarkable accuracy. However, it can prove to be time-consuming, especially for multi-physics simulations. To overcome this challenge, a combination of proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) and Kriging interpolation is utilized to create a surrogate model, which can provide quick approximations of FE solutions. In this study, the POD-Kriging approach is implemented to examine the steady current-heat conduction transient problem in a dry-type transformer.

articleTitle: Pulse Power Stabilizing Technology based on Combined Control of Hybrid Energy Storage Systems and Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the emergence of high-power density generators and the improvement of battery performance, more electric aircraft (MEA) are becoming the development direction in the aviation military field. At the actual tactical level, directed energy weapons effectively improve the technical and tactical performance of the equipment. However, the pulsed power electronic loads place higher demands on the stability of independent electric power distribution systems (EPDSs). This paper mainly focuses on the voltage stability of the 270 V high-voltage DC power system and proposes a joint droop control-based hybrid energy storage system and brushless DC motor smoothing technique, which achieves a better smoothing effect under high peak-to-average ratio pulsed power loads. The simulation results based on the PLECS simulation model validate the effectiveness of the proposed combined control approach in enhancing the stability of the aircraft's EPDS containing multiple loads.

articleTitle: Grid-forming Control of the Grid-connected Voltage Source Converter System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the grid-connected converter system with intermittent and fluctuating input power, a grid-forming control strategy is proposed in this paper. The control strategy takes the dc-link voltage as the control target, and the autonomous synchronization is realized according to the dynamics of dc-link capacitor. The cascaded control structure with the outer power loop, middle voltage loop and inner current loop is adopted for the grid-connected converter. Under this control structure, the dc-link voltage of the grid-connected converter can track the grid frequency and play the role of a frequency-locked loop. Moreover, a startup control loop and flexible startup control method for this grid-forming voltage source converter system are proposed, which can improve the engineering application value of this grid-forming control strategy. Finally, by building the simulation model of grid-connected voltage source converter system in Matlab/Simulink, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization of Double-D Orthogonal Coil in the Underwater Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This article presents a novel design and optimization method for a double-D (DD) orthogonal coil in the wireless power transfer (WPT) system for underwater environments, with the aim of maximizing power transfer efficiency and power transfer density. First, a magnetic circuit model of the DD orthogonal coil is developed to analyze the influence of each coil parameter on its performance. Finite element simulations are then performed to validate the proposed model and further analyze the parameters. Based on this analysis, design guidelines for multi-objective optimization are presented. The Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm (NSGA-II) is used to optimize the coil parameters for power transfer efficiency and power transfer density. The Pareto front of the coil coupling coefficient and quality factor is obtained for efficiency and transfer density in underwater environments. Finally, a 3-kW DD orthogonal coil experimental system is built and tested, and the experimental results demonstrate that the proposed DD orthogonal coil achieves a higher transmission efficiency and energy transfer density of 91.73% and 33.78kW/m2, respectively. Notably, even at a misalignment of 100 mm, a transfer efficiency of 89.78% is achieved.

articleTitle: UAV Transmission Line Inspection Algorithm Based on Cross-scale Feature Fusion and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Insulators play an important role in transmission lines and almost 81.3% of power accidents in the power transmission system are caused by insulator defects. Hence, insulator identification is an important task in the process of UAV inspection. However, due to the interference of complex environment, it is difficult to identify multiple targets or small targets with the normal detection of UAV. In this paper, a YOLOv7 insulator recognition algorithm based on cross-scale feature fusion and attention mechanism is proposed. First, the YOLOv7 model framework is built. In order to reduce the interference brought by the complex inspection environment, the attention mechanism is introduced to improve the contrast between the detection target and the background. Secondly, the FPN+PAN structure in the original framework is converted into BiFPN structure, which increases the ability of cross-scale feature fusion. Secondly, in the neck part, Focus layer is selected to replace MP module, which preserves the integrity of feature extraction. Then, the original SPPCSPC structure of the space pooling layer is replaced by SPPFCSPC structure to improve its computing speed. Finally, a case study is implemented to verify the accuracy and timeliness of the proposed algorithm. The results show that the proposed algorithm can achieve good results in insulator image recognition, with an average accuracy of 97.8%.

articleTitle: Fault line selection method of distribution network based on improved Neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to determine the fault line when the single-phase grounding fault occurs in the small current grounding system of the distribution network, a fault line selection method based on the improved sparrow search algorithm (ISSA) is proposed. First of all, based on the good characteristics of the search strategy of the bird swarm algorithm, the position of the discoverer and the joiner in the sparrow search algorithm (SSA) is improved to solve the problem that its individual is easy to jump to the optimal solution and fall into the local optimal solution. Then, an improved neural network (ISSA-BP) model is constructed. The simulation and physical platform experiment results show that this method can accurately select the fault line without noise interference under different fault conditions, and its accuracy and speed are better than BP, PSO-BP, SSA-BP neural network models under the same parameters.

articleTitle: Average Voltage Observer Based Distributed Secondary Sliding Mode Control with Reactive Power Sharing for Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Combining distributed power generation units into self-operating islanded microgrids is conducive to improving the penetration rate of new energy power generation. However, the impedance mismatch leads to the contradiction between voltage regulation and reactive power sharing in islanded microgrids. To this end, based on the average voltage observer, this paper proposes a distributed sliding mode secondary control strategy, which can adjust the average voltage of the microgrid to the reference value while realizing reactive power sharing. In this paper, first, the hierarchical control architecture for islanded mi-crogrids based on droop control is shown; next, the deficiencies of the primary control are analyzed, and the goals of the secondary control are given; after that, the average voltage observer used in secondary control is introduced; then, the distributed sliding mode secondary voltage controller is designed by selecting the sliding mode function combined with the exponential reaching law; finally, the simulation experiment is carried out to verify the performance of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Power Safety Management and Control Based on the Risk Fusion Model of Object Detection and Power Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power safety operations have always been a serious topic and a shallow research field. The issue of electricity security involves a wide variety of targets of all sizes. Therefore, this paper proposes a method for power safety management and control based on the risk fusion model of object detection and power operation scenario. Firstly, the object detection model is established, and then different image processing methods are used for the two situations that require scene recognition and scene recognition, and finally various risk detection standards are established and detected and identified. The test results verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Portfolio of Wind-solar-hydro Hybrid Renewable Generation based on Variable Speed Pumped Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Compared with separate solar or wind generation, the hybrid wind-solar-hydro renewable portfolio can achieve better generation characteristics due to their temporal-spatial complementarities. This paper proposes optimal portfolio of wind-solar-hydro hybrid renewable generation based on variable speed pumped storage (VSPS). In this portfolio, the complementarities of hydro-solar-wind hybrid renewable energy sources (RESs) are fully exploited via various conversion and storage devices for zero carbon 100% renewable supplies. Compared to traditional fixed speed pumped storage (FSPS), the VSPS has obvious advantages in power regulation and renewable accommodation, which is comprehensively modeled to capture its dynamic operational dispatchability and flexibility. The portfolio production, conversion, storage, and consumption are formulated via a two-stage framework, which takes the minimum system investment cost as the objective function. Case studies on southwest China are performed to show the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed methodology on cost-effective accommodation.

articleTitle: Magnetic Integration of Coupled-Inductor with Optimized Air-Gaps for A CRM Buck Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: PCB-winding-based planar have been widely adopted for high-frequency, high-power-density, and high-efficiency power conversion. Due to the planarized structure of the magnetics, the position of the air gaps in a planar inductor dominates the flux distribution in the magnetic core, thus the core loss is closely related to the position of the air gaps. This paper thoroughly analyzes the flux in the magnetic core of a four-pole structure coupled inductor for a critical-mode (CRM) Buck converter and studies an optimized four-pole structure with improved air gap configuration to reduce the core loss, as well as the height of the inductor, and to improve its efficiency and power density. The influence mechanism of the air gap position on core loss is revealed, and a detailed optimal design of the studied structure is presented. To verify the effectiveness of the studied coupled inductor, a prototype with a height of 7mm, a power density of 800W/in3, and a peak efficiency of 99% is developed.

articleTitle: Sensorless control of PMSM based on a high-frequency injection using a complex-valued filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The traditional high-frequency (HF) injection-based sensorless control uses a band-pass filter (BPF) and a low-pass filter (LPF) for position signal demodulation, however, their narrow bandwidth limits the convergence rate of the sensorless control and can result in instability issue. In this work, a complex-valued filter (CVF) is proposed to demodulate the critical signal for position estimation, which features no phase delay and can replace LPF and BPF. Along this way, a phase-locked loop with selective harmonic compensation (SHC-PLL) is suggested to cancel the HF harmonics in the estimated speed, which further improves the estimation precision of the position. Finally, the proposed method is verified by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Voltage and Reactive Power Coordinated Control Strategy for Distribution Networks Utilizing Gaining-Sharing Knowledge Based Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Existing heuristic optimization algorithms are prone to obtain a set of non-dominated solutions overconcentrated within an intermediate area in the objective space. It results in a poor diversity performance of the Pareto front when handling the problem on multi-objective voltage and reactive power coordinated control (MOVRPOC). For mitigating the aforementioned disadvantages, a newly developed heuristic algorithm, gaining-sharing knowledge based algorithm (GSK), is implemented to handle the problem of MOVRPOC. Then, the minimum system losses, the minimum average voltage deviation and the minimum curtailment rate are treated as optimization objectives, and then the revised IEEE 33-bus distribution system is utilized as the benchmark networks.
