Grey wolf optimization (GWO) and equilibrium optimizer (EO) are taken as a comparison to validate the improvement on diversity of GSK. The results reveal that GSK is capable to obtain more diverse non-dominated solutions to MOVRPOC for distributed networks, which can be better applied to the practical scenarios on MOVRPOC distribution networks.

Author Keywords: Multi-objective voltage and reactive power coordinated control (MOVRPOC)

articleTitle: False grounding phenomenon of medium voltage distribution network and its solution
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the false grounding phenomenon of medium voltage distribution network caused by the increase of grid investment construction scale and the automatic tuning of arc suppression coils, this paper analyzes the false grounding phenomenon and its causes on the basis of the failure of the arc suppression coil damping device of Dandong power grid. The system neutral point asymmetric voltage and unbalanced degree model are built, using the theory of three-phase voltage imbalance. The measures to reduce the distribution network neutral displacement voltage are given by analyzing the mechanism of neutral displacement voltage rise and false grounding. The greater the capacitance current of system, the smaller the arc suppression coil damping effect. According to this phenomenon, in combination with the practical situation of 220kV LangTou substation and 220kV Gangcheng substation, it is proved that the reasonable system operation mode can effectively reduce the imbalance of the conductor and reduce the displacement voltage of neural point by theoretical calculation and data comparison before and after the adjustment of operation mode. So the false grounding in 66kV system can be eliminated.

articleTitle: Short-term prediction of offshore wind power based on an improved N-BEATSX model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Short-term forecasting of offshore wind power plays an essential role in ensuring the safe and stable operation of the grid. Due to the high randomness and variability of offshore wind power, it is difficulty to acquire good results by traditional trend extrapolation of time series of historical power data. In this regard, a novel N-BEATSX model improved by Copula entropy is proposed as a short-term prediction method for offshore wind power. First, the Copula entropy metrics are used to filter predictors to obtaining factors highly relevant to the active power output of offshore wind. Secondly, the auxiliary and historical power data from the wind farms are imported into the N-BEATSX model for future wind power forecasting. Finally, a numerical example is given to demonstrate the feasibility of the developed method. Comparing the prediction results of the proposed model with those of other models, it is demonstrated that the proposed method improves the accuracy of short-term prediction of offshore wind power.

articleTitle: Research on Electrical Safety of Live-line Work of Ground Wire for UHV/EHV Transmission Line Based on Helicopter Winch Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Helicopter winch method has the advantages of flexible operation, convenience and efficiency, and high safety. In order to solve the difficulties in the maintenance of conventional overhead ground wire, the helicopter winch method can be applied to the live maintenance of overhead ground wire. In this paper, the electrical safety and protective measures for ground wire repair for UHV/EHV transmission line based on the helicopter winch method are studied. The minimum safety distance and the minimum combined clearance are obtained by carrying out switching impulse discharge test for live working gap under the typical working conditions. To ensure the safety of the helicopter body and live workers, the induced electricity characteristics of overhead ground wire for UHV/EHV transmission line are analyzed, and the minimum effective insulation length of insulated rope for hanging maintenance workers and safety protection measures are studied. Finally, the field application of helicopter winch method for live-line work of ground wire has been successfully carried out, which proves the feasibility, safety and efficiency of helicopter winch method, and lays a foundation for the promotion and application of this maintenance method.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Investment Benefits for the Incremental Distribution Network based on System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Penetration level of distributed power sources in the incremental distribution network (IDN) has continued to rise. How to clarify the dynamic relationship among various participants in the IDN and analyze the influencing factors that affecting investment benefits has become the key to the planning, investment, and operation of the IDN. This paper thus establishes a multi-agent competitive evaluation model of investment benefits for the IDN with the distributed renewable energy under multiple scenarios based on the system dynamics modeling. The economic evaluation is carried out through the indicators of net present value and the rate of net present value. Sensitivity analysis is then carried out on key parameters including electricity wheeling tariffs, the electricity consumption by large industrial customers, and the electricity sale price for large industrial customers. The model can be used to scientifically analyze the investment benefits of IDNs with distributed power supply, provide suggestions for the collaborative development of IDN and renewable energy, and provide decision-making basis for capital investment in IDNs.

articleTitle: Deadbeat Predictive Current Control Based on Accurate Discrete Luenberger Observer for PMSM under Low Frequency Ratio
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of discrete truncation error and parameter sensitivity of traditional deadbeat predictive current control under low frequency ratio, a deadbeat predictive current control based on accurate discrete Luenberger observer for permanent magnet synchronous motor is proposed. In order to eliminate the angle delay caused by coordinate transformation, an accurate discrete model of permanent magnet synchronous motor is established in the <tex>$\alpha\beta$</tex>-axes. On this basis, an accurate model deadbeat predictive current control is designed. At the same time, in order to suppress the steady-state error of deadbeat predictive current control caused by parameter mismatch, an accurate discrete Luenberger observer is embedded in the deadbeat predictive current control, which directly designs the parameters of the Luenberger observer in the discrete domain, and analyzes the stability of the accurate discrete Luenberger observer. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified on a 2.1 kW permanent magnet synchronous motor experimental platform.

articleTitle: Optimal Reactive Power Adjustment Based on Jacobi Matrix Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of excessive reactive power and high voltage caused by renewable energy connection and the increase of the proportion of cables, a reactive power optimization approach based on the Jacobi matrix decomposition is proposed. The voltage sensitivity is obtained based on the Jacobi matrix decomposition. The reactive power resources sensitivity and reactive power network loss sensitivity are combined to determine the buses where the reactive power adjustment is carried out. The scheme of reactive power optimization that meets the voltage adjustment requirements is obtained through an iterative convergence calculation method. An urban power system is taken as the case study, which shows that the proposed method can optimize the reactive power voltage optimization effectively.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Location Method for Multi-branch Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of fault location for distribution network, a novel fault location method is proposed in this paper. According to transmission characteristics of traveling wave, multi-branch distribution network can be divided into multi-level T -branches. And a three-terminal fault matrix is defined. By the analysis of fault characteristic in the three-terminal fault matrix, an identification principle of potential fault line is built. Then, according the potential fault line, a new three-terminal fault matrix is established. The scope of fault line is gradually narrowed until the potential fault line is the real fault line. Simulations show that the proposed method can locate faults accurately and improve reliability of fault location for distribution network.

articleTitle: Electro-thermal-mechanical multiphysics coupling analysis for the short-circuit failure of Si/SiC cascode device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the short-circuit failure mechanisms of 650V Si/SiC Cascode device at 400V DC voltage has been investigated using experiment and finite element method (FEM), considering electrical, thermal and mechanical stresses. It is found that the typical thermal-runaway fault occurs due to the rapid rise of temperature caused by the power loss of high-voltage (HV) JFET in the short-circuit case. The thermal and mechanical co-simulation results show that cracks occur in SiC JFET gate electrode and drain electrode due to mechanical stress, which is reflected in Si/SiC Cascode device leakage current and failure of drain source.

articleTitle: Mechanism Analysis and Application of PSS4B to Suppress Ultra Low Frequency Oscillation in Power Grid With High Shares of Hydropower
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Yunnan power grid is a typical hydropower grid in China, which may be the main cause for ultra-low frequency power oscillation in Yunnan power grid in recent years according to some research results. An effective solution to suppress ultra-low frequency oscillation is to add PSS control to the excitation system of hydropower units. Compared with the conventional single-band PSS, PSS4B has higher order and control freedom with three independently adjustable phase compensation branches for low, medium and high frequency bands. Firstly, this paper analyzes the negative damping characteristics of the hydropower in the low frequency and reproduces the ultra-low frequency oscillation phenomenon based on RTDS real-time simulation. Then the mechanism of PSS4B to suppress the ULF(ultra-Iow frequency) oscillation is analyzed. The parameters of PSS4B are adjusted and PSS4B is applied to the main hydropower unit (NZD plant) of Yunnan Power Grid. The ULF oscillation is successfully suppressed, which verifies the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Basic Modulation Strategy and Sub-module Voltage Balancing Control for Half-Wave Inverter AC-AC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Flexible low-frequency transmission technology has competitive advantages in offshore wind power transmission, and the converter is the key equipment of flexible low-frequency transmission technology. According to the requirements of high-voltage and large-capacity scenarios, the topology and working principle of a half-wave variable-frequency AC converter applied to flexible low-frequency transmission are introduced. The topology can realize four-quadrant operation, and the number of sub-modules at the same voltage level is less than that of a modular multi-level matrix converter (M3C). On this basis, the modulation strategy and the sub-module capacitor voltage control are studied, and a sub-module capacitor voltage balance throwing strategy based on the nearest level approximation is proposed. This method can quickly realize the output voltage modulation, effectively control the capacitor voltage unbalance, and reduce the switching loss. Finally, MATLAB/Simulink simulation is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed throwing strategy in the half-wave low-frequency AC converter.

articleTitle: Dynamic performance of Controllable Line-Commutated Converter (CLCC) in HVDC systems with weak sending end AC network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Both the sending end and the receiving end AC network of long distance HVDC systems are getting weaker and weaker, with fast growing renewable energy penetration under “dual carbon” scenario. The inherent defect of HVDC-commutation failure has become a more prominent problem. The Controllable Line-Commutated Converter (CLCC) raised recently has been proved to be effective to eliminate commutation failure. This paper aims to discuss the dynamic performance of CLCC in HVDC systems with weak sending end AC network. Firstly, the circuit topology and operation principle of CLCC are introduced. Then the dynamic performance of CLCC is theoretically analyzed. Finally, the dynamic performance of the proposed method is validated by simulation on the developed 500kV/1.2kA CLCC HVDC model in PSCAD/EMTDC. And the result shows that compared with LCC-HVDC system, CLCC-HVDC can significantly reduce the impact of active power and reactive power fluctuation imposed on the sending end AC network during the AC fault at the receiving end and greatly improve the stability of the electric power system.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Configuration of Grid-side Energy Storage Considering Operating and Potential Planning Benefits
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the context of energy transformation, energy storage has been widely used on the grid side due to its high energy density and bidirectional power regulation characteristics, which the grid-side energy storage capacity planning problem has become the key. In this paper, an optimal configuration strategy of grid-side energy storage considering energy storage operating and potential planning benefits is proposed, which is considering the operating and potential planning benefits brought by energy storage configuration to the grid side. Firstly, this paper fully analyzes the revenue model of energy storage configuration on the grid side. Then, based on this, a bi-level model of optimal configuration of grid-side energy storage and the solution process of the model is proposed. Finally, a regional power grid is used as an example to verify the optimal configuration capacity of the grid-side energy storage, and the economy of the strategy is analyzed and compared. The results can provide reference for the configuration scale of grid-side energy storage in the region.

articleTitle: Secondary Equipment Placement Strategy Considering Grid Layer Constraints of Screen Cabinets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Modularization is in line with the development trend of smart substations. However, research on the systematic analysis of the influencing factors of smart substation modularization is still lacking. This paper systematically analyzes the influencing factors of smart substation module division from the perspectives of function, space, time, cost and the whole life cycle. Afterward, from the perspective of substation construction cost, the placement of the secondary equipment in the panel cabinet is analyzed, and the corresponding mathematical model is established with the optimization goal of minimizing the number of panel cabinets. Our model can provide the solution with the greatest space utilization on the premise of ensuring the same function as the secondary equipment screen cabinet.

articleTitle: Negative Effect Suppression of Current Measurement Errors in Electric Propulsion System via ILC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the interference of equipment aging, mechanical vibration and other environmental factors, the current sensors in electric propulsion system are prone to gradual measurement problem, such as offset and gain errors. In the case of sensor failure, the motor system will work in a “sub-health state”, and periodic torque disturbance will be introduced into the system. If it is not restrained and compensated, the speed performance of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) will be affected. In order to suppress periodic fluctuation, an iterative learning control (ILC) algorithm with forgetting factor is paralleled on the basis of the traditional speed PI controller. The traditional PI controller is used to ensure the performance of the electric propulsion system, and the ILC algorithm is used to suppress the amplitude of periodic fluctuations. From the simulation results, the proposed algorithm reduces the amplitude of periodic fluctuations by more than half.

articleTitle: Thermal analysis in an axial implantable left ventricular assist device based on multi-physical field simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the implantable left ventricular assist device (LVAD), the heat leads to destroy of blood and potential thrombosis, which remains a limitation to their long-time clinical use. To study the heat distribution in implantable LVADs, a novel multi-physical field method is proposed in this paper, which combines with the numerical model of the cardiovascular system coupled with LVADs. By analyzing the electromagnetic field, the electromagnetic power of the motor was calculated and was considered as heat source in thermal field simulation. An axial LVAD (FW-X pump) was used to validate the proposed model. Based on multi-physical field simulation, the temperature distribution and blood flow were simulated and investigated under different levels of heart failure. The results show that the heat of the FW-X pump mainly came from the copper loss generated by windings of the motor. The temperature on the casing of the FW -X pump and in the blood increased with the increasing electromagnetic power. The peak temperature is 38.57°C, 40.56°C, 41.58°C on the casing of FW-X pump and 38.22°C, 39.18°C, 39.57°C in the blood, respectively, under different levels of heart failure, which were acceptable for clinical applications. The proposed method can be used in LVADs designing and parameter optimization.

articleTitle: Static Hysteresis Process Modeling Based on Modified Tellinen Hysteresis Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Modeling the process of the static magnetic hysteresis accurately is essential to compute the magnetic fields of electrical devices and components, and a modified static hysteresis model based on Tellinen hysteresis model is presented and verified in this paper. Only two measured ascending curves are needed to solve this static model, rather than the limiting loop, which is friendly to measuring device. By comparing the measured static hysteresis curves with the calculated static hysteresis curves, it is found that the static model shows good efficiency and accuracy, and the error caused by Tellinen hysteresis model itself could be negligible when the two measured curves the model demands are close to the curve to be computed.

articleTitle: A novel real-time energy management and monitor framework for the fuel cell hybrid buses
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To improve the energy performance of powertrain system and heuristic strategy used in fuel cell hybrid buses currently for complex traffic scenarios, we propose a real-time energy management and monitor framework in this work. To be specific, dynamic programming is applied online in the cloud level to find optimal energy management strategy from real-world cycle based on the monitor platform. Furthermore, the experiments and simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework can improve the economic performance of object vehicles. As the conclusion, the hydrogen consumption is reduced from 2.47kg to 1.97kg compared with the rule-based strategy. For the energy consumption, the online optimization can reduce it to 27.64 kWh, which decreases by 10.28% in the CWTVC. Therefore, compared with traditional strategy on the fuel cell hybrid bus, the real-time energy management and monitor framework has better energy-saving potential.

articleTitle: A Current-fed Resonant Semi-dual Active Bridge DC-DC Converter with Minimum Input Current Ripple
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a current-fed resonant semi-dual active bridge (semi-DAB) dc-dc converter with LCL resonant tank. The operating principle with the proposed control strategy is analyzed in detail. The resonant current expressions are derived from Fourier fundamental wave analysis. Based on the resonant current expressions, ZVS conditions can be derived. Full range ZVS can be achieved for all the switches in wide input voltage range. In the low voltage side (LVS), the duty cycle of the bottom switches is fixed at 50% to get minimum current ripple. The output power is controlled by the phase shift control. A 1kW experimental prototype is fabricated to verify the effectiveness of the proposed topology.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of transient strong electromagnetic disturbance on acquisition unit port of electronic current transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The influence of transient strong electromagnetic disturbance on electronic transformer is one of the main reasons for its high failure rate, and it has become the most prominent problem faced by the development of electronic transformer technology. According to the statistics of practical fault cases and electromagnetic compatibility tests, surge, electrical fast transient burst and damped oscillatory wave are the main factors causing electromagnetic compatibility faults of electronic transformer, which are the key research content of electromagnetic disturbance suppression of electronic transformer. In this paper, an electronic current transformer product from a domestic mainstream manufacturer was selected, and the surge immunity test, electrical fast transient burstimmunity test and fast damped oscillatory wave immunity test were carried out on the product respectively through the signal and power port of the acquisition unit, which was stricter than the current national standards. The test results verify that electronic transformers have passed the electromagnetic compatibility tests stipulated by the national standards, but there are still problems in the field application, which mainly due to the more severe electromagnetic environment in the substation site. The influence rule of transient strong electromagnetic disturbance on signal and power port of acquisition unit is obtained. The distortion degree of transformer output waveform is positively correlated with the voltage level of electrical fast transient burst. The distortion period of the waveform is consistent with that of the applied electrical fast transient burst. The influence of damped oscillatory wave on transformer is strongly related to the oscillation frequency. The sensitive oscillation frequency depends on the circuit structure of the acquisition unit. The results of this paper are instructive to the electromagnetic protection measures of the acquisition unit of the electronic transformer.

articleTitle: The Research of High Voltage Cross-Passage Control Based on Model Predictive Virtual Vector of Energy Storage Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The traditional high-voltage ride-through strategy for grid-connected energy storage converters presents a slow response speed, which makes it difficult to fulfil the requirements for high-voltage ride-through. To address this issue, this paper proposes a high-voltage ride-through control strategy based on model prediction. The model of the energy storage converter is established, discretized and used to switch the active and reactive current reference values when grid voltage swell is detected. The current predicted value is then adjusted and the cost function is constructed for the selection of optimal vector output. Through MATLAB/Simulink simulations, the proposed strategy is proven to meet the high-voltage ride-through requirements with a fast response speed.

articleTitle: Study on the Trigger Properties of Plasma Injection Excited by Pulse Transformer for 10-kV Smart Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The fast control and protection switch in 10kv smart distribution network required stable trigger conduction at very low operating coefficients and high potential isolation, and the trigger route of plasma injection excited by pulse transformer could effectively meet the above requirements, but the trigger properties remained to be further studied. In this study, the influence of the intermediate energy storage capacitor and its value on the trigger propertied were focused on. The result showed that adopting the intermediate energy storage capacitor could generated the higher trigger voltage and trigger current, which meant that the trigger cavity was easier to conduct and could get more energy infusion, and trigger properties were enhanced; when adopting a larger intermediate energy storage capacitor, the trigger voltage and trigger current would be increased, and the threshold voltage would be lower. Based on the research, it could be known that adopting the intermediate energy storage capacitor with larger value at the secondary side of the pulse transformer could effectively enhance the trigger properties, which provided effective guidance and theory for its application in engineering.

articleTitle: Intelligent Log Analysis Technology for Distributed Energy Production Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the demand of distributed energy production management system for intelligent operation and maintenance, considering the problems in current log analysis method, we propose an intelligent log analysis technology for distributed energy production management system. This technology applies distributed log framework to achieve the collection, storage, analysis and display of various equipment and service logs in the energy production management system. On the one hand, we use log anomaly detection technology to realize the anomaly detection of single node and the generating of log anomaly alarm, On the other hand, we use rule reasoning technology to realize the analysis and tracing of log anomaly alarm. In addition, we combine with practical application, optimize the traditional rule matching algorithm, which improves the fault tolerance of the matching network, and gets better accuracy and efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Fast analysis of wind power consumption path based on graph theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of wind power in the power supply structure, its impact on the safe and stable operation of the power system is increasingly significant. The contradiction between the development of wind power in some regions and the safe operation of the system is gradually emerging, and the phenomenon of wind abandonment continues to occur. The consumption of wind power has become a key issue affecting the healthy development of China's wind power. Therefore, it is very important to quickly and accurately analyze the absorption path of wind turbines in the whole power grid. This paper uses graph theory to quickly calculate the power composition of transmission lines and the actual power transmission relationship between generators and loads, thus providing a reasonable basis for how to improve the grid structure to improve the wind power absorption capacity. The proposed method is also applicable to the analysis of the relationship between active and reactive power transmission in practical systems. The standard IEEE 14-node system is used for simulation calculation, and the results verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Insulation Fault Location of Rails Based on Dynamic Rail Potential in DC Traction Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The insulation fault of running rails in urban rail transit leads to the abnormal rise of rail potential (RP) and stray current (SC) in return system, which seriously endangers the safe operation of urban rail trains. The fast and accurate location of insulation fault of running rails is an important issue to ensure the safe operation of the system. In this paper, a dynamic calculation model of RP in DC traction power supply system of urban rail transit is proposed to solve the insulation fault of running rails. By analyzing the dynamic distribution characteristics of RP of running rails under ideal insulation and insulation fault during the running of the system, the insulation fault of running rails can be detected and located. At the same time, based on the data of Hefei Metro Line 2, the dynamic distribution of RP of the train under different conditions of insulation fault is simulated and analyzed. The results show that the proposed method can be used to locate the insulation fault of running rails effectively.

Author Keywords: dynamic calculation model of rail potential

articleTitle: Stability analysis of grid-connected inverter under unbalanced grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at studying the system stability of the grid-connected inverter under unbalanced grid, this paper establishes the small-signal model of dual second order generalized integrator phase locked loop(DSOGI-PLL), and derives the sequence impedance model of the grid-connected inverter with DSOGI-PLL. Then, the system stability under unbalanced grid is analyzed by using the generalized Nyquist criterion. It is found that the use of DSOGI-PLL can significantly improve the system stability under unbalanced grid, due to the lower bandwidth of DSOGI-PLL. Finally, the corresponding simulation and experimental verifications are carried out, and the results prove correctness of the theoretical analysis in this paper.

articleTitle: Data-driven Multi-Energy Flow Calculation Method for Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the deepening of the interconnection of multiple energy sources, multi-energy flow computing has become an indispensable tool in modern integrated energy systems (IES). Conventional solutions, such as joint legislation or decomposition, are typically based on the assumption that the parameters of IES can be accurately measured. For IES, the parameters of power cables, natural gas pipelines and heat transfer pipelines may be difficult to be measured in practice due to aging of lines, climate change, unexpected disturbance and other reasons. Therefore, a novel multi energy flow analysis method for IES system is proposed to learn the mapping relationship between the given variable and the demanded variable from the historical operation data. The proposed method is data-driven, thus it is not necessary to know the exact values of pipeline parameters. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified in the test IES system.

articleTitle: Research on a Whole Scheme of Intelligent Air Switch Communication for Power Distribution Room
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The intelligent miniature air switch integrates control and multiple protection functions. The air switch is widely used for AC and DC equipment power supply, operation circuit control, short circuit control, fault isolation, etc. in the ring network box and distribution room. It plays an important role in the power grid field. This paper analyzes and compares various bus technologies applicable to the intelligent air switch communication of the ring-network box based on the actual scenario of the ring-network box. From the perspective of economy, feasibility and practicality, Lora and Powebus (two bus) bus technologies are selected, supplemented by carrier and RS485 bus technologies, to realize the overall solution of the intelligent miniature air switch communication.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Electric Vehicle Charging Optimization with Renewable Generations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing penetrations of electric vehicles (EV) and distributed renewable generations in power distribution systems, the peak load of EVs are overlapped with the conventional peak load of the distribution systems and creates the peak curve, which challenges the system operations. In this work, a deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based EV charging optimization strategy is proposed. Firstly, the problem is formulated as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) for DRL algorithms. Secondly, the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) algorithm is implemented to optimize the charging decisions of EVs. Lastly, distributed solar generation and location energy storage systems are utilized to further improve the economy and reduce carbon emissions. The proposed DRL-based framework is tested with models and the performance is validated with real-world data.

articleTitle: Modulation Strategy of Common DC Bus Open- Winding-Star Dual Winding Induction Generator System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposed a kind of common DC bus open-winding-star dual winding induction generator (OWS- DWIG) topology. In order to suppress the zero sequence current on the open winding side of OWS-DWIG, this paper analyzed the generation mechanism of zero sequence current, and studied the suppression method of zero sequence current from the perspective of SVPWM. The middle voltage vector method is used to reduce the common-mode voltage on the open winding side so as to suppress the zero sequence current. Finally, the simulation results show that the common-mode voltage and zero sequence current are effectively suppressed.

articleTitle: Active Power Backflow Suppression Strategy Based on Improved Zero-Sequence Voltage Injection for Three-Phase CDCB-CHB inverter under Inter-Phase Short-Circuit Fault
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Three-phase cascaded H-bridge (CHB) inverter can connect medium-voltage power grid without the bulky power-frequency transformer, and can realize multi-level output, reducing the volume of the filter. In addition, when the common DC-bus structure is adopted, the power imbalance problem of the CHB inverter can be completely avoided. Therefore, the three-phase CHB inverter based on the common DC bus structure (CDCB-CHB) receives more attention in applying high-voltage photovoltaic (PV) power generation. However, the three-phase CDCB-CHB inverter has the active power backflow (APB) problem during asymmetric voltage sags, which will cause the DC voltage of the H-bridge (HB) to rise, triggering inverter overvoltage protection. Some APB suppression strategies have been proposed, but the existing strategies will lead to overmodulation in some cases during the inter-phase shortcircuit fault. This paper proposes an APB suppression strategy based on the improved zero-sequence voltage injection method, it can reduce the overmodulation region of the system further, and expand the operational range of the CDCB-CHB inverter under the condition of inter-phase short-circuit fault. A down-scaled experimental platform is made to verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategies.

articleTitle: The Monitoring of Operating State of Electric Motor Based on Spectral Centroid Factor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To monitor the operation state of electric motor by applying the noise of motor, and judge whether the operation state of the motor is abnormal and the cause of the abnormality by combining the monitoring results. The concept of spectral centroid factor is proposed considering the mechanism and characteristics of motor noise, and the spectral centroid analysis model is constructed. The paper studies the basic principle and implementation approach of the spectral centroid factor, and adopts software to conduct the simulation analysis. The analysis results show that the parameter is capable of clearly extracting the fine features of motor noise, reflecting the operation state of the motor in real time, and can be referred as an effective basis for motor operation state monitoring and failure analysis. Based on this, the paper proposes a new monitoring approach for motor operation status, and conducted experimental verification, which is of strong theoretical research value and significantly practical application value.

articleTitle: Detection of Dissolved Gas in Transformer Oil Using Pt-Doped WTe2 Based Sensor: A First Principles Study
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The online monitoring of the insulation status of transformers is important to guarantee the stability and safety of a power system. Dissolved gas analysis (DGA), which employs highly sensitive gas sensors for detecting dissolved gas in transformer oil to reflect the insulation performance of such equipment, is a promising method to realize this purpose. In this paper, we used density functional theory to analyze the potential of a new 2D material, the Pt-doped WTe<inf>2</inf> (Pt-WTe<inf>2</inf>) monolayer, to detect typical fault gases (including H<inf>2</inf>, CH<inf>4</inf>, and C<inf>2</inf>H<inf>2</inf>) in transformer oil. Results indicated that the most stable structure of Pt-WTe<inf>2</inf> monolayer could be obtained by doping Pt atom right above the W atom, and its suitable adsorption performance allows Pt-WTe<inf>2</inf> to be used as a sensor and a scavenger for C<inf>2</inf>H<inf>2</inf> and H<inf>2</inf>, respectively. This article illustrates the mechanism of the interaction of Pt-WTe<inf>2</inf> with H<inf>2</inf>, C<inf>2</inf>H<inf>2</inf>, and CH<inf>4</inf>, which lays the foundation for the preparation of gas sensors for DGA.

articleTitle: Distribution characteristics of metal particles in flowing transformer oil with paper-covered electrodes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Metal particles are generally regarded as the most hazardous solid particle impurities to the insulation capability of transformer oil. The aggregation of particles in oil channels can cause a significant reduction in insulation performance. However, the distributing characteristic of particles in flowing transformer oil will be changed due to the solid insulation dielectrics. In this paper, the particle distributing observation system was constructed and the distribution images in flowing oil with paper-covered electrodes were observed using a high-speed camera. Simultaneously, the change of leakage current was recorded. Finally, the force conditions of free particles and adsorbed particles were analyzed and the change mechanism of distribution characteristics when the electrode was covered by insulating paper were discussed.

articleTitle: A Novel Meta-Learning and Network Architecture Search Approach for Few-Shot High-Voltage Circuit Breaker Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have achieved worth seeing results in mechanical fault diagnosis of high-voltage circuit breakers (HVCBs) due to their powerful classification capabilities. However, due to the discrepancy in the vibration signals of different voltage levels and types of HVCBs, it is difficult for the model developed on one dataset to be generalized and deployed to all scenarios, especially in the case of small samples in the field. To this end, this paper proposes a method for HVCB mechanical fault diagnosis based on meta-learning (ML) and neural architecture search (NAS). Firstly, NAS is adopted to automatically obtain the network model with the best existing modal performance. ML is then utilized to learn the design experience of the fault diagnosis model from the NAS process of existing modalities. When it is finally deployed in the field, the gradient update is performed on the basis of the learned design experience, that is, the HVCB fault diagnosis model can be quickly obtained under the condition of a small sample. The validity and feasibility of the proposed method are verified by laboratory and field data. The diagnostic accuracy of small samples on site reaches 94.15%, which provides a novel solution for HVCB fault diagnosis on-site.

articleTitle: Evolution Model and Risk Assessment of Cascading Failures in AC/DC System with Wind Power Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to more accurately simulate cascading failures in AC/DC systems with wind power integration, this paper presents a cascading failure evolution model based on multiple time scales and corresponding control measures. Firstly, based on the multi-time scale model and the operation characteristics of wind power and DC lines, an evolution model of cascading failures is built including wind power fluctuation, voltage protection and disconnection, DC line power increase(decrease) and restart after commutation failure. Secondly, taking the improved IEEE39 system as an example, the interaction between wind power and AC/DC system is analyzed. Finally, a variety of scenarios are constructed for comparative analysis, and based on risk theory, the impact of wind power on control quantity and accident chain risk in each link of AC/DC system cascading failure process is studied. The simulation shows that the penetration rate, output power and its changing trend of wind power, and whether to disconnect from the power grid will have different effects on the risk of cascading failure, which needs to be analyzed in detail.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Optimization Design of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Traction Motor Based on Taguchi Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To optimize the performance of the permanent magnet synchronous traction motor under rated operating conditions, the rated torque, rated point efficiency, stator core loss, and magnetic density amplitude are taken as the optimization objectives, and the stator outer diameter, magnet length, magnet thickness, pole arc coefficient of the spacer bridge on the magnet, and breath length are selected as the optimization factors on the optimization factors, and the effect of the above optimization factors on the optimization objectives is studied by Taguchi method. By establishing the orthogonal experiment matrix, the motor performance under each parameter combination is calculated by using the finite element (FE) electromagnetic simulation software. The parameter combination with the highest efficiency and the smallest magnetic density amplitude is preferred under the condition of ensuring a certain rated point output power.

articleTitle: RD-YOLO Target Detection For Night Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the problems of blurred background, dim light and less feature details in night images, the accuracy of visual object detection is reduced and the difficulty of visual detection is increased. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a RD-YOLO target detection algorithm, which combines the feature extraction ability of ResNet network, the image generation ability of DCGAN network and the YOLOv5 target detection ability to effectively improve the night target detection effect. Experimental verification on typical night data sets shows that the RD-YOLO network proposed in this paper can achieve 92% mAP and 270FPS detection speed, which is significantly higher than the original network, and meets the actual requirements of the night scene target detection task.

articleTitle: Parallel control of Three-Phase Four-Leg inverter based on virtual impedance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This letter proposes a sequential control method for three-phase four-leg(3P4L) inverter to improve the output voltage imbalance and power imbalance of parallel system under unbalanced conditions. In order to make the capacity of each inverter in the parallel system match, it is proposed to use the droop control on the first three legs, the negative sequence current and the fourth leg current use the virtual impedance method to control the distribution of positive sequence, negative sequence and zero sequence current respectively, the front three leg and the fourth leg of the 3P4L inverter control independently. Finally, the output voltage is balanced at the same time the output current and the output power of the parallel system are distributed according to the capacity of the parallel inverter under unbalanced conditions, and the circulation of the system is reduced. The correctness of the method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Effects of Conductor Erection Modes on the Ground Wire Power Loss for Double-Circuit Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When our research is concerned with the induced power loss caused by ground wires, the conductor erection mode that whether conductors of different circuits are installed on the same tower is a key technical scheme. It is a common practice that the ground wire power loss will not be taken into account in the life cycle cost, which will affect the electric energy transmission efficiency and the economic benefit of power grid. Although the power loss is only a small percentage of electric energy, the total quantity in the entire power grid is huge beyond our imagination with the increase of the power deliver and the improvement of the voltage level at present. Therefore, the power loss should be considered in the evaluation of life cycle cost when we adopt conductor erection mode. Taking the 750kV transmission lines widely constructed in northwest China as example, this paper analyses the characteristics and economic indexes of double-circuit transmission lines on the same tower and two parallel single-circuit transmission lines under different phase sequence arrangement to recommend the best energy saving conductor erection mode and the optimal phase sequence arrangements.

Author Keywords: Double-circuit transmission line installed on the same tower(DCTLST)

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Scaled Ratio on Aircraft Lightning Zoning Model Test
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Lightning zoning determines the lightning safety of aircraft, and the scaled ratio has a great influence on the model test result. In this paper, lightning impulses are applied to the model test gap of different scaled ratio, and the development process of discharge plasma in the gap between electrode and model is observed by CCD camera. The statistics show that when the scaled ratio increases from 1/35 to 1/25, the probability of arc striking the model fuselage decreases from 90% to 30%, and the two are approximately normal distribution. The experimental results show that with the increase of the scaled ratio, the induced discharge plasma length on the model tail and the probability of intercepting the downward discharge shall increase. Based on the discharge process image and electrostatic field simulation, it is considered that a scaled ratio will reduce the length of the upward discharge plasma initiated from model tail, which makes it more difficult to intercept the downward discharge.

articleTitle: Two-step control of multiple DERs based zero emission power grid using DNN enabled terminal sliding mode control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This research paper proposes a novel two-step control for a zero carbon power grid, which combines the use of deep neural networks (DNNs) and global terminal sliding mode control (GTSMC). The proposed power grid is composed of several distributed energy resources (DERs), including wind and photovoltaic (PV), and a hydrogen energy system. The two-step control configuration first employs DNNs for maximum power point tracking (MPPT) reference generation, followed by GTSMC based tracking controller. The control system's stability is evaluated using Lyapunov stability criteria, and its performance is assessed through simulations in MATLAB with real-world commercial and residential loads of 2-12 KW and weather profiles from a wind farm in Jiangsu, China.

articleTitle: Distributed hierarchically optimal schedule of distribution network with multiple virtual power plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the construction of novel power system, the renewable energy resources are integrating to the distribution network with increasing penetration, which brings great challenges to the safe and efficient operation of the power system. Virtual power plant (VPP), as a means of distributed resource aggregation, has been proposed to mitigate the impact of renewable energy grid connection on the grid. This paper proposes a distributed hierarchically optimal scheduling strategy for distribution network with VPPs. In the lower layer, the schedule of VPPs are optimized to minimize the operation costs while in the upper layer, the distribution network layer makes decisions based on the optimisation results of the VPPs. Distributed solution algorithm based on the alternating direction method of multiplier (ADMM) is developed to protect privacy information and improve solution efficiency. Finally, the simulation results of an example verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Load Aggregators Participate in the Design of Medium- and Long-Term Time-Sharing Patterns and Their Clearing Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The massive number of independent, fragmented, and small-capacity response resources on the demand side of the power system can be integrated through load aggregators that can participate both planning and market users. In this paper, the market participation mode of load aggregators as price recipients and price leaders is designed, the utility of load aggregators' participation models is considered for different supply and demand scenarios, and the changes in social welfare and the benefits of load aggregators are analyzed. Then, under the premise of promoting clean energy consumption and reducing peak loads, considering the different modes of load aggregators participating in the market and market responsibilities, the market clearing model is constructed to maximize social welfare, and finally using example analysis, under the price taker model, load aggregators can promote peak shaving and valley compensation under the premise of obtaining higher returns. In the price leader model, load aggregators can facilitate peak weakening and trough filling, and narrow the peak-to-valley spread with relatively low returns.

articleTitle: Study on Mechanical Performance of Transmission Tower in Coastal Area Considering Corrosion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A tower-line coupling model is established for coastal areas through numerical simulation. The model applies wind loads to determine the worst-case wind direction angle for the structural condition of the transmission line under different wind speeds and directions. The axial stress changes of the main materials of the transmission tower before and after the node plate disconnect at different positions are analyzed under the worst-case wind direction angle. The axial stress response of the transmission line reaches extremum as the wind direction angle increases from 0 degrees to 90 degrees, with the maximum stress occurring around 50 degrees of wind direction angle. To investigate the changes in axial stress of the main materials of the transmission tower, a comparative analysis of intact tower, tower with one discontinuity, and tower with two discontinue-ities is conducted.

articleTitle: Battery storage model optimization and its ground fault characterization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to make comprehensive use of solar energy, wind energy, biomass and other renewable energy and natural gas, hydrogen and other environmentally friendly energy, distributed power supply is widely used and developed, which also puts forward higher requirements for its energy storage technology, and battery energy storage technology is more widely used, so this paper builds a battery equivalent circuit based on the Oliver Trembly model in PSCAD/EMTDC, reduces two inputs based on the existing mathematical model of the battery, and verifies its usability through simulation. The simplified model was used to investigate the transient characteristics of the battery module in the event of a ground fault. The simulation results show that the magnitude of the earth impedance only affects the magnitude of the voltage and current values such as <tex>$\boldsymbol{E}_{\text{bat}}$</tex>, but that the two parameters <tex>$\boldsymbol{V}_{\text{bat}}$</tex> and <tex>$\boldsymbol{I}_{\mathbf{batt}}$</tex> change 1.2s before the fault occurs. The fault characteristics derived from the simulations can provide a theoretical basis for subsequent fault warning of the energy storage module.

articleTitle: Lifetime Prediction of Composite Insulator Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Composite insulators in long-term operation are subjected to ultraviolet, electric field, moisture, temperature difference and other factors, which inevitably lead to aging. It is important to carry out prediction research on the lifetime of composite insulator so as to replace the aging and deteriorated insulators to ensure the normal operation of power grid. In this paper, the performance indicators with strong correlation with insulator life were selected by Poisson correlation analysis, and the operation lifetime was predicted based on BP neural network. The research results show that when nine performance indexes such as hardness, hydrophobicity, water diffusion leakage current and tensile strength are used to predict the lifetime of the insulator, the difference between the predicted and actual values is within 5%.

articleTitle: Optimal inventory strategy of electricity meters based on the combination of Holt-Winters and XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Accurate forecast of electricity meter inventory demand and reasonable formulation of inventory mode are of great significance to reasonably arrange the arrival, verification and distribution of electricity meters and reduce the operation and maintenance cost of the electricity meter storehouse. Under this background, an optimization of energy meter inventory strategy based on the combination of Holt-Winters and XGBoost is proposed. Based on the Holt-Winters and XGBoost algorithm, a linear regression combined forecast model of inventory demand is proposed to predict the inventory demand of electricity meters. Then, an optimization model of electricity meter inventory strategy is proposed to minimize the total cost of operation and maintenance of the meter storehouse, so as to obtain the optimal storage and use strategy of each batch of electricity meters in the meter storehouse. Finally, the proposed model is analyzed and verified by taking the 5-year inventory demand data of a meter storehouse as an example. The results show that the proposed strategy can accurately predict the electricity meter demand and develop a reasonable electricity meter inventory strategy.

articleTitle: Extreme learning machines improved by differential evolution algorithms to estimate the state of health of lithium-ion battery
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The accurate estimation of the health state of lithium-ion batteries is of great importance for battery health management. In this paper, a model for estimating the health state of lithium-ion batteries is developed by differential evolution algorithm and extreme learning machine. Firstly, through cyclic ageing tests, the five health state related features are extracted from the battery charging curve and incremental capacity curve; secondly, the correlation between the health state of lithium-ion batteries and the features is obtained by using grey relational analysis; then, the five selected health features are used to construct an extreme learning machine based lithium-ion battery health state model; finally, a differential evolutionary algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the extreme learning machine model parameters to improve the accuracy of Lithium-ion battery capacity estimation. By comparing several other algorithms, the results show that this model is more accurate than other methods.

articleTitle: Research on the line safety assessment method of the distribution network considering meteorological factors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, with global climate change and frequent extreme meteorological disasters, the safe and reliable operation of the distribution network is faced with great risks. Therefore, this paper presents a distribution network line safety assessment method, which includes line fault frequency and line fault consequence evaluation index, considering external meteorological factors. A distribution network line fault probability model based on the SSA-LSTM model is established to reflect the change of external meteorological conditions with the input of meteorological data. The evaluation indexes of line fault consequences include power outage, capacity, power shortage, number of households during power outage, and important level of power outage users. Combined with risk theory, the fine-distribution network line safety early warning level is formulated. Realize accurate perception and timely alarm of meteorological safety hazards. Finally, taking the fault data of a regional distribution network in a city as an example, the effectiveness and precision of the proposed distribution network line safety assessment method are verified.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on Power Cycling of High Power Thyristor Based on Electromigration Degradation Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the reliability evaluation of high-power semiconductor devices, the power cycle test is used to simulate the thermal fatigue failure of devices triggered by temperature fluctuation stress, and the test is conducted with the device failure or significant drift of electrical parameters as the cutoff condition. The coffin-Manson life model based on the number of cycles obtained is the basis for evaluating the device's reliability. In this paper, we obtain the changing pattern of material properties triggered by electromigration through simultaneous observation of device material electromigration during the power cycle test. By data analysis, we get the quantitative relationship between material degradation and device electrical parameters/number of power cycles. Using electromigration degradation as a supplement to device aging characterization, we adjust the prediction results of the coffin-Manson life model on the device reliability index.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Pulse Current Spectrum Characteristics of PD at Tower Head of 10kV Overhead Insulated Line
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Partial discharge is often generated at the tower head of the electric pole in the 10kV overhead insulated line. In order to master the mechanism of partial discharge generation, this paper mainly studies the influence of various factors, such as insulator deterioration at the tower head of the electric pole, binding line form, pollution and water, and alalyzes the pulse current characteristics of partial discharge. It can provide the basis for carrying out the equipment condition assessment based on the line operation.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Electromagnetic Field Radiated by Electronic Transformer under Disconnector Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The switching operation of disconnector in Gas Insulated Substation (GIS) will generate Very Fast Transient Overvoltage(VFTO), forming a transient space electromagnetic field, it causes electromagnetic interference to the electronic transformer connected with GIS and threatens its operation. This paper first studied the electromagnetic field interference of the very fast transient phenomena on the electronic transformer, and analyzed the coupling path of the electromagnetic field radiated by the electronic transformer. Then based on the transmission line theory, a three-dimensional electromagnetic simulation model of GIS connected electronic transformer with VFTO wave as excitation source is established, calculated and analyzed. The calculation results show that the internal radiated electromagnetic field is the most serious in the vertical position between the electronic transformer acquisition unit and the GIS conductive pole. The metal shell of the acquisition unit can act as an electromagnetic radiation shielding box and has a certain electromagnetic protection ability.

articleTitle: Heat Dissipation Design and Power Consumption Estimation of CRAFT Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To guarantee the successful completion of the Fusion Technology Integrated Research Facility (CRAFT) project, this paper presents the thermal design of the converter. After conducting a comparative analysis, the flow channel of the thyristor radiator is determined. Subsequently, the overall temperature and water pressure are analyzed using FLUENT in ANSYS. Additionally, the power consumption of all equipment is calculated to preliminary estimate the cooling water consumption of the power system. The design results of this paper will provide valuable guidance for the successful implementation of this project.

articleTitle: Comparative study on rotor topology of Permanent Magnet Assisted Synchronous Reluctance Motor with concentrated winding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Considering the price of rare earth permanent magnets and its supply crisis, this paper proposes the design of a permanent magnet assisted synchronous reluctance motor with permanent magnets embedded in the rotor magnetic flux barrier. The Finite element method is used to analyze and compare the electromagnetic performance of PMa-SynRMs with different rotor topologies. The results show that the V-type rotor structure has the largest output torque; the multi-layer magnetic barriers can effectively increase the reluctance torque.

articleTitle: Simplified Calculation Method of Fault Current in Low Frequency Transmission System Based on M3C
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The low frequency transmission system based on modular multilevel matrix converter has the technical advantages of AC and DC transmission, and has unique advantages in the application of medium and long distance offshore wind power. The calculation of fault current is of great significance to relay protection setting calculation, electrical equipment selection and verification. Therefore, a simplified calculation method of fault current is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the transient process of fault is analyzed comprehensively. According to the energy conservation principle, the capacitance determined by the control strategy is equivalent in time domain, and then the analytical formulas of arm current and sub-module capacitance voltage before and after converter blocking are derived. The research shows that the equivalent method of time-varying capacitance before converter blocking is feasible. The peak value and rise rate of fault current can be obtained by equivalence, and then the fault current can be simplified. Finally, a test system is built in PSCAD / EMTDC to verify the effectiveness of the simplified calculation method. The results show that the proposed method has high calculation accuracy and good versatility.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of long-distance pipeline transportation of compressed air foam system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Numerical simulation of long-distance pipeline transportation of compressed air foam system (CAFS) was carried out by Fluent software. According to the real scene in the converter station, a numerical model of long-distance transmission pipeline network is established to simulate different transmission pipe diameters and flow conditions. The viscosity variation of compressed air foam (CAF) during long-distance transportation and the influence of different transportation conditions on response time were analyzed. Through numerical simulation, the viscosity at the inlet of the pipeline is large and the viscosity in the pipeline is high in the middle and low on both sides. The flow rate at the elbow of the pipe decreases, resulting in a decrease in local viscosity. The larger the diameter and flow of the pipeline in each scene, the larger the corresponding viscosity value, and the longer the response time of the system. By analyzing the simulation results, combined with the response time and foam extinguishing effect, the optimization suggestions for long-distance pipeline transportation are finally given.

articleTitle: Active Disturbance Rejection Control for Precise Position Tracking of Shape Memory Alloy Actuators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) method for accurate position tracking of shape memory alloy actuators (SMAAs) with uncertain dynamics and disturbances is presented in this paper. It is difficult to achieve precise positioning of SMAAs because of its strong nonlinear characteristics due to its solid phase transition mechanism. To solve the problem that the SMAAs mechanism modeling is difficult and the nonlinear characteristics have adverse effect on the precise position control, a second order transfer function model is established through step response system identification. Furthermore, nonlinear active disturbance rejection controller (NLADRC) are used for accurate position tracking of SMAAs. The overshoot of step signal tracking is effectively inhibited by using a tracking differentiator (TD), and the uncertain dynamics and disturbances are estimated by a designed third order extended state observer (ESO). position tracking accuracy and response speed of the SMAA servo systems are improved by nonlinear error feedback controller (NEFC). The experimental results demonstrate that the present NLADRC scheme for SMAA servo systems can improve the control performance in the accurate position tracking.

articleTitle: Nanocarbon Synthesis by Gas-liquid Plasma Using N-hexane as Raw Material
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The experimental investigations of nanocarbon synthesized by pulsed gas-liquid discharge plasma in n-hexane were carried out. The process of a pulsed discharge can be roughly divided into three stages: streamer development, gap breakdown and spark discharge. Moreover, the pulsed discharge process mainly occurs in the bubble, and the active particles retained in the bubble lead to a larger area and a stronger luminescence of subsequent pulsed discharge. The color of n-hexane solution became dark brown due to the formation of nanocarbon after 30 min of plasma treatment. The main nanocarbon products are carbon quantum dots (CQDs) in the supernatant and carbon nano onions (CNOs) in the sediment. Due to the photoluminescence (PL) effect of CQDs, the supernatant showed blue fluorescence under 365 nm ultraviolet excitation. The optical emission spectra (OES) of gas-liquid plasma is mainly composed of C<inf>2</inf>, CH, H<inf>α</inf> and Ar I, indicating that C2 and CH species are main precursors of the nanocarbon.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification for Wireless power transfer System via Primary Electrical Information
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to avoid the potential safety issue caused by purely closed loop control strategy, accurate parameters identification process is necessary. However, too bulky auxiliary circuit and complex calculation process make identification difficult to execute. In this paper, a parameter identification method without additional components is proposed. The mutual inductance and primary self-inductance value can be estimated accurately with only rms value of primary voltages and currents. More importantly, proposed parameters identification method performances well when the primary current oscillates or distorts under bed operation state. Finally, an experimental platform is built to verify the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Electric-Hydrogen Integrated Energy System Optimization Considering Ladder-Type Carbon Trading Mechanism and User-Side Flexible Load
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimal scheduling model of an electric-hydrogen integrated energy system (IES), in which both carbon trading and user-side flexible load are taken into account. The model can enhance resource utilization, optimize the flexibility of equipment operation, and further reduce the level of carbon emissions of IES. To make the system more ecologically friendly, the model is first updated to include a ladder-type carbon trading mechanism. The flexible load is then split into three categories: shiftable load, curtailable load, and translatable load, which can increase system efficiency and rationalize load distribution. Also, a number of limits in the electric-hydrogen IES are introduced to the model, and the power-to-gas process is improved to reduce operating costs, such as those associated with carbon trading, flexible load scheduling, and system energy. The Gurobi commercial solver is used to validate the effectiveness of the proposed model. It's shown that flexible load and ladder-type carbon trading mechanism in the IES can reduce system operation costs, peak-to-valley difference rate of load, peak power pressure, and carbon dioxide emissions.

articleTitle: Frequency Modulation Parameter Design Method Considering Wind Power Low-voltage-ride-through Characteristics and Carrying Capacity Improvement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous increase of wind power permeability, the power generation space of thermal power and other conventional units in the power system is crowded out, leading to the increasing risk of frequency instability. Therefore, the wind power carrying capacity will be constrained. At present, most studies on the improvement of wind power carrying capacity are based on the analysis of frequency modulation parameters under the power step disturbance, without considering the active power recovery characteristics of wind power after low-voltage-ride-though. This may lead to excessive design of frequency modulation parameters, resulting in redundant installation of frequency modulation energy supply devices such as energy storage and a waste of investment. Therefore, a frequency modulation parameter design method considering wind power low-voltage-ride-through characteristics and carrying capacity improvement is proposed in this paper, which realizes the minimum frequency modulation energy consumption. This quantitative calculation method provides a reference for frequency modulation parameter design and frequency modulation energy allocation under target wind power carrying capacity.

Author Keywords: the improvement of wind power carrying capacity

articleTitle: Optimization method for suppressing main steam pressure fluctuations in primary frequency regulation based on feed-forward of feed-water
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An optimization method of suppressing main steam pressure fluctuations in primary frequency regulation based on feed-forward of feed-water is proposed, which combines the primary frequency regulation action amount with the current main steam pressure deviation and important parameters on the boiler side for mathematical processing, and add the feed-forward signal to the steam pump for feed-water control, so as to adjust the steam pressure fluctuations caused by primary frequency regulation in advance, instead of passively adjusting after monitoring the steam pressure fluctuations, realizing the accurate suppression of steam pressure fluctuations in secondary reheat units participating in grid primary frequency regulation. The steam pressure fluctuations generated by the secondary reheat unit in the process of primary frequency regulation are accurately suppressed in advance, which reduces the magnitude of the main steam pressure fluctuations and shortens the adjustment time for the restoration of stable main steam pressure, ensuring the performance of primary frequency regulation while maintaining the safe and economic operation of the unit. The test shows that the optimized control method can effectively reduce the main steam pressure fluctuation and adjustment time of primary frequency regulation, which is both applicable and effective.

articleTitle: Low Frequency Operation Control Method for Modular Multilevel Converter Based on Improved Arm Current Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: as one of the most promising power electronic topologies, modular multilevel converter (MMC) has broad application prospects in the fields of electric traction systems and variable frequency drives. However, the sub-module (SM) capacitor voltage fluctuates greatly when MMC is running at low frequency, which will endanger system security. This article proposes a low frequency operation strategy of MMC based on improved prediction method of arm current. This strategy considers arm current as control target and combines model predictive control (MPC) as well as high frequency injection method to achieve arm current control without tracking error and the effective suppression of SM capacitor voltage. Furthermore, compared to traditional MPC strategy, this strategy can avoid the cost function and rolling optimization. Finally, in order to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy, simulation study was carried out. The result demonstrates that the proposed strategy can suppress SM capacitor voltage effectively and reduce the harmonic content of output current.

articleTitle: A Data-driven Approach to Probabilistic Harmonic Current Prediction for Residential Loads
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the widespread use of nonlinear power electronics in residential households, the harmonic content caused by them is increasing. To effectively counter the increasingly negative impact of residential harmonics, it is necessary to predict the harmonic currents of residential loads. Since residential loads are highly random, their harmonic current data have probabilistic fluctuations. For this reason, this paper proposes a probabilistic time-series harmonic current prediction method based on a neural network point prediction method. In this paper, multiple neural network methods are used to predict the deterministic components of harmonic currents, and the best prediction method is selected for each case according to the prediction error, while the statistical probabilistic prediction method is then used to predict the stochastic harmonic currents. Finally, the accuracy and practicality of the proposed probabilistic harmonic current prediction method are verified based on the measured data.

articleTitle: Non-destructive method by nonlinear ultrasonic measurements for aging characterization of silicone rubber
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Silicone rubber has been widely applicated in the electrical field, especially used as insulation materials, due to its excellent physical properties. However, the performance of silicone rubber will decline with its aging process leaded by plenty of factors. There's lack of methods for overall nondestructive characterization of the aging degree of silicone rubber in use presently. In this paper, the thermal aging experiment of silicone rubber is designed, and the nonlinear coefficient of the sample is measured by nonlinear ultrasonic method during the aging process, the change of the nonlinear coefficient of the sample during the aging process is analyzed, the rule of thermal aging of silicone rubber is summarized, and the feasibility of using the nonlinear coefficient as the aging characterization of silicone rubber is discussed.

articleTitle: SHEPWM for Closed-control of AC Machine
