publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The current harmonic distortions by asynchronous space vector pulsewidth modulation (ASVPWM) under the low pulse ratio are considerable. These harmonics can be reduced by selective harmonic elimination pulsewidth modulation (SHEPWM) in steady-state conditions. However, negative effects such as overcurrent with SHEPWM occur in transient conditions. To overcome this problem, a SHEPWM pulse generation method with a phase-locked regulator to maintain synchronization between the current regulator and actual output voltage phases even for fast dynamic processes is proposed. As a result, fast dynamic response without current excursions can be achieved. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an 18-kW IPMSM.

articleTitle: Frequency Response Model and Its Application for the Renewable Energy Resources Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Renewable energy resources (RESs) are usually connected to the power plant through power electronic converters which cannot provide inertia to the power plant like synchronous machines. Therefore, the power plant's frequency dynamic response performance may be unsatisfactory when power fluctuations occur. In order to evaluate the influence of RESs output fluctuation and load power fluctuation on the frequency of the RESs power plant, this paper establishes a frequency response model. Then, the model is discretized and its corresponding matrix form expression is derived. Consequently, based on the proposed frequency response model, this paper establishes the frequency security constraints, which is combined into the economic dispatching problem of the RESs power plant. The accuracy of the proposed frequency dynamic model is verified by case studies. The case studies also show that the economic dispatching model is conducive to simultaneously improving the safety and economy of the RESs power plant.

articleTitle: Electric field simulation of air gap defects in HVDC cable accessories based on sub model method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: HVDC cable accessories are one of the key equipment of DC transmission system. In order to study the influence of air gap defect on the electric field distribution of HVDC cable accessories, an electric field simulation method of HVDC cable accessories with air gap defect based on submodel method is proposed. Taking ± 200kV DC prefabricated intermediate joint as an example, a 3-D submodel of air gap defects is established, and the surface nodes of the submodel are mapped to the 2-D coordinate system. Taking the 2-D electric field simulation results of cable accessories at the same coordinate node as the known boundary condition of the submodel, the electric field distribution of the air gap defect is obtained, and the cutting boundary of the submodel is used for verification. The influence of the location and size of air gap defects on the electric field distortion is analyzed, and the theoretical critical size of partial discharge of air gap defects is obtained. The results show that when air gap defects in the insulating layer is located near the tip of semi conductive stress cone, the most serious electric field distortion occurs, and the half diameter of air gap should be controlled below 0.02mm. The research results are helpful to guide the production and manufacture of HVDC cable accessories.

articleTitle: Research on optimal scheduling strategy of micro-energy grid based on stochastic evolutionary game
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the randomness and uncertainty of renewable energy output in the micro-energy grid, a micro-energy grid optimal scheduling strategy with the stochastic matching of supply and demand is proposed. First, considering the randomness of the output of renewable energy such as wind and photovoltaic, it is proposed to use Kantorovich distance index to generate the optimal wind and photovoltaic output scenario, which transforms the stochastic optimization problem into a deterministic optimization problem. Secondly, taking the minimum system scheduling cost and the minimum environmental pollution cost as the objective functions, the multi-objective optimal scheduling scenario model of micro-energy gird is constructed. Finally, considering the impact of the energy storage station on the matching of dispatching supply and demand, the stochastic evolutionary game algorithm is used to solve the model. The example analysis verifies that the proposed optimal scheduling strategy can effectively improve the utilization rate of renewable energy and reduce environmental pollution.

articleTitle: Cable Fault Location in Distribution Network Based on Decomposition of Time Reversal Operator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of cable fault location in the distribution network, this paper proposes a cable fault location method based on the decomposition of time reversal operator (DORT). The proposed method constructs time reversal operator based on the scattering matrix of the network and its eigenvectors to eliminate the influence of network topology and terminal reflection. Reversal waveform will then be injected from each port of the network. The time domain response and spatial energy spectrum of each part of the network are combined to achieve the fault point location. The proposed method can be extended to multi-fault location by the differential scattering matrix decomposition algorithm, which only needs to measure the fault scattering matrix once to locate multiple faults, significantly improving the efficiency of fault location. The test case results demonstrate that this method can effectively overcome the influence of network topology and achieve accurate location of single and even multiple faults in the distribution network.

articleTitle: Study on Stress Simulation and Layout Optimization of 550kV GIS Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: GIS equipment operating environment is harsh, the force situation is complex, and the mechanical failure often occurs. In order to improve the reliability of mechanical structure of GIS equipment field layout, this paper carries out stress field simulation analysis on GIS equipment pipeline structure, and studies the influence of constraint conditions at both ends and support seat layout on stress distribution of GIS equipment. The results show that when a large volume device is connected at both ends of the GIS bus, it is equivalent to imposing fixed constraints on both ends. The stress on bellows is large and the deformation displacement is concentrated in the middle, so more attention should be paid to the deformation of the bellows. However, when the volume of the equipment connecting the two ends of the bus is small, there is no fixed constraint on the two ends, the stress on support seat is large, and the deformation displacement gradually decreases from the two ends to the middle, so more attention should be paid to the deformation of the support seat. The stress of bus increases with the increase of support distance, while the stress of bellows bolt is small when the support seat is arranged symmetrically, so it is suggested that the support seat should be arranged symmetrically with small distance. These conclusions can provide guidance for GIS equipment production design and operation and maintenance, and ensure the safe and stable operation of GIS equipment.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Wireless Power and Data Transfer System with Reduced Common Mode Noises Based on Symmetric Filter Inductor Configuration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Noises from power interference deteriorates the communication quality in simultaneous wireless power and data transfer (SWPDT) system. Previous researches only pay attention to noises originating from power carrier, neglecting that from common-mode (CM) currents. To solve this problem, the model of CM noises of the simultaneous wireless power and data transfer system based on split filter inductor configuration is established. Then the effects of split filter inductor on reduction of CM noises are analysed. It is shown that a symmetric filter inductor can minimize the CM noises caused by switching of MOSFETS. Finally, a 120W LCL based SWPDT prototype is built to validate the finding. Compared with traditional configuration, CM noises are reduced significantly using symmetric filter inductor configuration.

Author Keywords: simultaneous wireless power transfer and data transfer

articleTitle: Diagnosis Method for Thermal Aging and Water Tree Aging of Insulation Based on Lissajous Figure and Current Harmonic Characteristic Quantity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power cables are one of the most important devices in the power system. In order to diagnose the aging state of XLPE cable insulation, this paper carried out 90°C, 120°C, 150°C accelerated thermal aging experiments and accelerated water tree aging experiments on the cable section samples in the laboratory, tested and analyzed the changing laws of <tex>$\tan\delta-f$</tex> curves, Lissajous figures and current harmonic content of different samples. The experimental results show that for the cable section samples with internal water tree aging, the Lissajous figure inclination angle is significantly larger than that of the thermal aging samples, and the harmonic component of the current is mainly within tenth order. With the increase of aging time, the characteristics will be more obvious, so the ageing type of the cable can be distinguished. At the same time, the minor axis length of the Lissajous figure and the harmonic distortion within the tenth order THD<inf>10</inf> have a good correlation with the <tex>$\tan\delta$</tex> of the cable, which can be used to judge the aging degree of the cable.

articleTitle: Phase Shift Strategy of CPT System Based on Three-inputs Fuzzy PID Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Contactless Power Transfer (CPT) is a well-known problem, and has received widespread attention in the generation industrial applications. CPT system is vulnerable to interference by mutual inductance change or load change in the application, which can easily lead to unstable output voltage and low efficiency. Conventional PID control is too easy to meet the CPT system, and fuzzy PID consider output voltage only so that it isn't applicable to the system on battery load. Therefore, a three-inputs fuzzy PID control is proposed to solve this problem. In this paper, we derive and present accurate models of the CPT system. A control method which combined the phase-shift strategy and the three-inputs fuzzy PID algorithm are then invented. Simulation results demonstrate that the three-inputs fuzzy PID has the advantages of fast response, small overshoot and strong anti-interference ability compared with PID and fuzzy PID.

articleTitle: Characteristics of bubble discharge driven by the different pulse power supply
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The plasma power supply directly affects the plasma-liquid interaction, which are reflected visually by electrical properties and solution properties. In this paper, the characteristics of bubble discharges and the solution properties driven by nanosecond and microsecond pulse power supplies were investigated. The results show that the nanosecond pulse bubble discharge (NPBD) presents a single current at the rising edge of the voltage, while multi-currents mode is observed in the microsecond pulse bubble discharge (MPBD). The current intensity of NPBD is much higher than that of MPBD. The pulse frequency and voltage amplitude have different effects on the current. The effect of the two power sources on the effectiveness of reactive species is positively correlated with power and less correlated with the type of power source. The difference of the solution pH in the NPBD and MPBD is mainly related to the concentration of aqueous reaction species. The solution temperature is apparently lower in the NPBD when the voltage varies, which has a greater relationship with its pulse characteristics.

articleTitle: Multilevel and Synergistic Management Strategy for Power Quality Based on Data Driven
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the expansion of power grid scale, abnormal disturbance of power quality will bring serious harm. In view of the failure of traditional power management to effectively explore the potential capability of multiple power electronic equipment, a multilevel and synergistic management strategy for power quality based on data driven is proposed in this paper. Firstly, based on the local operation characteristics of the power quality control device, the important features in the power quality time series of each node of the distribution network are extracted. In order to improve the data quality, the data cleaning method based on k-nearest neighbor is adopted to construct isochronous dimension sequence array, and the correlation of each node data is analyzed by improved gray relational analysis (IGRA). The nodes are sorted according to the power quality correlation degree and the dominant nodes are determined by k-means++. The global governance under the power quality disturbance is realized through the regional regulation. Finally, the IEEE14-node simulation example is used to verify the accuracy of the proposed method and the rationality of improving the power supply quality in the whole network.

articleTitle: Feasibility study on a anti-icing method for OHL conductors using shape memory alloys
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Shape memory alloys maintain different shapes at different temperatures. This paper proposes an anti-icing method of conductors without manual intervention. The method arranges shape memory alloys on the surface of wires and use the deformation to change the electric field strength on the surface of wires to inhibit icing accumulation. The field natural icing experiment were carried out at Xuefeng Mountain Energy Equipment Safety National Observation and Research Station of Chongqing University. With two ends bent upward, Cylindrical aluminum bars arranged on the surface of LGJ-150/25 conductors were used to replace the shape memory alloy. Results show that the arrangement of memory alloys after deformation replaced by cylindrical aluminum bars can suppress the icing. Especially icing quality and thickness of wires is reduced by 57.1% and 48.7% when initial electric field intensity E is 10kV/cm.

articleTitle: Analysis of wide-pulse fault locating considering waveform distortion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Since the narrow pulse has the defect of measuring blind area and the wave velocity has a great impact on the accuracy of fault location, a theory of eliminating the wave velocity of the wide pulse has been caught out, which has been verified in Simulink. In addition, since the pulse can be distorted during the transmission process of lossy transmission lines, which can affect the identification of the pulse edge, then affect the measurement time of the reflected pulse to the beginning terminal, considering the pulse edge is rich in detail components, wavelet analysis has been used to identify the edge. Moreover, lossy transmission line models have been established in ATP-EMTP to verify the theory. The simulation results have shown that through this method, the 4% relative error can be reduced to less than 0.02%. Both theory and simulation results have proved that the traditional pulse fault detection method can be improved.

articleTitle: Refining and Physicochemical and Electrical Properties Analysis of Natural Ester Insulating Oil based on Sapium Sebiferum Seed Oil
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Natural ester insulating oil has been used more and more in transformer industry due to its advantages of high ignition point, environmental protection and non-pollution. Through degumming, deacidification, decolorization and dehydration of sapium sebiferum seed oil, sapium sebiferum seed insulating oil with excellent physico, chemical and electrical properties was prepared. The physical, chemical and electrical properties of sapium sebiferum seed insulating oil were studied. The electrical performance indexes such as breakdown voltage and dielectric loss factor of sapium sebiferum seed insulating oil, refined camellia seed insulating oil, rapeseed insulating oil and 25# transformer oil were compared and analyzed. The antioxidation mechanism of sapium sebiferum seed insulating oil was analyzed, and the oxidation stability of sapium sebiferum seed insulating oil added with three kinds of antioxidants was tested. The test results show that the insulating oil of sapium sebiferum seed has excellent performance in terms of kinematic viscosity, acid value and condensation point, and has excellent electrical properties. Reasonable selection of antioxidants can improve its antioxidant capacity.

articleTitle: Study on the adaptability of traction power supply system under the operation of high density heavy haul train
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: While the operation of high-density heavy-load trains brings greater economic benefits, the increase in the number of trains running in the same power supply arm will lead to an increase in the burden and stability of the traction power supply system. Therefore, it is necessary to build a simulation model of the fully parallel AT traction power supply system and study the impact of high-density heavy haul train operation on the traction power supply system. Based on the PSCAD electromagnetic transient simulation software, this paper establishes the simulation model of traction power supply system, calculates the equivalent impedance model of heavy-load train through the relevant theory of electromagnetic field and the chain network model, and quantitatively analyzes the characteristics of the impact of heavy-load train on the traction network and traction substation under different operating conditions. The research shows that the simulation model of traction power supply system built in this paper is reasonable and correct. Based on the idea of chain network model, the equivalent impedance of trains at different positions can be obtained iteratively by updating the system node admittance matrix, and the iterative algorithm has fast convergence speed. When three heavy-load trains in the power supply section are running at the same time, the minimum voltage of the traction network can drop to 26.04kV, and the maximum current of the T contact line of the outgoing line of the traction substation can reach 764.5A. The research results of this paper can provide reference for exploring the feasibility of high-density heavy-load train operation and the adaptability of traction power supply system.

articleTitle: The effects of voltage amplitude and frequency on hydrogen by 1D fluid simulation of Ar/NH3 DBD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A 1D fluid model was used to study the influence of voltage amplitude and frequency on the hydrogen yield by ammonia decomposition with plasma under atmospheric pressure. The hydrogen yield was analyzed at the conditions of voltage amplitude of 1kV to 5kV and driving frequency of 0.5kHz to 30kHz. The results show that the hydrogen yield increases with the increase of voltage amplitude and frequency. The voltage amplitude has a higher contribution to hydrogen yield than frequency. The main reason is that increasing the voltage amplitude can enhance the reduced electric field which will lead to the increase of the average electron energy and the electron density. The reaction rate of the related electron collision that dominates the H2 production was enlarged correspondingly. When increase the frequency of applied voltage, the charge accumulation was mainly affected that further dominates the self-built electric field.

articleTitle: Optimal coordinative scheduling of the electric–thermal integrated energy system considering weather forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Unlike the anti-peak regulation of wind power, the power generation characteristics of solar power could help reduce the restriction of heating load on the electric power output flexibility of combined heat and power (CHP) units. In this work, an optimal coordinative scheduling model of the electric-thermal integrated energy system (IES) considering weather forecasting is constructed. The current IES considers the time delay and heat loss of the district heating system. On this basis, a solar power forecasting method based on ensemble numerical weather forecasting and the model chain is adopted to serve the scheduling. The simulation result shows that the presented coordinative scheduling strategy is able to save, as compared to the reference, 6300 tons of coal equivalent (TCE) during the heating season.

articleTitle: Resonant Parameters Optimization Design for Improving Operation Performance of LCC-type Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Featuring better output voltage regulation performance and better reliability with short-circuit or open-circuit condition, the LCC-type resonant converter became favorable in high-voltage dc power supply. Traditionally, LCC-type resonant converter was more widely used under discontinuous current mode. However, when requires steady, highly sinusoidal voltage, there would be no rectifier and the converter should operate in continuous current mode. This paper will focus on investigating the relationship between resonant parameters and the output voltage, resonant current and switching performance through theoretical analysis and simulation. Three main resonant parameters, including series resonant filter parameters, parallel resonant capacitance and primary series inductance, were chosen based on theoretical analysis. Then the relationship would be verified by sets of experiments based on a prototype of the proposed LCC-type resonant converter. Finally, the resonant parameters would be optimized and the improvement of system performance after parameter optimization would be validated.

articleTitle: Experiment Study on Defect Development Process of Resin Impregnated Paper Bushing under Electro-thermal Effect
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The epoxy resin impregnated paper bushing (RIP bushings) has the advantages of oil-free, small size and excellent electrical properties, it has been widely used in transformer bushings and wall bushings. However, it has the disadvantages of complicated manufacturing process and its defects are prone to occur in the production process. In order to obtain the insulation characteristic parameters corresponding to the defects, this paper has analyzed the causes of the defects, and simulated the defects in the actual RIP bushing, including the poor drying of the insulating paper inside of it and the core caused by the concentration of thermal stress during the curing process of the core. Through comparative measurement, the characteristics of partial discharge dielectric loss factor tan δ and capacitance number during the development of early insulation defects of RIP bushings are studied. The results show that the tanδ value and the capacitance value of the defective bushing show an overall increasing trend with the aging time. The research results can provide a reference for the bushing factory test and on-site insulation diagnosis.

articleTitle: Atmospheric pressure air plasma uniformity study
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the further research of atmospheric pressure low temperature plasma in the field of material treatment, a high frequency high voltage plasma experimental platform is built and a diffuse air plasma at the atmospheric pressure is implemented. A judgement method of plasma uniformity is proposed with the egg inner membrane surface ablative degree after plasma treating. The egg inner membrane. The comparison experiments are set with air and argon plasma as the treating work gas. The result shows that the egg inner membrane surface treating with argon plasma jet causing more serious ablation than the air plasma, because the argon plasma jet obtain discharge filaments while the air plasma does not. Then the electric field distribution in a needle plate electrode system is analyzed with different gap distance through experiments and simulations. and the effect of the gap distance on the discharge uniformity is discussed. According to the electric field distribution results of 5-12mm, it is found that the needle-plate electrode produced plasma that progressed outwards from the needle electrode.

articleTitle: Demagnetization Fault Diagnosis of Traction Motor of New Energy Vehicles Based on Back-EMF Image Data with Improved AM-CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To address the issue that the traditional convolutional neural network is computationally intensive and not highly discriminative for the demagnetization characterization of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), this paper proposes a convolutional neural network based on the attention mechanism (AM-CNN) to diagnose the demagnetization faults of PMSM. In this paper, the moving rearrangement method is used to transform the collected one-dimensional vibration signal of the motor into two-dimensional grey-scale image data. Then, AM-CNN is used to extract effective feature vectors from the two-dimensional vibration image data. Finally, the fault status diagnosis is realized through the fully connected layer with SoftMax function. Through a large number of verification experiments, it is concluded that compared with the traditional variable mode decomposition and traditional convolutional neural network methods, the method proposed in this paper has higher diagnostic accuracy and stronger generalization ability.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of layout methods of fluorescent fibers on the detection of partial discharge signals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Partial discharge optical measurement method has a strong anti-interference ability and high sensitivity, becoming one of the most important and effective methods to evaluate the insulation condition of electrical equipment, whose signal detection capability is closely related to the way the fluorescent fiber sensor is laid out. In order to clarify this point, an experimental platform for fluorescent fiber PD detection was built in this paper. Compared with the commonly used UHF method, the influence of the variation of the relative distance between the sensor and the insulation defect on the PD detection effect was studied in two cases: linear layout and Archimedes layout. The results show that the sensitivity of the fluorescent fiber Archimedes layout is better than the linear layout for the same horizontal distance; when the distance from the PD defect is less than 45 cm, the two layout methods of fluorescent fiber sensors have higher detection sensitivity than the UHF sensors. For a linear layout, increasing horizontal distance has a more detrimental effect on PD detection than vertical distance.

articleTitle: A Model Integration Strategy for Quantitative Aging Assessment of Insulating Paper by NIRS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) has been used for non-destructive, quantitative assessment of the aging condition of insulating paper. Massive algorithms are proposed to explore the relationship between the NIR spectrum of insulating paper and its degree of polymerization (DP). However, how to evaluate and choose an optimal algorithm of high precision and generalization ability from many algorithms deserve to be further studied. In this paper, we propose a two-layer ensemble learning strategy that takes the output of the base learners as the input of the meta-learner, maximizes the use of valid information mined by each algorithm, and corrects the prediction bias of the base models. Firstly, the selection strategy of base learners and meta-learner is given, and the general structure of the two-layer ensemble learning is described. Then, we test the performance of the base model and the meta-model using a dataset of 509 samples including 8 types of insulating paper. The results show that the two-layer ensemble learning has higher modeling stability (RMSE<inf>var</inf> of 68), and the obtained meta-model has higher accuracy (RMSE<inf>mean</inf> of 72) compared to the best base model (RMSE<inf>mean</inf> of 79, RMSE<inf>var</inf> of 79). The two-layer ensemble learning has a significant advantage compared to the winner-take-all strategy.

articleTitle: Single-phase grid-connected power decoupling inverter based on Buck converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In single-phase grid-connected inverter, the inherent double frequency pulsating power at the grid side will lead to the non-ideal low-frequency ripple of the DC bus voltage/current. The common solution is to connect large capacity electrolytic capacitors in parallel on the DC bus. The service life of electrolytic capacitor is low and will lead to a significant reduction in system power density. In order to remove the electrolytic capacitor from the design, this paper designs an active power decoupling circuit with Buck structure to compensate for the second harmonic power fluctuation. The reference value of decoupling capacitor voltage can be obtained by the instantaneous power feedforward at the grid side. The active decoupling control of the second harmonic power is realized by using the double closed-loop control method of the outer loop of the capacitor voltage and the inner loop of the inductance current. The effectiveness of the control strategy is verified by Matlab/Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Study on the color-changing characteristics of a reversible color-changing coating for the detection of heating defects of disconnect switches
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The abnormal heating problem of disconnector contacts is prominent, which affects the safe and stable operation of power grid. In order to detect abnormal heat in time, a temperature measurement method of reversible color-changing coating for temperature detection is proposed, and its performance is analyzed and studied. The results show that the best color-changing performance is achieved when the ratio of color-changing material is crystalline violet lactone: bisphenol A: palmitic acid = 1:1:50. It is able to maintain good color-changing reversibility within 150 °C. The color-changing microcapsules are prepared based on in situ polymerization method to improve their weathering properties and carried out particle size analysis. Its particle size distribution of microcapsules is relatively concentrated and the wrapping effect is good. The color-changing coatings are prepared by mixing and stirring method. The prepared color-changing coatings are coated on tinplate and copper sheets respectively to test their adhesion properties. The experimental results show that they have good adhesion performance.

articleTitle: Congestion Management of Urban Power Grid Incorporating EV Load Spatial Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The rapid growth of electric vehicles (EVs) and fast charging stations in recent years provides a new type of spatial flexibility resource for the operation of the urban power network. Through the guidance of charging price incentives, the EV fast charging loads can be transferred among different charging stations, which provides an auxiliary measure to regulate substation load and power flow distribution. In this paper, a coordinated congestion management framework incorporating both the intrinsic network reconfiguration measure and the additional EV load spatial flexibility exploitation is proposed. The EV charging load distribution is described as a stochastic user equilibrium model, with its aggregated spatial flexibility estimated via tractable data-driven models. The power network reconfiguration problem is modeled as a mixed integer linear program. Case studies validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and methods. The combination of network reconfiguration and EV load spatial flexibility is proven to yield better congestion management effects.

articleTitle: Research on the optimal allocation of new energy connected to electrolytic aluminum
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of high proportion of new energy access to electrolytic aluminum, wind power generation, photovoltaic (PV) power generation and energy storage are combined to maximize the absorption of new energy in the electrolytic aluminum production process by optimizing the configuration. Using the new model of wind, solar and storage complementarity, a bi-level programming model for the high proportion of new energy access is proposed. For the propose of achieving the power required for the electrolytic aluminum production and the new energy power generation as much as possible, minimum energy storage configuration capacity is used as the upper optimization model and the maximum economic benefit is taken as the lower model. Based on the hourly power generation data of wind turbines (WT) and photovoltaics and the hourly power consumption of electrolytic aluminum process in a certain area, the nondominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) is used to optimize the configuration of the wind turbines and photovoltaic power generation capacity. The results of research show that the optimal solution of wind-solar storage allocation capacity can maximize the local consumption of new energy on the basis of lower investment cost. At the same time, it can achieve better economy of electrolytic aluminum production, which has practical significance for the high proportion of electrolytic aluminum production and the utilization of new energy.

Author Keywords: photovoltaic (PV) / wind turbines(WT) / storage power plant

articleTitle: An Improved Simplified Model of Capacitor Charging Power Supply with Homopolar Inductor Alternator Considering Field Flux Linkage and Speed Changes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Homopolar inductor alternator (HIA) has shown its promising advantages in capacitor charging power supply (CCPS). For accelerating HIA-CCPS system design process, researchers have been making efforts to simplify the simulation analysis, but the models were not universal or effective enough. In this paper, a simplified look-up-table model considering the changes of speed and field flux linkage in HIA-CCPS is proposed. While realizing fast calculation, it can also reflect the dynamic process similar to the transient model, which is very exact and effective.

articleTitle: Design of strong isolation power supply for Restraining Transient Interference
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid construction and development of smart grid and ultra-high voltage transmission and transformation projects, the transient ground potential rise caused by the operation of switch equipment has a serious impact on the safe operation of local protection devices and various intelligent secondary equipment. When the intelligent substation generates transient ground potential rise due to switching operation, it is possible to make the equipment fail due to strong electromagnetic interference, especially the power supply stability of the secondary side equipment affected. Because the power supply module of the electronic transformer fails under the strong transient electromagnetic interference, false alarm will be generated, resulting in switch misoperation, and affecting the normal operation of the substation. In this paper, an strong isolated power supply is designed, which has the function of suppressing strong transient electromagnetic interference and ensures the stability of power supply for secondary equipment. The circuit hardware design, PCB design, circuit simulation and test are carried out around the strong isolation power supply. Then use Multisim software to simulate the circuit and verify the parameters of the selected device; Finally, the strong isolation power supply is tested. When 1K load is applied, the output voltage is 12V and the current is 0.011mA.

articleTitle: Voltage-time Characteristics of the Different Nano-Oil under Lightning Impulse
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents experimental results of breakdown voltage-time characteristics of transformer oil and three kinds of nano-oil (Fe304, TiO<inf>2</inf>, Al<inf>2</inf>O<inf>3</inf>) under lightning impulse voltage. The test results show that three kinds of nanoparticles can improve the positive breakdown performance of the transformer oil, but has little effect on the negative breakdown performance. The reason for this phenomenon may be that the three kinds of nanoaprtcles can weaken of the electric field near the positive streamer head and enhance of the electric field of the negative streamer head, but the specific mechanism still needs to be explored. The results of the paper can provide a certain reference for insulation design by using nano-oil as insulation medium.

articleTitle: Simulation study on the Influence of different frequency harmonics on Gas Insulated Switchgear temperature rise
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the “double high” characteristics in power system caused by the harmonic problem is increasingly significant, the harmonic components are seriously increased and complicated, easy to cause equipment overheating, aging and even misoperation phenomenon, bringing great risks to the safe operation of power equipment. In this paper, a three-dimensional electromagnetic heat flow coupling model is established for the influence of different frequency harmonics on the temperature rise of GIS. Under the superposition of five, seven and eleven harmonics of fundamental wave respectively, the temperature distribution of GIS is calculated by electromagnetic heat flow coupling simulation. The effects of different frequency harmonics on the distribution characteristics of GIS temperature rise were studied by comparing the loss value and temperature rise of GIS under superimposed different frequency harmonics. The result shows that the higher the frequency of superimposed harmonic pairs, the higher the corresponding loss value, but the harmonic value of 5% has little effect on GIS temperature rise and can be ignored.

articleTitle: An Accurate Reactive Power Sharing Strategy Based on Adaptive Virtual Impedance Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For isolated microgrids, the key task is to achieve precise power-sharing according to the rated capacity ratio of the distributed generators (DGs). However, due to the mismatch between feeder impedances, conventional droop control strategies become ineffective to achieve precise reactive power sharing. Such drawback may put the entire microgrid at risk, as it will cause large loop current between inverters, and even leads to current overload of certain inverters. In this paper, we mathematically analyze the cause of inaccurate reactive power sharing when applying droop control techniques and then, we propose a low communication-dependent strategy based on adaptive virtual impedance optimization to achieve accurate reactive power sharing. First of all, the actual feeder impedances are identified online by using the recursive least squares algorithm with forgetting factor, which is passive and ensures high-quality power supply to the public loads. Second, the proposed strategy uses the identification results of feeder impedances to realize the optimal adjustment of virtual complex impedance for each inverter. This strategy prevents additional deteriorations of the microgrid voltages in comparison to existing adaptive virtual impedance strategies. Additionally, the proposed control is credible and robust to communication faults. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified in both normal and communication fault conditions by simulation results.

articleTitle: Management insights of regional logistics efficiency on power industry layout: an integrated DEA approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The transportation of key materials in the electric power industry cannot be separated from a stable logistics environment, and the changes in regional logistics efficiency have strong reference values for the layout of the electric power industry. Previous literature has mostly studied the power industry from the perspectives of mixed energy, key technologies, and capital financing, but lacks consideration of the stability of grid material supply and logistics efficiency. To provide management insights into the planning and layout of the power industry from the perspective of regional logistics, we propose a comprehensive DEA model to explore the regional logistics efficiency in China, while combining the advantages of the model in rankings to construct a new evaluation system. This study measures the static and dynamic efficiency of regional logistics through DEA and Malmquist index models, respectively. In addition, we analyze the changes in regional logistics ranking when encountering major events. The results show that the overall efficiency grows over the years, and with the impact of sudden major events, Chongqing's ranking rose the fastest, Qinghai's ranking fell the fastest, and Hubei's ranking dropped by eight places. The results of the index model show an interesting spatial phenomenon, with the coastal regions of Zhejiang, Guangdong, Fujian, Hainan, and Liaoning showing a decrease in growth rate, while the growth rate of the regions connected from Xinjiang to Hubei to Fujian shows a decrease.

articleTitle: Identification Method of Weak Links Based on Grid Strength Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The modern power grid features the high penetration of renewable energy resources and power electronic devices, which aggravates the coupling effect both between power electronic devices and the power grid and between different devices, and hence increases the risk of oscillation and small-signal instability. Therefore, it is urgent to discriminate the weak links of buses and AC lines in the power grid, and then carry out targeted operation control. This paper explores the method of identifying power system weak links by using the generalized short-circuit ratio (gSCR) index from the perspective of small-signal stability. We establish the characteristic equation of the multi-infeed power electronic system and analyze the small-signal stability based on the gSCR index, i.e., the evaluation index of power grid strength. According to the sensitivity of the gSCR to the control parameters of power electronic devices and the admittance parameters of AC lines, we find that links with the maximum sensitivity are the weakest links of buses and AC lines in the power grid. Finally, the weak link identification method proposed in this paper is validated through the eigenvalue analysis of a 5-infeed power electronic system.

articleTitle: Nonlinear error correction method for temperature sensor of on-load tap changer based on neural network optimized by genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: On-line temperature monitoring of on-load tap-changer is a conventional technology to monitor the running state of on-load tap-changer. In order to ensure the effectiveness of monitoring, it is necessary to test the sensitivity of the sensor. However, there are inevitable errors in the detection process of temperature sensor, which seriously affect the detection results. In order to eliminate the influence of errors on the detection results as much as possible, this paper establishes a nonlinear error correction method of on-load tap-changer temperature sensor based on neural network optimized by genetic algorithm. The algorithm flow is proposed. 140 of 158 data are randomly selected as neural network training, and the remaining 18 values are used as neural network correction. The results show that the corrected test results are basically consistent with the actual values.

articleTitle: Study on Wide DC Voltage Output Characteristics of Submodule Hybrid MMC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the great development of renewable energy power generation technology, the flexible direct current transmission technology (VSC-HVDC) comes into being with the advantages of no commutation failure and low harmonics. At present, with the development of power electronics technology, modular multilevel converter (MMC) has become the preferred converter topology for flexible HVDC systems. Among them, the hybrid MMC system based on half-bridge submodule and full-bridge submodule has the advantages of fewer components and low switching loss on the basis of the self-clearing ability of DC short-circuit fault. Therefore, this paper analyzes the DC voltage output capacity of hybrid sub-module MMC, analyzes the mechanism of the wide DC voltage output of hybrid MMC system, and further adds the restriction conditions to the DC side voltage output range of hybrid MMC in combination with the balance requirements of the capacitance voltage stability of the half-bridge sub-module in the actual operation process. Finally, the simulation model and physical model are established respectively based on MATLAB/Simulink software and <tex>$\text{DSP}+\text{FPGA}$</tex> platform.

articleTitle: Separation properties of magnesite particles in the trapezoidal high voltage electric field
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposed a trapezoidal high voltage collecting electric field to study the separation characteristics of Magnesite particles from the mixture of SiO<inf>2</inf> and MgCO<inf>3</inf>, which was charged by the negative corona discharge. The mathematical model of particle motion was established to simulate the separation process of magnesite particles based on the analysis of the force on charged particles. The advantages of the trapezoidal electric field were experimentally verified, and the separation efficiency of magnesite particles was investigated at different angles and voltage levels of the electrode plates. Results show that pulsed plasma corona discharge could improve the ability of MgCO<inf>3</inf> particles to accept a charge and the charge-to-mass ratio increase from −2.179 nC/g to −7.232 nC/g. Furthermore, if the charge-to-mass ratio exceeds −10 nC/g, the charged MgCO<inf>3</inf> particles will collide with the electrode plate, and the separation efficiency will decrease. If the charge-to-mass ratio is less than −2.5 nC/g, the deflection of the charged MgCO<inf>3</inf> particles is not apparent, which also reduces the separation efficiency. At the same voltage applied on the electrode plates, the optimum angle of the electrode plate is 5 degrees. At an angle of 5 degrees and a voltage of −20kV, the separation efficiency achieves 83%.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Deep Flux Weakening Algorithm for Five-phase PMSM Based on Deadbeat Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the flux-weakening depth of FIPMSM is not deep, this paper proposes a hybrid deep flux weakening control algorithm based on negative d-axis current compensation combined with MTPV for FIPMSM. In addition, in order to solve the problem that the current loop when adopting PI control is saturated and out of control when the motor just enters the flux weakening stage, the current loop adopts the deadbeat current predictive control based on the Luenberger state observer to realize delay and disturbance compensation. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified through experiments, and 2.5 times of flux-weakening based on this algorithm for FIPMSM is achieved.

articleTitle: A Compound Decoupling Control Strategy for DFIG Considering PLL under Weak Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As one of the main types of wind power generation, doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) has been widely used with the rapid development of new energy. In this paper, the mechanism of insufficient stability of DFIG control system under weak grid is investigated. By constructing small signal model of DFIG in weak grid, the influence loop of phase-locked loop (PLL) on current closed-loop control is analyzed. Based on the small signal model, a compound decoupling control strategy considering the effect of PLL is proposed, which effectively improves the stability margin of DFIG in weak grid. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Fault monitoring and Prediction Model of highway Electromechanical Equipment Based on FFT-WT and CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Modern highway system is composed of complex, including a large number of mechanical and electrical equipment. It is very important to detect, diagnose and predict the failure of mechanical and electrical equipment. This paper focuses on the study of voltage monitoring waveform of mechanical and electrical equipment. Based on CNN-LSTM model, combined with fast Fourier change and wavelet transform, a WT-AE-net model is proposed to train waveform data set, and a method that can quickly realize waveform prediction is obtained to realize fault monitoring and prediction of highway motor equipment. The prediction and calculation time of the model can reach 10s, and the standard deviation of the predicted waveform is about 0.22, which is lower than that of the traditional model.

Author Keywords: Long and short term memory network

articleTitle: A Hybrid Cascaded Power Electronic Transformer With Tight Voltage Regulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency and voltage regulation performance of the power electronic transformers (PETs), a hybrid cascaded PET with tight voltage regulation is proposed in this paper. In this hybrid cascaded PET, multiple LLC resonant converters and a three-level half bridge converter are employed as the isolation stage, where the LLC converter works in the dc-dc transformer mode to maximize the efficiency and the three-level half bridge dc-dc converter is used to realize the tight voltage regulation. Control strategies for the hybrid cascaded PET are proposed and a simulation model is built in MATLAB/Simulink. The simulation results verify the validations of the proposed structure and control strategies.

articleTitle: Optimization operation strategy of cyber physical system of micro-energy grid based on Petri net
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Micro-energy grid is a typical cyber physical system (CPS), which combines energy physical entity and cyber computing unit. Aiming at the coordination optimization problem of cyber physical system of micro-energy grid, an optimization operation method of micro-energy grid based on Petri net is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the cyber physical system architecture of micro-energy grid is given. Secondly, taking the minimum operation cost and maximum utilization of clean energy as the objective function, the optimal scheduling model of micro-energy grid was constructed. Then multi-agent system and Petri net theory are used to determine the operation optimization strategy of the whole system according to the power load. Finally, the validity and correctness of the proposed method are verified by an example simulation analysis, which is of great significance for improving energy utilization efficiency and economic benefit.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Characteristics of Nano-modified Vegetable Insulating Oil
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the premise that the global is advocating low-carbon development, vegetable insulating oil has attracted widespread attention as a green and clean material. Compared with traditional mineral insulating oil, vegetable insulating oil have the disadvantages of poor fluidity and insufficient insulating performance. Nano-doping modification is a commonly used insulating oil modification method. The vegetable insulating oil models with different doping mass fractions of nano-silicon dioxide, nano-aluminium oxide, nano-silicon dioxide modified with silane coupling agent (KH550) and nano-aluminium oxide modified with silane coupling agent (KH550) were established using Materials Studio simulation software to explore the optimal conditions for nano-modified vegetable insulating oil. By analyzing the non-bonded interaction energy between nanoparticles and vegetable insulating oil molecules, the Mean Square Displacement (MSD) and the DC breakdown voltage of the modified system, it was explored whether the modified vegetable insulating oil could stably exist and the modified conditions with the best heat dissipation and insulation characteristics. Finally, the optimal conditions for nano-doping modified vegetable insulating oil were comprehensively analyzed, including the type and doping concentration of nanoparticles.

articleTitle: The enlightenment of foreign mature power futures designed logic to China
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the promotion of the power marketization reform in China, the main body of the power market is facing a variety of market risks, and the problem of the power spot market is becoming increasingly prominent. From the foreign experience, the power futures as a risk management tool have played an important role in price discovery and maintaining market fair competition, etc. The article combed the domestic and foreign scholars on the study of electricity futures, represented by America, northern Europe, Australia, from the electricity futures market development present situation, contract element, trading rules Angle should be carefully analyzed the foreign mature operation electricity futures market development and product design logic, concluded that the development of the construction of the enlightenment to our country electric power futures.

articleTitle: Single Voltage Control Loop Strategy with Resonance Suppression Ability of Flexible HVDC Station Supplying Passive AC Line
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It is an essential operation part of flexible high voltage direct current transmission system supplying the passive AC lines for a high proportion of new energy power plant without power transferred, which has a high risk of resonances in closed-loop operation control. For this scenario, a single voltage control loop with resonance suppression abilities is proposed. The key factors causing resonance under traditional single voltage control method are analyzed based on the consideration of time delay. Secondly, a control strategy with voltage and current feed forward compensation is proposed and the analytical expression of voltage controller parameter are derived. Thirdly, the analytic calculation and optimal design of the parameter's selection ranges of the feed forward compensator are presented to suppress resonance from different frequency bands. Finally, simulation models are used to verify the effectiveness of proposed strategy and method of parameters calculation and optimization design.

articleTitle: Analysis on Disconnector Contacts Burned in a 252kV GIS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To research the reason of contacts burned of a disconnector in 252kV GIS in operation, through external measurement, disassembly inspection, theoretical calculation and other methods, it is concluded that because the outlet bushing and GIS body are not an integral foundation, the settlement of the separated foundation makes the crank arm of the disconnector offset, and the contact closing is not in place, which eventually causes the contact burning loss of the disconnector. The results show that when the center distance deviation of the connecting rod is greater than 5mm, the contact of the disconnector is in the state of rigid contact; When the center distance deviation of the connecting rod between phases is 7mm, the contact of the disconnector is in the off state.

articleTitle: Temporal and Spatial Characteristics of Surface Charge Deposited by He Plasma Jet with CF4 Additive
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Atmospheric pressure plasma jets (APPJs) with trace active ingredients can make the material surface have the specified performance, which has a wide range of applications in the field of surface modification, biomedicine, and microelectronics. In this paper, the charge-discharge behavior of quartz glass surface acted by He-APPJ with CF4 additive was studied, and a basic photoelectric joint diagnosis system and a reflective linear electro-optical effect diagnosis platform were built. Combined with the fast surface charge density inversion algorithm, the temporal and spatial distribution of quartz surface charge density under the action of plasma was observed. Temporal and spatial variation of charge density deposited by He/CF4 APPJ on the quartz surface. The results show that the spatial distribution of positive and negative surface charges of pure He-APPJ in filamentary discharge mode has an obvious polarity effect at the initial discharge. The positive charge presents branching distribution, while the negative charge presents circular distribution, and the surface charge distribution gradually becomes stable after 20 cycles. When the concentration of CF4 increases, the positive and negative charge distribution area on the quartz surface decreases gradually, and the peak value of positive charge density first increases and then decreases, reaching the peak value at 0.5% CF4. Negative charge density peak decreases all the time; According to the distribution of charge density and total charge, it can be inferred that the addition of CF4 brings dual effects to the discharge process. First, a small amount of CF4 can aggravate the deposition of positive charges on the surface; Second, excessive addition of CF4 can inhibit the deposition of positive and negative charges, especially the accumulation of negative charges on the surface.

articleTitle: Analysis and Calculation of Typical Influencing Factors of Overhead Line Conductor Sag Under Vegetation Fire Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When a vegetation fire occurs under overhead transmission lines, high temperature leads to increased sag of the conductor, which leads to an increased trip risk of lines. To analyze the insulation strength of transmission lines under vegetation fire conditions, it is necessary to calculate the nonuniform temperature rise sag accurately. In this paper, a vegetation fire temperature measurement platform was established to obtain the fire temperature of pinus yunnanensis at different heights. Taking a 400m span and LGJ-500/65 conductor as examples, the effects of different vegetation types, number of fire spots and wind on maximum sag were analyzed. The simulation results show that the sag obtained considering the non-nonuniform temperature rise is more accurate than the existing piecewise calculation results. The highest flame temperature of pinus yunnanensis is 829°C, and its maximum sag can reach 15.82m. When the length of the conductor affected by flame is unchanged, the increase in the number of fire spots has little influence on the sag, and the maximum increase is only 2.51%. Under the transverse wind, the vertical height of the flame will be significantly reduced, so that the temperature at the conductor will be reduced, and the sag of the conductor will be reduced. The results can provide a reference for the accurate construction of the gap breakdown voltage prediction model under vegetation fire.

articleTitle: Influence of DC Voltage Component on Surface Flashover of Insulating Screw under Composite AC and DC Voltage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to deeply understand the flashover problem of insulating screw under composite AC and DC voltage in converter transformer, an experimental electrode satisfying the electric field distribution characteristics of insulating screw surface was designed on the basis of simulation. By building an AC-DC superimposed power system in which the DC voltage component can be adjusted arbitrarily, the influence law of DC component on the flashover characteristics of insulating screw along the surface under composite voltage was studied. The results show that the flashover voltage along the surface of insulating screw increases with the increase of DC voltage. However, space charge accumulates on the surface of insulated screw under DC voltage, which distorts the electric field and leads to the decline of AC component, which decreases continuously with the increase of DC component.

articleTitle: Design of miniaturized extraction equipment for lithium polymer battery
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the use of polymer materials, lithium polymer battery has the characteristics of miniaturized, light-weighting, and high stability materials, which make them competitive in some special areas such as the military. In order to realize independent production of this battery, the essential extraction equipment has been designed and produced by Shanghai Institute of Space Power-sources. This paper introduces the structure design, safety design, and sealing design of lithium polymer batteries.

articleTitle: Magnetic Field Energy Harvesting with Broad Frequency Band
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Magnetic fields with a broad frequency band are widely distributed in the nearby space of power electronic devices. Harvesting magnetic field energy over these frequency bands will help supply wireless devices. This paper proposes a method of harvesting magnetic field energy from broad frequency band over k-Hz. Two broadband impedance matching networks based on Butterworth design and optimal power bandwidth product design are proposed, which have the characteristics of flattest power pass and maximum power pass, respectively. The designed prototype can harvest magnetic field energy in a broad frequency band from 10 kHz to 20 kHz. With eleven frequency points selected from magnetic field strength measurement in an MMC valve hall, total power of 410 μW for Butterworth matching network and 460 μW for optimal PBP matching network can be obtained.

articleTitle: Research on configuration optimization of integrated energy system considering equipment nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The integrated energy system has clear economic, energy-saving, and environmental benefits and is considered an important approach to achieve the dual-carbon strategy. Optimizing the capacity of each component in the integrated energy system is crucial in determining its overall performance. However, existing studies often simplify the equipment characteristics through linearization, which affects the optimization results. To overcome this, this paper presents a configuration optimization method for the integrated energy system that considers the non-linear characteristics of the equipment. The method is based on a hierarchical solution structure derived from multi-energy flow balance calculations, making the non-linear optimization easier. The effectiveness of the method is demonstrated through comparisons with traditional configuration optimization methods.

articleTitle: Wide-area Monitoring Systems of Broadband Oscillations in Offshore Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The interaction of offshore wind with VSC-HVDC system may trigger broadband oscillations, which seriously affects the safety and stability of offshore wind power integration. In order to realize the real-time monitoring of broadband oscillation, this paper proposes a broadband oscillation monitoring system suitable for offshore wind power in view of the lack of detection ability of broadband oscillation, lack of processing ability of non-stationary signals and difficulty in real-time to meet the monitoring needs of existing measurement technologies, builds a key technical system, establishes a mathematical model based on local mean decomposition algorithm, and verifies the feasibility of the algorithm through specific examples. Finally, the hardware architecture design of the broadband monitoring system was carried out, which provided technical support for making full use of offshore wind energy resources and achieving “carbon compliance”.

articleTitle: Study on the discharge and defect characteristics of the binding wire to the insulated conductor in the distribution network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The root cause of partial discharge at the overhead binding line of the distribution line is that the electric field strength increases and exceeds the initial electric field strength of the discharge, so it is important to analyze the factors affecting the change of the electric field strength. In this paper, the electric field distribution characteristics of the distribution line at the overhead binding line under normal working conditions are simulated and calculated, and the key characteristic quantities of the discharge and the possible positions of the discharge are obtained under three working conditions of the insulator under different deterioration degree, wetting degree and binding line structure. The simulation results show that the maximum electric field strength decreases from 6.72kV/cm when the conductor is intact to 4.63kV/cm with the deepening of insulator deterioration cracks; With the increase of the distance between the binding wire and the conductor, the maximum electric field strength decreases continuously, and the minimum value is 0.266kV/cm; The field strength increases with the decrease of humidity at the binding line, and the maximum value is 7.8kV/cm.

articleTitle: Fractal UWB Antenna for Partial Discharge UHF Detection in GIS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a design of an ultra-wideband antenna based on fractal technology, aimed at detecting partial discharge signals in Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) systems. The design incorporates a fractal transformation applied to the radiation patch component of the antenna, which results in an expanded bandwidth, facilitated by the use of an inverted triangle gap in the ground plane. The geometric parameters of the antenna were subjected to optimization and simulation. The simulation results indicate that the antenna exhibits a frequency band range of 0.5GHz to 3.0GHz. Furthermore, the antenna demonstrates good directivity in the aforementioned frequency band range. The compact size of the antenna, with dimensions of 200mm x 130mm x 2mm, renders it suitable for use in GIS partial discharge signal detection applications. The findings of this study demonstrate that the proposed ultra-wideband antenna based on fractal technology satisfies the requirements for partial discharge signal detection in GIS systems.

articleTitle: Research on Vibration Characteristics of Inter-turn Short Circuit on Secondary Side of Amorphous Alloy Transformer Winding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Transformer is the core equipment in power system, because of its interturn short circuit fault often affects the stability and safety of transformer work, so the analysis of transformer core saturation characteristics has important practical significance for transformer fault diagnosis and protection. In this paper, Ansys/Maxwell was adopted to model the amorphous alloy transformer SBH15-M-400/10. After verifying the accuracy of the model, short circuit occurred in the secondary side windings of the transformer with different turns and at different positions of turns with the same number and test. The results show that when the interturn short-circuit fault occurs in the secondary side winding of the transformer, the short-circuit turns winding will generate a short-circuit circulation several times the rated current, and the short-circuit turns increase with the increase of the number of short-circuit turns. When the short-circuit position and the number of short-circuit turns change, the current of the high-voltage normal winding is little affected, while the iron core has a large vibration. The conclusion can provide support for the visualization of transformer digital twinning.

articleTitle: A High Power Rotating Energy Harvester Based On Gyroscopic Effect For Self-Powered Wireless Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a gyroscopic energy harvester is proposed with watts level output power that is capable to power wireless sensors with large energy requirement. The rotor, magnet and coil of the gyroscopic energy harvester are optimally designed to increase the electro-magnetic rotation effect. An experimental prototype was also built with power conversion stage to form a fully self-powered system. The output power of this gyroscopic energy harvester reaches to 904 mW at a speed of 4800 rpm. The output power of the gyroscopic energy harvester increases with its speed. And its output can provide sufficient power for the wireless sensor after the power conversion circuit. The proposed gyroscopic energy harvester can be applied to collect vibration energy from ocean wave and overhead lines for on-line monitoring of deep-sea floating wind power platform and long-distance power transmissions.

articleTitle: Investigation of Novel Interior PM Machine with Asymmetric Magnet Distributions for EV Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel magnet-axis-shifting IPM (MAS-IPM) machine with asymmetric magnet distributions for traction applications. With asymmetrical PM distribution and adjustment of air space barriers width of the rotor, MAS effect can be achieved to make the magnet and reluctance torque components reach their peaks at closer current angles. The operating principle and the topology derivation of the proposed MAS-IPM are introduced first, and the open-circuit field distribution is utilized to reveal the MAS effect clearly. In addition, the design optimization is carried out to obtain the optimal torque performance of the proposed machine. The electromagnetic characteristics of the proposed MAS-IPM machine are investigated and compared with those of the benchmark Toyota Prius 2010 IPM machine. The analysis results suggest that the proposed MAS-IPM machine can provide higher torque density and higher efficiency using same volume of PMs, which makes the novel machines promising for electric vehicle applications.

articleTitle: Solar irradiation prediction model based on cloud and aerosol parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Observation-based statistical and neural network models have been widely used for solar irradiance prediction. However, the existing models predict solar irradiance through time series or neural networks lacking a clear link to physics and predict solar irradiance which do not reflect the specific effects of influences such as clouds and aerosols on solar irradiance. In this paper, the physics process is incorporated into an observation-based model to fully consider the interaction of clouds and aerosols with solar radiation. A radiation attenuation model (CA model) is developed, in which the effects of clouds and aerosols on solar irradiation are discussed separately. Comparing the CA model with the simple model and the smart model, it is verified that the CA model has higher accuracy under both sunny and cloudy conditions.

articleTitle: A flux-free closed-loop control for reducing torque ripple of Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A flux-free closed-loop strategy based on direct torque control (DTC) is proposed to solve the problem that switched reluctance motor (SRM) is prone to produce large torque ripple in commutation zone. Firstly, the closed-loop control of constant flux linkage is cancelled by analyzing the reason of large torque ripple caused by traditional DTC method. Secondly, according to the torque error signal and the inductance characteristics, the selection method of voltage vector when the torque needs to be increased or decreased at present is analyzed, and the traditional candidate voltage vector switching table is reconstructed. Finally, a 6/20 motor with permanent magnet auxiliary outer rotor is simulated and verified. The results show that the proposed control strategy can not only reduce the torque ripple of the motor, but also improve the torque-current ratio under different speed and load.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Polypropylene Cable Based on Electro-Thermal Multi-physics Coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Compared to XLPE cables, Polypropylene cable has the advantages of simple manufacturing process, high conveying capacity and recyclability, so PP cable will have a wide market in the future and it is essential to study the operational status of PP cable. In this paper, the physical field states of a PP cable under operating conditions is investigated by building an electrical-thermal coupling simulation model. The results show that when the current of the cable reaches 800A, the electric field strength distribution of the insulation layer tends to be flat along the radius of the cable, so it is recommended that the cable is operated at about 800 A. When the current is small, the thickness of the insulation layer has a small effect on the temperature difference between the inside and outside of the insulation layer, while the temperature difference of the insulation layer increases obviously with the increase of insulation thickness when the current is higher. When the cable is laid in the tunnel, the temperature of the conductor is 12.9 °C lower than that of directly buried lying. The heat dissipation efficiency of tunnel lying is significantly higher than that of directly buried lying.

articleTitle: Magnetic Pole Optimization of Sinusoidal Pole-shaping Surface-mounted Multi-phase Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To compare the optimization effects of air gap flux density between the eccentric pole shaping(EPS) and the sinusoidal pole shaping(SPS) in surface-mounted multi-phase permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs), the air gap flux density under two pole shaping models are calculated by using the control variable method. Firstly, the mathematical models of permanent magnets (PM) under two different pole cutting modes are established by equivalent surface current method. Secondly, the air gap flux density is calculated by subdomain method. Thirdly, the electromagnetic performance of the multi-phase PMSM with different pole shaping modes is compared through controlling the PM volume and the minimum air gap length. Finally, an 10kW surface-mounted nine-phase permanent magnet synchronous motors is simulated to verify the calculation results.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of temperature characteristics and surrounding flow field of power cable along the bridge
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power cable simulation is of great significance to the construction of engineering projects. The specific simulation process generally needs to include the surrounding environment to realize the accurate simulation of the power cable itself. In this paper, Fluent is used to simulate the power cable, the surrounding flow field and part of the bridge. The results show that the increase of wind speed can enhance the heat dissipation process of power cables, but the relationship between the wind speed and the maximum load current is not linear. At the same time, the ambient temperature will also have an impact on the final temperature of the power cable. Usually, the rise in ambient temperature will directly affect the temperature of the conductor.
