Therefore, in order to ensure that the conductor temperature of the power cable is less than or equal to 363K during long-term operation, after considering the influence of environmental factors and load current fluctuations, the maximum load current should be properly adjusted to prolong the life of the power cable.

articleTitle: Research on Accurate PI Parameter Design for Power Amplifier of Active Vibration Reduction System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The stable operation control and accurate quantitative PI controller design of power amplifier in active vibration reduction system are mainly studied in this paper. The continuous and discrete models and their design results are compared. It is illustrated that the bandwidth and optimized PI parameters are strongly related with discrete delay in digital control, and the parameters designed under these two models differ greatly. The quantitative PI design can be suitable only under accurate model considerations. The experimental waveforms under unipolar double frequency SPWM control are supplied to verify the effectiveness of the design results.

articleTitle: Research Trends and Hotspots of Integrated Energy System: Visualization Analysis Based on CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Integrated energy system (IES) is essential in promoting the energy production and consumption revolution. It helps to build a clean, low-carbon and efficient energy system. To systematically analyze the development of the IES, CiteSpace is used to analyze the publications “integrated energy system” literature in the core collection of the Web of Science. Firstly, this paper maps the collaborative network of countries, institutions and core authors. The distribution of research power and scientific cooperation in IES is available. Secondly, the co-occurrence, clustering and emergent analysis of keywords are carried out to obtain research hotspots, development trends and research frontiers. Based on the above analysis, the recent hotspot is IES with solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC), and power flow is an emerging trend in the field. The results can guide the future research development of the IES.

articleTitle: Impact assessment for large-scale off-grid of renewable energy on weakly interconnected systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the background of increasingly serious off-grid problems of renewable energy, this paper analyzes the impact of large-scale off-grid of renewable energy and voltage stability in the weakly interconnected system. First, an improved index is proposed based on Simpson formula for assessing transient voltage stability and achieving early warning of instability risk. Then, based on the simulation of a real-life UHV (Ultra-high voltage) weakly interconnected system, two typical cascading failure scenarios are reasonably anticipated. These cascading failures contain a series of renewable energy off-grid and blocking of DC transmission caused by different initial failures, whose voltage stability is evaluated by the proposed index. Besides, the nature of cascading failure evolution is analyzed. Finally, accuracy and efficient of the proposed index are verified.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Design and Analysis of High Speed Permanent Magnet Motor with Composite Rotor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For high-speed permanent magnet synchronous motors (HSPMSM), the rotor eddy current loss is generated by the time and the space harmonics, which results in the rotor temperature rise. This paper deals with the design and analysis of a 100kW, 20000r/min HSPMSM with novel composite rotor. The novel composite rotor includes a shaft, sintered permanent magnet, novel composite magnetic materials with low conductivity and carbon fiber sleeve. With the power supply and rotation speed unchanged, the effects of magnetizing methods, pole-arc coefficient and interpolar filling materials on rotor eddy current loss are analyzed based on finite element analysis (FEA). Finally, the electromagnetic (EM) performance and losses are compared with those of the different rotor structure.

articleTitle: A Sensorless Control Method for Low-voltage and High-current BLDC Based on Back-EMF
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the position sensorless drive system of low-voltage high-current brushless DC (BLDC) motor for oil pump, a three-stage start-up control strategy to improve the voltage at the back electromotive force terminal voltage is studied. The back-EMF detection circuit is built with sampling resistor and comparator. The logical relationship between the comparator output signal and the power device switch is determined. Pre-positioning is achieved by energizing any two phases in the inverter and controlling the winding current. The BLDC is steadily accelerated by increasing the commutation signal frequency of the driver. When the motor accelerates to the predetermined speed, it can accurately detect the back-EMF zero-crossing signal and switch to the self-synchronization operation state. The proposed method is verified by simulation and experiment, and the results show that the speed and current closed-loop sensorless PI control strategy has good performance.

articleTitle: Rotor Stress of Slotless High-Speed Permanent Magnet BLDC Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The rotor stress research is one of the hot issues in the field of high-speed permanent magnet motor. In this paper, the rotor stress of high-speed permanent magnet brushless direct current (BLDC) motor is studied. Firstly, the theoretical analysis of rotor stress is given. Secondly, the influences of interference fit, temperature and speed on the stress of different parts of rotor are studied by finite element method. Finally, the rotor strength of stator slotless motor is calculated under rated working conditions.

articleTitle: Cost Allocation for Frequency Regulation Mileage Based on Contributions to System Power Unbalance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In market environment, it is necessary to reasonably allocate the frequency regulation mileage costs to the market participants who cause the need for regulation mileage. In this way, market participants can be incentivized to reduce their uncertainties and fluctuations, which helps to improve the ability to consume renewables of the power system. However, the current cost allocation methods cannot consider the comprehensive impact of the uncertainties and fluctuations of different market participants. With this in mind, this paper proposes a cost allocation method of regulation mileage based on contributions to the system power unbalance is proposed. The system power unbalance is defined and calculated to reflect the regulation mileage requirement. Based on the sensitivity analysis, the contributions of market participants to the system power unbalance are quantified, according to which the cost allocation can be implemented. Case studies illustrate the reasonability of the proposed cost allocation method.

articleTitle: Small resistance earthing protection computation and engineering verification for renewable energy generation dominated power system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Transient characteristics of power system has developed significantly because of the increasing share of renewable energy generations (REGs). In order to cope with these inevitable impacts from large scale REGs. This paper presents a practical small resistance earthing protection computation for REGs relay protection configuration scheme under extreme fault conditions. First, relay setting calculation is analyzed to identify its key characteristics in renewable energy generation dominated power system. Second, we propose an improvement small resistance earthing protection computation strategy based on theoretical analysis above. Considering the difficulties in project implementation, the detailed calculation process is given with practical engineering example and operation data verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Conduction and Amplification of Harmonics in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the “network” side cable rate significantly increased, the impedance and capacitive characteristics of the network are highlighted, and harmonics are prone to conduction and amplification in high-cable ratio distribution networks. This paper studies the establishment of the equivalent model of harmonic transfer for the main components of the power network based on circuit theory, qualitatively and quantitatively analyzes the transfer characteristics and amplification reasons of harmonics after passing through cable lines and transformers through the harmonic transfer coefficient, and based on the MATLAB simulation software, observe the change of the harmonic transfer coefficient under the influence of different parameters. Then, ETAP software is used to build a network element model to analyze the influence of different factors on the harmonic content rate, and to further analyze and verify the above theory.

articleTitle: An improved model for predicting the maximum power point of PV modules
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The maximum power is a very important quantity in operation of PV modules. The values of current, voltage and power at the peak power point are affected by the environment conditions such as incident irradiance and temperature of PV modules. In this paper, an improved analytical model using the single-diode model is proposed to predict the maximum power point of PV modules under different climatic conditions. The proposed model portrays the relationship between the maximum power and meteorological parameters G and T. The accuracy of the proposed model is verified by measured data collected in actual experiments. Compared with traditional methods, the improved model has smaller errors in estimating current, voltage and power values at the peak power point in both low and high irradiance ranges. This proposed improved model provides a reference for subsequent research on PV.

articleTitle: Novel reactive power decoupling control of virtual synchronous generators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of new energy generation, more and more renewable energy sources (RES) with inverters as interfaces are connected to the grid. The rising RES penetration within power systems and the reduction of rotating generators lead to a lack of inertia and damping in power systems. To improve the safety and stability of power systems with high RES penetration, virtual synchronous generators (VSG) are proposed to enable inverters to provide inertia to the grid. In this paper, a novel power decoupling control method is proposed based on the basic VSG control, which modifies the reactive power control and analyze its reactive power response. The effectiveness of the proposed method in this paper is verified by MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Online Identification Method of High Voltage AC Power Grid Strength Based on Disturbance of Control System of MMC Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The decrease of the strength of AC power grid will adversely affect the stable operation of the modular multi-level converter HVDC (MMC-HVDC) transmission system. To avoid the potential safe and stable operation risk brought by the weak AC power grid to the AC/DC system, and to realize the rapid online monitoring of the AC power grid strength under complex and changeable working conditions, this paper proposes an online identification method of strength based on disturbance of Control System of MMC Station. Firstly, the principle and identification method of disturbance and calculation method of AC power grid are introduced from the theoretical perspective. Then the influence of the frequency variation characteristics of the transmission line and the amount of reactive power injection on the accuracy of the power grid strength identification results are introduced respectively. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed method and the constraint of the identification accuracy are verified in simulation.

articleTitle: Identification Method for LVRT Control Parameters of Type-3 wind turbine Based on Short-Circuit Fault Frequency Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Accurately modeling the low voltage ride through (LVRT) fault characteristics of type-3 wind turbine is crucial for ensuring the safety and stability of high-proportion new energy power systems. However, identifying the controller parameters of the main external characteristics of type-3 wind turbine presents a significant engineering challenge, given the black box of manufacturer converter controller parameters. Existing identification methods have several limitations, including low identification accuracy and unrealistic identification scenarios. This paper proposes a new step identification method based on the short-circuit fault frequency model. The LVRT control strategy parameters are identified based on the output dynamic characteristics of type-3 wind turbine and the generalized LVRT control strategy. The short-circuit fault frequency model proposed in this paper is used to identify the controller parameters. Finally, the accuracy of the proposed method is verified by simulation examples. The results indicate that the proposed method has high accuracy and is suitable for practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: Discrete Library based Automatic Multi-objective Optimal Design Method for LLC Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As one of the most popular isolated DC/DC converters, LLC resonant converter has been widely adopted in different industrial applications. Optimal design for the converter is the most effective and straightforward approach to improve the converter efficiency. In this paper, a discrete library based automatic multi-objective optimal design method is proposed for LLC resonant converter based on the accurate time domain analysis. The key components, including primary switch, secondary rectifier, resonant inductor, transformer, litz wire, and heatsink, are optimized from the library. The resonant frequency, transformer turns ratio, and resonant tank parameters are optimized automatically. The system efficiency and power density are selected as the optimization objectives. The genetic algorithm is used to achieve the automatic optimal design of the converter. In addition, instead of using the fixed operating point's efficiency, a mission profile based averge weighted efficiency (it can also be customized) is selected as one of the optimization objectives. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed discrete library based optimal design method, a design example with 380 V input voltage and 48 V output voltage conversion ratio and 1 kW power rating for data center application is illustrated. The theoretical efficiency over the whole load operation range is above 97% with the optimal design candidate.

articleTitle: Influence of Damaged Tapes on AC Loss of Three-phase Coaxial HTS Cable
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The AC loss of a 10 kV three-phase coaxial high-temperature superconducting (HTS) transmission cable operating at rated operating conditions with damaged HTS tapes is solved based on the <tex>$H$</tex>-equation. One group has one damaged HTS tape in each phase of the cable. In the other group, two different types of unevenly distributed currents are applied in each phase of the cable, and the variance <tex>$\alpha$</tex> defines the difference between the individual transmission current and the average transmission current. The results show that even if there is only one damaged HTS tape, regardless of the phase in which it is located, it significantly increases the AC loss with its neighboring tapes. When the three-phase current is not unevenly distributed, the AC loss increases with the variance ratio <tex>$\alpha$</tex>.

articleTitle: Distributed Event-triggered Control of Thermostatically Controlled Loads as Virtual Power Plant Considering Signal Noises
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The rapid development of fluctuating renewable energies puts forward higher requirements on reserve capacity for sustaining the balance of the power system. To address this issue, this paper investigates a distributed control method of massive thermostatically controlled loads (TCLs) as the virtual power plant (VPP) to provide reserve capacity, considering signal noises. Firstly, the VPP model consisting of massive TCLs is derived to participate in the load regulation. Then, a distributed event-triggered control method is designed for TCLs in the VPP, which can realize the same regulation target and response speed while substantially reducing the communication burden compared with conventional time-scheduled distributed control methods. Finally, the VPP model and the proposed control method are verified by numerical studies, which takes the impact of signal noises into consideration.

articleTitle: Raman Spectroscopy of Decomposition Products of C4F7N/CO2/O2 Gas Mixture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N /CO<inf>2</inf> gas mixture has excellent insulation and interrupting properties, and is considered to be the most promising SF<inf>6</inf> replacement gas at present. In order to avoid the carbon precipitation phenomenon of C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N /CO<inf>2</inf> gas mixture in the process of opening and closing, O2 needs to be added as the second buffer gas. When partial discharge or local overheating occurs, the C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N /CO<inf>2</inf>/O<inf>2</inf> gas mixture will decompose, and the fault in gas-insulated electrical equipment can be determined by detecting the decomposition components of the gas mixture in gas-insulated electrical equipment. However, the existing C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N ICO<inf>2</inf>/O<inf>2</inf> gas mixture decomposition components are difficult to achieve relatively accurate multi-component simultaneous detection. In this paper, the Raman spectra of each single gas and gas mixture of C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N /CO<inf>2</inf>/O<inf>2</inf> gas mixture and its decomposition gas were obtained by simulation, and the spectral characteristics of the characteristic Raman peaks of each gas were investigated. This study provides some basic data for the detection and quantitative analysis of the decomposition components of C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N /CO<inf>2</inf>/O<inf>2</inf> gas mixture, and shows that Raman spectroscopy has great potential in the field of detection of the decomposition components of C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N /CO<inf>2</inf>/O<inf>2</inf> gas mixture.

articleTitle: Research on multi-converter control strategy for DC offshore wind power collection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasingly severe form of global fossil energy, to further address the excessive use of fossil energy and the environment pollution and other issues, wind power has become a hot research scholars in recent years. Offshore wind power has become an important source of energy for sustainable development in the future because of its advantages in land area, wind energy resources and stability, and low noise pollution. In recent years, the pure-DC wind farm based on DC collection-DC transmission has been subjected to a comparison. Considering the difficulty in control of a large number of converters, a distributed control strategy is proposed to ensure the voltage stability of DC collection bus for DC offshore wind power. Firstly, the key converter modular multilevel converter(MMC) is modeled and analyzed, and the calculation formulas of voltage and current inside MMC are obtained. Secondly, the voltage and current double loop control is designed for the collection converter, and the power coordination control is adopted in the outer loop to ensure the consistent output power between individual wind turbines. To verify it, a multi-typhoon multi-condition collection simulation model is built in MATLAB/ SIMULINK. The results show that the proposed control strategy of offshore wind power DC collection multi-link converter could effectively maintain the DC bus voltage stability.

articleTitle: Influence of gas type and input power on ion distribution in transformer coupled toroidal plasma
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Transformer-coupled plasma sources are widely used in the semiconductor industry. In order to better control the plasma generated, it is urgent to understand the plasma characteristics inside transformer-coupled plasma source equipment. In this work, a two-dimensional numerical model of transformer-coupled toroidal plasma is established with considering a matching circuit. The Poisson equation and the transport equations of charged and neutral particles are calculated in a coupled way. The electron power deposition and fluid velocity are updated by calculating the specified components of Maxwell's equations and the fluid equations at specified time points. Two gas mixtures, namely Ar/NH<inf>3</inf> and Ar/NF<inf>3</inf> are studied in the simulation, and the density of Ar<sup>+</sup> in these two mixtures are compared. We also change the power of the radio frequency (RF) source coupled to the plasma and investigate the corresponding influence on the Ar<sup>+</sup> distribution. The results show that the Ar<sup>+</sup> density increases with the RF power. Since NF3 is more electronegativity than NH3, the density of Ar<sup>+</sup> in the Ar/NH<inf>3</inf> mixture is higher than that in the Ar/NF<inf>3</inf> mixture under the same condition.

articleTitle: A Short-Circuit Protection Control Strategy for Single-Phase Voltage Source Inverters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Current limiting protection against short-circuit is an important capability for the reliability of the voltage source inverter (VSI). In this paper, a novel overcurrent protection strategy is proposed, which can limit the peak value of output current to a constant value, and users can set the value. The proposed control method contains three operations to suppress overcurrent. First is the feedforward of output voltage to the current control loop, then the anti-windup loop in the voltage controller, and finally, once a short-circuit fault is detected, reduce the current loop gain immediately. The principle of the three parts is described in detail in this paper. Simulation results and experimental results on a commercial single-phase inverter verify the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Distribution System Considering its Interactions with Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the practice of low-carbon development and energy transformation of power systems, more renewable energy will be connected to the power system by forming multiple microgrids. This paper proposes a reliability evaluation framework of the distribution system considering its interactions with microgrids. The proposed method expatiates the relationship between system-level and microgrid-level reliability evaluation. Specifically, for the evaluation of the distribution system, the microgrid model can be simplified as an average value model, and obtain reliability indices of the system and load points. For the evaluation of microgrids, utilize the failure rate index of point of common coupling (PCC) as the input information that reflects the distribution system's impact to implement the evaluation task. The proposed framework is verified by the modified IEEE-123 test system. Results show that the simplified microgrid model can improve the evaluation efficiency while maintaining the accuracy of the distribution system evaluation.

articleTitle: Harmonic Analysis for Low-Capacitance Cascaded H-Bridge STATCOM with Phase-shifted PWM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Phase-shifted pulse width modulation (PSPWM) has been an industry standard applied to cascaded H-bridge (CHB) multilevel converters. The application of film capacitors to dc-link results in a reliable CHB system, but considerable capacitor voltage variation is also introduced due to the low power density of film capacitors. This paper develops an analytical solution to the harmonic spectrum of the pulsewidth modulated output voltage of the CHB-STATCOM connected to the dc bus with considerable voltage ripple. Simulation results are presented to validate the analytical solution.

articleTitle: Method to Pre-evaluate the benefits of Time-of-use Tariff on Residential Electric Vehicle Charging Loads
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Time-of-use (TOU) tariff is an important approach to encourage residents to alter their energy consumption behaviors in response to grid demand, which is also considered the most promising strategy for dealing with the rapidly growing residential electric vehicle charging load. However, due to the lack of systematic pre-evaluate method to predict the benefits of time-of-use tariff on electric vehicle charging loads, the development of a time-of-use tariff for electric vehicle loads is still not entirely evident. Additionally, the real-world data quality has rarely been considered, so most studies are not directly applicable. In this paper, a quantitative method for pre-evaluation of the time-of-use tariff benefits on residential electric vehicle charging loads is proposed considering the practical implementation with real-world coarse data. Based on the analysis of the large-scale real-world residential charging data, models to predict the residential charging load under both the fixed tariff and time-of-use tariff are built and the corresponding evaluation framework is established. Using the proposed method, the impact of applying a time-of-use tariff on the charging load in Tianjin is analyzed as a case study. The benefits of time-of-use tariffs in the medium and long term are predicted and evaluated, and the results provide important references for policy-making of both the large-scale adoption of electric vehicles and the development of the low-carbon power grid.

articleTitle: An Online Monitoring Method for Mechanical Instability of UHV Converter Transformer Based on Vibration Complexity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power transformers are the core assets of power systems, and there is still a lack of effective means for online monitoring of their mechanical instability. In this paper, in view of the lack of existing transformer on-line monitoring methods, based on the Lempel-Ziv complexity algorithm, the complexity analysis method of the signal uploaded by the power transformer based on the MEMS sensor is carried out. The principle and properties of the Lempel-Ziv complexity algorithm are described in detail. For the MEMS sensing signal of UHV converter transformer, the construction process of the sensing signal sequence is explained, and the corresponding instability criteria are formulated. Finally, the effect of the algorithm is verified by the 1000 kVA power transformer test platform. The verification results prove the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Aging State of Composite Insulators Based on Terahertz Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Composite insulator is an important insulating equipment of power system, which is prone to internal faults that are not easy to detect during operation, and the detection and diagnosis of faults becomes an important issue. Terahertz method is an emerging method to detect internal faults of insulators, which has the advantages of strong penetration ability, high safety and accurate measurement, and can effectively extract the information of the measured samples and precisely determine the fault location of insulators. In this paper, firstly, samples of six composite insulators with different operating ages in a region of North China were made, and afterwards, in order to investigate the influence of aging degrees of composite insulators on the terahertz wave transmission parameters, the terahertz vector network analyzer was used to conduct experimental tests on the calibrated groups of samples\, and a model of aging detection of composite insulators based on the terahertz signal transmission characteristics was established.

articleTitle: Efficiency-Power Density Multi-Objective Optimization Design of LLC Resonant Converter Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As all knows, the dramatic improvement in the performance of wide band gap devices, such as SiC devices, can greatly increase the power density or efficiency of converters. However, with the increase of the switching frequency, the volume of the electrical electronic device has decreased significantly, but the loss has greatly increased. Therefore, the conflict between the converter device design indicators is exacerbated, and a comprehensive optimization design needs to be performed. The existing converter design method may only consider the optimization of the single goal, or the order design method that depends on artificial experience. There are defects for the optimized design between multiple targets and changes when the demand changes. In this paper, a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based multi-objective optimization design method for the efficiency-power density of a single-phase LLC resonant converter is presented as an example, which enables the optimal design parameters to be obtained quickly at design time according to the design objectives. When the design requirements change, it is possible to achieve rapid access to the best design parameters according to the design objectives. First, a framework for DRL-based efficiency-power density optimization is presented; then the efficiency and power density of the converter are modelled. Afterwards, the agent is continuously trained by self-learning with deep deterministic policy gradients (DDPG) and an optimization strategy that minimizes power loss as well as volume is obtained. Finally, the strategy is able to respond quickly to changes in design specifications and provide design parameters that optimize efficiency-power density.

articleTitle: Recognition of branch node topology in low voltage power network based on meter acquisition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The massive amount of meter measurement data brought by smart meters and remote meter reading technology makes it possible to carry out topology identification of low-voltage power supply networks. This paper proposes a topology identification method for low-voltage power supply network based on meter measurement data. The method defines the meters in the topology as branch node meters. According to the characteristics of power mu-tation, the feature is extracted by wavelet transform, and the connection relation of branch nodes is determined by similarity judgment. By using actual field data, an example analysis of a power supply network with 12 branch meters and 114 user meters is carried out, and the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper is verified by the results.

articleTitle: Instantaneous Power Decoupling Control Strategy for T-type Three-level Rectifier with Independent Double Loads
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In some applications, two independent loads are connected to the upper and lower DC-link capacitors, and the T-type three-level rectifier operates in the dual output mode. In these applications, the DC-link voltages control, power exchange relationship and modulation method are quite different from that in single output mode. The instantaneous power exchange principle in the dual output mode is analyzed in this letter. Based on that, an instantaneous power decoupling control (IPDC) is proposed. The proposed method adopts respective regulators for the upper and lower DC-link voltages, and the zero-sequence voltage (ZSV) is injected to decouple the input power. Under balanced or unbalanced DC-link voltages and loads, DC-link voltages and exchanged power can be well controlled with the proposed method. From the analysis of the output voltage of the upper or lower capacitor, buck type rectifier is realized, which improves the operating range of the T-type three-level rectifier, especially in the field of electric vehicle charging. Finally, the feasibility and superiority of the proposed method are verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Design of the Tri-redundant Permanent-Magnet Synchronous Machine for More-electric Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: There is a strict demand on the reliability of the driving motor for the electrical actuator of the more electric aircraft. However, the power density is inevitably decreased if inceasing the reliability only by arranging multiple sets of windings to the stator. Given that, this paper provides a dual-stator tri-redundant permanent magnet fault-tolerant motor, which can output the rated power with single-redundancy winding faulty and 50% rated power with two-redundancy winding faulty, improving the reliability while maintaining the high power density. The selection of the winding topology was discussed comprehensively to choose that having lower coupling degree between different sets of three-phase windings. The structure of the rotor was optimized to reduce the rotor-eddy loss, and the strength of the rotor was evaluated as well. Then the thermal-analysis model was built and the thermal characteristics of the motor were calculated under different running conditions. Finally, a 6 kW, 12 000 rpm prototype was manufactured to verify the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Operation Mode Design and Optimization of Building Type Energy Supply System Based on TRYNSYS Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The building energy system combined cooling heating and power system (CCHP) has the advantages of low grid line loss and high reliability of the energy supply system. In order to improve the economy of the energy supply system and reduce the level of building energy consumption, taking the building type energy supply system in a certain area as the research object, combined with different equipment operation combinations, a variety of system operation modes were designed, and the TRNSYS software was used to build the calculation model of the energy supply system. Taking the primary energy utilization rate and annual operation cost of the system as evaluation indexes, the system energy utilization rate and economy under different operation modes are compared and analyzed. The results show that, for the natural gas CCHP system, compared with the full-load operation mode, the use of energy storage tank peak cutting and valley filling and heat fixed operation mode can improve the energy utilization rate of the system and reduce the operation cost of the system. The use of electric compression heat pump for cooling and heating, the annual operating cost of the system is the lowest.

articleTitle: A Detection Method for Detuned Components of DC Filters in UHVDC System Based on Fault Record Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Detuning of DC filters in Ultra High Voltage Direct Current (UHVDC) system will increase the harmonic level, and the location of the detuning component has important application value for improving the operation reliability of DC filters. This paper proposes a method to detect the detuning components of the dual-tuned DC filter based on fault recording. First, the components are grouped according to the filter structure, and the detuning components in each group and the corresponding detuning degree can be determined by calculating the harmonic current and harmonic impedance by using the electrical quantity of the recording measuring point recorded by the system after the fault. Finally, the correctness and validity of the proposed method and criterion are verified by the calculation and analysis of PSCAD simulation data and on-site recording data.

articleTitle: Coordinated Voltage Control Based on Projected Gradient Descent Algorithm for PV-Rich Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Large-scale distributed photovoltaic (PV) access to the distribution network has adverse effects on system operation and voltage control. This paper proposes a distributed voltage control strategy based on the projected gradient descent algorithm. The optimal voltage control problem is formulated as an optimization program, with the goal of maintaining the voltage profile of node with PV across the network. The voltage control problem is reduced to a quadratic programming constrained optimization problem. By minimizing the voltage deviation, the reactive power injection problem of PV inverters is solved by the projected gradient descent algorithm. The proposed method only collects neighbor information of PV to communicate with each other without global communication. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively maintain the voltage to the security operating range.

articleTitle: Empirical formula for the frequency breakdown voltage of C4F7N/CO2 gas mixtures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to obtain an empirical formula for calculating the insulation performance of C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N/CO<inf>2</inf> gas mixtures, and to facilitate the insulation design, pre-testing and operation and maintenance of C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N/CO<inf>2</inf> gas mixtures, this paper investigates the variation characteristics of the insulation performance of gas mixtures with the mixture concentration, air pressure and electric field inhomogeneity coefficient as parameters, using experimental and currently reported data related to the industrial frequency breakdown of C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N/CO<inf>2</inf> gas mixtures. The data are then fitted to a complete empirical equation to predict the actual insulation capacity of the gas mixture.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a New Type of Stator Hybrid Excitation High-Speed Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Because the permanent magnet is easily demagnetized by centrifugal force and high temperature, a new type of stator hybrid excitation high-speed permanent magnet synchronous motor (HEHS-PMSM) is proposed to solve this problem. Firstly, the topology structure and working principle of the motor are introduced in detail. Secondly, the main structural parameters are obtained by designing the motor. And based on the finite element simulation, the electromagnetic performance of the motor is studied from the aspects of air gap flux density, rotor and permanent magnet eddy current loss. Finally, compared with the surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motor of the same volume, the results show that the electromagnetic performance of the motor is better.

articleTitle: Clamping Force Affected Power Cycling Capability of Double-sided Cooling Transferred IGBT Modules
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In practical applications, clamping force must be applied to eliminate the contact thermal resistance between D ouble-sided cooling (DSC) module and heatsink to ensure good heat dissipation performance. The clamping force determines the thermal performance of the DSC module, and also affects its long-term reliability. However, the effect of clamping force on the power cycle life of DSC module is rarely studied. In this paper, Firstly, it was found that among three cooling fixtures, fixture B has better uniformity pressure distribution on the surface of DSC module through Fuji paper test. Secondly, A 3D finite element model of DSC module was established after thermal calibration, the power cycling lifetime was simulated with Coffin-mason lifetime model under different clamping forces and two situations of the same junction temperature fluctuation which <tex>$\Delta \boldsymbol{T}_{\mathbf{j}}=100\mathbf{K},\boldsymbol{T}_{\mathrm{j}\max}=150^{\circ}\mathbf{C}$</tex> and the same power loss with <tex>$\boldsymbol{P}_{\text{loss}}=603\mathbf{W}$</tex> discussed respectively. Finally, the simulation results show that lower clamping force will lead to a decrease in the lifetime of the module because of the change of temperature distribution, and higher clamping force will cause additional stress on the chip and also increase the system cost.

articleTitle: Study on the Flow Field Characteristics of Pulse Dielectric Barrier Discharge Jet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Pulse dielectric barrier discharge jet is widely used in various fields. Pulse discharge can produce plasma with high chemical activity and uniformity. However, pulse discharge's instantaneous high power and energy deposition can also cause changes in the flow field, so further research is needed. This paper studied the characteristics of the flow field of pulse needlering dielectric barrier discharge jet. The schlieren imaging technology was combined with a high-speed camera to record the spatial-temporal resolution images of the flow field under different electrical parameters. It was found that with the increase of voltage amplitude, the emergence time of downstream turbulent vortices was advanced. The turbulent vortex average propagation speed (-3 m/s) was much lower than that of the jet (~10<sup>4</sup>m/s) but close to the gas velocity (2.97 m/s). However, the pulse width and repetition frequency had little effect on the flow field. It was also considered that the formation of turbulent vortices was related to the forward momentum of gas molecules.

articleTitle: Study on characteristic gas migration based on a scale-down ascending flanged base
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The large oil gap and poor oil circulation in the ascending flanged base of large transformers may lead to difficulty or delay in the migration of fault characteristic gas, making it difficult for the fault to be detected in time by the online or off-line dissolved gas diagnosis technology, which seriously endangers the safe operation of the transformer. Numerical simulation is a practical approach to obtaining the gas migration characteristics in a real high-voltage transformer, in order to verify the simulated results, a scale-down ascending flange base of forced oil circulation transformer is established. The Characteristic gas migration process, is numerically simulated by finite element method considering convection and diffusion. The results are in good consistency with the experimental results, which proves the effectiveness of the simulation method. By comparing the simulation and experimental results, it is found that the convection caused by forced oil circulation and temperature gradient dominates the gas migration. It provides conditions for further research on the gas migration in a real transformer.

articleTitle: Research on antioxidant property of ester with different ortho-substituted phenolic antioxidant groups based on DFT simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Synthetic polyol esters derived from natural esters have become the direction of development for safe and environmentally friendly liquid insulating oils in recent years. However, the oxidative stability performance of natural ester-based synthetic esters is still inadequate due to the influence of natural ester fatty acid feedstock. Besides, the introduction of phenolic antioxidant groups into the oil molecules via transesterification is a novel way to solve this problem. Phenolic methyl ester is an important raw material for introducing antioxidant groups into the oil molecule during the transesterification modification process, and its antioxidant property is affected by its ortho substituting group. Therefore, in this paper, frontline molecular orbitals, energy gaps and O-H bond dissociation energies of phenolic antioxidant groups under different ortho substituents were obtained by DFT simulation in order to figure out the mono-phenolic group with optimal antioxidant property. The results show that the ortho substitution decreases the energy of LUMO orbital of phenolic ester molecules, making the antioxidant groups more likely to react with alkyl radicals. In addition, the fully hindered phenolic ester with ortho bis-tert-butyl substitution shows the smallest O-H bond dissociation energy due to spatial effects, and are the best monophenolic options for introducing antioxidant groups into oil molecules.

articleTitle: Thermal, Electromagnetic and Structural Performance Evaluation of CFETR Toroidal Field Superconducting Magnet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As a critical component of Chinese Fusion Engineering Testing Reactor (CFETR), the structural performance of TF magnet is very important. This paper mainly analyzes the electromagnetic, structural and thermal hydraulic characteristics of TF magnet. Firstly, the electromagnetic analysis was conducted to obtain the magnetic field intensity and distribution., the the maximum magnetic field of the TF magnet is 14.5T. Secondly., through electromagnetic-structure coupling analysis., the maximum stress of TF magnet is 872MPa., which is located at the front area of inboard leg in TF coil case (TFCC). the shear stress of insulation is 61.2MPa. In addition., a thermal hydraulic analysis is performed to study the cooling performance of TF conductor. The result shows that the layout of cooling pipe should be optimized. Finally, the stability analysis of superconductors reveals that the temperature margin of TF coil is enough, but the minimum energy margin of strands is only 14 mJ/cc. All of the analysis shows that the stress intensity of TF magnet meets design criteria. The thermal hydraulic characteristics of TF inboard and the stability margin of TF conductor should be improved. These analyses provide important references for the design of CFETR TF magnet.

articleTitle: Fault Detection based on Perturbation Observer of Open-circuit Fault in Cascaded H-bridge STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a perturbation observer-based fault detection method to detect the multiple open-circuit switch faults of cascaded H-bridge STATCOM. Based on analysis of open-circuit fault characteristics of insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT), two perturbation observers of current and voltage are used to detect swiftly open-circuit fault. By using the difference of measured value and the observed valued of arm current and voltage, the faulty SM can be distinguished and located. Simulation results have confirmed that the proposed perturbation observer-based method has better detection performance compared with sliding mode observer (SMO).

articleTitle: A Modeling Method of SiC-MOSFET Short-circuit Failure Based on COMSOL Multiphysics and Simulink Co-simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As a typical device of wide-band semiconductor, SiC-MOSFETs have the advantages of high temperature and high voltage tolerance, fast switching speed, and low conduction loss, which have great potential in high power density and high-power applications. Thanks to the advantages, the short-circuits withstand time is much shorter than Si-MOSFET (2-7μs), so the establishment of the SiC-MOSFET short-circuit thermoelectric coupling model is important to improve the device application reliability and short-circuit protection circuit design. However, it is difficult to accurately characterize the junction temperature variation of different types of power devices, especially for the power devices of different processes technology. Since the short-circuit junction temperature of the device changes rapidly, considering the unbalanced thermal conductivity of different heterogeneous structures inside the chip, the accuracy of the short-circuit junction temperature model becomes the key to analyzing the short-circuit failure of power devices. Therefore, this paper proposes a simulation method based on the combination of the Simulink circuit model and the COMSOL Multiphysics device model, which can couple the actual power circuit and power device through the function interface. It realizes the joint simulation of independent SiC-MOSFET device models and different simulation circuits so that the circuit system is approached to the actual power circuit.

articleTitle: Suppression of Three-Phase Short Circuit Current in Dual Three-Phase Surface-Mounted PM Machines with Different Winding Configurations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For dual three-phase surface-mounted PM (DTPSPM) machines, three-phase short circuit (3PSC) is usually assumed to happen in only one winding group whilst the remaining one is normally supplied. In this paper, by fully utilizing healthy winding group (HWG), two suppression methods against 3PSC current are proposed for DTPSPM machines with different winding configurations. The first method is regulating HWG current amplitude and angle. For DTPSPM machines with symmetrical winding configuration, it is found that the <tex>$d$</tex>- and <tex>$q$</tex>-axis peak 3PSC current can be reduced to its minimum value when HWG current angles are about 90 and 135 electrical degrees, respectively. In addition, the suppression effect can be further improved when HWG current amplitude increases. For DTPSPM machines with asymmetric winding configuration, the suppression effect of regulating HWG current heavily depends on 3PSC start rotor position. The second method is forcing HWG into 3PSC. This method leads to an additional inductance component in faulty winding group, which thus reduces 3PSC peak current. Finally, the theoretical analysis is validated by FE simulation.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Trapezoidal Wave (ATW) Modulation Scheme for Modular Multilevel Resonant DC/DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The modular multilevel resonant dc/dc converter (MMRDC) is suitable for interconnection between medium-voltage dc grids and low-voltage dc grids because of its high power and high voltage handling capability. However, the current stress of MMRDC with the conventional quasi-square-wave modulation scheme is high when in light load conditions. To address this problem, a novel asymmetric trapezoidal wave (ATW) modulation scheme is proposed in this paper, which separately modulates the duty cycles of string output voltage rising and fall processes. The time-domain mathematical model of MMRDC with the ATW modulation scheme is established. Then, the soft switching and current stress characteristics are analyzed. Finally, the simulation results verify the validity of the analysis.

articleTitle: End-to-end autonomous vehicle navigation control method guided by the dynamic window approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Existing end-to-end vehicle navigation control methods based on deep reinforcement learning generally have low exploration efficiency and difficulty converging the model to the ideal state. To address these problems, this paper proposes a hybrid reinforcement learning framework that can fuse the traditional path planning algorithm (dynamic window approach, DWA) with the deep reinforcement learning approach. By taking advantage of DWA's ability to plan a collision-free trajectory with guaranteed vehicle dynamics constraints quickly, giving positive guidance to the DRL module at the early stage of its training, thus improving exploration efficiency while ensuring exploration breadth. To verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, a joint CARLA and ROS simulation environment is built and simulated in a typical scenario. The simulation results show that compared with existing deep reinforcement learning methods, the proposed method in this paper has significantly improved in terms of model convergence speed, stability, and pre-mid-term decision performance, in which the training time of TD3 decision network can be shortened by more than 85%.

articleTitle: Electrochemical and thermodynamic modeling and simulation of alkaline electrolyzer under different operating parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the model of alkaline electrolyzer is summarized and established. The model can be integrated into different types of renewable energy systems. Different from the traditional model established by empirical formula, the influence of physical parameters of the electrolyzer cell on the energy consumption of the cell is considered, and the influence of different temperature, pressure and current density on the energy consumption of the cell is also explored. The operation of the cell is described, and the simulation results are given. The results of this paper can be used as an important reference for evaluating the transient performance of electrolytic cell and the energy consumption of start-up and shutdown.

articleTitle: Surface modification of Poly-p-phenylene benzobisoxazole fiber by dielectric barrier discharge for magnet reinforcement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, Poly-p-phenylene benzobisoxazole (PBO) fiber is one of the most preferred reinforcement materials for magnet. However, the poor interface performance between the PBO fiber and resin matrix has become the bottleneck of the pulse magnetic field intensity improvement. Surface modification of the PBO fiber may be an effective way to solve this problem. In this paper, PBO fibers were treated by atmospheric dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) in air under different treatment time. It is found that when the discharge power density remained unchanged at 8.49W/cm<sup>2</sup>, the optimal treatment time is 60s. In this case, the shear strength of PBO fiber-resin interface increases up to 52.77% compared with the untreated, while the tensile strength of fiber monofilament only decreases 4.73%. The plasma treatment results in a large number of deep pits and protrusions on the surface of PBO fibers and a significant increase in roughness. The relative content of C element on the surface of PBO fiber decreases significantly, the content of O element increases obviously, and the content of N element increases slightly. Polar groups -O-C=N- and -C=O- are introduced through grafting copolymerization reaction, which enhances the chemical activity and wettability of the fiber surface. All of these contribute to the interfacial shear strength increase between the PBO fiber and the resin.

articleTitle: Research on an IoT-based Smart Monitoring System for Distribution Transformers in Solar PV Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The growing demand for renewable energy sources has led to a significant increase in the number of solar power systems in the desert. However, reliable operation of these systems in such harsh environments requires continuous and accurate monitoring. This paper introduces a smart monitoring system based on Internet of things (IoT) for distribution transformers in solar photovoltaic (PV) plants. The proposed system adopts both optical fiber sensors and traditional electronic sensors in order to collect data including temperature, vibration, ultrasonic and partial discharge. As for data transmission, a wireless transmission system featuring tree- structured topology based on LoRa is built, which has high reliability. The collected data is analyzed using multi-class support vector machine (SVM) model with time-frequency parameters, which can determine the health status of the transformers and identify potential faults if any. This system provides a new perspective for the monitoring and maintenance of photovoltaic power transformers.

articleTitle: A PSO-based Economic Optimal Strategy for PV-ESS Combination Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the research for economic optimization in power systems is usually regarded as multi-constrained, nonlinear problems. The particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm has been widely applied to solving economic optimization issues due to its easy implementation, few algorithm parameters, fast convergence, and good optimization ability. Nevertheless, the traditional solutions for these optimization issues lack the consideration of algorithm performance, resulting in huge deviations between the actual and the optimal results. Therefore, an improved PSO-based economics optimal strategy for photovoltaic (PV) and energy storage system (ESS) combination power systems is proposed in this paper. Under the proposed scheme, the improved PSO algorithm's convergence and speed are given full discussions bound to the algorithm parameters, which help obtain optimal results and improve solution speed. The feasibility of the proposed strategy is verified by simulation in the standard IEEE 33 bus test system.

articleTitle: Optimization of a Permanent Magnet-assisted Switching Reluctance Motor Based On the Iterative Optimization Strategy of NSGA-III
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the torque performance and vibration characteristics of the permanent magnet-assisted switched reluctance motor, a multi-objective optimization design method of permanent magnet-assisted switched reluctance motor based on the iterative optimization strategy of NSGA-III is proposed. Firstly, the basic structure of the permanent magnet-assisted switched reluctance motor is introduced. Secondly, the mathematical model of the motor was established using CCD response surface experiments and neural networks, and correlation coefficient analysis was performed. Then, the NSGA-III algorithm was introduced to clarify the principle of the iterative optimization strategy. Then, the multi-objective optimization design of the motor was carried out according to the proposed strategy, finally, the optimization results were verified and analyzed by using finite element simulation software.

articleTitle: Residual life prediction of lithium-ion batteries based on data preprocessing and a priori knowledge-assisted CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries have become widely used in many industries due to their outstanding performance, making it vital to accurately predict the remaining useful life (RUL) of these batteries. This will aid in developing energy allocation strategies and ensure the safe use of lithium batteries. To overcome the issue of inaccurate RUL prediction, a new method is proposed that leverages data preprocessing and a prior knowledge-assisted convolutional neural network-long short-term memory neural network (CNN-LSTM). This method utilizes capacity as the health factor and employs CEEMDAN to decompose the capacity sequence, eliminating noise components through data reconstruction. The reconstructed capacity sequence data are then used to pretrain the CNN-LSTM neural network, forming a priori knowledge. Finally, real-time battery capacity data are used to train the prior knowledge-aided CNN-LSTM neural network for real-time RUL prediction of Li-ion batteries. The results show that this method significantly improves the RUL prediction accuracy and reduces the prediction error while being more robust than existing methods.

articleTitle: A Date-Driven Voltage Control Strategy for Distribution Network Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A data-driven voltage control strategy is proposed for real-time optimized distributed voltage control of distribution networks connected to the energy storage system (ESS) and distributed photovoltaics (PVs) with high penetration. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods are used in the control of voltage in the distribution grid. Firstly, based on the division of distributed networks, the decision-making process of combined distributed voltage control is given, which is mainly based on the reactive power compensation of photovoltaic inverters and supplemented by ESS active power regulation. A multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADRL) model is then applied to the distributed voltage control model. The Multi-Agent Twin Delay Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (MATD3) algorithm is then applied. Finally, offline training and online testing are performed on a 33-bus test network with a branch structure to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-path Propagation Modified Partial Discharge Localization Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When partial discharge localization method based on time difference of arrival of signal is applied to the electrical equipment with complex structure, the time difference of arrival of ultra high frequency signal often has a large error due to the non-line-of-sight propagation of ultra high frequency signal, thus affecting the localization accuracy. In this paper, an innovative partial discharge localization method considering the non-line-of-sight propagation of ultra high frequency signal is proposed. Compared with the traditional localization method based on time difference of arrival of signal, this method has a significant error correction effect when there is blocking medium between the partial discharge source and the sensor, and effectively improves the localization accuracy of the partial discharge source.

articleTitle: Cable steel bracket cost calculation considering mechanical properties
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Cable steel brackets are widely used in urban power network underground tunnels. Calculating the cost of cable steel brackets is required since different steel bracket materials have varying mechanical properties and unit costs. This paper details a method for estimating the cost of a cable steel bracket using finite element structural analysis. First, a structural mechanics finite element analysis is used to determine the minimum section thickness of a cable line steel bracket that satisfies the requirements of stress design. Second, the volume of square, channel, and angle steel cable brackets made of carbon steel and stainless steel is calculated separately, and the price of the entire cable is then computed. Finally, the cost of 110kV steel bracket of a power grid is calculated, and the conclusion is that the square steel type is the lowest of the three types of bracket, and the cost of carbon steel material and stainless steel material is 41,286 yuan and 123,755 yuan respectively.

articleTitle: An Improved Carrier-Based SVM Strategy for Variable Power Factor Operation of Vienna Rectifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Vienna rectifier, which is used in many applications such as wind power systems and power factor correction systems, not only provides energy to the load but also regulates the power factor to enhance the quality of the power throughout the entire system. However, many modulation strategies are only suitable for the Vienna rectifier operating at unity power factor, and when at variable power factor, input current over-zero distortion occurs. Therefore, an improved modulation strategy is proposed to suppress the input current over-zero distortion by injecting the compensation component to the modulation waveform of carrier-based space vector modulation (CB-SVM), and the range of power factor variation under this improved modulation strategy is evaluated. Simulations are performed under the d-q control theory, and the results demonstrate the effectiveness of the improved CB-SVM strategy.

articleTitle: Enhenced energy storage performance of polyetherimide by adding few amount of CNO nanosheets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The low dielectric constant of polymers restricts their usage in energy storage capacitors. Existed methods of adding traditional ceramic fillers to enhance dielectric constant of polymers inevitably sacrifice their machinability since large amount of fillers are required. In addressing this issue, this work prepared the polymer-based composites by selecting the calcium niobate (CNO) nanosheets with high dielectric constant as fillers, the polyetherimide (PEI) as polymer matrix. At a low loading level (1 wt%), the PEI/CNO composite present excellent energy performances due to their enhanced dielectric constant and suppressed dielectric loss. The strong interactions between the negative charged CNO surface and the positive charged O atoms in polymer chains endow the PEI/CNO composites with these excellent performances. Finally, the finite element analysis simulation and the density functional theory calculation were employed to confirm these results. This work provides a simple method in fabricating polymer-based dielectrics focused on the practical application, which might serve some new ideas in designing capacitive polymers.

articleTitle: Prediction of Partial Discharge of the Cavity in Insulation Based the Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the digital twin has attracted significant attention. Researchers try to apply this technology to recognize and predict the condition of the power equipment. This paper used the digital twin technology to predict Partial Discharge (PD) in power cables. The cavity model in the insulation of power cables was established in COMSOL to obtain the PD data under different temperatures. The digital twin model combined with the pulse sequence analysis (PSA) spectrum was built and used to recognize and predict PD. The PSA spectrum shows that with the temperature rising, the characteristic of the PSA spectrum is different. The digital twin model can effectively simulate PD events in the cavity. PSA spectrum characteristics provide a new idea for PD pattern recognition and also give a reference for predicting the development trend of PD.

articleTitle: A Junction Temperature Monitoring Method Based on the Combined TSEPs for Power Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Junction temperature monitoring is helpful for the reliability evaluation of power devices. However, many junction temperature monitoring methods are afflicted by the issue of load current dependence. To address this, this paper proposes a junction temperature monitoring method based on the combined thermo-sensitive electric parameters (TSEPs). In this method., the turn-off delay time is used as the junction temperature indicator., and the parameter dependence analysis of this indictor is accordingly provided. It is revealed from the analysis that the behavior of the turn-off time is adversely affected by the troublesome problem of load current dependence. Considering this., another TESP., i.e., the combined turn-off delay time., is introduced in the proposed junction temperature monitoring method. By doing so., an achievement of load current independence is developed. Extensive double-pulse tests and experimental tests are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed unction temperature monitoring method.

articleTitle: A Frequency Feedforward Compensation Optimization Strategy for Grid-connected Active Power Response of Energy Storage VSG
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The energy storage virtual synchronous generator (VSG), which can provide inertial support for the grid, has attracted wide attention. However, there is a problem that the dynamic characteristics and the characteristics of primary frequency modulation of grid-connected active power cannot be satisfied at the same time. Therefore, the dynamic oscillations suppression strategy of energy storage VSG grid-connected active power based on frequency feedforward compensation is proposed in this paper. This strategy uses the rated frequency to feed forward to the grid-connected active power closed-loop modulation loop through the compensation link and increases the transient damping of the system without affecting the characteristics of primary frequency modulation of the energy storage VSG, to effectively suppress the dynamic oscillations of its grid-connected active power. Finally, the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed strategy are verified by the Matlab/Simulink simulation model of the energy storage VSG grid-connected system.

articleTitle: Variable frequency control three-phase PFC full range ZVS dead time design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Compared with PWM control, the advantages of three-phase dual-switch Boost PFC under frequency conversion control are that soft switching can be realized and the switching loss can be reduced. In order to ensure the soft switching, it is necessary to set the dead time between two switches properly. In this paper, many factors affecting the design of dead time are considered, and a feasible calculation method is proposed, which is verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Research on Characteristics of Wireless Power Transfer Systems Running in Parallel Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The paper presents an analysis of characteristics of wireless power transfer (WPT) systems running in parallel mode for electric vehicles. Firstly, the parallel model of two WPT systems with SS compensation network is established. Then, according to the model, the output power and efficiency of the parallel system are derived and analyzed. Finally, based on measured parameters, simulations are conducted to verify the analysis conclusion. Results demonstrate that, for the parallel system with SS compensation networks, the variation of mutual inductance and battery voltage will affect the output power and efficiency of the parallel system; the mutual inductance variation of one parallel unit do not affect the efficiency and output power of the other parallel units; when the efficiency of parallel units is different, the overall efficiency of the parallel system is between the efficiency of parallel units. And, the analysis in the paper can effectively calculate the output power of WPT systems in parallel mode.

articleTitle: Capacitance and electric field analysis of UHVDC SF6 gas insulated wall bushing support insulator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper aims to investigate the effect of the number of support insulators on the electric field and capacitance distribution in 1100kV DC SF6 gas insulated wall bushing. The double-layer shielding scheme is a common technique used in SF6 gas insulated wall bushing to equalize the electric field., in which the support insulators connect the floating potential electrode and the grounded electrode. A detailed model of SF6 gas insulated wall bushing is established and its impact on the electric field distribution in the bushing is analyzed by varying the number of support insulators. The result indicates that as the number of support insulators increases., the potential of the floating potential electrode decreases., the surface field strength of the shielding cover decreases., and the external field strength of the sheath does not change significantly. Meanwhile., the capacitance matrix in the bushing is simulated and calculated. The results show that as the number of supporting insulators increases., the capacitance between the floating potential electrode and the grounded electrode increases. This is considered to be the direct reason of the increase in potential of the floating potential electrode.

Author Keywords: 1100 kV DC SF6 gas insulated wall bushing

articleTitle: Classification of highway energy community based on density and correlation of highway traffic-power coupling network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The coupling between electrified highway traffic network and distribution network makes the traffic flow and power flow more complicated. The dynamic traffic flow in highway traffic network presents the characteristics of multi-temporal distribution and congestion. Dynamic vehicle-flow coupled distribution network has strong randomness, uncertainty and dispersion. Therefore, a method to divide highway energy community based on the density and correlation of highway traffic network and power network is proposed herein. Firstly, the coupling model of highway traffic network and power network is established based on the electric-hydrogen integrated energy supply station. Secondly, the highway energy community is defined, and its measurement index is given based on synergetic theory. Finally, a method of dividing highway energy community structure based on density and correlation is proposed. Simulation results show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: A Recurrent Neural Network-based Approach on Grounding Fault Type Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The single-phase ground fault of the distribution network is a relatively high failure leading factor and includes many fault causing types. If the different types of grounding faults cannot be properly handled, the reliability and availability of the distribution network will be hazard in the long run. How to distinguish different fault types according to the detection of waveform map of the power grid within a short duration has always been a research hotspot. In this study, a fault type detection method based on recurrent neural network is proposed to solve the problem that the current and voltage characteristics of high resistance grounding fault are not obvious and the detection of high resistance grounding fault is difficult. Firstly, the zero-sequence voltage data in 2 cycles after the single-phase ground fault is extracted, and the zero-sequence voltage is mapped into the two-dimensional time-frequency map. Secondly, the LSTM network is built to identify the fault type and the detection accuracy is therefore optimized. To verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, we built a 10 kV distribution network simulation model, by which the experimental results show that our method can effectively detect the arc high resistance grounding fault signal and identify such grounding fault types.

articleTitle: Architecture of Intelligent Decision Embedding Knowledge for Power Grid Generation-Load Look-ahead Dispatch Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the construction of new power systems with renewable energy as the mainstay, the uncertainty of the operation modes for power systems increases obviously, and the type and number of generation, load, storage as dispatch objects grow exponentially, making the dramatical increase of complexity of grid dispatch decisions. Especially in the intra-day stage, the availability and computational efficiency of traditional mechanistic models based on optimization analysis can hardly meet the dispatching needs at the short time scales, and abnormal situations are still highly dependent on dispatcher's experiences. The data-driven approach enables self-exploration and updating of dispatching strategies but suffers from insufficient robustness and difficulty in ensuring security. The paper proposes an architecture of intelligent decision embedding knowledge for power grid generation-load look-ahead dispatch based on deep reinforcement learning to improve the accuracy and efficiency of intra-day dispatch. The key technologies are proposed, which is beneficial for improving machine cognitive ability, and promoting the progress of artificial intelligence technology for power grid dispatch.

articleTitle: The Effects of Neutron Irradiation on the Electrical Characteristics of High-power Thyristor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-power thyristor, as the basic components of switch and power supply system, is widely used in large fusion device. Those applications are long-term irradiated by high-dose neutron from deuterium tritium reaction, which will lend to the change of the electrical characteristics of the thyristor and may eventually bring irreversible damage to the devices. The thyristor switch of the commutation circuit in the Quench Protection System (QPS) of fusion device is regarded as the study object in this paper.
