Six ABB 5STP 52U5200 thyristor devices were selected and distributed in a spherical space with radii of 20 cm, 40 cm, 60 cm, and received the neutron fluence in the range from 4.3×10<sup>11</sup> to 0.48×10<sup>11</sup> n/cm<sup>2</sup>. By comparing the electrical parameter changes of thyristor devices before and after neutron irradiation, the effects of neutron irradiation on the characteristics of thyristor are obtained. Moreover, the effect of irradiated thyristor characteristics change on the whole QPS is also been studied by accurate simulation, which provides a valuable guideline for the maintenance and renovation of QPS.

articleTitle: Power Text Data Preprocessing of Power Grid Infrastructure Project based on Skip-gram Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The power grid infrastructure project is a large-scale and long-period instance which often involves various subjects. It would produce a large amount of data, serving as an important original data source of the operating maintenance and asset management systems in power supply enterprises. However, the manpower analysis fails to deal with unstructured natural text language data as well as nonstandard semi-structured tabular data. To address this issue, the deep analysis on the data with different forms is first conducted based on the power grid infrastructure project. Then, a data cleaning technique is used to eliminate the noise in the original low-quality data. Finally, a skip-gram model is built to convert the text data into a word embedding vector form. The well-preprocessed data contains contextual semantic information which is more suitable for data mining. Extensive simulation experiments clearly demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A novel method for parameter identification of PV modules by using effective irradiance and temperature
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Single-diode model (SDM) has been widely used to model the 1-V characteristics of PV modules because of its accuracy and convenience. The paper proposes a novel method for the performance estimation of PV modules under various operating conditions based on SDM by using effective irradiance and temperature. The proposed method extracts effective irradiance and temperature by optimization algorithm based on transformation equation of physical parameters in SDM. Then, BP neural network are trained by using measured and calculated data to find the relationship between measured and effective irradiance and temperature. Further, the parameters in transformation can be estimated under different operating conditions, thereby simplifying the process and improving the accuracy of the performance estimation of the PV modules. The accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method are validated by large number of experimental data under wide range environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Study on Effect of Permanent Magnet Remanence on High Speed Permanent Magnet Assisted Synchronous Reluctance Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Synchronous reluctance machines (SynRMs) are widely used in fan and water pump system, due to the high efficiency and low cost. However, low power factor is a major disadvantage which limits the application of SynRMs. To improve the power factor of SynRMs, permanent magnet assisted synchronous reluctance machine (PMa-SynRM) attracted more and more attention. For the PMa-SynRMs, the magnetic characteristics of PMs significantly affect the machine performance. This paper does not study how to change the permanent magnet (PM) magnetic characteristics, but study the influence of PM magnetic characteristics on the performance of the machine and the results can be used to guide the processing of permanent magnetic materials.

Author Keywords: permanent magnet assisted synchronous reluctance machine (PMa-SynRM)

articleTitle: Analysis of A Novel Flux-Switching Permanent Magnet Machine With Flux-Reversal Effect
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A novel flux-switching permanent magnet (FSPM) machine with flux-reversal (FR) effect is analyzed and optimized. The structure characteristics and the operation principles of the machine are analyzed. Taking 6-stator-slot/19-rotor-tooth structure as an example, the conventional and novel FSPM machines are analyzed and compared. It is shown that, compared with the conventional topology, the no-load back induced back-electromotive force (EMF) amplitude of the novel topology increases by 7.2%, and the torque density increases by 10.5%. In order to further improve the torque density, the structure parameters of FSPM machine are optimized.

articleTitle: Long Life Design Method for Highly Reliable Charge and Discharge Regulator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The leapfrog development of space power supply products brings new challenges to reliability engineering. Space power controllers have long life and high reliability requirements due to its complex and precise composition, long mission time, high mission success rate and difficult to maintain during orbit operation. Once failure occurs, it will directly affect the completion of the mission. The service life of space power controllers is an important technical index. Generally, the service life of space power controllers need to meet about 20 years. The traditional life evaluation methods are far from meeting the verification requirements of long life index. In order to effectively evaluate the life of the power controller and provide support for the long time in-orbit operation of the spacecraft power subsystem, a long-life design method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, based on the theory of stress cumulative damage model, a method to quickly evaluate the reliability and life level of the current product is obtained. Secondly, according to the structural characteristics, historical fault information, service environment and maintenance mode of charge and discharge regulators, the main fault modes and the most critical excitation environment factors affecting the life of charge and discharge regulators are obtained. Finally, the controller is tested by this design method. The experiments results verify the prototype design is rational and feasible.

articleTitle: Neural Network Algorithm for Short-term Photovoltaic Power Prediction Accuracy Improvement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: One of the methods to improve the accuracy of short-term Photovoltaic(PV) power prediction is the improvement of prediction algorithms. To sort out the application of neural network algorithms in short-term PV power prediction, four algorithms, Back Propagation Neural Network(BPNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Long Short Term Memory (LSTM), and Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM), are selected for analysis and validated by practical arithmetic cases in this paper. The results show that the neural network algorithms are well adapted to short-term PV power prediction and have high prediction accuracy. The accuracy of short-term PV power prediction can be improved by improving the neural network prediction algorithm.

articleTitle: Fault diagnostic of power transformer by CFS-GA Case-Based Reasoning model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To address the problems that knowledge rules are difficult to obtain and inadequate use of fault case experience in the process of transformer fault diagnosis, a CFS-GA case-based reasoning model is proposed. The model uses the correlation- based feature selection (CFS) method to extract key attribute features with strong correlation in power transformer fault cases, and solves the feature redundancy in case searching caused by excessive test data of transformers. Using the reduced attribute features, a genetic algorithm (GA) method is employed to optimize the feature weights that are difficult to determine manually and assign them to the K Nearest Neighbor (KNN) network to realize the diagnosis and final classification of power transformer fault category. The feasibility of the method is verified by experiments. The overall recognition accuracy of fault diagnosis is over 70% and it can reach 84% with the selected attribute feature set and optimized weights. This method also

articleTitle: A Junction Temperature Balance Control for Parallel-Connected SiC MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When SiC MOSFETs work in parallel, there will be thermal stress imbalance among various devices, which greatly influences the life and reliability of the whole operating system. Therefore, a junction temperature balance control method based on regulating gate driver voltage is proposed in this paper, which can effectively adjust the junction temperature imbalance between parallel SiC MOSFETs, promote the junction temperature balance, and improve the service life and operational reliability of the whole system. The simulation and experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed junction temperature balance control method.

articleTitle: Dynamic Reconfiguration Strategy for AC/DC Power Distribution System Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the system runs under different topologies and loads, the economic benefits of the system will also change due to the different power flow distribution. In order to make the power system run safely and economically, the dynamic reconfiguration of the distribution network has become a better choice. This paper studies the dynamic reconfiguration strategy for AC/DC distribution system considering demand response (DR). The strategy combines demand response, unit commitment and optimal line switching to discuss the optimization problem of AC/DC distribution network, and then adjusts the operation state of lines according to the predicted daily load of the distribution network and the possible line power flow. Then the operator can dynamically select the optimal power network topology, which not only keeps the stability of the system but also improves its economy. Therefore, the optimization model is established, the revised IEEE 33-bus AC system with a DC system is used to validate the model. The results show that the optimization strategy can reduce the operation cost of AC/DC distribution system and improve its stability to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Day-ahead Optimal Scheduling of Active Distribution Network Considering EV Response to Dynamic Time-sharing Pricing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to avoid the impact of disordered charging and discharging of electric vehicles on the power system, a day-ahead optimal scheduling model for active distribution network considering dynamic time-sharing pricing in response to electric vehicles was proposed. Firstly, the load model, photovoltaic model and electric vehicle model of optimal dispatching day are established. Secondly, on the premise that all charging piles participate in grid dispatching, an optimal scheduling model is established with the minimum load fluctuation rate, minimum network loss and minimum voltage deviation as the objective function. Then, the second-order oscillating particle swarm optimization algorithm was used to solve the model, and the real-time rolling charging and discharging electricity price on the optimal scheduling day was calculated by using the optimal charging and discharging power obtained from the model. Finally, an example is given to the actual distribution system to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Two New-type Control Strategies for Six-Phase Open Winding PMSM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes two new-type control strategies, namely quasi-two-vector control and quasi-four-vector control, for six-phase open-winding permanent magnet synchronous motor drive system. Compared with the traditional SVPWM method, it not only improves the calculation of sector judgment, but also removes the calculation of action time. Therefore, the calculation is simple and fast, the program running time is reduced by about 10%, the system efficiency is increased by 2%, and the switching action of power tube in a control cycle is reduced by 30%, so its switching loss is also reduced by 30%. In addition, the total harmonic distortion is only 15%. At last, the correctness and effectiveness of the quasi-two-vector control and the quasi-four-vector control are verified on the test bench.

articleTitle: Active Disturbance Rejection Control of T-type Three-level Permanent Magnet Motor Drive System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The suppression of current harmonics is very important to improve the performance of permanent magnet synchronous motor. Therefore, this paper uses T-type three-level inverter to drive permanent magnet synchronous motor, which can effectively suppress current harmonics. In addition, since permanent magnet synchronous motor is easily affected by external disturbance in complex environment, the motor speed performance deteriorates, so active disturbance rejection control technology is used to improve its control performance. This paper analyzes the advantages of t - type three - level inverter, studies the t - type three - level SVPWM modulation technology and the design of active disturbance rejection controller. A simulation model is established in MATLAB to verify the advantages of T-type three-level inverter driven by active disturbance rejection technology.

articleTitle: Study on Time-sensitive Network Scheduling for Substation Based on Gating Shaping
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Real-time and certainty are important performance indicators of substation network data transmission. There are many time-sensitive data in the substation site, and the transmission of these data has very high real-time and deterministic requirements. Due to the fusion communication of high-bandwidth data in the IT network, the transmission delay and jitter of some time-sensitive data are increased. In order to reduce the transmission delay and jitter of time-sensitive data flow in the substation, this paper designs and implements a time-sensitive network synchronization scheduling algorithm based on gating shaping.

articleTitle: Frequency-constrained Stochastic Unit Commitment Considering Voltage Security
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increase of renewable energy penetration ratio, the randomness and volatility of power system are continuously enhanced, and the problems of frequency and voltage security of the system are prominent. To improve the frequency regulation ability and voltage regulating ability of the power system, this paper proposes a modified frequency-constrained stochastic unit commitment (M-FCUC) model considering the voltage amplitude. In the model, ROCOF and frequency nadir security constraints are established to limit the system frequency after disturbance, and linear voltage amplitude constraints are established to guarantee node voltage security of the system. The case studies in IEEE 118-bus system show that compare with traditional stochastic unit commitment, M-FCUC can make more reasonable day-ahead scheduling decisions that better guarantee frequency security and voltage security.

articleTitle: Anomaly analysis of 3rd harmonic voltage ratio caused by harmonic elimination device of voltage transformer primary side
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The abnormal mechanism of the 3rd harmonic voltage ratio caused by the harmonic elimination device at the primary side of the voltage transformer is analyzed theoretically from the influence of harmonic voltage and excitation characteristics, and verified by experiments. The selection basis of primary harmonic elimination device of voltage transformer which can reduce the third harmonic voltage content is obtained.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis and Torque Ripple Minimization Control for Modular Permanent-Magnet In-Wheel Motor with Interturn Fault
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a fault diagnosis method and a torque minimization control strategy for modular permanent magnet in-wheel motor with interturn fault. Firstly, the module with interturn fault is located based on the fundamental component of zero-sequence voltage component (ZSVC). After the faulty module is located, this module is powered off. Then, in order to reduce the torque ripple caused by interaction between short-circuit current in the faulty module and permanent magnetic field, the proportional-resonant (PR) controller is proposed to be connected in parallel with PI speed controller. Finally, the simulation results verify the effectiveness and compatibility of the proposed fault diagnosis method and the torque ripple minimization control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on suppressing common-mode current modulation strategy of photovoltaic three-level inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The working mode of photovoltaic three-level inverter is analyzed, and the common mode equivalent circuit is established. According to the equivalent circuit, the main causes of the common mode current of the inverter are common mode voltage and neutral point potential offset. Therefore, a 4MV (four medium vector) modulation strategy is proposed, which selects six medium vectors with common-mode voltage of 0 to minimize the common-mode voltage of the system. In each sector, four middle vectors are used to synthesize the reference voltage vector, two of which are used to synthesize the reference vector, and the other two are used as the equivalent zero vector to introduce the neutral line current to effectively reduce the fluctuation of the neutral point potential, thereby reducing the common mode current. In order to verify the practicability and effectiveness of the 4MV modulation strategy, a simulation and hardware-in-the-loop experimental platform is built using matlab / simulink and Starsim. The simulation and hardware-in-the-loop experimental results show that in a stable state, the 4MV modulation strategy is compared with the 2MV1Z (two medium and one zero vector) modulation strategy. The midpoint potential offset amplitude and the common-mode voltage amplitude caused by the midpoint potential offset can be reduced to 33 % of the latter. The common-mode current of the former can be suppressed to 6.67 % of the latter, indicating that the 4MV modulation strategy has a good effect on suppressing common-mode current.

articleTitle: Energy Scheduling for Power System Integrating River-network Type Hydrogen Chains
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Hydrogen products produced from abandoned power from renewable energy bases can be transported to load centers to directly supply common hydrogen loads and support the grid to by generating electricity. However, the existing modes of hydrogen transmission by pipeline and vehicle may be not cost-effective considering hydrogen transmission capacity, investment fee and delivery cost. To address the problem, this paper proposes a novel river-network-type hydrogen chain integrating hydrogen production station, hydrogen carrier vessel, hydrogen refuel station, and hydrogen power plant. The river-network-type hydrogen chain is first modelled and then integrated into the power system. On this basis, a day-ahead energy scheduling strategy for the power system integrating the river-network type hydrogen chain is formulated to ensure the operation economy. Simulation studies on an adjusted IEEE-30 node power system indicate that the proposed strategy is effective in promoting the power balance while satisfying the hydrogen load demand.

articleTitle: The Improved Carbon Flow Calculation and Tracing in the Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The carbon emissions of the power system are generated along with the power production which is balanced with power consumption in real time. When characterizing carbon emissions of the power system, it should consider the power consumption as well. For this reason, micro carbon flow based on power system draws attention in recent years. Although many current studies have established relatively perfect calculation indicators, it can be improved by examining the carbon emission analysis with different time scales, especially on the issue of carbon emission traceability. Therefore, this paper improves the existing calculation method of carbon emission flow in power system, and traces the daily electricity consumption and carbon emission in Guangling base of Yangzhou city. It analyzes the source of electricity in each period, realizes the micro carbon flow, and improves the power supply company's insufficient grasp of the energy consumption and carbon emission characteristics of all levels of equipment.

articleTitle: Research on robust voiceprint recognition of circuit breaker faults in complex noisy environments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to address the problem of low accuracy of existing circuit breaker voiceprint fault recognition methods in complex noisy environments, under the constraint of only one single sensor adopted, this paper proposes an acoustic spectrogram reconstruction mechanism with noise greatly reduced based on deep residual convolution, convolutional block attention module and autoencoder (Res-CBAM-Autoencoder). In the meantime, three commonly used mainstream closed-set classification algorithms are employed in the verification experiment, where 2000 pieces of data from ESC dataset are selected as a noise set. In an environment of triple randomness added and a zero signal noise ratio(SNR), the proposed method propels the recognition accuracy of VGG11 from 33.66% to 96.33%, Resnet18 from 39% to 97.33% and SVM from 33.66% to 89.66%, whose superiority is testified in terms of noise reduction and ability of generalization in complex noisy environments.

articleTitle: Rapid quantization of battery degradation mode based on multi-head attention model of Variational autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Lithium battery is widely used in various industries due to its excellent performance. Due to the huge demand, the diagnosis and prediction of lithium battery are paid more and more attention by researchers. This paper aims at the rapid quantification of battery degradation patterns. The rapid diagnosis of battery degradation patterns can optimize the battery management system and better prevent the adverse consequences of battery aging. In this paper, a data-driven method based on Variational autoencoder(VAE) is used to quantity the battery degradation patterns quickly and convert the sequence signals to image signals. The VAE network is used as the feature extractor and transformer module is used as the battery degradation patterns quantifier. At the same time, through training and testing with existing advanced methods and some common neural networks on common commercial battery data sets, the results show that the proposed model has achieved good experimental results, and verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: An ASIC Implementation Method of BeiDou Satellite Signal Detection Based on Rayleigh Distribution Fitting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-voltage power equipment is a typical source of power frequency electromagnetic radiation, especially corona discharge will produce strong electromagnetic radiation, which may seriously interference with radio equipment near power facilities. The BeiDou Satellite System(BDS) can provide a critical infrastructures for the power system in time-frequency domain. Because the BDS signal is extremely weak, it is easily affected by various electromagnetic interference. According to the specific characteristics and propagation characteristics of BDS signal, in this paper, the thermal noise, typical interference of BDS receivers and channel transmission model are modeled, meanwhile a quadratic fitting algorithm based Rayleigh distribution is designed in combination with the implementation of baseband ASIC of BDS receivers, so as to accurately and efficiently calculate the detection threshold. Compared with the traditional algorithm, the Monte Carlo simulation results shows that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the acquisition performance and accuracy of BDS signals by BDS receivers in the power frequency electromagnetic interference environment of power facilities.

articleTitle: Research on AC asymmetric fault control strategy of AC/AC system based on M3C
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the modular multi-level matrix converter (M3C) offshore wind power transmission system, asymmetric disturbances in the onshore frequency grid will result in non-sinusoidal three-phase currents on the frequency side of the M3C converter, fluctuations in active and reactive power, and large voltage fluctuations in the capacitive voltage of the converter body module. To solve these problems, the first step is to create asymmetry. To solve these problems, firstly, a double αβ mathematical model of the M3C system under asymmetric grid is established, then the grid voltage and current are separated from positive and negative sequence by using delay filters, and the phase is locked by decoupling the double rotating coordinate system; secondly, the variation law of the power on the AC side of the industrial frequency is analysed, and a control strategy is proposed for the M3C converter to suppress the negative sequence current under the asymmetric fault on the industrial frequency grid side. Finally, based on MATLAB/SIMULINK simulation software, a converter station simulation model of M3C IF/LF is established, and the simulation is verified for the occurrence of single-phase short-circuit fault on the IF grid side, and the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Battery State of health estimation with fewer labelled data: a semi-supervised approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Accurate estimation of battery state of health (SOH) is indispensable for reliable battery management. While machine learning methods are playing an increasingly important role, they generally require profuse training samples which consist of input data and measured capacities. To alleviate this issue, we present a semi-supervised approach that can draw on easily available training samples without measured capacities to train deep neural networks (DNNs) with high SOH estimation performance. First, a label propagation strategy is proposed to generate pseudo capacities for unlabelled training samples by resorting to the similarity between input data. Then, a training strategy is designed to efficiently train the DNN using the training samples with measured and pseudo capacities while taking into account the label propagation errors. A large battery degradation dataset is developed for method validation. End-to-end SOH estimation using is carried out based on a typical long short-term memory (LSTM) DNN. The validation results based on electrochemical impedance spectra demonstrate that reducing the number of training samples deteriorates the performance of the supervised DNN. In contrast, the proposed method can achieve higher accuracy than the supervised DNN and another two machine learning models with fewer labelled training samples. Our results provide an efficient and general approach to developing data-driven SOH estimation models with reduced data collection efforts.

articleTitle: An Optimal Allocation Method for Dynamic Reactive Power Compensation Device in Receiving Power grid with High Proportion of New Energy access
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, it is inevitable that the AC/DC trans regional transmission channel with large capacity to consume new energy will be connected to the receiving power grid, which also leads to the “hollow” trend of the receiving end, which may become a more common problem. Synchronous generator is the dynamic reactive power source with the largest basic capacity in the power system. Large scale clean energy access leads to the reduction of synchronous generator startup, as well as the reduction of reactive power supply of the system, which leads to voltage stability problems in the receiving power grid. This paper proposes A configuration method of dynamic reactive power compensation equipment. First, the power system simulation software is used to build the system simulation model, and use this model to determine the weak area of system voltage stability. Secondly, the optimization model of generator excitation voltage is built to improve the transient voltage stability of the system by optimizing the generator excitation voltage in the system. Then, based on the results of the generator excitation voltage optimization model, the simulation model generator excitation reference voltage is modified. The modified simulation model and the dynamic reactive power compensation effect index are used to configure the dynamic reactive power compensation device in a time domain simulation cycle to maximize the system voltage stability, improve the voltage quality and minimize the investment. Finally, an example is given to verify the validity and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Characteristics of lightning activity on high altitude areas from 2500m to 5500m
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Lightning stroke is the most important factor that endangers the safe and reliable operation of transmission lines. Most of Tibet, Qinghai and other places in China belong to plateau regions, with the highest elevation of nearly 5500m. The terrain is complex and diverse, and the thunderstorm climate is changeable. The terrain is complex and diverse, and the thunderstorm climate is changeable. Lightning protection is one of the key technical problems in the Qinghai Tibet Plateau area with strong lightning activity and bad geological conditions. The study on the characteristics of lightning activities in the high altitude area of the Qinghai Tibet Plateau is the basis to solve this problem, but there are few related studies. This paper discussed the characteristics of thunder clouds at high altitude, including frontal thunder clouds and air mass thunder clouds. The lightning activity in a typical high altitude area, Tibet Autonomous Region, was given. The lightning characteristics were statistically analyzed. The statistical characteristics of thunderstorm characteristics at typical monitoring stations on the plateau were given and compared with those at plain stations at the same latitude. The thunderstorm activities in different latitudes were comprehensively compared, and the characteristics of lightning activities in the Qinghai Tibet Plateau region of China were given, which laid a solid foundation for lightning protection of power systems in high altitude regions of China.

articleTitle: Outage Prediction of Overhead Line Based on Regional Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Severe convective weather seriously affect the operation of power system, so the forecast of overhead line outage is important. The research on this problem has the following difficulties. First, large-scale forecast problem, the objective environment of overhead lines in different regions is quite different, and the single model has limited accuracy. Second, the training sample is imbalanced. Overhead line outage sample account for a small proportion in the actual operation data, so the problem of sample imbalance exists in model training. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes an adaptive regional ensemble learning algorithm to predict the outage probability of overhead line in severe convective weather. Aiming at sample imbalance, this paper designs a improved cross entropy loss function to reduce the loss weight of a large number of simple negative samples. Our method has been verified by actual data, which can provide technical support for the grid digital forecast.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy for Smart Meter Rotation Plan Considering Time and Workload Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Smart meter rotation is one of the technical measures to ensure the accuracy of electricity meters. However, the formulation of smart meter rotation plan only focuses on the rotation cycle of smart meters, which is easy to cause great pressure on the rotation workers at the end of the year, and it is difficult to arrange the rotation work for the power company. Therefore, an optimization strategy for the smart meter rotation plan considering time and workload constraints is proposed. The minimum total number of on-site operations in the distribution systems is taken as the optimization goal, and constraints such as monthly workload, holidays, inventory, and rotation cycle are considered. Then, the Cplex solver is used to solve the multivariate linear integer optimization model for smart meter rotation schedule. Finally, case studies on the smart meter rotation plan of Zhejiang electric power corporation in China are performed for verifying the effectiveness of the proposed smart meter rotation strategy. The simulation results show that the workload at the end of the year and the total number of on-site operations in the distribution systems can be greatly reduced by the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: WGAN-GP with Residual Network Model for Lithium Battery Thermal Image Data Expansion with Quantitative Metrics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Energy storage systems, especially lithium battery energy storage, play a significant role in microgrids. Thermal images of lithium batteries are crucial for the study of lithium batteries since lithium batteries are strongly impacted by temperature. In order to increase the sample of thermal images from lithium batteries, this paper designs the WGAN-GP with ResNet model (Wasserstein generative adversarial network with gradient penalty and residual networks). A complete WGAN-GP with ResNet model is built with the embedding of a generative adversarial network (GAN) structure, introducing gradient penalties, and combining residual networks. The experimental results demonstrate that WGAN-GP with ResNet have a greater improvement in training stability and generated image quality than GAN and Wasserstein GAN by using four evaluation indicators to examine the generated image quality.

articleTitle: Research on Development Status, Development Strategy, Key Technology and Development Suggestion of Comprehensive Smart Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the context of carbon neutrality, comprehensive smart energy has attracted more and more attention from all walks of life, and gradually evolved into the focus of energy transformation. Firstly, the background and connotation of comprehensive smart energy are analyzed in this paper, and the development status of comprehensive smart energy at home and abroad is introduced. Secondly, the development strategy of comprehensive smart energy is summarized from two aspects: unified interface standard and coordinated energy application. Then, the key technologies of comprehensive smart energy are summarized into five aspects: energy production, energy transmission, energy storage, energy consumption and energy intelligence. Finally, suggestions are put forward to strengthen the overall planning of comprehensive smart energy, promote the localization of key technologies and equipment, improve the comprehensive smart energy market and promote the development of user-side energy services.

articleTitle: Inference of Tampering Based on Measurement Discrepancy in EV Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As electric vehicles (EVs) become more common, the risks and harms of cyber-attacks on EV charging equipment and systems are increasing. The data collection of charging stations and the network of each charging pile may be tampered with by fraudulent consumers or malicious code, resulting in metering discrepancies. Without a systematic reasoning framework, identifying rogue devices or meters can be challenging when there are many compromised endpoints. Fortunately, alarm systems in metering infrastructure can provide operators with decision support tools with quantitative parameters/indicators to identify potential electronic intrusions in charging stations. However, from a security point of view, the interactive implementation of alarms and log data from the distribution network, the charging station, and the charging piles is still underdeveloped. Therefore, this paper proposed an inference for establishing metered network trustworthiness based on changes in the measured values of feeder remote terminal units (FRTU/RTU) and IP-based smart data collection meters (SMs) associated with the root and leaf networks at the charging station, respectively, and validate the inference framework based on the relevant data of an actual charging station.

articleTitle: Customers Baseline Load Estimation Based on Cluster Analysis of Control Group
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Demand response (DR) improves the adjustment ability of power system from the user side, which plays an important role in improving the flexibility of power system and promoting the consumption of new energy. The estimation of customer baseline load (CBL) involves the benefits of DR participants and providers, so the accuracy of CBL estimation directly affects the implementation of DR projects. The control group method has a high accuracy. However, how to make full use of the non-DR load information of power users and improve the estimation accuracy of CBL is a problem that needs further research. This paper proposes a method for CBL estimation of power users based on k-means clustering control group. Firstly, the historical data of power users in the control group and the data on DR day are analyzed by k-means clustering to generate k load vectors of cluster center, and the historical data of users in the DR group in non-DR periods and the data on DR day are matched with the cluster center, and the weight vector was determined by the optimization method to estimate the CBL of DR users in DR periods. Taking the measured load data of residential users of a power company as an example, it is proved that the method can improve the estimation accuracy of CBL.

articleTitle: Voltage control method considering virtual power plant in distribution network based on deep learning long and short-term memory networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the grid connection of virtual power plant in distribution network such as large-scale distributed power sources, energy storage devices and active loads, the traditional distribution network is transformed into a new type of active distribution network, which affects many aspects such as power quality and safe operation of the power grid, and also brings great challenges to the planning, optimization, control and management of the distribution network. The existing analytical algorithms and intelligent algorithms for solving the optimization and control problems of active distribution networks reveal many shortcomings such as complex mathematical modeling, difficulty in satisfying the solution accuracy and fast solution speed in the face of multiple optimization objectives and complex network structures, while deep learning algorithms have unique advantages in solving complex nonlinear problems. Therefore, this paper takes active distribution network voltage control as the research objective, considers the power output characteristics of distributed power sources and energy storage devices and the grid operation constraints, designs a multi-time scale voltage control strategy, including two time phases before and during the day, schedules the reactive power output of distributed power sources and the charging and discharging of energy storage systems, and uses a deep learning long and short-term memory network as the solution algorithm. Using the improved 33-node distribution system as an example, the results verify the feasibility of the long and short-term memory network for optimization calculation, which can effectively control the node voltage, reduce the active network loss, and ensure the accuracy of the optimization control without the complex mathematical model, and at the same time can realize fast dispatching.

articleTitle: Distribution network state awareness and risk prediction based on ELM algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, with the continuous access of photovoltaic, energy storage and charging piles, the distribution network field is facing a comprehensive transformation of digitalization, informatization and networking. However, the existing distribution network lacks the ability of comprehensive analysis and risk prediction of the overall operation of the distribution network. In this paper, the security situation of the distribution network information energy network is studied from two aspects: multi-source spatial-temporal data fusion and situation risk prediction. First, the artificial fish swarm algorithm (AFSA) is used to optimize the limit learning machine (ELM) to spatial-temporal fusion the equipment information and access energy parameters of the flexible resource access point in the distribution network line, and the risk pattern recognition method of AFSA-ELM multi-classification curve analysis is constructed; Secondly, the parameters obtained from AFSA-ELM algorithm network are converted into information utility values., and the risk values of distribution network risk points obtained from AFSA-ELM are quantified to obtain the coordinates of actual risk points; Then, the Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average model(ARIMA) time series prediction algorithm is used to predict the risk change process of the risk points and reconfirm the situation of the risk points; Finally, the model is verified to have good evaluation and prediction effect by using the data collected from the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Bidding Strategy of Virtual Power Plant Participating in Spot Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Virtual power plants gathers different power generation resources and gives play to their respective advantages in order to gain more profits in the electricity market and guarantee the interests of internal members. This paper establishes a two-layer bidding model of virtual power plants participating in spot market. The upper level of the model is the power exchange center to determine the winning power quantity of each power manufacturer with the goal of the lowest social electricity cost; the lower level is the virtual power plant operator to optimize the bidding strategy with the goal of maximizing their own income. The example analysis shows that the participation of all kinds of power generation resources in the spot market in the form of virtual power plants can improve the overall profit, and the moderate adoption of more conservative bidding strategy can further improve the profit of virtual power plants.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive LCOE Estimation Method for Wind Power based on Weibull Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wind power is a fast-growing and dominant renewable energy that has attracted attention of many researchers and institutions because it is a cleaner and more economic way of electricity generation. With the advances in wind power technology and its consequent widespread application, the economics of new wind power generation technologies has become a hot topic of research in the real-world industry. The levelised cost of electricity (LCOE) is a widely used metric in this field to measure the cost of electricity generation and can be modified and applied to renewable generation technologies. In this paper, the definition of LCOE is presented in a comprehensive manner dedicated to the estimation for wind power in various scenarios. In addition, since LCOE is relevant to the annual energy production (AEP) of a power plant, this paper also proposes a wind speed simulation model based on Weibull distribution to make AEP estimation more appropriate in the real-world industrial applications.

articleTitle: Research on Abnormal Electrical Behavior Identification Technology Based on Cost Sensitive RAE-AdaBoost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: One of the difficulties to the power supply company is to identify the abnormal electricity usage behavior and deal with the electric larceny. Considering the limited abnormal power consumption data samples and the temporal characteristics of user power consumption data, accurate identification is challenging. This paper proposes a cost-sensitive RAE-AdaBoost algorithm to identify abnormal power consumption behavior. Firstly, k-means algorithm is used to cluster the user load curve to realize the division of the electricity consumption behavior and improve the accuracy of identified objects. Secondly, a recursive neural network based on autoencoder is used to obtain the sequence characteristics of the load data, so as to reduce the dimension of the original data and retain the data characteristics. Then, considering the imbalance of abnormal power consumption samples, the AdaBoost algorithm based on cost compensation is proposed to compensate the weight of the misclassified samples, so as to solve the problem of high miss rate. Finally, the robustness and efficiency of the proposed method are verified from the evaluation indexes such as accuracy, recall rate and ROC curve through the experimental with real-world power usage data.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Demand Response based on Distributed Privacy Data Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As demand response(DR) is gradually progressing toward the extensive participation and lower barrier to entry, a trend of diversification has been observed in DR participants, which greatly aggravates the unpredictability of its effect. Risk assessment of DR becomes the necessary link of future organization DR. However, due to the conflict between the centralized risk assessment and the customer privacy, the risk assessment of DR has been limited by insufficient data support. To solve this, a data acquisition and risk assessment method for DR is proposed in the paper. Decentralized access to privacy data is designed, so that customers' appeal for data privacy protection has been met, as well as the risk assessment of DR is supported by more data. The risk assessment method and its implementation by the blockchain are described. The simulation results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Distributionally Robust Optimal Dispatching of Integrated Electricity and Heating System with Multiple Functional Areas Considering the Uncertainties of Sources and Loads
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The optimal dispatching of integrated electricity and heating system (IEHS) can satisfy the diversified energy demand and improve the renewable energy consumption level through electro-thermal synergy and complementarity. However, the failure to fully exploit the consumption potential of renewable energy sources can be caused by insufficient consideration of multiple functional areas, and the economy and robustness of optimal dispatching will be affected by the uncertainty of IEHS. Therefore, a distributionally robust optimal dispatching model of IEHS with multiple functional areas considering the uncertainties of sources and loads is proposed in this paper, aiming to minimize the operation cost and renewable energy curtailment of IEHS and achieve the balance between robustness and economy of optimal dispatching. Firstly, the uncertainties model of sources and loads based on Wasserstein distance is established. Then, a distributionally robust optimal dispatching model of IEHS with multiple functional areas considering the uncertainties of sources and loads is established to minimize the operation cost of IEHS while considering the uncertainty costs. Finally, a certain IEHS with multiple functional areas is taken as a case study to verify the effectiveness of the proposed optimal dispatching model.

articleTitle: A Review of Features, Vulnerabilities, Cyber-Attacks and Protective Actions in Smart Grid Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The future power system will be an innovative administration of existing power grids, which is called smart grid. Above all, the application of advanced communication and computing tools is going to significantly improve the productivity and consistency of smart grid systems with renewable energy resources. Together with the topographies of the smart grid, cyber security appears as a serious concern since a huge number of automatic devices are linked through communication networks. Cyber-attacks on these devices have a direct influence on the reliability of extensive infrastructure of the power system. In this survey, several published works related to smart grid systems, features, requirements, main constituents, vulnerabilities, potential intentional attacks, and suggested countermeasures for these threats have been investigated.

Author Keywords: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition System

articleTitle: Two-level optimal allocation method of integrated energy system considering source and load uncertainty and carbon trading
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the reasonable allocation of resources in the integrated energy system(IES) under the background of “double carbon”, this paper proposes a two-level optimal allocation method of the integrated energy system considering the uncertainty of source and load and carbon trading. Firstly, the structure of the integrated energy system and the mathematical model of each energy equipment are established; Secondly, a two-level optimal allocation model of the integrated energy system is established: the upper planning model takes the investment cost and the operation cost is the optimization objectives, the lower planning model takes the daily operation and maintenance cost, energy purchase cost and carbon transaction cost is the optimization objectives to obtain the optimal scheduling results of each equipment; Then, in order to deal with the uncertainty of source and load, the fuzzy chance-constrained model is introduced into the lower level planning model, which is transformed into a fuzzy optimal allocation problem through a clear equivalence class. The calculation example shows that the proposed method improves the economy of the integrated energy system and the ability to cope with the uncertainty of source and load.

articleTitle: Online Evolutionary Maximum Power Point Tracking for Photovoltaic Grid-connected System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The utilization of clean energy is increasing because of energy shortage. Meanwhile, the advancement of photovoltaic grid-connected technology has emerged as one widespread approach both domestically and internationally as a crucial component of microgrids. Thus, this study proposes an online evolutionary strategy for photovoltaic maximum power point tracking to fully utilize the solar energy in grid-connected photovoltaic and realize adaptive adjustment of maximum power point tracking control facing environmental dynamics. In this study, the conventional regulation is upgraded into an online evolutionary approach, which deploys incremental adjustment and deep learning. A deep neural network is proposed to continuously modify the weight matrix, which adaptively tunes tracking parameters. In addition, a two-stage single-phase grid-connected photovoltaic inverter is designed with environmental dynamics. The proposed strategy of online evolutionary maximum power point tracking is demonstrated on photovoltaic panels under different solar conditions. The experimental results present that the developed evolutionary approach can overcome the shortcomings of traditional maximum power point tracking, which accelerates the response speed and reduces the power fluctuation under external disturbances.

articleTitle: Study on the nondestructive detection method of composite insulator internal defect based on microwave reflection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to realize the internal defect detection of composite insulator, the detection method based on microwave reflection is proposed in the study. Firstly, the significant fluctuation of microwave reflection signal as internal defect appears provides the possibility of using microwave reflection to detect the defect. Then, plate sample without defects is detected and the reflection signal intensity fluctuates within 0.2V which can be attributed to the systematic error. The artificial manufacturing defects contained in the plate sample can be effectively detected, and the minimum defect size is about 4mm wide and 0.3mm deep. Carbon deposition near the defect due to ablation may cause a decrease of the detected reflected signal intensity. Finally, it is proved that internal defects in the actual insulators can be successfully detected using the device and method proposed in this study.

articleTitle: Synergetic effects of atmospheric plasma and UVA treatment for eye infection pathogens disinfection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: We report a combined method of using atmospheric surface micro-discharge (SMD) with UVA exposure to provide a fast and efficient method against eye infection pathogens. 4 kinds of typical eye infection bacteria were chosen and treated under SMD treatment only, UVA exposure only and 5min SMD treatment followed by 1 or 2 min UVA exposure in buffered solution. The combination of plasma treatment and UVA exposure presented the best antibacterial effect, especially for the UV-resistant bacteria strain, Serratia marcescens. This synergetic method has been found to have no selectivity on bacterium type. The possible mechanism of the synergetic effects was preliminarily proved to be caused mainly by photodecomposition of nitrite. UVA photolysis analysis of pure nitrite, H<inf>2</inf>O<inf>2</inf> solution and their mixture indicated the formation of peroxynitrite in buffered solution partly contributed to the anti-bacterial effect in this work.

articleTitle: Research on electromagnetic transient real-time simulation compensation algorithm of power system with large-scale new energy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The math model of power system with large scale new energy including a large number of power electronic switch devices model, and semi physical real time simulation research of new energy integration control algorithm often uses a relatively larger simulation step size, thus this situation greatly reduces the simulation accuracy and stability of model with a large number of power electronic devices. This paper proposes a real time simulation compensation algorithm for fixed step to solve the problem. This algorithm compensates PWM waveform sampling error because of the fixed step real time simulation to improve the simulation accuracy, at the same time, it avoids the problem that the traditional algorithm increases the amount of computation with the increase of switching devices, laying the foundation for power system real-time simulation with large scale new energy.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of thermoelectric coupling of pollution-covered degraded insulators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The existence of degraded insulators seriously affects the safe operation of the power grid system. For this reason, this paper analyzes the temperature field characteristics by simulating the temperature rise of degraded insulator strings under fouling conditions and draws lessons for the insulator infrared diagnosis technology. This paper introduces the heat generation principle on the insulator surface, establishes a thermoelectric coupling model by Simulation Software, and analyzes the influence of the degradation and fouling of a single insulator and the degradation location and degree of contamination in the insulator string on the thermal field characteristics. The results show that dry fouling and the size of the fouling degree have no effect on the detection of fouled and degraded insulators by infrared imaging, and wet fouling will affect the accuracy of infrared diagnosis results.

articleTitle: The effect of reference condition selection on parameter extraction of DDM for PV modules with different methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Double-diode model is widely used in photovoltaic system modelling and output estimation because of its high accuracy. This paper uses different methods to obtain the parameters of DDM under reference condition and uses transformation equations to get the parameters of DDM under any reference conditions. Applying different methods and selecting different reference conditions will affect the accuracy of parameter extraction, then it will affect the estimated and calculated I-V curves. The parameters of the double-diode model are calculated by analytical method, optimization method and hybrid method. Five different reference conditions are selected to obtain the parameters of the double-diode model under any reference condition, and the RMSE of 36765 curves are obtained and compared. The estimated Pm calculated by three methods is compared with the measured data based on condition 4 and 5. The estimated I-V curves calculated by three methods based on high irradiance reference conditions are compared with measured data.

articleTitle: Application of the Steady State Voltage Simulation Model Based on PSCAD in the Reverse Charging Test of Ultra-high voltage Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As an important part of ultra-high voltage transmission project, the stability and reliability of ultra-high voltage direct current converter station is related to the safe operation of power system. In order to discover potential hidden problems of UHV DC converter station equipment as early as possible, the inverted charging test is carried out before the converter station goes into operation. The steady state voltage is an important factor affecting the successful completion of the reverse charging test. This paper builds a refined simulation and calculation model of power supply, cable, switch, transformer and GIS by PSCAD, proposes an optimal adjustment strategy for steady-state voltage, simulates and calculates the steady-state voltage of inverted charging, and verifies the validity of the simulation model through tests, and forms targeted opinions and suggestions.

articleTitle: Investigation on Vsd(T) and Vds,on(T) Methods for Cascode GaN Device Junction Temperature Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As one of the most effective ways to realize an enhancement mode characteristic, a comprehensive junction temperature measurement investigation is rarely mentioned for cascode GaN devices. In this paper, the reason for the difference in junction temperature measurement of cascode GaN device by V<inf>ds,on</inf>(T) and V<inf>sd</inf>(T) methods is studied. By comparing the junction temperature measured by V<inf>ds,on</inf>(T) and V<inf>sd</inf>(T) method with that measured by infrared camera on the chip surface, it is found that V<inf>ds,on</inf>(T), reflects the average temperature on the GaN chip surface, while V<inf>sd</inf>(T) method reflects the average temperature on the Si chip surface. The transient thermal resistance simulations on both chip surfaces are also studied to confirm the conclusions. Different heating modes lead to different heat sources, so it is suggested to select measurement method which can reflect the junction temperature of the chip which is used as the heat source.

articleTitle: An entropy-based LiDAR loop detection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Since the existing loop-closure detection algorithm based on LiDAR is relatively simple in extracting point cloud features, and the problem of yaw angle needs to be considered in later matching, this paper proposes a multi-feature laser scanning context method based on entropy to achieve stable and reliable loop-closure detection. Firstly, the global descriptor is created by extracting multiple feature information of the LiDAR point cloud to build an image to record the three-dimensional information of the surrounding environment fully; At the same time, an image-matching algorithm based on entropy is used to make the loop detection rotation invariant, so that the yaw angle does not need to be modified. Relevant experiments have confirmed the superiority of the method proposed in this paper and the excellent performance of the experimental results.

articleTitle: Research on Single-phase Grounding Fault Line Selection Based on EMD Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the intricacy and complexity of the power grid, the single-phase grounding faults mostly occur in small current grounding systems and timely remove the line faults being critical to the stability and safety of the power system. For that purpose, the fault transient signals are analyzed of single-phase grounding faults to accurately extract the characteristic frequencies that reflect the fault information, and the EMD method is used to model and simulate the fault information in following experiments. The experiments are conducted for two types of grounding distribution network models which are overhead lines and cable hybrid lines to study the simulation data of single-phase-to-ground short circuit of distribution network under various fault conditions; the faulty line location can be derived on the basis of the intrinsic modal energy; accordingly, the fault line selection can be obtained quickly which verifies the rationality of that method.

articleTitle: A Performance Comparison of Different Secondary Structures for Linear Permanent Magnet Eddy Current Brakes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Eddy current brake is an electromagnetic device which can outputs the braking force or torque base on Faraday law of electromagnetic induction and the equation of Lorentz force. Relative to the traditional mechanical friction brake, the eddy current brake has the advantages of no mechanical contact, low noise, convenient maintenance, long working life, easy to control, high reliability and nonpolluting. In this paper, linear eddy current brakes with different secondary structures, ie, cage, smooth solid, slitted solid and compound solid, were compared in cases where the geometrical size is kept constant. In order to compare the performance characteristics brought about by the change in the secondary's structure for different speeds, all the eddy current brakes were analyzed with the finite-element method (FEM).

articleTitle: Improving the thermal conductivity of epoxy resin composites by magnetic orientation of boron nitride nanosheets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Preparation of high thermal conductivity epoxy resin (EP) composites can effectively solve the heat dissipation problem of windings of new energy vehicle drive motors. In this study, the high thermal conductivity of the vertical plane of boron nitride nanosheets (BN) was utilized, and the CoFe<inf>2</inf>O4 (CFO) prepared by hydrothermal method was attached to the exfoliated BN surface by van der Waals attraction and Dopamine (PDA) coating. The EP composites were prepared by magnetic orientation of BN, which improved the thermal conductivity of EP and achieved higher thermal conductivity enhancement at lower content. As the content of 6.81 vol.%, the thermal conductivity of the oriented BN@CFO composites reached 0.65 W/m.K, which is 263 % of EP. The thermal conductivity of the composites with different magnetic orientation times were compared, and it was found that the extended magnetic orientation time was beneficial to improve the thermal conductivity of the composites. In addition, it was confirmed using simulation that BN orientation is more favorable for heat transfer. This study provided an effective approach for the preparation of high thermal conductivity epoxy resin composites.

articleTitle: A wind-fire-storage optimal scheduling method considering the combination of stepped carbon trading and energy storage mileage function
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Nowadays, carbon trading market and energy storage technology only consider the production cost of the system, but ignore the objective law that carbon emission follows when participating in market trading and the law that the operating cost changes due to the change of energy storage element lifetime, which results in the weak guiding force of carbon trading market and the unreasonable allocation capacity of energy storage. Therefore, this work researches the wind-fire-storage optimal scheduling problem, proposes a multi-objective model, introduces A multi-objective model is proposed, a wind abandonment penalty mechanism and an energy storage element life change model are introduced to improve the adaptability of wind power, and a joint wind-fire-storage optimal dispatch model is constructed considering the combination of stepped carbon trading costs and storage charging and discharging milestone functions.

Author Keywords: Energy storage charging and discharging milestone function

articleTitle: Fault Coding Inspired Agile Diagnosis for Traction Motor System with Improved GWO-SVM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the incipient fault detection and isolation issues of high speed train (HST) traction motor. The multiple fault feature in such a motor is obscure with few fault samples, and the fault separation vary in nonlinear pattern. This paper presents an agile diagnosis combining electromagnetic torque energy entropy coding and support vector machine(SVM) model optimized by improved grey wolf optimizer(IGWO) algorithm. The perform of the proposed work is validated through experimentation on a fault testing verification platform for HST traction motor system.

articleTitle: The operational risk management of PDN with EV charging and the operation method assessment: A Shanghai case
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The integration of the charging network and the power distribution network (PDN) will be increasingly close with the penetration of large-scale electric vehicles (EV). The two networks should be considered collaboratively in operation assessment. A hierarchical indicator system is established and the weights are determined by Delphi method and analytic hierarchy process (AHP). The assessment results are calculated by TOPSIS in three scenarios. The proposed methods pass the cross check with entropy weight method (EWM) and grey relational analysis method (GRA). A case study in Shanghai based on real data and simulation verifies the performance of the operation optimization method. This research is expected to be applied in future high EV penetration scenes and improve the comprehensiveness of power system assessment.

articleTitle: Improved Three-vector Control Based On Minimum Current Ripple
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to obtain better system performance, an improved three-vector model predictive current control (MPCC) based on minimum current ripple is proposed. In this method, two different combinations of voltage vectors are used according to different working conditions. One is the combination of two non-zero voltage vectors and a zero vector, the other is the combination of three non-zero voltage vectors. By calculating the current ripple of two different combinations, the combination that has smaller current ripple is selected to act on the next control period. Finally, comparative experiments show that the proposed method has better steady-state performance than the traditional three-vector MPCC in the medium and high speed.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Loading System for Electromagnetic Coil Device Based on EtherCAT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems such as not being able to be co-supported and co-controlled for many kinds of large loads and fast reloading, the intelligent loading system of electromagnetic coil device was designed and researched, and the accurate adaptive position control design was carried out for the loading end point of the intelligent loading system. The real-time location of the launcher's body tube is detected by laser ranging technology, and the data is calculated and converted by EtherCAT real-time industrial Ethernet to complete the real-time online correction of the loading endpoint of the intelligent loading system. The adaptive trajectory planning of the intelligent loading system is realized by combining PLC trajectory planning technology. The results show that the intelligent loading system can realize automatic loading with large load and high speed under the double S-type trajectory planning based on adaptive control. In the study, the end point feedback and the end point command value track well during each loading. The application of EtherCAT network technology and laser ranging technology in the field of automatic filling was expanded, which provided theoretical guidance for the subsequent development of automatic filling control system.

articleTitle: Simulation and Measurement on Vibration Characteristics of Power Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Normal operation causes the transformer core, winding, and cooling device to vibrate, which in turn causes the vibration of the transformer body. The main sources of vibration include core vibration caused by magnetic hysteresis of silicon steel sheet and winding caused by magnetic leakage of load current. In order to study the relation between the electromagnetic force of the iron core, the vibration of the iron core and the vibration of the transformer body surface, the finite element model of connecting the transformer winding and the electromagnetic force field of the iron core was established, and the vibration characteristics of the transformer core were simulated. The vibration characteristics of the oil tank in different directions were tested by the acceleration sensor, and the vibration transmission process was discussed. It is found that the magnitude and direction of the core electromagnetic force have obvious correlation with the vibration of the fuel tank.

articleTitle: Modulation Strategy and Control Scheme of AC-AC Boost Converter for Under Voltage Compensation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The under voltage is an essential issue for the distribution network, which troubles millions of users. Compared to the traditional load tap changer counterpart, to pursue flexible and deep voltage-dip compensation, the AC-AC boost converter with advanced modulation and control schemes is proposed in this paper. To avoid the short-circuit risk during commutation and dead-time sectors, the improved modulation strategy is proposed to ensure the bi-directional free-wheeling paths. Concerning the forward, reverse, commutation, and dead-time modes of the converter, the operation principles and current routines of the converter are comprehensively revealed. Besides, the output voltage feedback loop is comparatively studied to eliminate the circulating current and ensure the safe commutation. Meanwhile, considering the voltage distortion effect, the blind time of the commutation is also carefully designed. Finally, the 500 W AC-AC boost converter prototype is fabricated and tested. The experiments in steady-state and dynamics examine the validation of the proposed modulation and control. The findings prove the AC-AC boost converter is a preferred solution for the voltage-dip compensation of the distribution network in the future.

articleTitle: Research on calculation method of locating time difference of UHF partial discharge signal based on short time energy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the long time operation of GIS equipment, partial discharge often causes faults. In order to improve the accuracy of ultra-high frequency location of GIS partial discharge, this paper proposes a calculation method of positioning time difference of ultra-high frequency partial discharge signal based on short-time energy. The ultra-high frequency original signal is processed by short-term energy calculation, and the energy difference curve is obtained. The time difference is located by the normal distribution statistical method. Finally, this method is applied to the partial discharge detection of an UHV station to judge the fault location of the sensor on site, and realize the localization of GIS local defects.

articleTitle: Research and Application on the Risk Management and Control System for Power Grid to Prevent and Resist Typhoon
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: China's policy to deal with COVID-19 has achieved a phased victory. It gives power grid a reference for how to prevent and resist typhoon risk. This paper proposed a risk management and control system for power grid to prevent and resist typhoon, which is characterized by reference to epidemic prevention. Firstly, the fault characteristics of coastal power grid affected by typhoon were analyzed. And the dynamic and static zoning administration modes of typhoon harmfulness were proposed. Secondly, the reliability and importance evaluation system of power grid to anti-typhoon was constructed separately, which was considered from multi-level and multi-angle. Further, the power failure risk assessment system was constructed from two aspects of user and region. Finally, a case of Zhejiang coastal power grid was carried out. The results show that the management system involves many aspects of typhoon-proof. And it can improve the power grid's ability to cope with typhoon disasters.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation Method for Human Body Electric Shock Protection Based on Human Body Impedance Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Human body electric shock protection is related to the life safety of the people and is an important topic in low-voltage distribution network. According to the characteristic difference between the real part and imaginary part of the model of human body impedance by IEC, a human body electric shock protection principle based on the real part of residual current variation impedance is constructed to protect against human body electric shock by sampling the residual current and three-phase voltage. Based on Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA), a fully digital hardware design scheme for human body electric shock protection is proposed, including high-speed sampling, Discrete Fourier Transform, and fault sudden-change starting, fault phase selection, impedance calculation and discrimination. The experimental results show that the application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) designed in this paper provides human body electric shock protection at a sampling rate of 5kHz, and behaves well in terms of the speed and effectiveness of the protection.

articleTitle: Research on Phase-number Switching Method of Interleaved Parallel Boost Circuit Based on Current Ripple Cancellation Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a method of phase number switching of interleaved Boost circuit based on ripple cancellation technology is proposed. Firstly, a new Boost circuit topology is proposed. By calculating the parameters of the auxiliary circuit, it is proved that the topology is effective in eliminating the current ripple of any phase Boost circuit.
