The introduction of oil flow can significantly improve the insulation strength of the oil gap only when the flow rate was above a certain critical value. In stationary and low speed oil flow, the cellulosic bridge across the electrodes formed at low voltage would break and form cellulose clusters on the surface of the electrodes in the process of raising the voltage. The breakdown occurred on the side closer to the center of the electrodes in the clustering region. In high-speed oil flow, the cellulose particles were neither bridged nor agglomerated, and breakdown was triggered by local electric field distortion caused by the end of the short cellulosic bridge.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Control Strategy of Prefabricated Cabin Substation-Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The rapid development of electrical power demand and electrical vehicle industry will accelerate the construction of urban substations and charging stations, but it is also constrained by the shortage of existing land resources. On the basis of prefabricated cabin substation with the advantage of intentional resource utilization, considering the integration of substation and electrical vehicle charging station, an optimal operation strategy under the integrated service mode is proposed. First, a comprehensive framework of “Prefabricated Cabin Substation Charging Station” is established to analyze the feasibility of its integrated operation. Within this framework, the problems of grid impact and line overload caused by one-way charging of large-scale electrical vehicles are analyzed, and a V2G autonomous active reactive power control strategy based on virtual synchronous machine technology is proposed. The simulation results on Matlab/Simulink platform show that: The proposed strategy can active track the frequency and voltage changes at the grid connection point, timely provided active and reactive power support, effective guarante the operation of prefabricated cabin type substation electric vehicle charging station mode, and promote the station of the grid.

articleTitle: Tuning the ONOOH of plasma-activated water: Effect of the N2/O2 ratio and post-discharge duration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Plasma activated water (PAW) contains a variety of reactive oxygen and nitrogen species (RONS). Among them, ONOOH has an impact on the activity and function of cells in the biological system, and also has a pharmacological inhibitory on many human diseases. However, since ONOOH in PAW is a transient species that is difficult to determine, most of the current research is still mainly focused on its determination or basic applications. There is no in-depth study and discussion on its regulation mechanism. Therefore, this research mainly investigates the two aspects mentioned above. In this study, the dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) is used to treat phosphate buffer solution (PBS) for preparing PAW. The effect of different gas ratios of N2 to O<inf>2</inf> on the product characteristics and the lifetime of ONOOH with its precursors is studied, and the pH value of the solution is also tested. The result shows that the maximum yield of ONOOH is at a gas ratio of N2:02=6:4. Then, PAW prepared under different conditions is preserved, in which the products are detected on the different periods. The result shows that the concentration of ONOOH rises briefly after the treatment with the gas ratio of N2:02= 9:1, 8:2 and 7:3, which indicates that the generation of ONOOH can be more than the consumption under these conditions at 0–15 minutes.

articleTitle: Directrix-based Demand Response Based on Stackelberg Game for Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the new-type power system dominated by new energy, the regulation capacity of the generation side has decreased significantly. Hence, it is necessary to fully explore the regulation capacity of the demand side to make up for the lack of flexibility caused by the grid connection of new energy. The directrix-based demand response directly gives the user the desired shape of the load curve. It has the advantages of convenient, fast, intuitive, and easy to operate, and it can be well adapted to the development needs of the new power system. Firstly, a mathematical model is constructed according to the seller's and the user's income composition. Then, from the point of view of Stackelberg game, the revenue function of both sides is solved iteratively, and a new load line is obtained. Finally, a comparative example is given to verify that the load criterion obtained by this method has a more positive effect on the consumption of new energy.

articleTitle: Real-Time Adaptive Data Compression for Permanent Magnet Motor Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) control system processes massive electrical and mechanical data sets which are important for various data-driven methods of big data analysis or failure data recording. However, as the control frequency going up, motor data processing faces more challenges of the limited computational resource of a motor controller. This paper proposes a real-time data compression method based on connected piecewise linear regression (CPLR) and compressed sensing (CS), so the motor operational data can be recorded with a minimum memory storage space. The study demonstrates the parameter boundary of CPLR under the condition that samples obtained by digital sensors. On this basis, adaptive-CPLR is proposed, which tunes parameter automatically with the given active function and has parameter reset mechanism. Further, CS is implemented using sparsity binary matrix (SBM) for space and time saving and triggered by adaptive-CPLR aimed to preserve frequency domain information conditionally. Experiment results is presented to demonstrate the real-time characteristic of the proposed compression method in resource limited motor controller STM32F407. Adaptive-CPLR and CS are also evaluated, showing that the proposed method successfully achieves desired performance of high compression ratio and low percentage root mean square residues.

articleTitle: Double-Line Frequency Ripple Suppression for Boost Converters in Laser Drivers with Input Voltage Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The laser driver is an important part of the laser system, most of which use Boost converter to charge the energy storage capacitor. The input voltage of Boost converter is usually provided by the AC network through uncontrolled rectifier bridge. Due to that, there is obvious double-line frequency ripple especially in DC input voltage and inductor current. To solve this problem, a PI regulator with DC input voltage prediction is proposed in this paper. The reference duty cycle is calculated by a PI regulator, and then it is modified by the prediction. To predict well, the quadratic interpolation method with error correction is adopted. The effectiveness of the proposed method on double-line frequency ripple suppression is verified by experimental results.

articleTitle: Two-stage robust optimization for generation-transmission collaborative expansion planning based on potential game theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a robust cooperative planning model for power generation and transmission considering new energy and long-term planning uncertainty is established. First, a potential game based power optimization planning model for stakeholders is established, which forms a Nash equilibrium solution of the power planning game with full consideration of the dispersion, autonomy and interest motivation of the investment planning of interest subject. Then, the transmission line optimization planning model is established based on the static N-1 principle, and the iterative framework of generation and transmission cooperative planning is designed, and the robust optimization model of investment planning containing box type uncertainty set based on two-stage robust optimization theory is established, which is combined with potential game theory. The max-min-max problem is transformed into the bi-level iterative form by column generation algorithm, and the model is linearized by strong duality principle and McCormick linearization method. Finally, the proposed model and algorithm is verified with a provincial actual power grid system.

Author Keywords: Power generation and transmission collaborative planning

articleTitle: A Dynamic Response Optimization Strategy for Grid-connected Active Power of Energy Storage Virtual Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The energy storage virtual synchronous generator (VSG) can provide certain inertia support for the renewable energy power generation system, but its virtual damping coefficient is coupled with the primary frequency modulation coefficient, so the dynamic oscillation and the steady-state error of its grid-tied active power cannot be eliminated simultaneously when the active power command and the grid frequency are disturbed. Therefore, a dynamic response optimization strategy based on the improved virtual impedance for the energy storage VSG is proposed in this paper, which introduces the virtual impedance into the voltage control link in the conventional VSG control strategy. The proposed method can not only improve the system damping but also suppress the dynamic oscillation of grid-connected active power without any steady-state deviation. The correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy are verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: A Wholesale Business Model for Virtual Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Virtual power plants support the generation/load balance of the renewable-dominated power system by connecting and controlling disparate sources of renewable generation, small fuel-fired units, energy storage devices, etc. However, the lack of reasonable business models limits the development of VPPs. This article focuses on the business model for virtual power plants in the wholesale markets. Firstly, the construction and features of the virtual power plant are analyzed. Secondly, the business model in the wholesale market is proposed to support virtual power plants participating in medium and long-term markets, spot markets, and peak regulation markets. Thirdly, the case study is carried out to analyze the comprehensive costs of virtual power plants with the proposed business model. Finally, some policies are proposed in the conclusion part to reduce the comprehensive costs of virtual power plants.

articleTitle: Consensus-Based Online Decoupling Optimization for Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The complexity exists in the Integrated Energy System (IES) makes it impractical to implement in real-word. To this end, we propose a consensus-based online decoupling optimization method for the IES in this paper. First, an nonlinear optimization model is formulated in a centralized fashion, considering the dynamic carbon emission factors (DCF) and carbon market transaction costs. We further introduce an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) algorithm combing with consistency variables to solve the energy-carbon co-optimization problem, where the original problem is transformed to convex cone optimization problem. Moreover, the convergence performance of the ADMM algorithm is improved by dynamically adjusting the variable penalty coefficient. The numerical results show that the method can reduce the cost by transforming different types of energy and effectively improve the utilization of muti-energy.

articleTitle: Parameter Selection of Fast-Switching Current Mirror for Active Gate Driver of High-Power Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the switching frequency of power devices increases and the requirement of precision switching transient adjustment increases, the response speed of active gate driver (AGD) has become more demanding. However, the existing current source AGDs lack the ability to easily, quickly and accurately adjust the magnitude of the gate current. The theoretical analysis of the gate current switching process has not been studied. Therefore, in order to implement a controllable current source with fast switching speed, this article analyzes the switching process of the current mirror. The main device parameters affecting the current switching speed of the current source are revealed. The current switching speed of the current source is mainly related to the input capacitance of the MOSFET as branch switch, the equivalent capacitance of the PN junction of the BJT that constitutes the current mirror, and the damping coefficient of the output loop of the current source. For the design of current mirror in high-speed switching current source AGD, the device selection guidelines are proposed as well as circuit design. Finally, the dynamic switching effect of the proposed current source gate driver is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Diagnosing Sliding Bearing Failures using the Frequency Domain Integration and PCA Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Given the difficulty of the fault diagnosis of sliding bearings in induction motors, this paper designs a fault diagnosis method of the sliding bearing based on frequency domain integration and principal component analysis (PCA) algorithm. Taking the acceleration signal of the actual faulty motor bearing as an example, the displacement signal was obtained by frequency domain integration. The direct plotting of the axis trajectory led to a confused graph making it difficult to identify the fault. Then, the raw displacement signal was denoised by using the PCA-based signal denoising algorithm, and the axis trajectory was redrawn using the denoised displacement signal. The results showed that the purified axis trajectory is clear and the features are obvious, and the evident rotor misalignment fault of the motor can be identified. Compared with the denoising method of clustering ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) and empirical wavelet transform (EWT), the method presented in this paper can obtain a clearer axis trajectory, which helps to realize the diagnosis of motor sliding bearing faults.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Integrated Energy System Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To strengthen the interaction between supply and demand of integrated energy systems and fully mobilize the response potential of the demand side, in this paper, a system optimal allocation model considering demand-side response is proposed. Firstly, according to the time-of-use electricity price scheme, a flexible electricity load model is established; A flexible heat load model considering the thermal inertia of the heating system and the adjustability of heat demand is established. Secondly, based on the above load model, taking the minimum annual comprehensive cost as the upper objective function and the minimum typical daily operating cost as the lower objective function, a Bi-level programming model is established to optimize the type and capacity of the installed equipment. The Bi-level optimization algorithm combining adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm and CPLEX is used to solve the problem. Finally, a simulation example is built to show that the integrated demand response of the terminal load is of great significance in cost reduction and efficiency improvement of the system.

articleTitle: Migration Characteristics of Moisture in RIP Materials and Its Influence on Surface Insulation Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, the wall bushings and converter transformer bushings in domestic HVDC projects mostly use epoxy resin impregnated paper (RIP) dry bushings. The RIP material has a certain degree of water absorption, so the surface of the RIP core is coated with a two-component insulating varnish made of epoxy resin and modified polyamide resin to prevent moisture. This paper studies the surface insulation strength and moisture transfer law of materials subjected to moisture. It is found that the DC flashover field strengths of the coated samples before being wetted are higher than those of the uncoated samples by 5.7%. After the sample was exposed to moisture for 24 hours and 72 hours, the flashover voltage decreased by 31.6% and 47.1% respectively compared with the flashover voltage without moisture. The water absorption rate of RIP material decreased by 39.9% after being coated. However, after coating, the surface layer of the material has high humidity due to the easy water absorption of polyamide, so the insulation performance along the surface of the coated sample is still significantly reduced after being exposed to moisture for a long time. Based on the research results, a vacuum high-temperature drying process that can effectively improve the DC flash insulation properties of damp specimens is proposed, which provides reference and support for the method of core moisture resistance and improving its insulation performance along the surface.

articleTitle: Four-Level Half-Bridge Power Module Package
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Compared with the existing two-level and three-level converters, four-level converters have the advantages of lower dv/dt and lower switching losses. Taking a four-level dual T -type converter as an example, six different topology configurations are developed using different combination of IGBT and SiC MOSFET semiconductor devices. Subsequently, three 4L-DT half-bridge power module package schemes with 1200V/100A are proposed and discussed in this article. With the help of vertical flux cancellation and horizontal flux cancellation, the three commutation loop inductances of each package scheme can be kept at low values. Simulations have been done based on Ansys/Q3D to verify the proposed power module package schemes.

articleTitle: DC arc fault detection method based on K-line and spectrum integration difference of current
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: DC fault arc occurring in low voltage DC systems such as photovoltaic (PV) system and battery energy storage systems is difficult to be extinguished. The traditional arc fault identification approaches have low recognition accuracy for the series arc. Therefore, a reliable approach is needed to detect DC fault arc timely and accurately. In this paper, the time and frequency domain characteristics of the current signal of a low-voltage DC system circuit are analyzed. A comprehensive algorithm based on the K-line and spectrum integration difference of the current is proposed, which can detect the low voltage DC fault arc, and effectively distinguish four states of the circuit: normal current, DC arc, switch action and load mutation. The real time arc detection test is performed using a microcontroller STM32F407. In the experiment, the fault arc can be detected and isolated within 37 ms, which is in line with the UL1699B standard, and the identification accuracy can reach 99.17%.

articleTitle: A Novel DC Fault Ride-through Coordinated Control Strategy for DC Grid with Hybrid MMC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: DC grid based on hybrid modular multilevel converter (MMC) is an effective means to achieve large-scale renewable energy integration, multi-energy complementarity and friendly grid-connection. Aiming at the problem that the traditional DC fault ride-through (FRT) scheme will cause the interruption of power transmission in the whole network, a novel DC FRT coordinated control strategy is proposed in this paper, which can quickly interrupt the fault current and avoid the MMC exiting operation. Based on the analysis of fault current composition and key influencing factors, for fault line MMC (FLMMC), a negative voltage control strategy adaptive to the change of fault current is proposed, which can improve the current attenuation speed and ensure reliable fault isolation. For non-fault line MMC (NFLMMC), considering the over-voltage and over-current risks of FLMMC, the coordinated current-limiting control method and parameter selection principle of NFLMMC is proposed, where the current-limiting performance can be adaptive to the voltage change of DC bus, so as to realize the rapid recovery of DC power grid while restraining fault current. Finally, a four-terminal DC grid simulation model is built based on the RTLAB OP5600 real-time digital simulation platform. The simulation results show that the coordinated control strategy proposed in this paper can quickly interrupt DC fault current, shorten DC grid recovery time and improve system security and stability.

articleTitle: Transient Control Optimization of SVG in Renewable Power Collection System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The unbalance between reactive power and voltage in renewable energy collection system restricts sending capability and becomes one of the most concerned problems. However, many Static Var Generators (SVGs) installed in renewable energy stations is difficult to meet the expected demand in application, especially during the fault period. They usually couldn't offer the rated capacity of the reactive power to support voltage during the fault, and might increase the system overvoltage after the clearance of earth fault. In this paper, the SVG controller hardware-in-loop simulation platform is built first. And based on the simulation analysis, the reactive power response characteristics of SVG under different control modes during fault and after the clearance of the fault are explored. Then the standard mathematical model of SVG is established to build SVG electromagnetic transient simulation model whose reactive power characteristics is consistent with the hardware controller. Finally, an optimized control strategy of reactive power compensation is proposed. With the optimized strategy, SVG can do best to support voltage during the fault and will not be locked because of the overvoltage at DC side. At the same time, the overvoltage after clearance of fault will be inhibited. The effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by the simulation.

articleTitle: Application of the Luenberger observer for rotor resistance estimation in induction motor drives
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a method for online identification of rotor resistance using the Luenberger observer. The rotor resistance is estimated with a full-order adaptive law and is used as the feedback signal for the vector controls. To improve the steady-state performance of the identification system, a closed-loop model of it is constructed to analyze the stability and robustness. An experiment is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the indirect vector control system with the Luenberger observer.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimized design of high-density and low-noise IPMSM for electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to reduce the vibration noise of the permanent magnet synchronous motor of electric vehicles, a high-density low-noise IPMSM multi-objective optimization design method is proposed, firstly, the electromagnetic force harmonic source causing electromagnetic noise of the motor is obtained, the optimization target is constructed by combining the electromagnetic performance index, the motor stator and rotor structure parameters are selected as the optimization parameters, the strong sensitive level structure parameters are screened through sensitivity analysis of the optimization parameters, and the multi-objective-based The motor body is optimized based on the multi-objective genetic algorithm, and the vibration noise of the prototype is suppressed and optimized. The results show that the method of this paper can ensure the high torque output of the motor and the noise caused by the main harmonic sources of electromagnetic force has been significantly suppressed.

articleTitle: Open-Circuit Failure Analysis and Diagnosis of High Output Frequency Multilevel Inverter for Superspeed Maglev Train
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Superspeed maglev train can reach the speed of 1000 kilometers per hour, or even 2 to 3 times the sound speed. Linear motor is often used in maglev train, when the linear motor parameters are constant, the maximum speed of the train depends on the output frequency of the traction converter. Due to the large switching loss of high-voltage and high-power power devices, the output frequency of traditional high-power maglev traction converter is limited to 500Hz, to resolve this contradiction, a high-frequency output converter topology has been proposed in 2021 by our research group. However, the reliability is the key problem of high-power converter, and the largest failure probability is the open circuit or short circuit of the power electronic device. This paper focused on the open circuit failure of high output frequency converter, and the failure diagnosis method is analyzed in detail then a redundant failure protection method is proposed. The proposed failure detection method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Study on the DC transmission system control based on multilevel converter module
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to ensure the stability of the transmission voltage and effectively control the operation of the DC transmission system in the event of three-phase short circuit fault, this paper proposes a DC transmission system operation control method based on multilevel converter module (MMC). The multilevel converter module is designed by using the anti parallel diode and parallel capacitor to obtain the AC equivalent inductance, ensure that the AC/DC flow of the converter station is the same as the active power, and clarify the power situation in the converter station; The module is combined with the feedforward decoupling compensation term, and the PI is used to obtain the input value of the current inner loop operation controller to realize current decoupling, increase the stability control of DC voltage, and improve the anti-interference of the transmission system; The corresponding reference value is obtained through the correction and control link, and the optimal operation control result is obtained. The experiment proves that the designed module can ensure the smooth operation of the power transmission system under normal working conditions, control the impact in a safe range when a fault occurs, and ensure the stability of the power transmission system.

articleTitle: A Simple Model Predictive Control for Open Winding PMSM Based on Duty Ratio Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To enhance the control performance of open winding PMSM (OW-PMSM) with common dc bus, a simple model predictive control (MPC) based on duty ratio control is proposed. First, the conventional MPC method is introduced. Next, the optimized MPC based on duty ratio control (MPC-DRC) method is put forward where a null voltage vector (000) is inserted to recalculate the operating time of active voltage vectors chosen in conventional method instead of the whole control period. Finally, the experimental results prove that the current total harmonic distortion (THD) and zero-sequence current (ZSC) ripple can be significantly lowered in MPC-DRC method compared with conventional method.

Author Keywords: MPC based on duty ratio control (MPC-DRC)

articleTitle: A CNN-BiLSTM and KNN based missing data imputation for wind power generation forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A missing data imputation method combined with the KNN (K-nearest Neighbors) and BiLSTM (Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory) is proposed to catering the solve challenges of noise interference and large variance. In this method, Firstly, the influence of dimensions on wind power is analyzed by the correlation coefficient of Pearson. And the information is extracted by the CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks) model. At the same time, the BiLSTM model exploits the ability to learn the internal representation of time series data. Then the missing data are imputed one by one by the CNN-BiLSTM model and the KNN model respectively. Finally, the final dataset is composed of these imputation values. The numerical simulation is carried out based on the actual data, the result shows that the combining model has a better imputation effect and its R<sup>2</sup> increases by 0.02.

articleTitle: An Optimized Active Power Decoupling Control Based on Real-time Capacitance Calculation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Active power decoupling (APD) technology can effectively suppress the double-line-frequency ripple power in single-phase inverter systems, which can improve system reliability and increase power density. However, most of the existing APD control strategies are sensitive to systems parameters, especially the change of decoupling capacitors. In this paper, an optimized active power decoupling control strategy is proposed to overcome this issue based on real-time capacitance calculation. By accurately tracking the capacitance value, the performance of the inverter system with the proposed strategy is improved. The simulation results are provided to verify its effectiveness.

articleTitle: High Speed Switch with Series-connected Vacuum and Gas Interrupters and Its DC Fast Transfer Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The natural transfer time of medium-voltage large-capacity hybrid DC circuit breaker is long or even fails. Therefore, this paper proposes a hybrid DC circuit breaker topology based on vacuum and gas integrated series switch, and analyzes the basic principle of vacuum and gas integrated series for current transfer performance. The experimental prototype of vacuum and gas integrated series switch in medium voltage field is designed by double over-range linkage operation structure. The influence of gas type, pressure, contact structure and contact material on arc voltage characteristics is studied. The W70 Cu bridge two contact structure, hydrogen and nitrogen mixed gas (H2: <tex>$\mathrm{N}_{2}=2:3$</tex>), pressure 0.3MPa and other related parameters are determined. The arc voltage can be increased from 20 V to 121 V, and the current transfer time is reduced to 1/6 of the original. The feasibility and effectiveness of vacuum and gas integrated series switch applied to medium voltage hybrid DC circuit breaker are verified.

articleTitle: Design of an Outer Rotor Permanent-Magnet Vernier Machine Integrated With Magnetic Screw
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel linear electromagnetic actuator based on the concept of magnetic screw transmission, which offers high thrust force density and high reliability. In order to further improve the effective operation surface area, an outer rotor permanent-magnet vernier (PMV) machine is artfully integrated with the magnetic screw. Based on this design, the force per surface area can be increased to further improve the force density. This device consists of three parts, an inner stator, a common rotor and a hollow translator. Then, the operating principle is investigated, and the decoupling design is given. Moreover, the configuration of the proposed linear electromagnetic actuator is analyzed and its electromagnetic performances are presented by using finite-element method (FEM). Finally, the experimental results are also presented to verify the performances of the proposed structure.

articleTitle: Research on Demand Response Strategy of Data Center Considering Multiple Coupling Load Regulation Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the surge of the demand for cloud computing services, the volume of high energy consumption of data centers has increased rapidly which has become one of the main loads in China. Compared with other demand response resources, data center load is a special flexible load with spatio-temporal adjustment potential and its demand response potential is huge. However, in the actual scheduling process, different data center loads have different delay requirements and can bear different scheduling distances which makes their demand response mechanism is complicated. Therefore, based on the data center operation framework that considers multiple coupling load regulation methods, this paper builds a data center demand response model considering multiple coupling load regulation methods. By analyzing the demand response of data center load, refrigeration facility and auxiliary equipment, it provides a theoretical basis for the data center load to be incorporated into power grid dispatching.

articleTitle: Design of Peak Cutting Listing Trading Considering Strategic Quotation of Load Aggregators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, the solution to the supply-demand tension problem in China's power system is mainly the traditional method of orderly power consumption management, a process that fails to fully take into account the power consumption patterns of users in various industries and makes it difficult to promote users' autonomy to cut peak loads. In this paper, we propose a peak load shedding listing transaction, which first sets monthly pricing listing transactions, and load aggregators participate in the market to form a demand response resource pool, and then participate in day-ahead bidding listing transactions to promote full market competition. In order to improve the economy of market operation and the authenticity of market-based information, a settlement method based on incentive compatibility is used to improve the authenticity of information declared by market players.

articleTitle: Research Progress of Semi-Insulated GaAs PCSS and Spark Gap Combined Switch
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on GaAs Photoconductive Semiconductor Switch (PCSS), a kind of combined switch with spark gap and photoconductivity switch was designed and tested. Compared with the experimental results, under the condition of the same bias voltage and triggering pulse energy, the output peak value of the combined switch is higher than that of the single GaAs photoconductivity switch. Moreover, in the case of satisfying the nonlinear mode photoelectric threshold, the combined switch can suppress the nonlinear mode of GaAs PCSS.

articleTitle: Threshold electric field of conductance and space charge in PMMA under DC field
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: PMMA is the standard sample of space charge detection in IEC/TS 62758–2012, but its reference electric field has a wide range of recommended values at room temperature and does not involve high temperature environment. Based on the space charge response and high field conductance detection of PMMA under DC electric field, the threshold electric field of charge accumulation and conductance in samples at different temperatures is analyzed, and the correlation between the two parameters is discussed. The results show that obvious space charge accumulation occurs in the sample when the electric field intensity is higher than about 14.95kV/mm at 30°C. At 50°C, the polarization electric field threshold of space charge accumulation in the sample is about 10.24kV/mm. With the increase of the electric field intensity, the heteropolar charge near the cathode gradually increases, while a large amount of homopolar charge accumulates first and then is partially replaced by heteropolar charge near the anode, finally manifesting the accumulation of homopolar charge. As the temperature rises, the conductivity of PMMA tends to increase, while the polarization electric field threshold of obvious space charge accumulation inside the sample decreases, which indicates that the increase in temperature will promote the impurity dissociation inside the sample and the hole injection at the electrode side. In addition, it is advisable to observe charge accumulation at a threshold electric field lower than 10kV/mm to reduce the measurement error under higher temperature test conditions.

articleTitle: Research on soft measurement algorithm of carbon content of rare earth metal ingots
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the problems existing in chemical analysis, the drilling pressure and audio generated by drilling Pr-Nd metal were used as auxiliary variables for soft sensor. the accuracy of the classification model established by soft-sensing algorithm reached 98.78%, which was close to the accuracy of manual measurement, and could effectively screen out unqualified products with carbon content of praseodymium and neodymium metal. It provides an improved method for the online automatic measurement of carbon content of rare earth metals, and provides a reference and improvement for the determination of praseodymium and neodymium metal content in industrial production.

articleTitle: Averaged Model of Type-4 Wind Energy Conversion Systems Considering Fault Ride through Capability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Control design and stability analysis of wind energy conversion systems (WECSs) involve multiple repetitive operation scenarios or a large number of wind turbines. Although the detailed-switching-based electromagnetic transient models can accurately simulate the transient characteristics on different time scales, its application in the above scenarios is limited by the low computational efficiency. This paper proposes a dynamic average-value model (AVM) for the type-4 wind power generation system, which consists of a six-phase permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) and a dual converter channel. To ensure the numerical stability and compatibility with adjacent components, the interface form between converters and adjacent components are firstly designed. Then, average-value equations are constructed for the two-channel converter and dc chopper circuit. Finally, the accuracy and computational efficiency of the proposed model are validated through comparisons with the detailed switching model in both time-domain simulations and frequency-domain analyses.

articleTitle: An Optimal Deployment Method of Terminals in SDN based PDIoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to enhance the business support capability of power distribution Internet of Things and save economic cost, this paper proposes an optimal deployment method for distribution edge computing terminals in software defined network based power distribution Internet of Things. The base station of power wireless private network has abundant data flow and service flow. It has obvious advantage to deploy distribution edge computing terminal by using the site of wireless base station. This paper introduces the software defined network based edge computing architecture of the power distribution Internet of Things, and establishes the service, intelligent terminal and edge computing terminal of the power distribution Internet of things. Furthermore, considering communication mode constraints, delay constraints and hardware configuration constraints, and aiming at minimizing the sum of annual average equipment cost and annual operating cost, an optimal deployment model of distribution edge computing terminals was established. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: An accurate measurement method for broadband transmission characteristics of large power equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Since the power equipment itself is generally huge in size, when the impedance analyzer and network analyzer used for the test of small equipment are used for the test of large power equipment, it's necessary to use leads that may be several meters or even tens of meters. Stray parameters such as lead inductance and capacitance will have a certain impact on the test results. Therefore, some method must be used to eliminate the influence of the lead. This paper compares the two methods of calculating lead parameters and calibration to test the broadband characteristics of the two-port network, and analyzes the reasons that affect the test results. It's recommended to choose an impedance analyzer with lead calibration to test the effective broadband characteristics of large power equipment. At the same time, try to use the core of the <tex>$50\Omega$</tex> shielded cable as the test lead during the test to properly improve the influence of electromagnetic interference in the external space, and place the lead into a frame, and keep the basic shape of the frame unchanged during calibration and testing.

articleTitle: Cost-Effective Capacitor Voltage Balancing Strategy for MMC with a Prediction-Based and Improved PD-PWM Combined Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Modular multilevel converters face a serious issue in maintaining stable operation due to the sub-module (SM) capacitor voltage imbalance. Both pulse rotation and voltage sorting methods, which are the two widely used techniques for SM capacitor voltage balancing control, have benefits and limitations in terms of implementation and maintenance. A sorting-assisted rotation method was suggested to solve the contradiction between the capacitor voltage balance effect and the converter switching frequency. In this paper, the efficiency and working frequency of the sorting method are optimized to reduce the dependence of the proposed method on hardware and reduce the burden on the controller. The proposed approach is efficient and reliable, as demonstrated by simulation and experimental findings.

articleTitle: Traceability of power quality anomalies in distributed PV and energy storage power plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The distributed photovoltaic energy storage power station has many sites and covers a wide area. The operation and maintenance personnel of the power station need to further investigate the cause of the abnormality according to the abnormal alarm of the power quality of the monitoring system, which is difficult and time-consuming. By analyzing the mechanism of power quality anomalies in photovoltaic power plants, based on the instantaneous electrical signal sampling at the grid point, an online power quality anomaly traceability method is proposed, including feature extraction, feature selection and power quality anomaly type diagnosis. The method uses the combination of wavelet packet energy entropy and range normalization to extract sample data features, and uses principal component analysis to select fault features. The obtained fault feature vector is used as the input of the improved AdaBoost- SAMME algorithm to diagnose the corresponding power quality anomaly causes. The experimental results show that the method can accurately and quickly trace the cause of power quality anomalies, achieve fault location, and effectively improve the operation and maintenance efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Checking for Anti-short Circuit Ability of 500kV Power Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the crucial device of the power grid, the power transformer is important to ensure the safe and reliable operation of the electric system, which will cause great economic loss and damage of the power system once short-circuit fault happen. Based on the investigation and analysis of accident happened in recent year, more than a third of the power system fault relate to short-circuit of transformers. Given the 500kV power grid has become the backbone of the high voltage power transmission network system, as well as the auto-transformers make up a high proportion of 500kV transformers, it is imperative and indispensable to check and improve the anti-short circuit ability of 500kV transformer. In order to know the checking for anti-short circuit ability of 500kV power transformer profoundly, the rapid computational method of transformer short-circuit current under three kinds of short circuit conditions are deduced in paper including three-phase symmetric short-circuit faults, single phase short-circuit faults and two-phase short-circuit faults. Combined with the analysis of winding leakage magnetic field and short-circuit force, Comparison Research on short-circuit impact of 500kV power transformer is carried out. According to the result of analysis, it turns out the anti-short circuit ability of example transformer is insufficient, and need to take relevant measures. Besides, some relevant measures are put forward to enhance the anti-short circuit ability of the on-line transformers to provide the reference for daily maintenance of transformer.

articleTitle: V2G Dynamic Tariff Strategy Based On Multiple Games
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The increasing number of electric vehicles (EVs) brings about a huge impact on the safe and stable operation of the power system because of increasing random charging load demands. But a large number of on-board batteries can become an important resource for the ancillary service of power system if proper demand response technology is adopted. In this paper, for the scenario of peak-shaving and valley-filling of power system ancillary service, an electricity price mechanism is proposed to guide the orderly charging and discharging of EVs, aiming at the income balance of the power grid (PG), EV users, and electric vehicle aggregator (EVA). By the proposed method, firstly, an evolutionary game model is proposed to obtain the charge and discharge price range of EVs. Secondly, using the price range above and the cooperative game theory, the dynamic charging and discharging electricity price of EVs (here named as V2G price) are determined with equal distribution of the interests among the three parties. Finally, taking 10,000 EVs participating in peak-shaving and valley-filling as an example, the economy of dispatching EVs by the proposed method is compared with that by the traditional time-of-use electricity price model. The simulation results show that the V2G electricity price strategy proposed in this paper can reduce the peak-to-valley difference of the PG and keep the income of the PG, EV and EVA more balanced.

articleTitle: Investigation of activation energy for aged epoxy resin insulators in GIS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Gas insulated switchgear (GIS) is widely used in power systems, in which the basin insulator as the main solid insulation component fails under the action of long time electrothermal stress. The aging degradation of basin insulators is a slow chemical reaction process. Therefore, the activation energy method can be used to effectively evaluate the aging state. In this paper, the activation energy calculated by the thermal analysis and temperature-frequency dielectric spectroscopy methods are analyzed. The activation energy of epoxy resin used for basin insulators after electrothermal aging is analyzed using temperature-frequency dielectric spectroscopy. The results show that the activation energy obtained by thermal analysis is larger. The activation energy of materials after electrothermal aging increases with the aging time. The electric field accelerates the aging process of materials. The above studies show that the thermo-frequency dielectric spectroscopy method is simple to operate without material damage. It can also effectively estimate the degree of material aging, which is more suitable for online detection of basin insulators.

articleTitle: Plasma drying effect and quality evaluation of fresh Codonopsis pilosula slices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the high sugar and water content of freshly harvested herbs, they are easily affected by pests and mildew. Therefore, timely drying of herbs after harvesting is a key aspect to ensure the quality of herbs. With the improvement of living standards, the drying of herbal slices (especially mid- and high-end herbs) is in urgent need of new drying technologies with high retention rate of medicinal ingredients and long shelf life. Plasma is considered as a non-thermal drying technology with great potential to retain active medicinal components to a greater extent. In this paper, we used plasma technology to dry the slices of fresh Codonopsis pilosula as the research object. We investigated the effects of discharge gap, slice thickness and oblique cutting angle on the drying process of codonopsis slices. The differences in color between natural dried codonopsis and plasma dried codonopsis were also compared and analyzed, and the content of lobetyolin in codonopsis was determined by high performance liquid chromatography (HPLC). The results showed that different discharge gap, slice thickness and oblique cutting angle would affect the drying process of codonopsis slices. The color analysis showed that the plasma-dried codonopsis slices were lighter in color and did not undergo significant browning compared with natural dried. HPLC analysis showed that plasma-dried codonopsis contained about three times higher lobetyolin than natural dried ones. In conclusion, plasma technology performed well in drying codonopsis slices.

articleTitle: Research on a Leg Multiplexed Low-switch-ripple Bidirectional AC/DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a leg multiplexed low-switch-ripple bidirectional AC/DC converter topology. The converter uses the principle of switch multiplexing to achieve a small number of power-switches bidirectional AC/DC topology, and the composite leg current is actually reduced, reducing the power loss. Then, the coupled inductance and carrier phase shift are used to extract, alias and frequency doubling of the circuit ripple to reduce the switching ripple current. Finally, the converter is applied to the single-phase 220V terminal grid for grid-connected control. The simulation results show that the leg multiplexed low-switch-ripple bidirectional AC/DC converter proposed in this paper can realize bidirectional power flow, effectively reduce the switching ripple, provide stable and high-quality power supply to the load, and can be well applied to the single-phase 220V terminal power grid.

articleTitle: Harmonic Resonance Characteristics Analysis of Train-Network Compling System Considering full modeling of AC-DC-AC Traction Drive System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the electrified railway, harmonic resonance may occur in the train-traction network coupling system, which seriously affects the safe and stable operation of the train-network system. However, at present, the research on harmonic resonance phenomenon of the vehicle-grid coupling system mostly focuses on the impedance characteristics of the grid-side rectifier, while the resistance equivalence is adopted for the inverter and traction motor, which lacks the influence of the traction motor parameters on the harmonic resonance of the system. In this paper, the harmonic resonance phenomenon of electrified railway system are studied considering full system of AC-DC-AC traction drive. Firstly, the train-network coupling system is modeled with the consideration of the motor, and the train operation mechanism is analyzed. Then the harmonic resonance frequency of the vehicle-grid coupling system are analyzed according to the mathematical model. Finally, the simulation verifies the theoretical model analysis results. The results show that the model considering the full modeling of the AC-DC-AC traction drive system can accurately analyze the harmonic resonance characteristics of the vehicle-network coupling system, and provide ideas for reducing the resonance hazard.

articleTitle: Effect of contamination particle size on surface charge dissipation rate of plasma-treated silicone rubber
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The study of plasma penetration in porous materials is very important for its application. In this paper, contaminated silicone rubber is used as the experimental samples while the surface kaolin layer on it is used to simulate the porous inorganic layer. The process of plasma treatment on the contaminated silicone rubber is decomposed into the process of plasma penetrating the porous inorganic layer on the surface and the interaction between the penetrated high-energy particles with the surface of silicone rubber. In the light of the fact that the surface charge dissipation characteristics are very sensitive to plasma treatment, the surface charge dissipation characteristics of silicone rubber are used to study the plasma penetration behavior. The results show that the plasma can indeed penetrate the porous inorganic layer on the surface of the contaminated silicone rubber and treat the surface of experimental samples, which shallows the surface charge trap and accelerates the surface charge dissipation rate. Furthermore, the surface charge dissipation curve of silicone rubber is approximately a double exponential curve through data fitting, which confirms the theory that the charge trap on the surface of silicone rubber can approximately be described as one deep charge trap and one shallow charge trap. Concerned the properties of surface porous inorganic contamination, the results show that the larger the particle size of the porous inorganic contamination materials, the larger the pore diameter of the corresponding contamination layer, which enhances the the plasma penetration effect. Meanwhile, the smaller the contamination density, the shorter the distance for the plasma penetration which also benefit to plasma penetration process. Additionally, The higher the voltage and frequency of AC plasma source, the more high-energy particles the plasma contains, and the stronger its penetration in the porous inorganic contamination layer.

articleTitle: Analytic Prediction Method of Magnetic Properties Considering Skin Effect Based on Maxwell's Equation and Fractional Order Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As one of the basic studies on magnetic materials, accurate prediction of the materials' magnetic properties has important guiding significance for electrical equipment design. This paper proposes an analytic method combining Maxwell's equation with a fractional order method to predict the hysteresis loop at high frequency. Firstly., based on Maxwell's equation., an analytical approach presenting the average magnetic flux density as a variable is proposed to predict the eddy current magnetic field strength. Then, according to the fractional order method., a comprehensive approach is proposed to describe the materials' static hysteresis characteristics and excess effects under the non-uniform distribution of magnetic flux density inside the strip. Finally, an analytic method is established under the equivalent field separation technique to predict the materials' hysteresis loop at high frequencies. Compared with the classical method, the prediction accuracy of the proposed method is improved by 42.2%.

articleTitle: Research on the cooperative interaction strategy of electric vehicle network based on price signal guidance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As an important electric energy replacement carrier in transportation, electric vehicles play an important role in energy saving and emission reduction, environmental protection, while the flexibility of electric vehicle charging load makes them a potential regulating resource in the power system. This paper focuses on the cooperative interaction strategy between electric vehicle and power grid guided by price signals, which takes the minimization of user and comprehensive electricity cost as the objective function, considers both the load bearing capacity constraint and charging capacity constraint of the distribution system, and flexibly adjusts the charging plan according to the price signals, taking into account the charging demand of users and the adjustment response demand of the grid. In the paper, a typical case study is analyzed to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the above method.

articleTitle: Research and application of key technologies of full secondary equipment protection in power monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Focusing on the three major problems of the weak network security protection system of the traditional power monitoring system, the untimely perception of security threat monitoring, and the insufficient ability to trace the source of abnormal attacks, this paper combines the development needs of the new power system and the actual operation of Xinjiang power grid to improve the three-dimensional security protection technology of the power monitoring system from three aspects: full asset three-dimensional security protection, real-time monitoring of multi-source heterogeneous equipment, and multi link tracing of network attacks, The real-time monitoring response capability of multi-source equipment, the traceability and blocking capability of network attack multi link tracing, comprehensively improve the real-time monitoring, accurate traceability and blocking, and defense in depth capabilities of the power monitoring system, and ensure the safe and stable operation of the power grid through theoretical algorithm attack, intelligent tool development, and large-scale promotion and application.

articleTitle: Cooperative Control Strategy of Triple Redundant Motor Based on Virtual Impedance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The motor for electromechanical actuator has high reliability requirements. This paper studies a triple redundancy permanent magnet synchronous motor with winding redundancy structure. However, the triple redundancy system has the problem of asymmetric channel parameters, which leads to unbalanced winding phase current and affects the reliability of the triple redundancy permanent magnet synchronous motor. In this paper, the possible consequences of parameter asymmetry are analyzed. Aiming at the problem of stator current imbalance caused by parameter asymmetry, a cooperative control strategy based on virtual impedance is proposed. The control strategy compensates the parameters through the virtual impedance adjustment module, which can reduce or even eliminate the parameter asymmetry and realize the balanced control of the winding phase current. At the same time, a Simulink model is built to verify the effectiveness of the control algorithm. Finally, the hardware drive platform and software control algorithm based on YXSpace 2000 semi-physical simulator are built for experimental verification.

Author Keywords: triple redundancy permanent magnet synchronous motor

articleTitle: Effect of Repetitive Square Voltage on Conventional Stress Grading System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An inverter-fed motor operating above 6 kV driven by the pulse width modulation (PWM) voltage will experience severe electrical and thermal stress. Thus, it is important for insulation designers to study the temperature rise and potential distribution of conventional stress grading system, which comprises main wall insulation, conductive armor tape (CAT) and stress grading tape (SGT) under the repetitive square voltage. Here, two types of stress grading system are designed and optimized, and several experiments and simulations are performed. The rise time of the repetitive square voltage is found to have a significant impact on the temperature rise of the stress grading system. With an increase in dv/dt, the temperature rise of the stress grading system also increases. The capacitive reactance of the main wall insulation decreases, thereby increasing the power loss of the CAT and SGT. Further, an increase in the frequency leads to an increase in the power loss of the stress grading system, and the lower the surface resistance, the lower is the temperature rise. The results of the simulation model are found to be in good agreement with the experimental results, thus verifying the design of the stress grading system. The results of this study are expected to provide an experimental and theoretical basis for the design of stress grading system operating under PWM voltage.

articleTitle: Sensorless Vector Control of Six Phase Fault-Tolerant Permanent Magnet Rim-Driven Motor using Sliding Mode Observer with NFCPLL Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Successful acquisition of smooth and stable position estimation is a great challenge for sensorless six phase fault- tolerant Permanent Magnet Rim-Driven Motor (FTPM-RDM), especially in fault conditions. Combined with the characteristics of the structure and control system, an improved sensorless position estimation method that based on sliding mode observer and current vector fault-tolerant control strategy under healthy and faulty conditions are presented for FTPM-RDM. The Second-Order General Integrator (SOGI) bandpass filter is used to improve the chattering resistance of back electromotive force (EMF) instead of the traditional LPF in SMO. A normalized phase-locked loop with feedforward compensation (NFCPLL) is introduced to solve the rotor position delay problem caused by steady-state error. Experiments are conducted to verify the validation of the proposed estimation algorithm under both normal and failure conditions.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Design of 12/14 Conical Bearingless Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A novel 12/14 conical bearingless switched reluctance motor is designed for the problem that the torque and suspending force control of conventional BSRM are coupled with each other and cannot control the axial suspending force. First., the structure and principle of the conical bearingless switched reluctance motor are introduced., and the main dimensions of the 12/14 BSRM are calculated with reference to the design method of the conventional SRM. Then the size of the conical motor is determined by increasing the cone angle., etc. on the basis of the 12/14 column BSRM. Three structures based on the large end of the rotor., the small end of the rotor and the middle section of the rotor are proposed to explore the effect of the cone angle on the motor performance with the same excitation current and magnetic saturation., respectively., to determine the final size of the motor from the consideration of the performance and the difficulty of machining. Finally., the effectiveness of the designed motor is verified by analyzing the inductance., torque., suspending force and coupling characteristics of the motor.

articleTitle: Influence of Voltage Waveform and Duty Cycle on Solid Insulation Strength in High Frequency Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-Frequency Transformers (HFTs) are subjected to different types of voltage stress, including DC or AC grid voltage and high-frequency square wave voltage. As the demand for higher voltage ratings and greater compactness of HFTs continues to rise, the insulation strength of resin cast solid insulation becomes a crucial factor in the insulation design of HFTs. This study investigated the difference in breakdown voltage (BDV) under various voltage types, obtained the BDV of specimens with different installation polarity, and analyzed the influence of duty cycle for unipolar square wave. Additionally, the dynamic behavior of space charge was explained using a 2D axisymmetric bipolar charge transport (BCT) model. The results showed that the BDV is primarily determined by the peak-to-peak field for AC voltages. The unblocked carrier injection in the insulation causes a reduced BDV for AC voltage compared to DC voltage. Furthermore, long-term space charge accumulation has a negative impact on insulation strength under unipolar square wave, as it encourages the enhancement of local current on the electrode. The BDV was observed to reach its maximum value at a duty cycle of 10% for unipolar voltage, due to the balance between the barrier effect and the current enhancement effect of space charge.

articleTitle: An optimal scheduling strategy for an integrated energy system considering user-side electricity and hydrogen demand response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of increasing the total operation cost and load difference between peaks and valleys due to the low participation of users in energy dispatching in the current integrated energy system, this paper proposes an optimal scheduling strategy for integrated energy system considering the user-side electricity and hydrogen demand response. The user-side demand response electricity and hydrogen load is divided into translational, transferable and reducible loads according to load types, and participating in dispatching respectively. The compensation of demand response is converted into the operation cost of the comprehensive energy system. Finally, a comprehensive energy system economic scheduling model with the minimum total operation cost as the goal was established. Cplex was used to solve the calculation example, and the optimization results of demand response electricity and hydrogen load participating in scheduling were obtained under three scenarios. The simulation results show that the electricity and hydrogen coupling scheduling and the interaction between the electric and hydrogen loads in demand response can significantly reduce the operating cost of the system and reduce the peak-valley load difference.

articleTitle: Feature-Based Decision Tree Classification Method for Hot Spot Faults of Photovoltaic Modules
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The hot spot fault of photovoltaic modules seriously affects the power generation efficiency and safe operation of photovoltaic power stations, which is an urgent problem to be solved in the photovoltaic operation and maintenance. In this paper, a feature-based decision tree classification method for hot spot fault of photovoltaic modules is proposed, which extracts the geometric features of the hot spot target areas in the infrared thermal image of photovoltaic modules, then combines the decision tree classification algorithm to divide hot spot faults into two categories: external occlusion faults and internal defect faults, so as to provide a basis for photovoltaic operation and maintenance. MATLAB Simulation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Impedance Modeling and Analysis for Grid-Connected Converter Based on Hybrid Synchronization Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent, hybrid synchronization control (HYBSC) that combines the grid-forming control and the grid-following control is regarded to be able to provide both efficient power control and voltage/frequency support. In this paper, the grid-connected three-phase converter based on HYBSC is studied, and the harmonic linearization method is used to establish the small-signal impedance model, which considers the frequency coupling effects. Then, the validity of the theoretical impedance model is verified by time-domain simulation based on MATLAB/Simulink. Finally, the impedance characteristics of the converter with HYBSC are compared with the converter based on conventional grid-following current control (GFCC).

articleTitle: Fault Line Selection of Low Current Grounding Based on LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the basic principles of LSTM neural networks and applies LSTM neural networks to low-current ground fault selection. The small current ground fault model is constructed by Simulink simulation software, and the relevant data of the fundamental feature component, the fifth harmonic feature component and the wavelet energy feature component are obtained, and the LSTM neural network is trained, which verifies the accuracy and feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Study on The Operation Strategy of Electrochemical Energy Storage Station with Calculation and Efficiency Conversion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To achieve a more economical and stable operation, the power output operation strategy of the electrochemical energy storage plant is studied because of the characteristics of the fluctuation of the operation efficiency in the long time scale. Second, an optimized operation strategy for an electrochemical energy storage station is presented based on the proposed efficiency transformation model. The energy storage station's economic efficiency and load-smoothing effect are studied. Finally, the proposed optimization strategy and operation indexes are verified by calculation and simulation comparison with an example of an energy storage station in Guangdong. The results show that the proposed operation strategy of electrochemical energy storage station has an excellent technical economy.

articleTitle: Research on the Comparison of two Generator Systems with Multiple Power Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Conventional generator system with multiple power sources mostly uses one converter to control one input power source and all the converters are in parallel on the bus finally. This structure makes the control of the power source independently and without interference. However, the number of converters is redundant which reduces the system integrity and stability. This paper compares the system with an open-winding hybrid excitation generator system comprehensively. The voltage and power equation are deduced in the paper. And the speed range, load range, switch number and withstand voltage the system needs is analyzed by the mathematical model. It provides the theory basis for the application of the two systems in different occasions of multiple power sources system.

articleTitle: Grid-Forming Energy Storage In Fast Frequency Regulation Of Renewable Micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This proposed a fast frequency regulation method for renewable micro-grid based on grid-forming energy storage (GFM-ES). Firstly, the main circuit and control system of grid-forming energy storage is introduced. Then, with the case study presented in this paper, the function of GFM-ES in suppression of frequency change rate and frequency nadir is validated with a time-domain simulation, which are the critical index and dominate the security of micro-grid.

articleTitle: A Bi-directional LLC Topology with Symmetrical Gain and Anti-DC Bias Ability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Bi-directional LLC resonant converters play a key role in many critical applications, such as on-board charger, energy storage system. How to guarantee a symmetrical gain while enabling anti-dc bias ability with minimum cost is a major concern. In this paper, a new bi-directional LLC topology is proposed to address the above issue. A switch-controlled auxiliary magnetic inductor branch is added at primary side to have the exact bi-directional voltage gain. Another small inductor is added at secondary side, whose current is easily measured, to control the anti-dc bias. The operation principle, design consideration, and anti-dc bias control strategy are given in this paper. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by hardware-in-loop test.

articleTitle: Study on Impedance Characteristics and Detection Methods of Lithium-ion Battery Overcharge and Over Discharge Based on Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: There are inconsistencies among lithium-ion batteries, and the phenomenon of overcharge and over discharge will occur in the process of module charging and discharging, which will bring harm to the whole module battery. In order to accurately detect the overcharge and over discharge of a single battery, this paper studied the batteries in different states based on electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS), and proposed a method for the detection of the battery's overcharge and over discharge states. The experimental results show that both overcharge and over discharge accelerate the aging speed of the battery. By comparing the EIS data of the batteries, the equivalent circuit model was established by ZSimp Win fitting software, and the detection model was established by CPE1-n and CPE2- YO parameters. The reliability of the model was proved by experiments. This paper proves that EIS has a good ability to characterize battery overcharge and over discharge, which can provide a reference for the accurate detection of battery overcharge and over discharge, and improve the safety of batteries.

articleTitle: A Fault-tolerant Control Method for Integrated On-board Charging System Considering Static Electromagnetic Torque
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When open-phase fault (OPF) occurs during AC charging in the integrated on-board charging system, its fault-tolerant control is indispensable. Besides, static electromagnetic torque is generated during AC charging in integrated on-board charging systems, which in turn leads to vibration and noise problems. To solve the problems, a fault-tolerant control method considering static electromagnetic torque is proposed in this paper. Based on the asymmetric compensated current injection strategy, fault-tolerant control considering static electromagnetic torque is achieved in the integrated on-board charging system comprising a dual three-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor (DTPMSM). In this paper, via phase current regulation, zero q-axis current is achieved. Hereby the fault-tolerant control manages to come with the suppression of the static electromagnetic torque. The vibration of the rotor near the initial position is also inhibited. For the evaluation of the feasibility of the method presented, the comparison of the simulation results of the integrated charging system without or with the proposed strategy is given. Using the proposed fault-tolerant control method, 84.79% of the static electromagnetic torque is suppressed.

Author Keywords: dual three-phase permanent magnetic synchronized motor (DTPMSM)

articleTitle: Look-Ahead AC Optimal Power Flow: A Model-Informed Reinforcement Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of renewable energy in the generation side, it becomes more difficult to accurately predict the power generation and adapt to the large deviations between the optimal dispatch scheme and the day-ahead scheduling in the process of real-time dispatch. Therefore, it is necessary to conduct look-ahead dispatches to revise the operation plan according to the real-time status of the power grid and reliable ultra-short-term prediction. Application of traditional model-driven methods is often limited by the scale of the power system and cannot meet the computational time requirements of real-time dispatch. Data-driven methods can provide strong online decision-making support abilities when facing large-scale systems, while it is limited by the quantity and quality of the training dataset. This paper proposes a model-informed reinforcement learning approach for look-ahead AC optimal power flow. The reinforcement learning model is first formulated based on the domain knowledge of economic dispatch, and then the physics-informed neural network is constructed to enhance the reliability and efficiency. At last, the case study based on the SG 126-bus system validates the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Transient Thermal Impedance Measurement of HPD Power Modules
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: HybridPACK Drive (HPD) power modules, which exhibit high power density and high reliability, have gained significant traction in the realm of electric vehicles. In order to evaluate thermal performance of the device, transient thermal impedance of HPD power modules holds great significance.
