This study focuses on HPD power IGBT modules, with the objective of examining transient thermal impedance measurement results under various test conditions through multiple sets of experiments, encompassing cooling liquid flow, heating methods, measurement terminals, inlet temperature, and liquid types. It is demonstrated that cooling liquid flow and types of liquids do not significantly impact the junction-to-baseplate thermal resistance, while the baseplate-to-liquid and steady-state thermal resistance are affected. When heating the upper and lower switches of the same phase simultaneously, the observed results are greater than those under other conditions, as a result of thermal coupling. In addition, it is indicated that inlet temperature has minimal influence on the measurement results. Finally, the utilization of sensor terminals is necessary for measuring voltage, while load terminals are not recommended due to potential interference from external wires.

articleTitle: Speed-Sensorless Control of Induction Motor Based on Current Error Weighting Speed-Adaptive Law
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Adaptive full-order observer is widely used for speed-sensorless control of induction motors. However, it is unstable at low speed. To address this problem, this paper proposes an improved speed-adaptive law and introduces a feedback gain matrix into the system with improved speed-adaptive law. The improved speed-adaptive law is obtained by local linearization of the rotor flux distribution on the estimated rotating coordinate system. This method can improve the observation accuracy of speed. Furthermore, the introduction of the feedback gain matrix can make the poles of the observer far away from the imaginary axis and increase the dynamic performance of the system. Comparative study shows that the proposed method has better stability. The simulation results verify the effectiveness and feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Research on software and hardware resource configuration of relay protection device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The current relay protection resource configuration system has the following disadvantages: complex interface operation, low serial development efficiency and imperfect function. This paper provides a user-friendly interface, a parallel development mode of software and hardware, and a design scheme of complete configuration function. The system provides a simple and easy to understand visual interface, which can ensure that users can quickly, correctly and friendly complete the configuration of software and hardware resource files of relay protection devices. The system provides a solution to separate software features from hardware features, which can promote the improvement of development efficiency. The system supports the resource configuration of each link of relay protection, such as hardware feature configuration, software feature configuration, protection logic view configuration and overall configuration of each module. The practice results show that the system will greatly improve the development efficiency of resource configuration file, shorten the development cycle, reduce the development labor cost and reduce the maintenance cost of resource file. At the same time, the system is suitable for developing and using relay protection device resource configuration files for all levels of power users.

articleTitle: Research on Circulation Current of Sheath and Armor of Single-core Submarine Cable Based on Impedance Matrix Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The circulation current of sheath and armor of single-core submarine cable are important factors affecting its safe operation. In this paper, the impedance matrix model of single-core submarine cable is established for the insulation damage fault caused by heating at the grounding position of a 220kV submarine cable in a wind farm. Using the electromagnetic transient analysis software ATP-EMTP, the effects of resistivity and permeability on impedance matrix and circulating current were analyzed. Through the analysis, the cause of damage accident was found and suggestions were made for the operation and maintenance of the submarine cable.

articleTitle: Residential Load Response Potential Estimation Method Based on Mechanism and Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High penetration of renewable energy resources poses technical and economic challenges to system operation. Utilizing demand response (DR) to provide regulation power to the system is both low-carbon and economic. Therefore, an accurate response potential estimation method for loads is necessary for DR. Residential loads have great regulation potential, but the distribution of loads is scattered, which increases the difficulty of load response potential estimation. Therefore, this paper both analyzes the mechanism and data perspectives to decrease the estimation difficulty and increase estimation accuracy. Firstly, the aggregated power of loads is derived. Then, the response potential of loads is estimated based on mechanism analysis considering several factors. Finally, a novel estimation algorithm is presented through dividing the estimation of the overall loads into several independent groups, in which data analysis is adopted to obtain the characteristics of parameter distribution. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed response potential estimation method.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Space Charge Accumulation Characteristics in XLPE under DC Electric Field Based on Laser Vibration Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Space charge effect of polymer has always been the focus of attention in the field of high voltage cable insulation. However, with the wide application of polymer in extreme ambient temperatures such as aerospace and deep sea, it is difficult to realize the space charge measurement under the condition of extreme temperatures by traditional space charge measurement methods. In order to explore the application of laser vibration measurement in the field of space charge measurement, based on the electro-acoustic conversion principle of PEA method, this paper adopted laser Doppler vibration measurement instead of piezoelectric detection, and conducted space charge measurement and electrode surface vibration test under 5-50kV/mm DC field for degassed 48h cross-linked polyethylene, and the characteristics of charge accumulation threshold were evaluated based on the vibration velocity signal. The results of space charge response showed that the average bulk charge density characteristic <tex>$\rho_{\text{absolute}},\rho_{+}$</tex> and <tex>$\rho$</tex> - all showed a three-stage distribution with electric field, and the corresponding charge injection threshold field <tex>$E_{1}$</tex> and charge recombination field <tex>$E_{2}$</tex> were 15.77kV/mm and 30.44kV/mm, respectively. The results of electrode vibration test showed that <tex>$\varphi_{1\text{MHz}}^{\prime}$</tex> also presented a three-stage distribution with electric field, and the switching electric fields <tex>$E_{\varphi 1},E_{\varphi 2}$</tex> were in good agreement with <tex>$E_{1}$</tex> and <tex>$E_{2}$</tex>. In order to ensure the evaluation accuracy of <tex>$\varphi_{1\text{MHz}}^{\prime}$</tex> for the space charge threshold field, <tex>$\varphi_{\max}$</tex> was generally set at about 20°, and the appropriate AC excitation frequency can be selected according to the thickness of the sample. This paper can provide theoretical reference and experimental support for polymer space charge measurement and charge accumulation evaluation.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of pile expansion by shock wave of metal wire explosion in liquids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Construction of specially shaped pile foundations by compacting the soil around the borehole with shock waves, which can effectively increase the load-bearing capacity of the pile material. The metal wire explosion in liquid has the advantages of high energy efficiency, good repeatability and controllability. The strong shock wave generated by the explosion can compress the soil to enlarge the size of pile foundations and construct shaped pile foundations, which has industrial prospects. In order to analyze the mechanism of pile expansion by metal wire explosion in liquid, a test platform was established, and parameters such as discharge voltage, current and energy were obtained. Based on the dynamic analysis software Ls-dyna, a two-dimensional simulation model of the shock wave generated by explosion in liquid acting on the soil was established, and the material parameters and model dimensions were reasonably determined. The propagation and attenuation processes of shock waves in cement slurry and soil were numerically simulated. The cumulative effect of pile foundation expansion under the action of multiple shock waves was analyzed, and compared with the test results.

articleTitle: Study on neuron firing behavior of improved Hybrid neuron model based on memristor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The highly isospectral abnormal firing of neurons in the central nervous system is the cause of some neuropathy, which is related to the internal magnetic field of neurons. This paper studies the firing behaviors of a modified memristor Hybrid neuron model considering the influence of electromagnetic induction. Firstly, a state equation for the improved Hybrid neuron model with local active memristor autapse is proposed and and its equilibrium points stability is analyzed; Secondly, normal and abnormal firing behaviors of neurons can be simulated by changing the polarity of electromagnetic feedback, external input parameters, thus exploring the inducement of neuropathy, which provides a reference for clinical diagnosis and treatment of neurological diseases. Finally, circuit simulation is implemented in PSIM and Multisim.

articleTitle: A Novel Direct Control of Torque and Levitation Force Ripple for Bearingless Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An improved direct instantaneous torque control (DITC) strategy is proposed in this study for the 12/4 bearingless switched reluctance motor (BSRM), which employs a new commutation method to address the torque ripple issue caused by the switching of phases. The proposed strategy can effectively reduce torque ripple. In addition, two control modes are used to decrease torque ripple, which are based on partitioned control mode analysis. Each region is analyzed by using motor inductance characteristics. The turn-on and turn-off angles are adjusted by calculating the torque error. By utilizing this strategy, the torque current ratio is improved, and the torque ripple is decreased. Finally, a serious of simulations are conducted to demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Electrical highway power supply system and stability analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electrical highway based on overhead lines can reduce air pollution, achieve zero emissions, reduce dependence on fossil energy, realize braking energy recovery, and improve transportation efficiency. It is an ideal mode of transportation. In this paper, the basic electrical structure of the overhead line scheme is proposed, which mainly includes traction substation, catenary and vehicle load. The impedance model of each part is established, and the stability of the system is analyzed based on impedance matching.

articleTitle: Study on Characteristics and Voltage Regulation of Emergency Diesel Generator in Nuclear Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the external characteristics of the generator are studied, and the voltage characteristics of an emergency diesel generator are analyzed. According to the operation characteristics of an emergency diesel generator in a nuclear power plant, the relationship between the transfer function parameters of the generator excitation system and the regulation characteristics is analyzed, which shows and verifies that the emergency diesel generator is in operation.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic interference complexity evaluation method based on optimal adaptive S-transform time-frequency space model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the S-transform in the electromagnetic environment assessment process there are problems such as the amplitude varies monotonically with frequency leading to imprecise extraction of energy occupancy assessment parameters. This paper proposes a method of electromagnetic interference complexity assessment based on the optimal adaptive S-transform (OAST) time-frequency space model. The flexible adjustment of the window width of the S-transform window function is achieved by introducing adaptive parameters, so as to suppress the large migration of the amplitude characteristics with the signal frequency. The OAST time-frequency spatial evaluation model is derived and established; the evaluation criteria of the complexity based on the OAST time-frequency spatial model are analyzed and determined, overcoming the limitations of the independent grading of the traditional electromagnetic interference complexity evaluation parameters. Simulation and experimental results show that OAST can accurately extract the time-frequency energy occupation parameters and the feature parameters in the time-frequency domain are more accurate; the OAST time-frequency spatial model can evaluate the signal complexity level more accurately, and the evaluation experiments verify the correctness of the proposed method in this paper.

articleTitle: Study on the Electromagnetic Characteristics of two Different Types of Partial Discharge at the Initial Stage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the realm of partial discharge (PD), the emission of an electromagnetic wave signal can be observed. Detecting this signal is crucial to ascertain the occurrence of partial discharge. However, during the early stages, the electromagnetic wave signal is feeble, and it can be submerged by other interference electromagnetic waves. To address this challenge, surface and tip discharge models are employed to measure the frequency of the electromagnetic wave signal during the initial stages of partial discharge. Notably, the frequency centers of the tip discharge signal are 50MHz and 600MHz, whereas the frequency centers of the surface discharge signal are 30MHz and 800MHz. Based on the primary frequency range of the signal, the selection frequency range of the filter is designed accordingly. Specifically, the tip discharge bandpass is set at 400MHz-800MHz, while the surface discharge bandpass is set at 600MHz-1GHz. The filtered UHF method noise signal can significantly reduce the noise, enabling the identification of PD signal with greater clarity. The research outcomes serve as a foundation for the application of UHF method in PD detection.

articleTitle: Distributed hierarchical coordinated control method for photovoltaic and energy storage DC microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the DC microgrid with multiple photovoltaic and energy storage units, a new distributed hierarchical coordinated control strategy is proposed to improve the power supply reliability of the system. According to the operating state of the microgrid, the photovoltaic unit automatically and smoothly switches the working mode by controlling the voltage signal of the photovoltaic cell. The upper control can also realize the distribution of output power of multiple photovoltaic units and the recovery control of bus voltage. In order to realize the adjustable SOC equalization speed of multiple energy storage units, a power factor containing SOC acceleration equalization factor is added to the upper control. In this paper, through the sparse communication network, the voltage regulation and power regulation control loop based on the consistency algorithm is used to correct the loop reference voltage of the converter, and the reasonable distribution of the power of the multi-photovoltaic energy storage unit and the adjustment of the bus voltage are realized adaptively. The effectiveness of this method is verified by Matlab / Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Dual Four-stage-vector Model Predictive Control for OW-PMSM Drives
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A novel dual four-stage-vector model predictive control (MPC) strategy for open-winding permanent magnet synchronous motor (OW-PMSM) drives is put forward in this article. In each control period, four vectors, including two non-zero vectors and two zero vectors, are applied to the dual-inverter. According to the principle of minimum number of switches, two non-zero vectors are applied in the middle of the control period, while the two zero vectors are distributed at the beginning and the ending of the control period, significantly reducing the control frequency. In addition, two zero vectors of inverter2 (INV2) are optimally distributed to inhibit the flow of zero-sequence current (ZSC). Therefore, the ZSC of the system is well-suppressed. Finally, compared to the conventional strategy, the control performance of the proposed strategy is proved by an experimental platform with a 1.25kW OW-PMSM.

articleTitle: Research on Crosstalk Suppression of Automotive Communication System Based on Long Short-term Memory Prediction Phase Shifter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the high-speed and high-frequency requirements of the communication signals in new energy vehicles, electromagnetic interference is easily generated between the cables, which will lead to the paralysis of the vehicle communication system in severe cases. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a method of inserting a phase shifter in the transmission line, and using the long short-term memory neural network to predict the position and angle of the phase shifter to suppress crosstalk. This method first uses the long short-term memory network to predict the trend of the crosstalk peak data in the transmission line, and then establishes a three-dimensional model of phase shifter parameters and suppression effects, and then selects several groups of parameters with better suppression effects by analyzing the three-dimensional model, and uses long short-term memory The network predicts the frequency of these sets of parameters to find an optimal set of parameters. Finally, use this group of parameters to connect the phase shifter to the transmission line, so as to achieve the effect of suppressing crosstalk. Research shows that the method is simple to implement and can effectively suppress crosstalk.

articleTitle: Initial position identification strategy of permanent magnet synchronous motor based on inductance saturation effect
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In fan, water pump, engine power system and other applications, limited by the use environment and cost, permanent magnet synchronous motor usually adopts sensorless control mode instead of installing position sensor. The mode of open-loop starting and then switch to closed-loop control is adopted. If the initial rotor position of the permanent magnet synchronous motor cannot be accurately obtained, motor reversal and out-of-step will occur during the open-loop starting process, resulting in the final starting failure of the motor. In this paper, according to the application requirements of high-speed electric pump and engine starting controller series products, based on the inductance saturation effect of permanent magnet synchronous motor, six pulses of equal width were injected, and the initial position identification of permanent magnet synchronous motor rotor was realized by detecting the current response. The test results show that the identification accuracy can meet the position-free starting requirement of permanent magnet synchronous motor.

articleTitle: Research on carbon storage monitoring based on 4D active time constrained time-lapse cross-hole resistivity CT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Carbon capture and storage (CCS) technology is a new measure for realizing the Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutralization Strategy of our country. However, stored CO<inf>2</inf> has the risk of leakage, and the leakage of high concentration CO<inf>2</inf> will cause significant harm; therefore, so it is necessary to monitor the migration position of the stored CO<inf>2</inf>. In this study, the monitoring effect of four dimensions active time constrained (4D-ATC) time-lapse cross-hole resistivity CT method, which has excellent dynamic monitoring performance, on the migration position of CO<inf>2</inf> injected into the reservoir was studied. Based on the general migration path of the CO<inf>2</inf> injected into the reservoir and the geoelectric data of the CO<inf>2</inf> SINK test site close to Ketzin (Germany), two geoelectric models of carbon storage were constructed and numerically inversed. The inversion image shows that 4D-ATC time-lapse cross-hole resistivity CT can effectively monitor the migration of CO<inf>2</inf>, and can be used as an effective technology for carbon storage monitoring systems.

articleTitle: CVaR-based wind power consumption strategy in consideration of active loads and depth peak shaving
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of wind power and other new energy in the power system, it is an inevitable trend to improve the flexibility of the power system. In order to improve the flexibility of sources and loads, the depth peak-shaving technology of thermal power units is considered on the source side, and the existing down-regulating reserve space is excavated to improve the utilization rate of wind power. On the demand side, temperature controlled loads and data center loads are considered to relieve the system peak load of wind power. At the same time, the dynamic thermal ratings of transmission lines are considered to make the day-ahead scheduling results more consistent with the actual system operation. To include uncertain wind power, conditional value-at-risk is introduced to quantify the risk of wind power acceptance, and an optimal model of wind power consumption considering adjustable loads and depth peak adjustment of thermal power units is constructed. The revised IEEE 39-bus system is used to validate the proposed model. The results show that participation of controllable loads and thermal power unit peak adjustment can effectively improve the system's wind power acceptance capacity and reduce the operating cost of the system.

articleTitle: Generation of Helium atmospheric pressure plasma jet in different shielding gas and its characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Helium atmospheric pressure plasma jet (APPJ) is generated in shielding gas of air and oxygen. Influences of discharge parameters including the applied voltage, driving frequency, and gas flow rate on the jet characteristics are studied. The results show that the plasma jet can propagate longer in air than in oxygen under the same discharge conditions, but the variation trend of plasma jet length in both shielding gases is basically identical at different operating parameters. Electrical and optical diagnosis show that the device has a good stability, repeatability, controllability and security, to produce the plasma jet that meet the needs for cell treatment under the same operating conditions. This is helpful for refined research of the biological effects of ROS and RNS of plasma jet.

articleTitle: Harmonic Modeling of Nonlinear Home Loads Based on Z-transform Parameter Estimation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To accurately analyze the harmonic characteristics of nonlinear home loads with single-phase uncontrolled rectifier bridge circuit, a harmonic coupled model in the frequency domain is established based on the Z transform parameter estimation method. Firstly, the detailed frequency domain harmonic coupled model of a single-phase uncontrolled rectifier bridge with the resistance and inductance on AC side is derived and established, which can accurately reflect the coupling relationship between harmonic voltages and harmonic currents. Then a parameter estimation method based on the Z-transform method is proposed to estimate the circuit parameters of the nonlinear home load quickly and effectively, which provides accurate circuit parameters for the harmonic coupled model. Finally, under typical voltage conditions, the effectiveness and accuracy of the harmonic coupled model and parameter estimation method are verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Optimization of Quantum Current Beam Modulator Based on Electron Gun
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Producing high-quality and high-stability electron beams is the key to achieve current quantization by using a novel method based on particle accelerator techniques. In this context, a high-quality electron gun is designed to follow-up analysis. To generate a stable electron beam and maintain a good laminar flow, a solenoid coil is chosen to constrain the beam spread in transverse directions after extracted from the gun. For the problem of the fringe magnetic fields induced by the coil, methods of adding shielding and bucking coil are compared and analyzed. Through simulation, the damage of the fringe magnetic field to the quality of the beam extracted by the electron gun can effectively be solved, which shows this study provides a scheme for generating high quality and high stability electron beams.

articleTitle: Fixed Angle Difference Control for Multi-Converter Grid-Connected System to Improve Transient Stability During Grid Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Multi-converter grid-connected system is prone to transient instability under grid faults, due to the complex interaction between voltage source converters (VSCs). However, existing research has primarily focused on analyzing the impact of the interaction on the transient stability of multi-converter grid-connected system, without proposing methods for eliminating the interaction. To fill this gap, the mathematical model of two-converter grid-connected system under grid faults is firstly established. Then, the interaction between VSCs is analyzed, it is found that changing the output angle difference between two phase-locked loops (PLLs) will affect the interaction. Based on it, a transient stability enhancement control method is proposed to eliminate the interaction between two VSCs, by fixing the output angle difference between PLLs. Finally, simulation results validate the theoretical analysis and proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on electromagnetic coupled Theory High-speed Multi-stage Cylinder Linear Launcher
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: According to actual structure of High-speed Multi-stage cylinder linear launcher (HSMCLL), based on electromagnetic field theory, the mathematical model of the launcher is deduced, which considers inter-stage coupling effect. The discharge control strategy of the launcher is proposed. The dynamic performance of the launcher is simulated, and the current of drive coil and speed of armature are presented. Experiment results contrast with simulation results, they are coincidence well. It verifies the validity of the model and provides a new way for the study and implementation of control strategy of this kind of machine.

articleTitle: Research on the Low Voltage Ride- Through Technology for Variable Speed Pump Storage Group based on Rotor-Side Virtual Inductance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the virtual equivalent inductance regulation ability of doubly-fed variable speed pumped storage unit (DFVSPSU), a novel control strategy based on equivalent virtual inductance is proposed in this paper. The dynamic mathematical model of the DFIGM is derived to analyze its transient characteristics under normal conditions and fault conditions. Based on the analysis of the optimal port impedance characteristics satisfying the rotor voltage and current constraints, a low voltage ride-through control strategy with virtual equivalent inductance is proposed. By controlling the rotor side port impedance to an appropriate inductance, the rotor voltage and current constraints could be satisfied at the same time, thus improving the controllable virtual equivalent inductance ability of the DFVSPSU system. In addition, this method can eliminate the electromagnetic torque ripple in the transient process. The effectiveness of the proposed control method is verified by both theoretical analysis and simulation results.

Author Keywords: doubly-fed variable speed pumped storage unit (DFVSPSU)

articleTitle: Analysis of lightning strike characteristics of transmission lines under icing conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The research on lightning damage of transmission lines under icing conditions. It is helpful to the stable operation of transmission lines under extreme climate. Previous papers only analyze the lightning strike and icing separately, do not consider the lightning strike characteristics under the icing condition. The paper through the thickness of the insulator icing data and ATP-EMTP software to simulate the ice transmission line. It is found that with the increase of icing thickness, the lightning withstand level of transmission lines decreases and the trip-out rate increases. The conclusion provides data support for the lightning risk management of transmission lines.

articleTitle: Robust Passivity-Based Control for Grid-Forming Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of grid-connected converter-based renewable power generation systems such as photovoltaic and wind power, their control characteristics pose great challenges to the stable operation of power systems. One of the challenges is that the existing grid-connected converter control usually adopts linear methods, such as proportional-integral (PI) control, which is not sufficiently adaptable under nonlinear variation scenarios such as converter plug-and-play, and could cause new types of stability problems. Existing studies have proposed grid-forming control of converters based on passivity theory. However, due to the nonlinear control delay of the passivity-based controller in practical applications, this may lead to the risk of insufficient stability margin or even instability of the grid-forming converter. In this paper, the D-partition method is used to introduce nonlinear control delay, and a robust passivity-based control for the grid-forming converter is provided. It satisfies multiple performance indexes and obtains the stability region of the control parameter with robustness to system parameter variations and external disturbances. Finally, its effectiveness is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: A Pilot Protection Scheme of flexible DC Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problems of flexible DC line protection, A backup protection principle for flexible DC transmission lines based on the direction of low-frequency reactive power is proposed in this paper. First of all, DC reactive power is used to characterize the frequency characteristics of line distribution parameters. Subsequently, the direction of the faulty DC low-frequency reactive power is used to identify internal and external faults. The simulation results show that the proposed protection principle is not affected by distributed capacitance current, does not require strict communication synchronization, and has a strong ability to withstand fault resistance and noise interference.

articleTitle: Analysis of the temperature rise at the primary contact end of current transformers at different wind speeds
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Excessive contact resistance at the primary end of the current transformer is the main cause of abnormal temperature rise, and the effect of contact resistance on the primary end temperature varies at different ambient wind speeds. This paper uses the finite element simulation method to establish a three-dimensional model of the current transformer and carry out thermal-electrical bi-directional coupling calculations. Finally, taking the current transformer model LB7-110W3 as an example, the mapping relationship between primary end temperature and contact resistance under different wind speed conditions is obtained to provide reference for maintenance personnel's decision making.

articleTitle: Simulation and Comparative study on Cooling Performance of Thrust Bearing Cooled by Heat Pipe
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The thrust bearing of vertical hydro-generator unit bears the weight and axial load of the rotating part. During the operation, oil film friction will generate a lot of heat. A good cooling method and heat dissipation structure are the keys to ensure its safe and stable operation. In this paper, the thrust bearing of a generator set of a pumped storage power station in China is taken as the research object, and the cooling performance of the existing cooling form is analyzed through the simulation method of conjugate heat transfer. On this basis, two heat pipe cooling schemes and a flat micro heat pipe array cooling scheme were innovatively designed, and their cooling characteristics were compared and analyzed. The results show that the performance of the flat plate micro heat pipe array cooling scheme is better, which can significantly improve the temperature distribution uniformity on the basis of reducing the temperature of the thrust bearing pad, which provides a reference for the design of the thrust bearing cooling structure of the vertical hydro-generator set in actual engineering.

articleTitle: Calculation of theoretical line losses in PV stations containing distributed PV based on the modified equivalent resistance method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The large-scale access of distributed PV changes the structure and tidal distribution of the traditional distribution network, which makes it difficult to adapt the traditional theoretical line loss calculation method to the new power system. Firstly, the distributed PV power model is established, secondly, the three-phase imbalance in low-voltage station area is considered and the correction amount of three-phase imbalance is added, and finally, based on the traditional equal resistance method, a modified equal resistance method considering the three-phase imbalance in low-voltage station area with distributed PV is proposed. By calculating the theoretical line loss of an actual station area containing distributed PV, the modified iso-resistance method is compared with the traditional iso-resistance method and the forward back generation method to prove the accuracy of the modified iso-resistance method.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis and Design for Three-phase Y-Y Fixed-Frequency Bidirectional CLLC Resonant Converter with Synchronous PWM Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The frequency modulation is usually employed in the three-phase Y - Y type CLLC isolated bidirectional DC/DC resonant converter (CLLC-IBDC). However, the magnetic components and control loop design are complex when the output voltage and load vary over a wide range. To address this problem, the operation characteristics of the three-phase Y - Y-type CLLC-IBDC based on fixed-frequency synchronous PWM modulation are studied in this paper, and a parametric design method is further proposed to achieve ZVS (Zero Voltage Switching) over the full input voltage range. Firstly, the voltage gain and soft switching of the converter are analyzed based on the equivalent model, and the design principles of the resonant network parameters are obtained. Then a resonant parameter design method is proposed to achieve ZVS over the full voltage range. Finally, a 1.5kW experimental prototype is developed, and the experimental results verified the correctness of the characteristic analysis and the validity of the design method.

articleTitle: Optimization on Converter Control Performance of Urban Rail Transit Wayside Supercapacitor Energy Storage System Based on ADRC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, wayside supercapacitor energy storage systems have been increasingly used in urban rail transit. But it has been found in practical applications that the energy storage devices have a slow dynamic response in certain operating conditions. Therefore, this paper analyzes the factors affecting the dynamic response of the energy storage device. In order to improve its dynamic performance in different steady-state operating points, a double loop control strategy based on active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) is proposed. For the problem that the parameters of the ADRC controller are difficult to adjust, the genetic algorithm is used to find the optimal parameters of the controller. Finally, the least-squares method is used to fit the optimization-seeking results, which realizes the real-time optimal adjustment function of the control parameters.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization of the Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs) are widely used in various fields due to their high efficiency, high power factor and small volume. In this paper, a segmented permanent magnet interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) is proposed and optimized. First, the topology of the IPMSM is introduced. Second, multi-objective optimization is performed by non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm-II (NSGA-II) using rotor structure parameters as optimization variables, saliency ratio as constraint, electromagnetic torque and constant-power speed range as objective functions. Then, the electromagnetic characteristics of the initial IPMSM and the optimized IPMSM are analyzed and compared. The results show that the torque and constant-power speed range of the optimized motor are improved, which verifies the validity of the optimization method. The proposed motor is suitable for electric vehicles, which require large torque at low speeds and wide constant-power speed range at high speeds.

articleTitle: Influence of Slot/Pole Combinations on Torque Ripple in Partitioned Stator Doubly Salient Permanent Magnet Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Influence of slot/pole combinations on torque ripple in partitioned stator doubly salient permanent magnet (PS-DSPM) machines are comprehensively investigated. First, the slot/pole combinations for three-phase PS-DSPM machines are discussed. Then, a determination principle of the feasible slot/pole combinations is proposed for obtaining the approximately sinusoidal back-electromotive force (back-EMF) waveform, small cogging torque, and negligible reluctance torque. Furthermore, the unit PS-DSPM machines with proposed 18/5, 18/7, 18/11, 18/13, and 18/17 slot/pole combinations are compared against the conventional 18/12 PS-DSPM machine to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method to determine the slot/pole combinations. The results show that compared with the conventional 18/12 slot/pole combination, the proposed 18/5, 18/7, 18/11, 18/13, and 18/17 slot/pole combinations can significantly decrease torque ripple.

articleTitle: Comparison of FRPM Machines With Different Magnet Arrangements
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Four flux reverse permanent magnet (FRPM) machines with different magnet arrangements are compared using a finite element analysis method. The influence of the magnet parameters on the electromagnetic performance of each machine is analyzed. The air gap flux density, induced electromotive force and electromagnetic torque of the four machines are compared and the maximum electromagnetic torque of each machine is obtained. The analyzed results show that the electromagnetic performances of the proposed three machine models are better than those of the conventional machine.

articleTitle: PEMFC fault diagnosis based on SAE
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis of proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC), a fault diagnosis method based on stacked autoencoders (SAE) is proposed to realize the identification of PEMFC normal, flooding, membrane drying and hydrogen leakage. The SAE encoder network is used to reduce the dimension of the input data and obtain the feature information, which is used for fault diagnosis and classification. In order to verify the feasibility of the method, the PEMFC actual operation data is used to train and test the model. The experimental results show that the fault diagnosis model based on SAE has good recognition effect for four operating conditions.

articleTitle: Inhibition Mechanism Under Temperature Gradient on DC Surface Flashover of 3D-Printing Anisotropic Heat Conducting Composites
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The temperature gradient formation in insulating dielectric from inside to outside is caused by the heated conductor, resulting in a decrease in the resistance of the dielectric and the potential extension from the high-voltage (HV) electrode to the ground (GND) electrode, which easily triggers the phenomenon of DC surface flashover. The DC surface flashover under temperature gradient can be suppressed by the use of an insulating dielectric with low thermal conductivity, but the insulating reliability of the equipment is affected by the local high temperature of the dielectric. In this paper, the polymer composite with anisotropic thermal conductive is prepared with oriented hBN, which can inhibit the DC surface discharge under the temperature gradient by reasonable insulation design. The DC surface flashover characteristics of in-plane oriented hBN composites, out-of-plane oriented hBN composites, randomly oriented composites, and pure resin under temperature gradient are studied. The temperature-rising region of each sample is explored by using an infrared camera. The results show that the heat-dissipation effect of out-of-plane oriented composite resin is the best, when the electric field direction is perpendicular to the hBN orientation. The smallest high-temperature region near the anode is the main reason for the inhibition of the DC surface discharge under the temperature gradient.

articleTitle: Research on Multi - temperature Sensor Data Fusion Method Based on Improved Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Multi-sensor data fusion has always been a difficulty in the field of power temperature measurement. Traditional data fusion methods often use Kalman filtering, and the performance of Kalman filtering is highly dependent on the selected filter parameters. If the filter parameters are not selected properly, it will affect the filter gain and greatly reduce the reliability and fault tolerance of the fusion results. This is because the filter parameters directly affect the weight allocation of the filter to the observed values and model predicted values, and improper allocation can lead to a large deviation between the fusion result and the true value, thus greatly reducing the reliability and fault tolerance of the fusion results. Based on the traditional Kalman filtering algorithm, this paragraph describes an improved data fusion method that dynamically estimates the temperature values of multiple temperature measurement points by updating the covariance matrix of the state variables to improve the Kalman filter gain. Specifically, this method performs data fusion for multiple temperature measurement points on the basis of the traditional Kalman filtering algorithm, and updates the covariance matrix of the state variables to enable the Kalman filter gain to more accurately reflect the data contributions of different measurement points. This enables dynamic tracking of multiple temperature measurement points and more accurate estimation of their temperature values. Through simulation and experimental analysis, this improved Kalman filtering data fusion method demonstrates high credibility and fault tolerance, which means it can work stably in complex environments and correctly handle issues such as data anomalies and measurement errors. Therefore, this method can be widely applied to data fusion processing of multiple temperature measurement points, thereby improving the accuracy and reliability of data processing.

articleTitle: Study on Power Battery Matching Design for Hybrid Power System of Electric Tractor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the demand of high specific energy and high specific power of power battery of electric tractor, in this paper, a power battery optimization design strategy based on the multi-criteria decision model is proposed for electric tractors to solve the difficult problem of power battery matching selection. By analyzing the towing parameters and calculating the rated and maximum mechanical power of electric tractor, a hybrid battery system combined with supercapacitor is proposed, and the parameters of the hybrid battery system are matched on this basis; the performance of seven kinds of power batteries under different weight ratios is studied with battery weight, volume, cycle life, safety factor and cost as evaluation criteria. The results show that the lithium iron phosphate (FLP) battery is best choice under the current technical conditions.

articleTitle: an evolutional control strategy to mitigate commutation failure of multi-infeed HVDC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To reduce the probability of both commutation failure and continuous commutation failure in multi-infeed HVDC power transmission system, in this paper, the main reasons causing commutation failure are analysed, which include the voltage amplitude drop of commutation bus, direct current increasing sharply and commutating voltage zero-cross phase shift, therefore an evolutional constant extinction angle strategy whose setting value can be adjusted dynamically considering both the reduce of commutation bus voltage and commutating voltage zero-cross phase shift is proposed in inverter. Then, the mathematical relationship among active power, reactive power, DC current and DC voltage is analysed theoretically, and according to the reactive power interaction between multi-infeed HVDC system, the current correction coefficient is defined to adjust the current setting value in rectifier of during AC faults happening. What's more, the influence of the proposed control strategy on system operating parameters is also studied by theoretical derivation. Simulation results show that the proposed optimal control strategy, to some extent, has the ability to mitigate the commutation failure and continuous commutation failure under fault conditions, and the fault recovery performances of HVDC can be effectively improved. Therefore, the performance of the multi-infeed HVDC systems can be improved by the presented control strategy.

Author Keywords: commutation failure and continuous commutation failure

articleTitle: Influence of Metal Particle Contaminnation on Surface Flashover Characteristics of GIL Spacer in C4F7N/CO2 Mixtures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N/CO<inf>2</inf> mixture is one of the most promising environmental-friendly SF<inf>6</inf> alternative gases, which is favored by scholars and manufacturers at home and abroad. Aiming at the problem of metal particle contamination in C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N/CO<inf>2</inf> mixture insulation equipment, a surface flashover test platform suitable for scaled spacers is built to study the DC surface flashover characteristics of C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N/CO<inf>2</inf> mixture. The effects of metal particle length and attachment position on the surface flashover characteristics of C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N/CO<inf>2</inf> mixture are studied. The results show that the surface flashover voltage decreases with the increase of the length of metal particles. When the metal particle ia in contact with the high-voltage electrode, the electric field distortion at the particle tips is serious, and the flashover voltage is lower than that when the particle is not in contact with the electrode. In C<inf>4</inf>F<inf>7</inf>N/CO<inf>2</inf> mixture, the flashover voltage of negative polarity under extremely uneven electric field is higher than that of positive polarity, showing polarity effect. With the increase of C4F7N content, the polarity effect becomes more and more significant.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Typical Defects of 110 kV Cable Buffer Layer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to analyze the effect of typical defects of cable buffer layer on the operating performance, the simulation modeling of 110 kV cable was carried out in various cases. Several contact states between the aluminum sheath and the buffer layer were simulated, including the ideal contact state, local air gap defect, deposition of water-proofing powder from damp buffer layer, and imperfect grounding. The electric field is evenly distributed in the cable section, and there is no field distortion with ideal state. When the air gap exists at the interface of aluminum sheath and the buffer layer, the electric field in air gap is severely distorted, and the maximum field strength locates at the triple junction of air gap, aluminum sheath and the buffer layer. The electric field of air defects may be higher than that in cable insulation, far exceeding the breakdown field strength of air and then leading to the partial discharge. At the same position, the field distortion caused by the water-proofing powder deposition is lower than air defects. The local imperfect grounding may also produce larger area of electric field distortion, which will lead to large-scale partial discharge and even interfacial breakdown between the buffer layer and the aluminum sheath. This paper can provide theoretical and simulation reference for the operation and maintenance of high voltage cables.

articleTitle: Simulation of partial discharge of oil-paper insulation under high-frequency electric field
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Partial discharge in oil-immersed transformer is often an important inducement for equipment failure. The research on partial discharge of oil-paper insulation of oil-immersed transformer is mainly based on DC and power frequency AC conditions, there are few researches on partial discharge of gas-solid insulation system at high frequency, focusing on the influence of voltage form, temperature and other factors on the macro characteristics of discharge. In this paper, a high-frequency partial discharge simulation model considering the transition zone of oil-paper insulation interface is adopted, the characteristic changes of partial discharge of oil-paper insulation at different high frequencies are simulated, it includes initial partial discharge voltage, electron charge density and ion recombination, the residual charge and partial discharge amplitude in the transition region are compared under DC voltage and power frequency AC voltage. The results show that: the initial voltage of partial discharge at high frequency gradually decreases with the increase of frequency, under the action of strong electric field, ion recombination will occur; the amplitude of partial discharge at power frequency is much lower than that at high frequency, which is due to the influence of voltage rise rate and surface charge relaxation characteristics; in addition, the residual charge in the transition region at high frequency is significantly higher than that of DC, and the dissipation amplitude is also much larger than that of DC. Provide simulation basis for insulation coordination optimization of composite oil-paper insulation system under high frequency voltage.

articleTitle: Study on the detection and imaging of the residual stress distribution in GIS basin spacer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The basin spacer is the key component of gas insulated metal-enclosed switchgear (GIS), but the crosslinking reaction and cooling shrinkage of epoxy resin compound during the casting process will cause certain residual stress in the basin spacer, which will easily lead to cracking of the basin spacer when superimposed with the operating load, seriously threatening the reliable operation of GIS equipment. In this paper, an automatic detection and imaging system for the internal residual stress of the basin spacer is designed based on the acoustic elastic effect. First, the acoustic elastic coefficients of ultrasonic longitudinal waves at two frequencies ollf 2.5 and 1.5MHz are tested. By compiling the scanning path of the industrial robot arm, the automatic acquisition of the ultrasonic transmission time of each point on the basin spacer is completed, and the acoustic elastic equation under dual frequencies is established to eliminate the thickness of the spacer, which provides a reference for the reliability evaluation of the GIS basin spacer.ll

articleTitle: Aging Condition Diagnosis of the Oil-paper Insulation by Fluorescence Observation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Oil-paper combined insulation is the most important way of internal insulation in oil-immersed transformers, which greatly determines the service life of the transformers. The existing monitoring methods of transformer service life are in limited application due to their own shortcomings, and a new aging diagnosis method is urgently needed to solve the problems of the existing aging characteristics. The mineral insulating oil has its unique fluorescence characteristics, which can reflect the change of its state. In this research, the steady-state fluorescence spectra and quantum yield of the oil samples with different aging degrees were detected under the optimal excitation. Compared with the original insulating oil, the intensity of the steady-state fluorescence spectra of the aging insulating oil had a significant decrease and this phenomenon was more obvious in the early and middle aging stage. It was worth mentioning that the quantum yield of the insulating oil also gradually decreased as the aging process deepened, and there was a relatively good quantitative relationship between the degree of polymerization and the quantum yield of the insulating oil. This result provides a novel nondestructive method for monitoring the operation status of transformers, which is more sensitive in the early and middle stages of aging of the oil-paper insulation. At the same time, it also offers an important reference to the operation maintenance of transformers.

articleTitle: Lifetime Optimization by Injecting Circulating Currents with a Second-order Harmonic into MMCs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Effective management of the operational lifespan is a critical aspect in enhancing the reliability of modular multilevel converters (MMCs). Typically, the lifespan distribution of switches/diodes in each submodule (SM) is not uniform. This article puts forward a lifetime optimization control (LOC) of the MMC, where the lifetime of switches/diodes in the SMs could be improved by injecting the optimal second-order harmonic circulating current (SHCC) in MMCs. The proposed approach leads to a significant enhancement in the dependability of MMCs. Experiments using the PSCAD/EMTDC time-domain simulation tool have been performed, and the findings validate the efficacy of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant control for Semi-Markovian jump systems with application to dc motors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This article aims to address the control synthesis problem for networked dc motor systems, which consider probabilistic actuators faulty and network properties. First, the motor delay model is developed, in which the probabilistic actuators faulty and network properties are combined simultaneously. Secondly, according the probability that whether the packet is sent or not within a time bound, the resulting delay model which include two time-varying intervals is derived. Then, several sufficient conditions for the stability and mode-dependent fault-tolerant controller design are derived by using Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF). Finally, the effectiveness of the presented methodology is demonstrated by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Current Differential Protection Based on Bridge Phase Unit for Converter Station in Hybrid AC/DC Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: AC/DC hybrid grid has become the development trend of future grids. In AC/DC hybrid grid, the DC differential protection for converter severely loses selectivity. To enhance the selectivity of converter protection, this paper narrows the minimum protection unit to a bridge phase unit of converter firstly, and then constructs novel differential current and restraint current based on the three-terminal currents of bridge phase unit. Further, a principle of current differential protection based on bridge phase unit for converters is proposed. Finally, the proposed protection performance is compared with the DC differential protection for converter according to the results of digital simulation. The simulation result shows that the selectivity of converter protection is enhanced by the proposed protection principle significantly, which solves the problem of losing selectivity of DC differential protection for converter.

articleTitle: Technical and economic research on networking and transmission for Jiangsu far-reaching offshore wind power
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Jiangsu coastal area is rich in offshore wind resources for development. The development capacity of farreaching offshore wind power is 80 million kilowatts, and the development potential is huge. In this paper, far-reaching sea wind power networking and transmission active loss, economy and other factors, analysis of the system structure for far-reaching sea wind power; Aiming at the problem of large amount of active power loss in large wind power system networking and long distance transmission system, four networking and transmission modes of power frequency AC, low frequency AC, flexible DC and pure DC are compared on the basis of system technical and economic indexes. Firstly, the operation modes of four wind power systems are analyzed, and the technical analysis of transformers and cables is carried out. Secondly, the active power loss of the farreaching sea wind power system is calculated, and the loss model under different transmission distances is built by MALTAB/ SIMULINK. Finally, the economics of the four methods were compared by engineering cost calculation. Combined with the development plan of offshore wind power in Jiangsu Province, the transmission mode of large-scale offshore wind power pooling and outgoing transmission in Jiangsu Province is proposed.

articleTitle: Second-order Nested Terminal Sliding Mode for Current Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Sliding mode for current control of the permanent magnet synchronous machine has the merit of high robustness to parameter mismatch. However, the actual control accuracy is subjected to the effect of the sliding mode chattering. The nonsingular terminal sliding mode (NTSM) control can effectively reduce chattering, but its parameters are difficult to be selected and the convergence rate is slow. To this aim, a second-order nested terminal sliding mode (SNTSM) strategy is proposed to improve the control performance of the stator currents. The integral fast terminal sliding mode is nested in the NTSM surface. Through the SNTSM control design, the chattering is sustained well in theory, and the fast convergence of current without steady-state error is realized. At last, some experiments are made to verify the current control strategy and its merits is highlighted through comparative study.

Author Keywords: second-order nested terminal sliding mode control

articleTitle: Online Evaluation of Power Device Aging during AC Power Cycling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power devices are widely used in high-voltage converter valves as a core component. At present, standard aging test evaluate devices' reliability by using Direct Current (DC) power cycling test, without the converter conditions of high voltage and switching. Many researchers pay more attention to the actual aging of devices under converter conditions, which is called Alternating Current (AC) power cycling. Due to the complexity of AC power cycling control and the accuracy of junction temperature, it's difficult to achieve online measurements that includes measuring Rth and Vce% and evaluate power device junction temperature accurately at present. In this article, an AC power cycling circuit with accuracy junction temperature measurement is proposed. The equipment's novel features have special circuit and control strategy. A experiments and simulations of package and chip are tested for comparing the difference between AC and DC power cycling.

articleTitle: Reliability-oriented Component Criticality Analysis of Distribution Systems Based on Graph Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Severe power outages of distribution systems are usually first caused by the failure of a single component. Hence the analysis of critical components is very important for the reliable operation of distribution systems. This paper proposed a reliability-oriented component criticality analysis method for distribution systems based on graph theory. Specifically, a framework of analyzing the component criticality is proposed firstly based on the Monte Carlo simulation. The sensitivity of distribution system reliability indices to the fault parameters of vulnerable components is used to formulate the component criticality indices. Then, combining with the distribution system graph model, the topology structure of distribution systems is converted into a graph model. The zone partitioning and minimal path searching is applied to access the reliability-oriented criticality of components. Finally, the proposed method is applied to Roy Billinton Test System (RBTS) bus2 to validate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on the Process of Rock Fragmentation by High-Voltage Pulse Discharge
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Rock fragmentation by high-voltage pulse discharge (rock fragmentation by high-voltage pulse discharge, RFHD) is a potential, new and efficient drilling technology. The RFHD platform is established to study the relationship between voltage characteristics and discharge path distribution in typical liquid-rock composite media. Based on the discrete element method, multi-physical field simulation and numerical calculation, the development law of plasma channel in rock is analyzed. High voltage pulse discharge drilling experiments were carried out for rock-like components, which provided a theoretical and technical basis for the application of RFHD.

Author Keywords: Rock fragmentation by high-voltage pulse discharge (RFHD)

articleTitle: Enhancing Interface Bonding and Electrical Conductivity of Copper/Carbon Composites
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Carbon/copper composites are widely used in electrical engineering with good mechanical and electrical properties. However, the non-wettability between copper and carbon is a key bottleneck which limits high performance carbon/copper(C/Cu) composites. In this study, the C/Cu composites were prepared by using the iron (Fe) element in the copper melt to improve the carbon/copper wettability and enhance C/Cu interface bonding. The mechanical and electrical properties of the composites were obviously enhanced by the Fe<inf>3</inf>C interlayer generated at the C/Cu interface. In the Cu-8 wt% Fe/C system, the contact angle drops from 125° to 18° due to the Fe3C interlayer. In this case, the bending strength and electrical conductivity of the C/Cu composites increased by 77% and 358%, which has a good application prospect in the field of electrical contact material.

articleTitle: Design of Digital PR Controller for L-type Grid-Connected Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As a key link between the DC source and the grid, the L-type grid-connected inverter must have good and stable control performance. In this paper, the current inner loop of L-type inverter is studied and the PR controller is designed by analog method and direct digital method. The performance differences between the discretization methods are compared, and the effect of sampling frequency on the discrete error is also analyzed. In the direct numerical method, the law between the controller parameters and the open-loop root trajectory is analyzed, and two sets of PR controllers are designed based on this. Through simulation experiments, it is verified that the PR controller designed by the direct digital method in this paper can achieve smaller overshoot and faster regulation.

articleTitle: Development of magnetic-sensor-based hand gesture recognition system for sign language
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Sign language recognition is essential for the automatic translation of sign languages to enable communication for hearing-impaired people. This work proposes a system based on multiple magnetic sensors for recognizing hand gestures related to sign language alphabets. In particular, a magnetic detection system consisting of six magnetic sensor nodes measures the orientation of fingers and palms. A deep learning classification algorithm processes the measured orientation data. Experimental tests validate the proposed system and classification method. The results show that the proposed method provides close to 100% classification accuracy for 26 sign language alphabets under laboratory conditions. Thus, the feasibility of the proposed gesture recognition system for automatic translation of sign language alphabets is proved.

articleTitle: An Integrated Structure of Wireless Charging System and Auxiliary Power Module in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: There will be two charging systems in the electric vehicle (EV), namely wireless power transfer (WPT) to charge the high-voltage battery and the auxiliary power module (APM) to charge the low-voltage battery, which will increase the cost, volume and weight of the EV. This paper proposes an integrated system that combines WPT and APM with a shared coupler. The APM system uses a coupling coil to directly couple with the receiving coil of the WPT system. The common structure includes three parts: the active rectifier, the compensation network, and the receiving coil. When the EV is charged wirelessly, it is allowed to charge the high-voltage battery and the low-voltage battery simultaneously. When the EV is not wirelessly charged, the energy can be transferred from the high-voltage side to the low-voltage side through the coupling between the receiving coil and the coil at the APM side. The integration of WPT and APM can significantly improve the overall power density of the EV powertrain and reduce its weight and cost. An experimental prototype is implemented to validate the proposal.

articleTitle: Prediction of the Thermal Rating of Overhead Conductor Based on Empirical Mode Decomposition-Sample Entropy and Quantile Regression Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Prediction of the thermal rating of overhead conductor can help operators foresee and make full use of the current-carrying capacity of overhead lines, which is of great significance to the safe and economic operation of the power grid. In view of the characteristics of high volatility and randomness of the thermal rating of overhead conductors, based on the existing probability prediction methods, this paper proposes a probability prediction model based on empirical mode decomposition - sample entropy and quantile regression forest. This method first uses empirical mode decomposition technology to decompose the original thermal rating into a series of components with different characteristics and then uses sample entropy theory to stack the approximate components to reduce the task load. After that, the corresponding quantile regression forest model is established for each reconstructed subsequence to predict. Finally, the predicted results of each subsequence are superimposed to obtain the final thermal rating predicted results. The prediction simulation results show that by reducing the complexity of the original sequence and modeling each new sequence separately, the prediction results can be significantly improved, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Distributed collaborative optimal dispatch of distribution system with multi-stakeholders
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, to achieve energy conservation and emission reduction and the clean transformation of energy structure, the user-side distributed energy has developed rapidly, and the coupled operation characteristics of cooling, heating and power have become increasingly prominent. The distribution system with multiple stakeholders has received extensive attention. However, the change of distribution pattern will bring many problems to the optimal operation of power system. This paper introduces the analysis target cascading (ATC) theory and proposes a coordinated and optimized scheduling model with distribution network operators, distributed energy providers., and combined cooling heating and power (CCHP) load integrators as the main stakeholders by exchanging contact variable information. Based on the detailed technical model of the internal components of each stakeholder., the linkage variables between each stakeholder and the distribution network operator are decoupled and solved in parallel to improve the computational efficiency. The model considers the access of wind-light-storage and combined cooling., heating and power generation systems., which is conducive to the realization of multi-energy complementary operation of the distribution system and the transformation of energy structure.

articleTitle: Research on calibration algorithm of two-dimensional plane based on corner reflector
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, the main problem faced by the millimeter wave (MMW) radar imaging system is how to use the minimum antenna array to achieve high resolution. The introduction of multiple input multiple output (MIMO) array technology into the radar imaging system can reduce the number of array elements, and the combination of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) technology can effectively improve the resolution. However, in the actual imaging system, due to the mismatch of the amplitude and phase of the antenna array on the radar board, the imaging results will appear artifacts and range offset. Therefore, on the basis of the MMW imaging algorithm, the paper focuses on the calibration algorithm, proposes a two-dimensional plane calibration algorithm based on the corner reflector, realizes the accurate estimation of the coordinates of the corner reflector through the phase change and the least square method, realizes the simultaneous calibration of the distance and phase of each channel of the MIMO array. Besides, we build the MIMO-SAR MMW imaging system and carry out the MIMO-SAR imaging and calibration experiments. Finally, the feasibility of the imaging and calibration algorithm is verified by the experimental results.

articleTitle: The Effect of Base Oil Aging on Conductivity of Electric Compound Grease
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The aging failure of electric compound grease in humid and hot environment will cause heat generation problems and affect the safe operation of the electric grid. Most of the aging of electric compound grease is caused by the failure of the base oil. thermal oxidative aging is the main factor affecting the life of electric compound grease. The type of base oil has a great influence on the life of the electric compound grease. In this article, we found that silicone electric compound greases are more thermally stable than hydrocarbon greases and The thermal stability of polydimethylphenyl silicone electric compound grease is higher than that of polydimethyl silicone electric compound grease. During the hot oxygen aging process, the contact resistance of the copper bar will first decrease and then increase. Electric compound greases with good thermal stability and low oil separation rate will keep the copper bar with a small contact resistance.

articleTitle: Adaptive Backstepping Control of VSC-HVDC Systems with Unknown Disturbances and Transmission Delay
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The development of Voltage Source Converter Based High Voltage Direct Current (VSC-HVDC) technology plays an important role in promoting intelligent power grid and integrating renewable energy to the grid. Since that the control scheme has a great influence on system performance, it needs to improve the operation stability of the VSC-HVDC system with superior control strategy with the consideration of unknown disturbances and transmission delay. This paper presents an adaptive backstepping robust control scheme to improve the dynamic response of the system during transient process, so as to improve the stable operation ability of the system. First, a mathematical model of VSC-HVDC including the unknown disturbances and transmission delay is constructed. Secondly, the adaptive law is designed to observe the integrated unknown terms of the system. Then the adaptive backstepping robust control strategy of VSC-HVDC system is designed to improve the dynamic response characteristics of the system during the transient process. The simulation model and control system of VSC-HVDC system are built on the PSCAD/EMTDC platform, and the effectiveness of the proposed robust control scheme is verified.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Induction with X-rays to Detect Metal Particle Defects in SIR/XLPE Interface
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Metal particle defect in SIR / XLPE interface is one of the common defects in cable accessories. In the early stage of defect formation, the discharge signal may be weak, and the traditional partial discharge detection method is poor at low voltage. In this paper, X-ray is used to excite the partial discharge of suspended metal particle defects, and the sensitivity of partial discharge detection is improved at low voltage. Firstly, the SIR/XLPE interface metal particle defect samples were made, and the partial discharge detection and X-ray excitation platform were built to carry out experimental research. The experimental results show that X-ray can reduce the partial discharge inception voltage (PDIV) of metal particles with different thickness. The smaller the thickness, the more obvious the reduction. When the applied voltage is higher than the PDIV under X-ray and lower than the PDIV under natural state, X-ray has a decisive effect on discharge. When the applied voltage is higher than the natural PDIV, the discharge becomes self-sustaining. X-ray can increase the discharge repetition rate and the number of discharges in the state.

articleTitle: Audible noise sensing method for HVDC Transmission lines based on corona current detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Audible noise is an important factor that must be considered in the design of high volt direct current lines, but the outdoor audible noise test is vulnerable to environmental noise interference. This paper starts with the relationship between the wire power supply current and the audible noise to study the audible noise.
