Through the experimental study of corona current and audible noise of 6 * 1250mm<sup>2</sup> true split conductor in the corona cage, this paper obtains that the corona current and audible noise have similar characteristics of the CPB spectrum. Through the comparison of the results of converting the CPB spectrum to A sound level, it is found that the conversion law of audible noise can be obtained from the measured data of corona current. The research results of this paper can lay a foundation for further searching for the intrinsic correlation between corona current and audible noise.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Hybrid Energy Source System Based on Interconnection and Damping Assignment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the nonlinear control problem of the hybrid energy source system, encompassing both the battery and the supercapacitor, an Interconnection and Damping Assignment Passivity-Based Control (IDA-PBC) strategy is proposed. Combined with modes charging and discharging modes, a port-controlled Hamiltonian mathematical model of the hybrid energy source system is established. By configuring the interconnection and damping matrices, an interconnection and damping assignment controller, incorporating the rule-based energy management strategy, is designed. When the load power demand changes, the designed controller can maintain the stability of the DC bus voltage and reasonably distribute the power between the battery and the supercapacitor. Experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Active source-load control method for microgrid based on distributed control mode
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of new power system, more and more distributed new energy devices are connected to the power grid, and many microgrids have emerged to achieve source-load balancing by controlling distributed power sources. The cooperative interaction among multiple microgrids greatly improves the reliability of power supply and load recovery speed of microgrids, and in this process, it is necessary to clarify the recoverable power-loss loads of each microgrid and the sequence of load restoration. Therefore, this paper proposes an active source-load control method for microgrid based on distributed control mode. Firstly, the source-load control architecture of multi-microgrid collaboration is described, including the upper layer control mode composed of sub-microgrid control hub intelligences and the lower layer control mode composed of micro-source intelligences. Secondly, the microgrid load importance model is established, as well as the method of determining the restoration order of the power-loss loads. Again, the consistency calculation method under the distributed control model is proposed, and the power distribution and corresponding frequency compensation between the micro power supplies connected to each microgrid are determined through the consistency calculation. Finally, the calculation example verifies the effectiveness and scientificity of the method proposed in this paper, which provides important technical means for active source-load control of microgrid and has high engineering application value.

articleTitle: Effect of crystalline morphology of polypropylene on breakdown field strength
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Polypropylene (PP) is studied as an environmentally friendly insulating material in high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission such as the wind power grid connection, island power supply and long-distance transmission across the sea because of its excellent insulating properties. As a semi-crystalline polymer, PP's crystal structure determines the insulating properties. In this paper, pure isotactic PP samples with different crystalline morphology were prepared to investigate the effect of crystalline morphology on the breakdown field strength. According to the microstructure and DSC(differential scanning calorimetry) curve, the breakdown field strength of isotactic PP samples was discussed. The breakdown mechanism was analyzed. Due to the different crystalline morphology forming in samples, the electron transportation path changes, leading to the breakdown field strength change.

articleTitle: No-Load Magnetic Field Prediction of Surface-Mounted Permanent Magnet Machines with a Quasi-Regular Polygon Rotor Core Based on the Conformal Mapping Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this article, a new analytical model based on the conformal mapping (CM) method is proposed to address the special construction of surface-mounted permanent magnet (SPM) machines with a quasi-regular polygon rotor core (QPRC). The proposed model divides the upper surface of the QPRC into several segments to ensure that the CM method can deal with this special structure. The equivalent-current method treats PMs as current layers, and the CM method transforms the actual machine into an equivalent regular rectangular model. Then, the no-load air-gap magnetic field can be predicted by solving the complex potential generated by the equivalent currents. Finally, the accuracy of the proposed model can be verified by the finite-element analysis and the experiment.

articleTitle: Modeling and output performance analysis of six phase brushless AC exciter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to achieve high output rectifying current, this paper presents a six-phase design for the traditional three-phase brushless AC exciter. It is proved that the six-phase design can improve the output rectifying current in this paper. And the output performance of the six-phase brushless AC exciter is compared with that of the traditional three-phase brushless AC exciter by the finite element model. The results of the simulation model agree with the derivation. And in order to further improve the output rectifying current, the number of slots and parallel branches of the six-phase brushless AC exciter is changed. The six-phase brushless AC exciter with 96 slots presented in this paper efficiently increases the output rectifying current.

Author Keywords: high output rectifying current;brushless AC exciter

articleTitle: Real-Time Estimation of Parameters in Inductive-Resistive Power Networks Using Second-Order Extended Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In many control schemes for grid-connected systems, the acquisition of weak grid parameters is critical for robust stability and output quality improvement of grid-connected converter systems. In this paper, the second-order extended Kalman filter (SOEKF) algorithm, which enables recursive computation, is used for real-time estimation of weak grid parameters (including, PCC voltage, grid current, grid voltage, and grid impedance). Considering that the nonlinear dynamics of the inductive-resistive network can lead to rounding errors and subsequently deteriorate the accuracy of the real-time estimation, we reconstruct the inductive-resistive network model to a second-order nonlinear form that can be fully expanded with Taylor series. The theoretical advantages of the SOEKF over the extended Kalman filter (EKF) are dissected in the context of actual inductive-resistive networks. The simulation tests verify that the proposed method can accurately estimate each parameter of the weak grid, and the estimation accuracy is better than that of EKF.

articleTitle: Dimensioning of DC Capacitor for Voltage Source Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Grid-forming voltage source converter (GFM-VSC) can significantly improve the stability of renewable energy generation system connected with power gird. However, in photovoltaic power generation applications, the fluctuation and randomness of the irradiation can lead to the DC voltage fluctuation of GFM-VSC. When a sudden drop of irradiation occurs, DC voltage of converter would also drop significantly, leading to undervoltage problems and shutdown accidents. As an energy storage element, the DC capacitor can support the power imbalance between AC and DC sides of the converter, suppressing DC voltage fluctuation. This paper presents a DC capacitor dimensioning method for GFM-VSC. Through the transient modeling of DC voltage of the converter. the relationship between irradiance and DC voltage fluctuation is built. Then a dimensioning method is proposed. Capacitors selected by this method can avoid DC undervoltage and improve the DC voltage stability. Examples and simulations verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Modeling and Dynamic Performance Analysis of Grid Forming Doubly-fed Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The doubly-fed wind turbine based on grid forming control has the ability to establish terminal voltage independently and maintain stability, but the quantitative analysis of grid-connected stability and dynamic performance is insufficient, which affects the engineering application. To solve this problem, a small signal analysis model of grid forming controlled doubly-fed wind turbine is established. And based on the oscillation mode and participation factor analysis, this essay finds out the dominant modes which are influenced by grid forming control and key control parameters. Furthermore, based on the root locus analysis, the influence of grid strength and key control parameters on the stability and dynamic performance of the system is revealed as well as the variation law. Finally, the simulation model of the grid forming doubly-fed wind turbine is built in MATLAB/Simulink, and the simulation proves the accuracy and effectiveness of the theoretical analysis, which is expected to guide the popularization and application of the grid forming doubly-fed wind turbine.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Cast Steel Joint in 385m-high Long-span Transmission Tower
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on 385m-high long-span transmission tower of 500kV Fengcheng to Meili project, the selection of the joint of bottom-crossarm compression member is conducted. Three types of joints are put forward and compared, including tubular joint, welded hollow spherical joint and cast steel tubular joint. The cast steel joint adopts monolithic casting technology, it helps to solve the problem of space intersection of multiple members, and avoid complex welding process. Due to comparison results, the cast steel joint is selected, and steel material is G20Mn5QT. Then, the nonlinear finite element analysis is performed, the force characteristics and ultimate capacity of cast steel joint is investigated, and design capacity of the joint under different load cases is calculated. It reveals that the cast steel joint is safe and reliable, and it is suggested to be wildly used in super-high transmission towers.

articleTitle: Research on Blockchain-based Information System for Power business archives Co-construction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous popularization of the emerging technology of “big cloud mobile intelligence chain”, the environment, object and content of power equipment operation and maintenance status and archive management had undergone tremendous changes. This paper discusses the existing technical solutions and shortcomings of the power business archives information system, introduces the blockchain technology, and designs the power business archives information system model on the Hyperledger Fabric alliance chain technology platform based on the natural compatibility between the power business archives information system and the blockchain technology, and constructs the integration architecture of the business system and the archives system. Build a closed loop management system for the whole process of business-archival, and realize the power business archives information system of joint construction, data management and information sharing. It improves the reliability of electronic archives and provides convenience for the management and use of Power business archives

articleTitle: An improved method of supercapacitor aging prediction based on Prophet under actual working condition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Supercapacitors have a specific application in power supplement and energy recycling of electrical vehicles. The actual service life of supercapacitors under different working conditions may be inconsistent with the nominal life measured in the laboratory. This paper proposes a method for supercapacitor aging prediction with data from buses under actual working conditions. Aiming at the low sampling frequency and accuracy of the monitoring data, the limited memory least square method is used to identify the parameters along with the penalty function method. Considering the periodic change of aging indicators, a life prediction method based on an improved Prophet algorithm based on Fourier analysis is proposed. Finally, the forward chain method is used to verify the results, the prediction error of C and ESR is lower than 2.5% within 150 days

articleTitle: Magnetic Integrated Five-phase LLC Resonant Converter for Offshore Wind Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the offshore wind power generation system, the high voltage DC (HVDC) system is an important scheme for the long-distance transmission of electric energy. Modular isolated DCDC converter, such as half bridge LLC converter, are connected in series to improve the voltage and power level of system. With the capacity improvement of offshore wind power generation system, isolated DCDC module with higher power density are needed to reduce the volume cost of the system. In this paper, a modular five-phase LLC converter (FPLLC) is proposed. Combined with the higher operating frequency and the advanced transformer magnetic integration technology, the volume of the transformer can be further reduced and the power density of the module can be improved. Based on the first harmonic approximation (FHA), the working principle of FPLLC is analyzed. A parameter design process of FPLLC with the fixed gain characteristic is described. A 3kW prototype proves the feasibility of the proposed FPLLC scheme. The typical frequency modulation experiment shows that the FPLLC scheme can run stably and be used in practice.

articleTitle: Disturbance Compensation-Based Discrete Single-Phase-Shift Control for DAB DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To improve the dynamic performance of dual-active-bridge (DAB) dc-dc converter, a novel disturbance compensation-based discrete single-phase-shift (DCB-DSPS) control strategy is proposed in this paper. By using two discrete compensated phase-shift ratios <tex>$\Delta d_{\mathrm{H}}$</tex> and <tex>$\Delta d_{\mathrm{L}}$</tex> to compensate the open-loop phase-shift ratio <tex>$d_{\text{ol}}$</tex> of the SPS controlled DAB dc-dc converter, the proposed DCB-DSPS control can achieve accurate and fast adjustment of the output voltage under both input voltage and load step change. The control principle, parameters design and control performances of the proposed DCB-DSPS control strategy are developed. Experimental results of a 96V-48V/210W-50kHz DAB dc-dc converter are presented to validate the proposed DCB-DSPS control method.

articleTitle: Characteristics prediction of transformers based on long short term memory network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The transformer is an important equipment in power system, whose operational reliability of the transformer is the crucial factor to the system stability. the characteristic prediction is an useful direction for health assessment and fault diagnosis of transformers. In this paper, the characteristic prediction of transformers based on long short term memory network is investigated, and the comparison of the prediction effect for two input models is carried out. The results show that the prediction effects of two input models are almost same, and the prediction effect of the single input model is a little better. Particularly, for CH<inf>4</inf> and CO, the correlation coefficient of the multiple input model is a little higher than the single one. For CO<inf>2</inf>, the prediction has better adopt the single input model. This paper provides a technical support to the characteristics prediction of transformers.

articleTitle: Analysis of Impact of Inverter-Interfaced Distributed Generator Connected to Distribution Network on Action Characteristics of Phase Selector
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Inverter-interfaced distributed generator (IIDG) adopts positive sequence component control strategy. When an asymmetric fault occurs, IIDG only outputs positive sequence current, making the distribution coefficients of positive and negative sequence current on IIDG side seriously unequal, which results the degradation of the performance of phase selectors based on mutation of 2-phase current difference and symmetric component. Based on traditional phase selection principle, the influence of IIDGs access to the distribution network on phase selectors is analyzed. Results show that phase selectors on system side are less affected by the connection of IIDGs. And they can correctly identify the fault phase regardless of fault types. However, phase selectors on IIDG side cannot select fault phase correctly. A line model is built on PSCAD/EMTDC and the fault simulation is then carried out. The simulation results verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis. Finally, the prospection on the possible application of the phase selector criterion for contact lines containing IIDGs is given.

articleTitle: Data Fitting Method of Customer Electric Energy Consumption Based on Orthogonal Polynomial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The electric energy consumption data of marketoriented customers must be perfectly metered or accurately fitted, that is essential for the construction of electricity spot market. The electricity consumption behavior of market-oriented customers is complex and variable, to address the issue that the patterns of the electricity consumption data are difficult to be accurately characterized, an orthogonal polynomial neural network-based data fitting model of electric energy consumption is established. The model is implemented using Chebyshev orthogonal polynomials, Hermite orthogonal polynomials, Legendre orthogonal polynomials, and Laguerre orthogonal polynomials respectively, while the neural network weight coefficients are trained by gradient descent algorithm. The results show that the fitting effect of the same type of electricity consumption data differs significantly among different implementation methods. The neural network models using Hermite orthogonal polynomials and Laguerre orthogonal polynomials have higher fitting accuracy than other models. It is an effective way to achieve accurate data fitting of customer electricity consumption by selecting the corresponding fitting method according to the type of electricity consumption behavior.

articleTitle: Signal and Power Synchronous Transmission-based Bidirectional Communication for Parallel Buck Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Reliable communication is vital in achieving a good coordinated operation between distributed intelligent power converter systems. In this paper, a signal and power synchronous transmission (SPST) method is proposed which employs an extra signal modulation switching device for realizing SPST communication for parallel buck converters. By using frequency shift keying (FSK) and phase shift keying (PSK), the SPST communication is implemented by changing the control pulse of the switch to inject voltage ripples with specific frequencies as a signal carrier. This voltage ripple can be sampled on the signal receiving end and demodulated by calculating the frequency spectrum. The feasibility of the proposed bidirectional SPST method between two parallel synchronous buck converters is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Application of Dynamic Phasor for Internal and Dynamic Stability Assessment of Aeronautic AC-DC-AC Converter System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the internal stability and dynamic stability of the aeronautic AC-DC-AC converter are studied. The harmonic state-space (HSS) equation of the DC-AC inverter and the sequence impedance of the AC-DC rectifier are derived based on the dynamic phasor theory. Firstly, the distribution of the characteristic roots of the HSS equation with consideration of different dynamic phasor orders is illustrated. The simulation results show that the higher harmonic components are easy to cause the instability of the converter system. Secondly, the linearization model of the switching functions of the rectifier is established under the condition of small voltage perturbation. According to the mapping relationship between the input-terminal and output-terminal of the auto-transformer and the rectifier bridge, the analytic expression of the input sequence impedance for the rectifier system is derived. The Nyquist curve and zero-pole distribution indicate that the sequence impedance model derived with the dynamic phasor can effectively reveal the dynamic impedance characteristics of the converter system. Thus, the methods proposed in this paper provide a reference for the rapid analysis and calculation of the stability of the dynamic converter of the aeronautic AC-DC-AC Converter System.

articleTitle: Enhanced dielectrical and mechanical properties of polypropylene/ poly (vinylidene fluoride) blends with chlorinated polyethylene
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, polypropylene and poly (vinylidene fluoride) (PVDF) was Melt blended and the effect of chlorinated polyethylene (CPE) as compatibilizer was studied. CPE was effective in compatibilizing the component of PP and PVDF. The addition of CPE improved the crystallization of PVDF component through promoting its crystallization speed, increasing the crystallization temperature and crystallization degree. The improvement in the morphology and structure of the samples by CPE results in the increase in tensile strength and storage modulus of the prepared samples. The increase in tensile strength is 11 % (the elongation at break is also increased a little) at 6 wt%CPE loading. Besides, the increase in dielectric permittivity at 10<sup>3</sup> Hz are 9.0% and 12 % for the systems containing 6 wt% and 10 wt% CPE, respectively, which makes the prepared samples more attractive in application.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control Based Active Frequency Support Strategy for Combined Wind/Photovoltaic/Storage Power Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The high penetration of renewable energy sources connected to the grid has brought great challenges to the frequency stability of the power system. For the combined wind/pohotovoltaic/storage power station, it is of great significance for better frequency performance to realize the coordination control of active power. Therefore, this paper presents a frequency active support strategy for combined wind/pohotovoltaic/storage power station. By establishing the model of combined wind/pohotovoltaic/storage power station, this strategy applies model predictive control (MPC) to optimize the total active power reference value and the allocation of response power of the combined wind/pohotovoltaic/storage power station. For obtaining better frequency performance, this strategy aims at absorbing wind and solar energy resources and improving the economy of energy storage station. In order to verify the performance of the proposed strategy, it is compared with droop control using MATLAB/Simulink when the load increasing and decreasing respectively. The simulation results clearly show the effectiveness of the active frequency support strategy proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Redundant Time Synchronization Mechanism Using Kalman filter in Train Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The time sensitive network(TSN) has been implemented in the commercial high-speed railway in the current years. Robust time synchronization is one of the key TSN technologies to fulfill the requirement of huge data traffic. In this paper, the fault-tolerant mechanism for master-slave time offset has been analyzed. To address this issue, an improved Kalman-based redundant system is proposed to optimize the time offset. Furthermore, the validation is delivered in OMNeT++ with a real topology recommended by Shift2rail. The simulation results indicate that the predictor can detect fault from the master within one cycle. It illustrates that the system in principle conforms to the time synchronization process defined by the gPTP protocol and guarantees the fault tolerance of the master-slave clock synchronization process.

articleTitle: A Hot Spot Detection Method of Photovoltaic Module Based on Image Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Hot spots of solar cells are one of the most probable failures during the operation of PV(Photovoltaic) systems. Hot spot can lead to loss of power generation as well as economic benefits of the PV plant, and if not dealt with in time, it will bring hidden danger to the safe and stable operation of the PV plant. Existing studies have shown that the detection of hot spots by the mechanism model of PV modules faces many difficulties and is not accurate. To address the above problems, this paper proposes a hot spot detection method for PV modules based on image semantic segmentation. Compared with other image processing methods, the proposed method in this study introduces migration network in the image processing network to improve the detection accuracy of the model. The image dataset used in this paper is the infrared thermal image of PV modules, which is more discriminative for hot spots. The image enhancement using Gaussian blur before image processing makes the image fit the actual environment more closely and improves the generalizability of hot spot detection. The experiments show that the proposed method is accurate and reliable.

articleTitle: Controller Parameter Design Method for Generator Excitation System Based on Kharitonov's Theorem and Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper is focused on the controller parameter design of generator excitation system. The traditional design method is implemented through on-site experimental tests, which has the inevitable drawbacks, e.g., long test period and life cycle loss of devices. To deal with this problem, this paper proposes a controller parameter design method on the basis of Kharitonov's Theorem and PSO. In the design process, the s-domain reduced models of synchronous generator and its excitation system are firstly given. Then, the evaluation function is established by Kharitonov's Theorem to accurately judge the stability condition of excitation system. Furthermore, the excitation controller parameters are optimized through PSO to achieve the satisfactory transient performances. Finally, experimental results on a real-time digital system (RTDS) test bench have validated the effectiveness of the proposed controller design method.

articleTitle: A Full-Bridge Self-Activated Solid State Fault Current Limiter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a self-activated a solid state fault current limiter (FCL) without monitoring current for the ac power system. The FCL adopts a full-bridge type and utilizes on-state voltage rapidly increase in active area of IGBT to trigger an auxiliary branch, restricting the fault current rate. First, the working process is illustrated and selection of the threshold voltage to operate the FCL is given. Then, a 220kV ac system with the proposed FCL is established in PSCAD, and the effectiveness of the proposed FCL is verified by the simulated results at various fault types.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Multi-Source Data Clustering and Analysis Method for AC/DC Hybrid Power Grid Planning with Increased Complexity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to better analyze the response characteristics of an AC/DC hybrid power grid with increased complexity following various types of disturbances, this paper proposes an intelligent method for clustering dynamic responses of multi-source data obtained from actual measurements or high-fidelity simulators. Base cases for AC/DC hybrid power grid planning students are created first, and a list of high-impact contingencies is searched using a graph algorithm. Then, the electromechanical-electromagnetic hybrid simulation method is adopted to create multi-source simulation data in terms of dynamic voltage, frequency, etc. An unsupervised learning algorithm and cluster analysis are then conducted to extract key features of dynamic response characteristics of the AC/DC hybrid power grid and create specific cluster labels. Advanced analysis, e.g., fast evaluation of risks from multi-source steady-state data, can then be enabled for further analysis. The proposed approach's effectiveness is verified on the actual AC/DC power grid model in East China.

articleTitle: Environmental monitoring system with information transmission and acquisition based on ZigBee and 5G combined technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Air quality is constantly deteriorating with the rapid economic development in the 21st century, and air pollution has changed from the coal-burning pollution to the combined pollution caused by coal-burning, vehicle exhaust emissions and industrial emissions. Environmental air quality has been the key concern of people, in order to protecting people healthy, and it's greatly necessary to build a complete environmental monitoring system outdoors. In fact, most of the current environmental monitoring system at present has some problems such as single or partial utility, poor real-time response, wire communication needed and lag time response, et al. In this research, we integrated all of the monitoring functions such like PM2.5, CO, NO<sup>2</sup>, SO<sup>2</sup>, noise, temperature and humidity which are satisfied with Chinese environmental air quality standard (GB3095-2012) into one whole system, and it makes this monitoring system very convenient and well rounded to use. Especially, we combined ZigBee and 5G technology together, and it shows that this idea exhibit the merits of these two technology to solve the long distant wireless communication and the real time response problems which makes sure that all of the monitoring data can be transmitted to the information center timely and accurately. We used CC2530 chip for the short distance wireless transmission, and the ZigBee wireless sensor network was established by using z-tack protocol stack made by Texas Instruments (TI) Company to achieve short distance acquisition and transmission. Moreover, the a kind of field programmable gate array (FPGA) is adopted to realize long-distance information transmission by heterogeneous network with using EP4CE10F17C8 chip to convert ZigBee data frames into 5G data. The results show that this environmental air quality monitoring system can accurately realize the seven parameters monitoring demand according to the standard of GB3095-2012, and the monitoring data can be obtained by real time, wireless and long distant communication which is a kind of perfect choice for the wide area environmental air quality monitoring work.

articleTitle: Monthly Sectoral Electricity Demand Forecast considering Sector Chain Causal Relations using CCM-TCAN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Economic development highly relies on energy, and the causal relationship among energy demand of different sectors is closely related to the sector chain relationship. The existing researches on sectoral electricity demand lack the research on the causal relationship between sectoral electricity demand, which leads to the weak interpretation of the selected input indicators in the sectoral electricity forecast method. To this end, this paper innovatively adopts the convergence cross mapping algorithm (CCM) to identify the causal relationship of the change of electricity demand in various sectors, adaptively screens the prospective indicators that affect the sectoral electricity demand, and proposes a monthly sectoral electricity forecast method with embedded causality based on the temporal convolutional attention network (TCAN) model. This method can effectively identify the causality of electricity demand between sectors, and effectively improve the accuracy of monthly sectoral electricity demand forecast. Finally, the applicability and effectiveness of the proposed forecast method are illustrated based on the realistic data.

articleTitle: Research On Online Temperature Monitoring Device For Distribution Transformers Based On Intelligent Integration Terminal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Distribution transformers perform energy transmission tasks in the station area.it directly affects the reliability of power supply to users and causes a number of safety problems due to faults during operation. The transformer safety and stability can be ensured by the monitoring of operation status. The hot spot temperature of transformer winding is an important reference index. The load capacity and the thermal aging of insulation materials are determined by the hot spot temperature of transformer winding, the efficiency and economy of transformer operation can be seriously affected. Therefore, the distribution transformer winding temperature monitoring system is studied by this design based on intelligent integration terminal, the real-time monitoring and accurate acquisition of the transformer hot spot temperature can be realized. It has a practical significance to extend the service life and improve the utilization rate of the transformer capacity.

articleTitle: Research on the Protection Probability of Guide Strip by Using the Lightning Attachment Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To assist the lightning shielding design of ships and aircraft, a lightning fractal model is established, but its reliability in the prediction of lightning attachment probability needs to be evaluated. Therefore, a lightning attachment test platform based on a rod-plate air gap is built, and repeated discharges under different test configurations are carried out to investigate the influencing factors of attachment probability. The test results are compared with the simulation results to quantitatively evaluate the reliability of the model. The comparison between the lightning protection probability simulation and test results of the 2 mm HDPE plate under different spacing of the guide strip shows that the trends of the protection rate are basically the same, with the average probability difference being only 11.3%. The test is of certain equivalence with natural lightning, and the proposed lightning fractal model has good reliability in the prediction of lightning protection probability.

articleTitle: A Method for Generating Subsynchronous Oscillation Data of Power System Based on Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With a large number of power electronic devices connected to the power grid, the problem of subsynchronous oscillation caused by the interaction between the converter and the power grid seriously threatens the safe and stable operation of the power system. The existing research methods of subsynchronous oscillation, especially the artificial intelligence methods, mostly rely on a large amount of oscillation data, but in practice, such data is very scarce. Therefore, this paper proposes a method to generate subsynchronous oscillation data in power systems based on Wasserstein generative adversarial network (WGAN). In order to improve the quality of the generated samples and solve the problem of training instability, the JS distance is replaced by Wasserstein distance. Taking the oscillation data in the direct-driven permanent-magnet wind farm system as a practical example, the generated data are analyzed by dynamic time warping (DTW) and frequency to damping ratio methods. The results show that the data generated by the proposed method is consistent with the characteristics of oscillation data and has certain advantages in data quality.

articleTitle: Research on shared heat storage operation in integrated energy system considering refined power-to-gas model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the research work of integrated energy system (IES) with a high proportion of renewable energy, the power-to-gas (PtG) is regarded as the key coupling device to participate in the peak shaving with its energy coupling and storage characteristics. In order to carry out a more accurate system operation strategy and economic evaluation, the physical model of PtG is refined considering the waste reaction heat utilization. On this premise, the possibility building an energy hub with electricity /gas/ heat exchange around PtG is considered. The shared heat storage system (SHSS) is introduced, and the energy sharing between energy networks and SHSS is considered. Then, the distributed day-ahead scheduling model of multiple energy networks around PtG is carried out. Considering the security of information interaction, the alternating direction multiplier method (ADMM) is applied to solve the problem. Finally, the centralized optimization and the distributed optimization are carried out and compared in the case study, and the effect of energy sharing between multiple IESs is verified.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Active Disturbance Rejection Control for Interconnected Power Systems Subject to Hybrid Cyber Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, as renewable energy sources are connected to the grid, the power system continues to expand, making the communication network of power system suffer from communication channel congestion, cyber attacks. In this paper, the proposed event-triggered active disturbance rejection controller (ET-ADRC) is simulated, verified and quantitatively analyzed for two different scenarios of denial-of-service (DOS) attacks, false data injection (FDI) attacks in a multi-area load frequency control (LFC) power system in a three-area power system. The simulation results show that the event-triggered active disturbance control has smaller overshoot, shorter dynamic regulation time, fewer event triggers, and stronger anti-disturbance performance in the three-area load frequency control system than the event-triggered PI (ET-PI), so the ET-ADRC exhibits more bandwidth saving and anti-cyber attack capability in the multi-area load frequency control than the ET-PI. It demostrates the superior performance of load frequency control in multi-area power systems.

articleTitle: Characterization of Disinfection of LTP Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Low-temperature plasma(LTP) has wild applications in biological engineering, especially in regeneration medical science. It is often used in wound healing and has been verified efficient in promoting wound healing of live mice. However, there has been no quantitative analysis of the characteristics of wound, such as area, rating of wound healing. This paper proposed a series of image processing methods to quantify the rate of wound healing in mice. Mice apply the treatment of proper dosage of pulsed LTP, and wound pictures are recorded. It's found that plasma-treated mice have higher wound healing rate after processing wound images with threshold segmentation and morphology and quantitative analysis.

articleTitle: Quick Transient Stability Evaluation Method for Wind-thermal-bundled AC/DC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For wind-thermal-bundled power transmission through AC/DC hybrid system, when the proportion of power transmitted by the AC line is high, the transient instability of voltage and power angle is prone to arise after faults, threatening the system's safe operation. In this paper, an evaluation method is proposed to obtain the transient stability of the system quickly. First, the equivalent models of the synchronous generator, the wind turbine, and the HVDC transmission line are established, and the equivalent circuit model of the transmission system is further obtained. Next, the calculation procedure of the quick evaluation method for transient voltage and power angle is elaborated according to the equivalent circuit model of the system. Finally, the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed evaluation method are verified by comparing it with the result obtained by simulation software.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Spark Discharge Faults by Characteristic Gas Composition Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to internal electric field distortion, SF6-insulated power equipment will generate partial discharge in the operation process. Thus, the operating state of power equipment could be assessed rapidly by the detection of SF6 discharge decomposition products. Semiconductor sensors have enormous advantage of rapid response, small size and high sensitivity, which can be easily integrated in portable equipment. In this paper, a sensor array consisted of 8 commercial semiconductor sensors was employed to detected the SF6 discharge decomposition products. The response-recovery experiments were performed over 12 days to demonstrate the long-term stability. Furthermore, the correlation between sensor response and the discharge types is proved by the two-dimensional t-sne scatter diagram. Ultimately, the classification accuracy of KNN after 10-dimensional features extracting can reach 92.36%. To summarize, this work explored the relationship between sensor response and discharge faults, which also proved the enormous potential for the recognition of SF6 discharge faults.

articleTitle: Ageing Behavior of Epoxy Resin Impregnated Paper under Electrical and Thermal Stress for Wall Bushing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Epoxy resin-impregnated insulating paper is an important insulating material for dry-type Resin-Impregnated Paper (RIP) bushings of converter transformers, and it has been subjected to the combined action of heat and electricity for a long time. In order to study the effect of electrothermal aging on resin-impregnated paper, the main insulating material in dry bushings, Resin-Impregnated Paper samples were subjected to electro-thermal aging tests, and the electrical conductivity and dielectric properties of the aged samples were tested regularly. The results show that with the increase of electrothermal aging time, its volume resistivity shows a decreasing trend and its dielectric constant and dielectric loss value increase. Compared with the single factor effect of electricity and heat, the combined effect of electricity and heat on the volume resistivity and dielectric properties of the material is more significant, and it is greater than the superposition effect of electricity and heat. Electricity and heat mutually enhance the aging effect and have a synergistic effect. As the aging progresses, the volume resistivity decreases, the dielectric constant and dielectric dielectric loss increases which is of great engineering significance for grasping the aging law and evaluating the insulation state of the bushings.

articleTitle: Self-adaptive Emergency Control Strategy of Wind Farm-Level Energy Storage for Improving Frequency Stability of Wind Power Grid-connected System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) cannot participate in system frequency regulation, an self-adaptive emergency control strategy applied to battery energy storage system is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the working principle of the battery energy storage system participating in frequency modulation is introduced. And then a battery control strategy is proposed based on the active-frequency droop control. The strategy is based on adaptive single neuron proportion integration differentiation (PID) controller, and the control parameters in the frequency controller are adjusted online adaptively according to the real-time frequency. Finally, the simulation of wind-storage grid-connected system is carried out, and the maximum absolute frequency difference is introduced to analyze the performance of the control system. The effectiveness of the control strategy is verified in the single-machine infinity and multi-machine systems, and the control effect of the strategy proposed in this paper is better than the fixed-coefficient droop control through comparison.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Current Control for PMSM Considering Current Prediction Errors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Model predictive current control (MPCC) is a typically motor-parameters-dependent method. The change of motor-parameters will bring the error between actual predicted currents and ideal predicted values and thus directly affecting the operation performance of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM). To enhance the control performance of PMSM, an improved MPCC considering current prediction errors (MPCC-CPE) method is proposed. Based on the introduction of conventional MPCC method and the influence of parameter mismatch, MPCC-CPE method is put forward where the current prediction errors are calculated and cost function is updated to choose the optimal voltage vector. Finally, experiments are finished to prove that MPCC-CPE method can significantly circumvent the problem of parameter mismatch and enhance the control performance of PMSM.

articleTitle: Comparison study on underwater bubble dynamics via pulsed discharge and electrical explosion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Pulsed discharge in water is an indispensable method to carry out laboratory simulation of underwater explosion effects and bubble dynamics research, which has attracted more and more attention in recent years. In this paper, discharge characteristics and spatial-temporal evolution behavior of underwater bubbles in needle-needle pulsed discharge and electric explosion of a fine copper wire (<tex>$50\ \mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> in diameter) are compared in detail. High-speed photography and electrophysical diagnostics are applied to characterize dynamic processes. The results indicate that under the condition of 4 J stored energy, the deposition energy of underwater electrical wire explosion can reach 3.83 J (>95 %), which is 10 times higher than that of pulsed discharge under similar stored energy. The peak electric power of electrical wire explosion is 22.65 MW, which is two orders of magnitude higher than the pulsed discharge. Compared with the underwater pulsed discharge, the bubble diameter produced by the underwater electrical wire explosion is larger (the length of copper wire is 1 cm, the maximum diameter of the bubble is 2.64 cm), the expansion rate is faster, and the duration is longer. The bubble morphology generated by underwater pulsed discharge is irregular and influenced by the randomly-developed streamers, whereas the bubble generated by underwater electrical wire explosion exhibits obvious shock wave, explicit gas-liquid boundary, and typical cylindrical-spherical evolution process, close to the case of underwater explosion. In addition, for copper wire electric explosion, the larger the stored energy, the larger the bubble radius and the longer the duration.

articleTitle: Rotor Faults diagnosis in PMSMs Based on Branch Current Analysis and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problem that it is difficult to accurately identify the rotor eccentric fault, demagnetization fault and mixed fault of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) with slot pole ratio of 3/2 and several times of it, this paper proposes a method to identify the rotor fault based on the combination of branch current analysis and machine learning algorithm. First, in this paper, we select the stator branch current fluctuation in time domain without mutual cancellation as the feature of fault classification. Secondly, after signal preprocessing, feature factors are extracted and several fault feature factors with large differences are selected to construct feature vectors. Finally, genetic algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of support vector machine (SVM), and GA-SVM model is constructed as a classifier for multi fault classification of permanent magnet synchronous motor to classify these three types of faults. The fault classification results show that the proposed method using branch current signal combined with GA-SVM can be effectively diagnose faulty PMSM.

articleTitle: Research on Broadband Modeling of Transmission Line Tower Based on Vector Matching Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, the multi-wave impedance model of the tower widely used in lightning protection analysis can not reflect the difference of the induced overvoltage of the transmission lines. Therefore, it is of great significance to carry out the transient modeling of lightning tower. This paper first deduces the fitting process of rational function, then selects the 8th order vector to fit the frequency response of the tower numerical model, and establishes the tower broadband equivalent circuit model based on the passive network synthesis theory and the pole-residue. Then based on CDEGS and ATP-EMTP joint simulation, the validity of the broadband modeling method is verified. Finally, the accuracy and engineering practice value of the broadband model are further verified by the scaled tower experiment.

articleTitle: Power futures dynamic margin research - Based on SPAN system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power futures market is the next stage of the development of the electricity spot market. In the power futures market, we must consider how to deal with the risks brought by the emerging power financial derivatives. Based on the analysis of the principle of dynamic margin system of SPAN (Standard Portfolio Analysis of Risk) futures, we introduced SPAN system into Chinese power futures market, and simulated the parameters by VaR and risk matrix. Then, this paper selects two power futures products of ICE (INTERCONTINENTAL EXCHANGE) for example analysis of this model. The results show that, compared with the current static margin system in China, SPAN futures dynamic margin system can reduce the margin level of power futures products for a long time and reduce the occupancy rate of funds. The dynamic margin system is an important direction for the development of domestic power futures market in the future.

articleTitle: Surface Charge Distribution Characteristics of Epoxy Impregnated Paper Material under DC Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the HVDC project, the insulating material of the dry-type bushing of the converter transformer mainly uses epoxy impregnated paper. Surface charge will accumulate on the surface of the capacitor packet easily under the operating DC electric field. The surface charge will distort the electric field on the surface of the insulating material and it will be a threat to insulation safety. In order to study the surface charge accumulation characteristics of epoxy impregnated paper materials under DC electric field, we conduct surface charge measurement experiments on cylindrical samples of epoxy-impregnated paper with or without two-component polyester coating at room temperature. Its surface charge accumulation properties were obtained by measuring its surface charge characteristics after applying voltage for different time. The result shows that coated samples only accumulate charges of the same polarity as the applied voltage, and surface charge polarity of uncoated sample is as same as the polarity of its high and low voltage electrodes. Coated samples reach stabilization more quickly (The charge density gap rapidly narrows in the measurement result of 1, 3, 5 and 10h), uncoated samples are slower to reach stabilization. The average value of the charge density of the painted sample after taking the absolute value is 3.74 times higher than that of the unpainted sample after applying +26kV voltage at room temperature for 10h, and the average value of the charge density of the painted sample after taking the absolute value is 11.8 times higher than that of the unpainted sample after applying −26kV voltage at room temperature for 10h. For the sample of the same kind, the charge density of the coated sample under negative polarity is higher than that under its positive polarity, the charge density of the coated sample under negative polarity is lower than that under its positive polarity. For uncoated samples, the surface charge distribution is related to the distribution of the adhesive layer and paper layer on the surface, and the charge distribution of the coated sample is relatively even. For analyzing the effect of epoxy impregnated paper coating and optimizing the electric field on the surface of the material, obtaining this charge distribution law has important meaning in engineering.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy for Three-Level Inverters With Unbalanced DC-Link Voltages in the dq0 Coordinate
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When faced with unbalanced dc-link voltages in three-level inverters, the output voltage and current will be distorted if conventional control strategies and modulation schemes are applied. Therefore, in this paper, a control strategy is proposed for three-level inverters with unbalanced dc-link voltages in the dq0 coordinate. Based on the dual-loop control strategy, the unbalancing degree closed-loop is added and feedforward decoupling is adopted to mitigate the interact between different control loops. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed unbalancing degree control strategy is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Analysis of Stator Slot Flux Reverse Machine With Halbach Array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on the conventional flux reverse permanent magnet (FRPM) machine, the stator slot FRPM machine with the iron between the Halbach magnets is proposed and analyzed. Through finite element analysis, the maximum back-electromotive force amplitude is taken as the optimization objective, and the magnet thickness and magnetization angle are taken as the optimization variables to optimize the proposed FRPM machine. Finally, the air gap flux density, back electromotive force, and electromagnetic torque of the proposed machine are compared with those of conventional machine. The results show that the electromagnetic performance of the proposed machine is better than that of the conventional FRPM machine.

articleTitle: Design and Modeling of LCLCL Resonant Converter for Wide Input Range
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: LCLCL resonant converter with characteristics of wide input range and soft switching is proposed in this paper. And this paper analyses the gain characteristics of the converter, establishes the small signal model and designs the digital control scheme. Finally, a 48V/400W prototype is built. The efficiency of the multi-resonant converter is 95.7% under rated conditions.

articleTitle: Improved Model Predictive Control for Vienna Rectifier Based on Sliding Mode Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Vienna rectifier has advantages of low switching stress and high power factor. Based on the Vienna rectifier nonlinear system, a double closed-loop control strategy is proposed, which adopts sequential optimization model predictive control (SOMPC) in the inner loop and sliding mode variable structure control (SMVSC) in the outer loop. Firstly, the mathematical model is established to get the prediction error of grid-connected current and midpoint potential of dc side. Then, the given values of dc voltage and load current of the system are obtained through the outer of sliding mode. Finally, through the model predictive control cost function optimization to get the cost function minimum switch combination, achieved through switching sequence optimization on the system output and the exchange of current and neutral voltage in dc side control swiftly and effectively, realize the Vienna rectifier unit power factor control, stable dc voltage output and neutral voltage balance. Simulation results show the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Motion estimation method of metal particle defect in oil chamber of on-load tap changer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The on-load tap changer is the core component of the transformer. During the operation of the on-load tap changer, the moving and fixed contact system of the switching mechanism collides and closes quickly after the release of the energy storage of the fast mechanism. This violent collision inevitably produces the scattering of metal particle defects. In order to study the influence of metal particles on insulation, it is necessary to carry out the simulation experiment of metal particle defect motion in the oil chamber of on-load tap changer. In order to carry out the experiment effectively, this paper proposes a method to estimate the motion state and rising height of the simulated motion of metal particle defect with the increase of oil flow. The size of metal particle defect and the velocity of oil flow can be used to estimate the rising motion state and maximum height, and reduce the experimental difficulty of the study of metal particle defect motion induced discharge in the oil tank of on-load tap changer.

articleTitle: The Selection and Analysis on Statistical Beacon in the Electric Power Consumption Field
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: China's economic development has entered a “new normal” phase, delivering profound changes in the economic growth rate, structure, and driver. At the same time, the electricity consumption sector has also undergone significant changes. This paper examines the overall situation of electricity consumption in the consumer sector in Yangzhou, China. Based on the statistical results of consumer turnover, the opposite effect is observed in comparison with electricity consumption growth and total retail sale rates. By conducting deep analysis, this paper establishes a beacon user screening system that exploits the correlation of industrial electricity consumption and turnover, based on the electricity consumption of all users in the consumption sector in Yangzhou. It selects those users in each industry with a high correlation between electricity consumption and turnover for key monitoring, constructing a statistical beacon for electricity in the consumption sector in Yangzhou.

articleTitle: Research on Direct Coordinate Vector Modulation Strategy for Matrix-Converter-Based Transforms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To address the issues of high computational complexity and harmonic content associated with Indirect Space Vector Modulation (ISVM) strategy in matrix-converter-based transforms, this paper proposes a Direct Coordinate Vector Modulation (DCVM) strategy based on geometric area calculation. The proposed strategy represents the system input and output voltages in the form of vector coordinates, and converts duty-cycle calculations into triangle area ratio calculations. Unlike traditional modulation strategies, this strategy does not require the introduction of angles and trigonometric functions in duty-cycle calculations, reducing computational complexity. Moreover, the proposed strategy only requires six commutations per modulation cycle, effectively reducing switching losses and improving waveform quality. A simulation model based on Matlab/Simulink is used to compare the proposed strategy with ISVM strategy, verifying that the proposed strategy has the characteristics of fast response and high waveform quality. Finally, experimental results further confirm the feasibility of the DCVM strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Active Disturbance Rejection Control of Outer Rotor Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of heavy load start-up and frequent load changes in the operation of the mine outer rotor permanent magnet synchronous motor (OR-PMSM), an active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) strategy based on parameter identification is proposed in this paper. It can effectively solve the contradictory problem between overshoot and rapidity in the control system, and improve the operating performance of the OR-PMSM. Due to the change of the load state, the change of the moment of inertia will affect the dynamic characteristics of the system. The online identification of the moment of inertia is used to correct the parameters of the ADRC in time. Through the simulation verification, compared with the traditional PID control, the control system can effectively reduce the overshoot, improve the system response speed, and has strong anti-interference ability and stability.

Author Keywords: Outer rotor permanent magnet synchronous motor

articleTitle: Current control of EAST fast control power supply based on single neuron adaptive predictive PI
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak (EAST) is an important device developed by China to realize controllable nuclear fusion. The vertical displacement of plasma is controlled by the current output from EAST fast control power supply. Traditional PI control has shortcomings in current dynamic response. A single neuron adaptive predictive PI (SNAD-PPI) control algorithm is proposed to ensure fast and accurate current output. The adaptive structure is used combined with the single neuron structure to improve the problem of insufficient dynamic response under the control of fixed PI parameters. Advance tracking reference current is used as the adaptive objective function of tutor-supervised learning for setting PI parameters in a single neuron. The proportional adjustment coefficient and the proportional learning rate of single neuron adaptive control are adjusted in real time to realize fast convergence of single neuron. Outstanding current dynamic response performance compare to traditional PI control is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Analysis of 6Hz SSO caused by the interaction between wind turbines and MMC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Recently, 6Hz sub-synchronous oscillation (SSO) in wind farms connected with the modular multilevel converter (MMC) based HVDC has caused wide concern in actual projects. Existing studies mostly consider a single wind turbine connected to MMC-HVDC, which is impossible to reveal the mechanism of 6Hz SSO adequately. Besides, the assessment of the influence of different factors on SSO is qualitative, causing inconvenience to the parameter optimization of the system. Therefore, this paper fully considers the impacts of the types and positions of wind turbines and establishes the model of wind farms integrated with MMC-HVDC based on an actual project. Then the mechanism of 6Hz SSO is studied based on modal and participation factor analyses. Finally, to offer accurate information for parameter optimization of the system, quantitative research on the influence of control parameters of wind turbines and MMC on 6Hz SSO is conducted by sensitivity analysis.

Author Keywords: direct drive permanent magnet synchronous generator (D-PMSG)

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Short Circuit Faults in Generator Excitation Winding Based on Torque Comparison Principle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For safe operation, it is necessary to monitor short circuit fault in excitation winding online. As the short circuit fault causes loss of excitation magnetomotive force, it can be assumed that the excitation winding is still normal, based on the relationship between excitation magnetomotive force and electromagnetic power, the conclusion that the expected electromagnetic torque is bigger than the actual electromagnetic torque after a short circuit fault can be got. Then the conclusion was verified using a generator 2D finite element model. This method does not rely on massive historical operating data, real-time operating data can be used to determine a short circuit fault, and quasi real time performance can be achieved, the developing trend of the fault can also be presented.

articleTitle: Cooperative Operation Method of Multi-micro-grids Power-Sharing Based on Nash Bargaining
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Researching an energy system featuring efficient use of renewable energy and low-carbon operation of the power system will be an essential direction for constructing the energy internet. This paper builds a micro-grid model of electricity, heat, and gas coupling, which considers carbon allowances and carbon trading to reduce carbon emissions by adding the CHP unit's CCS and P2G systems. It constructs a model of cooperative operation of power-sharing across multi-micro-grids by combining Nash bargaining theory, which converts to the sub-problems of coalition profit maximization and cooperative profit distribution. To solve the problems in a distributed fashion, the alternating direction method of multipliers is used, effectively protecting each subject's privacy. The simulation results prove that the method has good convergence characteristics and effectively improves the proceeds of each micro-grid.

articleTitle: An novel integrated optimization approach for reconfiguring distribution network with distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a modified immune particle swarm optimization (MIPSO) algorithm and a new voltage stability difference index (VSDI) to solve distribution network reconfiguration (DNR) and distributed generation (DG) allocation problems, whose objectives are to reduce total real power loss, enhance the voltage stability and improve the voltage profile of a distribution system. The VSDI is put forward to determine the most sensitive buses to voltage collapse as candidate installation buses of DG allocation. The proposed MIPSO algorithm and VSDI are applied to IEEE 33- and 69-bus distribution systems considering eight different scenarios, and the obtained results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed MIPSO algorithm and VSDI on solving DNR and DG allocation problems of the distribution system.

articleTitle: Hybrid control strategy and parameter optimization of CLLC resonant converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As a key circuit connecting energy storage unit and DC bus, bi-directional dc/dc converter is widely used in electric vehicles, rail trains and energy storage systems. Due to the influence of voltage fluctuation and power regulation, bi-directional dc/dc generally requires to work in a wide voltage range, which poses a severe challenge to its efficiency. CLLC resonant converter has the same bi-directional transmission characteristics, and can achieve soft switching in the full load range, with very high efficiency. On the basis of this circuit topology, the full bridge and half bridge phase shift frequency conversion hybrid control mode adopted in this paper can further broaden the applicable voltage range of the converter without adding auxiliary circuits and other components. This paper studies this control mode and the selection of its switching point, and analyzes the problems of parameter design and device selection under this hybrid control mode. Finally, the effectiveness of this hybrid control strategy is verified by MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Lightning Intrusion Wave Characteristics in Converter Station of Flexible Low Frequency Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Lightning strikes low-frequency transmission line towers or lightning protection lines, in addition to causing flashover of transmission line insulators, part of the lightning energy will invade the interior of the converter station along the wires in the form of overvoltage waves, causing damage to the insulation of key equipment in the station. In this paper, using the electromagnetic transient simulation program for a low- frequency project in Hangzhou, the electromagnetic transient model including the converter station and the incoming section of the transmission line is established, and the simulation research on the transient process of lightning intrusion wave is carried out. The lightning overvoltage at the key equipment, the simulation results show that the lightning overvoltage amplitude at the key equipment is up to 536.29kV when the intrusion wave is shielded under the existing arrester configuration, which will not affect the converter station equipment and counter the intrusion wave The dangerous lightning current amplitude reaches 140kA, and after installing a controllable arrester (controllable ratio 20%), the back-flashover dangerous lightning current amplitude increases to 348kA, which can effectively ensure the safe operation of the equipment in the converter station. The research results provide guidance for the overvoltage and insulation coordination scheme of the converter station.

articleTitle: SOH Estimation of Lithium-ion Battery Based on Energy Features and WOA-XGBoost Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries have been widely used in various energy storage systems. To ensure the system's stable operation, it is necessary to accurately estimate the state of health (SOH) of lithium-ion batteries. Aiming at the problems of low practicability and weak generalization ability of traditional methods, we propose a SOH estimation method for lithium-ion batteries based on whale optimization algorithm and extreme gradient boosting (WOA-XGBoost) model. Firstly, we select two energy-based features by studying the relationship between the capacity degradation of lithium-ion battery and the changing trend of voltage and current during charging. On the other hand, we use WOA to optimize the parameters of XGBoost and introduce data incremental update mechanism to improve the generalization ability of the WOA-XGBoost model. The proposed method is verified on NASA data sets. Experiments show that the proposed method has minor estimation errors and strong generalization ability.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Partial Transmission Network Reconfiguration in Power Grid Equipment Maintenance Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the impact of transmission equipment maintenance on power grid security and measures resources, this paper studies the feasibility of applying partial transmission network reconfiguration in maintenance scenarios. Based on the DC power flow model, a partial reconfiguration optimization model of transmission network is constructed. Taking the branch switching cost as the main objective and considering the system loss comprehensively. The constraints consider the influence of power flow over-limit under the condition based on maintenance and expected faults. In order to improve the computational efficiency and avoid the dimension explosion problem in the conventional optimization model, this paper also proposes a strategy by limiting the set of switchable branches to reduce the number of integer variables and eliminate redundant constraints in the model, thereby reducing the scale of the model solution. Finally, the effectiveness is verified by testing a provincial power grid model. It means that the method proposed has practical significance for improving the enforceability and efficiency of maintenance scheduling.

articleTitle: Research on Wireless Power Transmission Based on Electromagnetic Metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To address the low efficiency in magnetic coupling resonant wireless energy transfer, utilization of negative magnetic permeability of electromagnetic metamaterials is proposed to increase transmission efficiency and distance. The circuit model of magnetic coupling resonant wireless energy transfer system was first established and theoretical derivations showed that the transmission medium can impact efficiency. The wireless energy transfer system was constructed in practice, and by comparing the received energy at the load with and without electromagnetic metamaterials, it was concluded that the latter enhances wireless energy transfer efficiency. This study advances the pursuit of real wireless energy transfer.

articleTitle: Calculation Method of Short Circuit Current of Collecting Line for Wind Farm with Energy Storage under Three Phase Short Circuit Fault
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Crowbar protection can make doubly-fed induction generator(DFIG) realize low voltage crossing when the system short-circuit fault occurs. Usually, the crowbar protection will act after a delay of a certain period of time after the fault occurs. Ignoring the effect of action delay will bring errors to the analysis of short-circuit current. In this paper, the transient process after three-phase short-circuit fault is divided into three stages according to the sequence of crowbar protection work. Based on stator rotor flux analysis, the calculation method of short-circuit current at the exit of single typhoon generator unit is given, and the relationship between the short-circuit current at the exit of single typhoon generator unit and the short-circuit current at the gathering line is further analyzed after the short-circuit fault at the gathering line in the wind farm. Finally, the calculation method of three-phase short circuit current at the collecting line in energy storage wind farm is analyzed. A test system was built on the Matlab/Simulink platform, and the short-circuit current of the single turbine and the gathering line was verified respectively under the conditions of the geographical location distribution and wind speed of wind turbines in different wind farms.

articleTitle: Design Of Isolated Gate Driver For Low Power Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Isolated gate drivers are widely adopted for half-bridge, full-bridge and dual boost AC-DC converters for power conversion in low power electromagnetic energy harvesting, in which efficiency is of great importance. However, commercial isolated gate drivers were all designed for higher voltage and higher power applications, which brought severe power consumptions at low power scenario. Aim at low power loss and simple driver architecture, this paper proposes two low power isolated driver circuits based on the transformer and the bootstrap capacitor respectively. The detailed design and loss analysis are carried out. The paper elaborates the design method and scope of application. The prototypes of the two isolated gate drivers are also built to verify the effectiveness on the experimental platform.

articleTitle: Improved Multiobjective Optimization for Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A multiobjective optimization model for IPMSM is innovatively proposed. To achieve simultaneous improvements in multiphysics performance, magneto-thermal coupling characteristics are considered in this model. First, in the sample data collection stage, segmented orthogonal experiments and correlation analysis are introduced to improve optimization efficiency. After that, a neural network algorithm optimized is selected to ensure the model prediction accuracy. Further, the optimal design scheme is obtained by an improved non-dominated sorting GA.
