Finally, a comprehensive comparative analysis including electromagnetic characteristics and temperature rise performance is implemented through finite element method (FEM) and computational fluid dynamics (CFD). The validity of proposed optimization model is excellently verified.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Sequential Topology Optimization Method of Interior PM machine Based on NGnet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-objective sequential topology optimization method (MSTOM) for interior permanent magnet (IPM) machines based on normalized Gaussian network (NGnet). Its methodology is mainly composed of global topology coarse optimization, design region reduction, local topology fine optimization and postprocessing successively. This method can alleviate the computation burden and promote the optimization efficiency. For machine topology structure quality, a postprocessing method called NGnet-oriented topology optimization mending postprocessing (NTOMP) is further introduced to guarantee a complete, connected and smooth optimized topology. Furthermore, the foregoing methods have been illustrated by a typical topology optimization example with an IPM machine. Finally, the feasibility, reliability and effectiveness of MSTOM have been confirmed by the optimization results of this machine case study, which is portable to other similar topology optimization scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Commutation Failure Suppression Strategy for Receiving-End Hybrid LCC-VSC Based on Reactive Power Clamp Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Commutation failure is one of the common faults in line commutated converter based high voltage direct current (LCC-HVDC). In the receiving-end hybrid LCC-voltage source converter (VSC) system, the commutation failure of LCC can be restrained by making use of the VSC. A novel commutation failure suppression strategy based on reactive power clamp control is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the topology and characteristics of LCC-VSC system are introduced. Secondly, the mechanism of VSC to suppress the commutation failure of LCC is studied. In case of faults, the maximum reactive power setting of VSC is clamped to suppress the commutation failure of the LCC, the commutation failure immune factor and commutation failure probability index are improved. Finally, a receiving-end hybrid LCC-VSC model is built in PSCAD / EMTDC for simulation analysis. The simulation results show that the control strategy can significantly improve the ability of LCC-HVDC to withstand commutation failure and improve the system fault recovery characteristics.

articleTitle: Study on the Performance Degradation of an Ejected-Plasma-Triggered SF6 Gas Gap for 10-kV Smart Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The plasma injection driven by pulse transformer could trigger the gas gap conduction at extremely low operation coefficients, and it was a potential technology to realize the rapid control and protection of the 10-kV smart distribution network which required high potential isolation, but the stability of trigger performance remained to be further studied. In this paper, the degradation of plasma jet trigger performance in high pressure SF<inf>6</inf> was studied, focusing on the trigger voltage, current and gap conduction delay. The result showed that under the action of 2kV, the SF<inf>6</inf> gas switch with 4kV gap voltage was successfully triggered 804 times continuously, and the range of the conduction delay was 80-120µs, as the number of triggering increased, the ablation of the trigger cavity increased, and the conduction delay increased gradually. Based on the research, the performance monitoring method and life change rule of the plasma injection driven by the pulse transformer was mastered, which was of great significance for its application in engineering and life improvement.

articleTitle: Influence of Voltage Frequency and Filler Content on Breakdown Characteristics of Epoxy Resin
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Epoxy resins have great potential for insulation of power electronic transformers due to their high dielectric properties and strong corrosion resistance. In the long-term operation of power equipment, epoxy resin will undergo insulation aging, and electrical treeing is the main way of its insulation aging, and electrical trees will gradually develop to complete breakdown. In practice, epoxy resins with fillers are often used as insulating materials. In order to study the breakdown characteristics of epoxy resin/Al<inf>2</inf>O<inf>3</inf> composites, a experimental platform for measuring the breakdown voltage of epoxy resin composites was established in this paper, and the effects of frequency and filler content on the breakdown properties of epoxy resin/ Al<inf>2</inf>O<inf>3</inf> composites under 50-2000Hz AC voltage were investigated. The results show that with the increase of frequency, the breakdown voltage decreases gradually, and the breakdown voltage has a threshold value; the breakdown voltage of composites shows a trend of first increasing and then decreasing with the increase of filler content.

articleTitle: Fully Decentralized DC Optimal Power Flow Model And Its Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the fact that renewable energy power generations such as wind and solar energy have been integrated into the power system in a high proportion in a distributed manner, driven by factors such as privacy and security of various power supply stakeholders, the power supply of the power system presents a decentralized management and control situation, making the traditional centralized DC optimal power flow difficult to achieve. In this paper, a fully decentralized DC optimal power flow model, its solution method and application are proposed. Firstly, based on the economic dispatch model of the traditional consensus algorithm, the node phase decentralized calculation method is established and the active power flow decentralized calculation method of the transmission line is given to determine the system overload line. Secondly, the improved Lagrangian optimal model of the centralized DC optimal power flow is proposed and the optimization equations are derived. Thirdly, on this basis, combined with the improved traditional consensus algorithm, the fully distributed DC optimal power flow model and its solution method are realized. Finally, a real system is taken as an example to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Vibration Monitoring System of the Rotor with Liquid Based on Qt
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to realize the measurement and real-time monitoring of the vibration signal of the hydro-generator evaporative cooling rotor model with liquid, a monitoring system capable of real-time feedback of rotor vibration signal changes is designed. The hardware design and software design of the system is carried out. The software part uses the Qt framework to receive, process, analyze, display, and store the transmitted data based on the idea of multi-threaded programming. After experimental testing, the system meets the requirements of measurement accuracy and can achieve rapid response to vibration signal changes.

articleTitle: Analysis of voltage loop bandwidth and control delay effects on the stability of VSG grid-connected system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Virtual synchronous generator (VSG) technology can support grid voltage and frequency, and can keep stable in weak grid conditions, which has a very wide application prospect, and it is crucial to ensure its stability during grid-connected operation. When VSG is connected to the grid, the bandwidth of the internal voltage loop is usually constrained by the system switching frequency and current loop bandwidth, and VSG is implemented by digital control technology, which has common control delay problems, both of which affect the stability and dynamic characteristics of the system. Therefore, this paper analyzes the effect of delay time and voltage loop bandwidth on the stable operation of VSG by establishing a state space model of VSG grid-connected system with control delay. Firstly, a complete state space model of VSG grid-connected system is established in this paper. Then, with the help of characteristic root trajectories and participation factors analysis, the effects of delay time and voltage loop bandwidth on system are evaluated. The analysis results show that low voltage loop bandwidth and large delay time can reduce the stability and dynamic characteristics of the system, and excessive voltage loop bandwidth can increase oscillation frequency in the system. Finally, simulation results shows the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: The Approach for Suppressing Intrinsic Shaft Voltage by Segmented Skewed Poles in Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The intrinsic shaft voltage caused by the disequilibrium of magnet circuit in permanent magnet synchronous motors(PMSMs) will damage the bearing seriously. In order to suppress the intrinsic shaft voltage preferably, it is necessary to analyze the characteristics of intrinsic shaft voltage qualitatively. Following the magnetic-circuit method and Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction, an analytical model of intrinsic shaft voltage has been proposed. The analytical model can clearly show the harmonic components of intrinsic shaft voltage and the relationship between intrinsic shaft voltage and electromagnetic parameters, which is an important precondition for suppressing intrinsic shaft voltage. Considering the influence of segmented skewed poles, the analytical mode can calculate the optimal number of segmented slices and skew angle, which can successfully avoid intrinsic shaft voltage. In order to testifies the efficacy of the analytical model, the amplitudes and harmonic frequencies are calculate by finite element method (FEM). The results received by the analytical model agree well with the FEM result, which proves the precision of the analytical model.

articleTitle: A Universal Control Strategy Enabling 1-ph/3-ph Operation for Three-Phase Four-Wire PFC Rectifier in On-Board Chargers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To enable operation with both three-phase and single-phase power grid, three-phase (3-ph) four-wire power factor correction rectifiers (PFCs) are widely used for on-board chargers. Conventionally, the PFC rectifier is regulated with three independent boost modes for the three-phase operation, while with totem-pole mode for the single-phase (1-ph) one. The control structure for the 1-ph/3-ph are different, which leads to additional effort for the control design. In this work, a universal control strategy enabling 1-ph/3-ph operations for three-phase four-wire PFC rectifiers is proposed. When switching to the single-phase operation, the third phase is modulated with the switching frequency, which is able to regulate the current distribution between the phase and neutral line. As a result, the current stress on the cables and power devices can be balanced, leading to a more efficient design. Besides, the voltage feedforward and deadtime compensation are also considered to improve the dynamics and increase the input power quality. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed control strategy is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Research and development of high-power power conversion system 630kW PCS System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the interface between the power grid and the battery, the power conversion system(PCS) can realize the energy exchange between the battery system and the power grid by controlling the charging and discharging process of the battery, and can also directly supply power to the AC load in the case of no grid. This paper takes T -type three-level energy storage converter as the research object, studies its control strategy, and develops a 630kW high-power energy storage converter experimental device according to the design principles of industrial devices, realizing the stable and off-grid operation of the energy storage converter.

articleTitle: A Reliable Packaging Design for 1200-V, 500-A SiC Half-bridge Modules with Junction Temperature over 200 °C
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a reliable packaging design for high-temperature SIC power modules. The packaging materials used in this package are able to maintain excellent mechanical and electrical characteristics at a temperature of at least 200°C. This is a necessary condition for the modules to be able to be used at high temperatures for a long time. The package also uses many advanced packaging processes, such as pressed silver sintering and ultrasonic soldering. These processes not only improve the reliability of the interconnect, but also improve the electrical and thermal conductivity at the soldered joints. On the basis of the processes and materials, the researchers expanded the effective heat dissipation area on the substrate by expanding the chip spacing to weaken the cross thermal coupling effect between the chips during operation. To verify the effectiveness of this measure, the researchers proposed two chip layout solutions, A and B, and simulated the thermal distribution on the substrate surface using finite element simulation tools. The simulation results prove that the measure can significantly reduce the chip temperature. In addition to temperature, the substrate layout also takes into account stress and parasitic parameters. Eventually, the researchers assembled and tested the modules, and the testing results showed that the modules could operate at a temperature of at least 200°C for a long time.

articleTitle: Solar Resource Zoning Method Considering Spatial and Temporal Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the context of climate change, the share of global renewable energy generation continues to grow. The flexible supply and demand balance of the system has become a central planning and operational concern, which places greater demands on the integrated management of solar resources. In planning, modelling only individual plants is computationally complex because of the large number of photovoltaic (PV) plants and their widely distributed locations. A model for zoning solar resources considering spatial and temporal characteristics is established in this paper. The annual irradiance eigenvectors are used as clustering indicators in each spatial area grid. K-means clustering is performed after determining the optimal number of clusters using the Davis-Boldin criterion. Using satellite data collected from 1987 to 2016 in a province of China as the research object, generation density was used to verify the effectiveness of the method and process.

articleTitle: Adaptive Resonant Extended State Observer Based Traction Control Method for LSM Considering the Influence of Suspension System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The high-speed maglev train is driven by the long stator linear synchronous motor (LSM). High-performance synchronous motor control and high-precision suspension control are the pivotal technologies to achieve stable operation of the maglev train. However, the levitation electromagnet is also the excitation magnetic pole of the linear motor, which leads to the serious nonlinear coupling between traction and levitation force. This paper established the mathematical model of the electromagnet and analyzed the impact of the suspension system on the traction system. Then the mathematical model of LSM considering the influence of the suspension system is built. To suppress the traction fluctuation and disturbance, a traction control method based on adaptive resonant extended state observer(RESO) is presented. The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy effectively suppresses the traction fluctuation caused by the suspension system, and improves the anti-disturbance ability and dynamic performance of the maglev train.

articleTitle: Electricity Theft Detection Based on SMOTE Oversampling and Logistic Regression Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Many countries are starting to construct the smart grid (SG) due to it creates a reliable, clean, and efficient power system compared to the traditional power grid. However, electricity theft can be harmful to grid operators, smart meter data from the Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) can be tampered by thieves by using advanced digital instruments or cyber attacks to reduce electricity bills, which can have devastating financial consequences for utilities. The performance of the existing detection algorithm is influenced by the serious imbalance of data categories. In this paper, a Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) oversampling is employed to solve the imbalance problem, so the processed data and normal data can achieve a relative balance, and select logistic regression algorithm for power theft detection.

articleTitle: Research on Generation and Reduction of Typical Operation Scenarios in Virtual Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing demand for energy security and the improvement of environmental protection requirements, the output of wind power and photovoltaic power generation has shown the characteristics of large fluctuations and high volatility, and its output uncertainty has become a key issue affecting the safe and stable operation of the power system. This paper summarizes the inherent characteristics of new energy in virtual power plants, such as randomness, volatility and intermittency. At the same time, the statistical change rules of its intra-day, intra-day and seasonal data are analyzed, the output of various types of energy is studied, and the typical scene set of the virtual power plant is generated through a large amount of historical data, and the scene reduction is carried out using the rapid generation and elimination technology of probability distance. Simulation results show that the scenario generation reduction method proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the amount of calculation and workload, and the scenario sampling generation and reduction technology is used to deal with the uncertainty of wind power and photovoltaic power generation output, forming a classic scenario with probability information.

articleTitle: Research on Accurate Calculation of Substation Engineering Quantity Based on GIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: State Grid Corporation is gradually carrying out 3D design of power transmission and transformation projects, establishing a 3D design technology system for power transmission and transformation projects, and applying 3D GIM results in the digital design stage of substations to cost control management and other processes, which can improve the management capabilities of power grid substations.3D design embodies the characteristics of visualization and collaboration of digital design technology. With the further promotion and application of 3D digital technology, more and more projects will adopt such technology, which will promote the construction of power grids into a new future.According to the research objectives, this paper formulates the overall research technology route, sorts out and transforms the data of the GIM design results, lays a data foundation for the subsequent development work, and carries out the development of the engineering cost control platform. The analysis and summary of the test results verifies the applicability of the development results.

articleTitle: An Identification Method for Sequence Impedance Model of DFIG Based on the Joint of Knowledge Driving and Data Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Impedance based stability analysis is an effective tool to study broadband oscillation in power system. However, the analytical modeling process of impedance of renewable energy equipment is complex, and the impedance acquisition method based on data measurement has the defects of time-consuming and inconvenience for online measurement. In order to solve the above problems, an impedance identification method based on the joint of knowledge driving and data driving for Doubly-Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) is proposed. First, the small-signal model of DFIG is established based on knowledge-driven, acquiring the variables with nonlinear relationship with sequence impedance. Then, the Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) model is trained based on data driving to realize the identification of DFIG's sequence impedance under multiple operating conditions. Finally, the experiment on CHIL (Control-hardware-in-loop) is carried out to verify the accuracy of the XGBoost model.

articleTitle: Optimization of Grounding Structure and Parameters of Three-core Submarine Cable Sheath Circulating Suppression
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The circulation of submarine cable sheath will reduce the ampacity of the submarine cable and greatly shorten the service life of the cable. In this paper, a grounding structure and submarine cable sheath circulation calculation simulation model are presented to suppress the circulation of the three-core submarine cable sheath, and an optimization method for solving the series resistance value in the grounding structure is proposed under the premise of ensuring that the voltage along the induced voltage of the three-phase sheath of the submarine cable meets the requirements. Taking a 13km long three-core submarine cable system as an example, the simulation model and optimization method of the cable grounding structure in this paper are used to give the optimized series resistance value, and the calculation results of the sheath circulation model of the submarine cable in this paper and the results of PSCAD/EMPTC software show that the sheath circulation is reduced by nearly 30% compared with the previous grounding form. It can be seen that the grounding structure and parameter optimization method for suppressing the circulation of three-core submarine cable sheath given in this paper and the correctness and feasibility of the calculation model of submarine cable sheath circulation.

articleTitle: Electric field strength distribution on the surface of contact network insulators for railroads under rainfall environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the rainfall environment, the electric field strength on the contact network insulator surface is distorted, which is detrimental to the normal operation of the high-speed railroads power system. To study the correlation between water droplets and insulator electric field characteristics, the electric field distribution on the surface of contact network insulators was simulated in multi-physics field simulation software. The effects of different water droplet parameters on the electric field distortion characteristics of the contact network insulator surface were analyzed with the electric field distortion rate as the evaluation criterion. The results showed that the presence of water droplets caused a severe distortion of the electric field. The water droplet spacing has the greatest effect on the distortion characteristics of the electric field, which is about 275%. Therefore, it is of great importance to analyze the influence of water droplets on the insulator surface on the field strength distribution under the rainfall environment.

articleTitle: A BP Neural Network Based Optimization Strategy to Suppress the Vibration of Power Electronic Transformer under DAB
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The vibration of Power Electronic Transformer(PET) is the result of the strong coupling of electric, magnetic and mechanical fields, showing highly-nonlinear characteristics. At present, there is no suitable vibration suppression strategy for PET. Under dual active bridge(DAB) topology, this paper proposes a novel method to predict the PET vibration by using BP neural network with double hidden layers. Experimental results validate that this method has high accuracy for vibration fitting of PET. Based on this neural network, the phase-shift angle corresponding to minimum vibration is found in the triple phase-shift(TPS) mode of DAB. Compared with common SPS, EPS and DPS at the same transmission power level, the optimized method could reduce the vibration amplitude at the key frequency by 24.06dB, 23.32dB and 21.11dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Investigation of Stator Spoke-Type Permanent Magnet Machine Considering Different Slot and Pole Combinations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents the slot design procedure and performance evaluation of a stator spoke-type (SSTPM) machine by combing the distinct advantages of simple rotor, good thermal management in stator permanent magnet (PM) machine, and flux-concentrating effect in spoke-type structure. In addition, since the PMs are located between the adjacent stator tooth tips, the parallel magnetic circuit relation between PM and armature reaction fields permits excellent demagnetization withstand capability of magnets. Firstly, the machine topology and operating principle are introduced, respectively. Afterwards, the feasible stator and rotor pole combinations for the proposed SSTPM machine are discussed. The electromagnetic performance of SSTPM machines with selected slot/pole combinations are evaluated and compared by using finite-element (FE) method. Finally, a 12/14-stator/rotor pole SSTPM machine prototype is manufactured and tested to verify the FE analysis.

articleTitle: Multi-criteria Fusion Method for Line Selection of Single-phase-to-ground Fault with Small Current based on GRU Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on the GRU neural network model, a multi-criteria fusion method of fault line selection for small current grounding system is proposed. In the experiment, using MATLAB/Simulink to build the small current grounding fault simulation model, using Fourier transform and Wavelet packet decomposition to obtain the data of the fundamental component, the fifth harmonic component and the wavelet energy component of various fault types, then input the data into the trained fault line selection model of GRU neural network to verify the feasibility and validity of this selection method.

articleTitle: Generalized Predictive Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Super Twisting Sliding Mode Observer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To reduce the influence of motor parameter perturbation and external load perturbation on the mechanical characteristics of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) and improve the systems' anti-disturbance ability, proposes a method based on a super twisting algorithm (STA). A sliding mode observer (SMO) can realize real-time observation of disturbances and convert the observed disturbances into currents for feed-forward compensation to quadrature-axis currents. On the basic, combined with the fast response characteristics of generalized predictive control (GPC), a speed controller based on GPC was designed. The research results show that the introduction of a super twisting algorithm sliding mode observer (STA-SMO) in the speed closed loop can decrease the influence of internal parameter changes and external load disturbances on the motor control performance and improve the robustness of the system. Finally, the good dynamic and static performance and robustness of PMSM with generalized predictive control based on super twisting sliding mode observer is verified by simulation analysis, which is suitable for occasions with complex operating conditions and frequent start-stop and speed regulation.

articleTitle: Hybrid AC/DC Microgrid Reconstruction in Rural Low-Voltage Distribution Grids to Enhance Electric Vehicle Penetration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, an easy-to-implement hybrid microgrid reconstruction scheme is proposed to enhance EV penetration in traditional rural low-voltage distribution grids. Unlike the traditional grid update solution, the introduced scheme reuses the existing transformers and power lines, and based on the energy routing unit (ERU), the AC distribution grid is converted to a hybrid microgrid. A prominent power transfer capacity increase and power loss reduction via hybrid microgrid reconstruction are quantified. Moreover, considering the efficiency characteristics of transformers and ERU, a power coordination strategy is designed to achieve optimal power dispatching between two feeders. The case study demonstrates that the maximum EV penetration in the reconstructed architecture could reach 352%, which is significantly superior to that in the traditional AC networks. Moreover, the overall efficiency and load ratio increase is realized under the reconstructed architecture.

articleTitle: Three-stage optimization model of medium and long-term contract energy decomposition considering equilibrium of carbon emissions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The decomposition of medium and long-term contracts is one of the key links for the multi-time scale power markets. As the requirements of carbon emissions are gradually stricter, the contract decomposition results of power generation enterprises such as coal-fired units impact on the carbon emissions to a certain content. Given this background, a three-stage optimization decomposition model for medium and long-term trading electricity considering the equilibrium of contract completion schedule and the equilibrium of carbon emissions is proposed in this paper. The model is divided into three stages as the annual, monthly and daily contract energy decomposition sub-models, which can decompose the medium and long-term contract energy into each period of the operation day. Especially, the annual decomposition sub-model considers the equilibrium of contract completion schedule and carbon emissions, and then two objective functions are proposed for optimization. Finally, case studies on a power system with three coal-fired units and two gas-fired units are performed to verify the effectiveness of the model. The results show that the proposed decomposition model could help to decompose the annual contract energy to trading curves of units, as well as achieve the target of carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Market mechanism involving Carbon Trading of Integrated Energy System based on Stackelberg game
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Integrated energy system (IES) is essential to achieving carbon neutrality and carbon peaking. However, the IES has a complex structure and multi-agent characteristics, so it must rely on reasonable market mechanisms to realize the large-scale application. This paper proposed the multi-agent market mechanism of the IES based on game theory. Firstly, the mathematical model of the system considering carbon trading is developed. Next, the market mechanism between the supply and demand sides is designed under the framework of the Stackelberg game and then solved by a self-designed hierarchical algorithm. The results show that the proposed method achieves the low carbon and economic operation of the IES.

articleTitle: Control Strategy of Voltage Active Support and Fault Current Suppression in AC System of MMC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The application of fully controlled insulated gate bipolar transistors as commutation devices and the voltage source converters constituted by them in power systems has produced and promoted the development of flexible direct current transmission technology. Considering the fragility of power electronic devices, if a short-circuit fault occurs in the HVDC system, the resulting overcurrent may damage the power electronic devices. This paper proposes a control strategy for flexible DC operation, which can realize active support for AC voltage and suppress fault short-circuit current. Finally, a simulation verification platform is built based on PSCAD/EMTDC. The simulation results show that the control method proposed in this paper can effectively achieve the expected control objectives and ensure the stable operation of the system.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of MMC grid-connected systems based on Floquet theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When considering the internal dynamics of the modular multilevel converter, the multi-frequency frequency coupling problem cannot be ignored, which complicates the modeling process. Compared with other modeling methods, the method using linear time-periodic modeling can preserve each frequency component and take into account the frequency coupling effect, and its stability can be discriminated by Floquet theory. In this paper, the linear time-periodic model of modular multilevel converter grid-connected system is established, and a selection method of period parameters when finding the Monodromy matrix is given. The analysis results show that increasing the short-circuit ratio, decreasing the delay time and the phase-locked loop integration factor can make the system stable when considering the time delay, while for the phase-locked loop scale factor and the current loop scale factor both large or small may make the system unstable. Finally, a simulation model is built in MATLAB/Simulink to verify the analysis results.

articleTitle: A Noval Electromagnetic Generator with Spring Amplification Structure for Vibration Energy Harvesting of Power Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The vibration with frequency of 100Hz is widely distributed in the power equipment, and this may provide a new method to supply energy for sensors by vibration energy harvesting. However, the vibration acceleration in power equipment is usually small. Meanwhile, the energy harvesting efficiency of existing vibration energy harvesters is low under small acceleration, resulting in limited practical application. Therefore, the vibration law of the two-degree-of-freedom system is studied, and an elastic amplification structure is proposed based on the spring and cantilever structure. Then, based on the electromagnetic generator (EMG), an electromagnetic generator with spring amplifier (S-EMG) was fabricated. Comparing with EMG, S-EMG could provide output voltage and power of 11.45V and 34.88mW (matched resistance is <tex>$100\Omega$</tex>) at an acceleration of 5m·s<sup>−2</sup>, which is 136% higher than the output power of general EMG. The 100mF capacitor could be charged to 3.74V within 300s, which is 44% higher than EMG. Besides, S-EMG can continuously drive a commercial wireless temperature/humidity sensor to send the signal to a mobile phone via Bluetooth.

articleTitle: Hardware Design of Micro PV - Battery System for Underwater Wireless Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The wireless power transfer technology has gradually been widely used for charging and discharging low-voltage electronic products. The electric energy transmission underwater has been a difficult problem, so that the wireless power transfer technique will be a good solution for the underwater system. At present, this paper tries to build a system using solar photovoltaic panels and battery as the power sources for the wireless power transfer system to realize the underwater power supply system. The whole power converter stage, driver and control system are designed and built. At last the designed PV and battery power supply system is tested by the conducted platform. The experimental results verify the correctness and effectiveness of the designed system.

articleTitle: Research on mechanical properties of pressboard structure for transformer under compression with different mechanical stress loading parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High density pressboard made of cellulose is a crucial component of power transformers because it combines good mechanical and electrical insulation properties that are well suited to power transformer design requirements. It is critical to characterize the mechanical properties of pressboards under various operating conditions in order to ensure a properly functioning transformer. In this paper, the stress-strain curves for pressboards with different total thickness and different mechanical stress loading parameters were studied. According to the fitting curves obtained by the tests, it can be found that the value of the strain of the thinner pressboards is 0.05 larger than that of the thicker pressboards under the same stress. In addition, the different loading speeds will affect the deformation of the pressboards. The faster loading speed in the range considered in this paper, the larger strain of the pressboards is. Through analysis, the relationship between the nonlinear coefficient of the mechanical properties of the pressboards and the deformation strength of the winding is a power exponential distribution.

articleTitle: High Performance Sensorless Control Strategy of IPMSM Drives Based on High Frequency Square-Wave Voltage Injection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the dynamic performance of sensorless Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (IPMSM) position observation at low speeds, this paper proposes a position error extraction method based on Luenberger observer and combined with deadbeat predictive current control (DPCC) strategy. To improve the robustness of the position observation, a high frequency square-wave voltage is injected into the d-axis to generate a high frequency current signal with position information. Then the actual current is subtracted from the observed signal to obtain the high frequency current error. The motor position information is calculated by position error decoupling and phase-locked loop. To improve the rapidity of the current loop, a DPCC strategy is adopted to obtain the predicted value of the motor current using the observer. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed control method can reduce the overshoot of position observation error and the dynamic performance of the motor controller is improved.

articleTitle: Effect of Electric Fields on the Initial Corrosion Behaviour of Carbon Steel at Different Chloride Salt Concentrations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The effect of electric field on metal corrosion under two different concentrations of NaC1 corrosion solutions of 20 g/L and 100 g/L was studied, and the experimental results were analyzed and studied by means of weightlessness experiments, open circuit potentials, polarization curves, etc. The results concluded that, under the premise that the pollutant ions reach a certain amount, continuing to increase the concentration of pollutant ions will not continue to accelerate the rate of corrosion, but will be due to the dissolvable oxygen concentration will lead to slower corrosion. The electric field will not essentially change the corrosion process, the electric field in different salt concentrations of the environment on the corrosion rate of the law is basically the same, the electric field will only be in the original environment caused by the corrosion rate on top of the superimposed on an accelerating effect.

articleTitle: Design Optimization of High Frequency Transformer for Resonant DC/DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Resonant DC/DC converter is extensively applied in the industry due to their superiorities such as zero voltage switching which enables it to operate under higher frequency. As the core component of resonant DC/DC converter, the high-frequency transformer (HFT) is critical to the performance of the converter in regard of power density, efficiency, and reliability. However, as the frequency and power rating increase, the power loss on the wire and core increase as well. It is desired to propose the optimal design process for integrated HFT which considers the tradeoff between volume and power. This paper comprehensively investigates the impact of air gap length, location and winding structure on the transformer. Based on the analytical model, the design flow of a magnetics integrated transformer which incorporates intrinsic magnetizing inductance and leakage inductance for the resonant tank is presented. Finally, the analytical model and the optimization design of HFT are validated with experimental results.

articleTitle: Utilizing Grid Forming Battery Energy Storage to Mitigate Subsynchronous Interaction between Type-4 Wind Turbines and Weak AC Grids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the significant increase in the proportion of intermittent renewable power generators, there has been an increasing application of grid-scale battery energy storage systems (BESSs) to store excess power. In addition to this, it is of great interest to utilize the BESS as a means to provide a wider range of power grid services. This paper aims at using grid forming (GFM) controlled BESS to suppress synchronous oscillations (SSOs) that may be caused by the interaction between nearby grid following (GFL) controlled type-4 wind farms and weak ac grid. This paper proposes two subsynchronous damping controllers (SSDCs) as modifications to the GFM control structure of the BESS such that the BESS provides positive damping for the unstable SSO modes in the GFL-controlled wind farm. The damping performance of the two SSDCs is compared and the effect of the capacity of the BESS on the damping is investigated. The results are verified through time-domain electromagnetic simulations.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy for Wide-Voltage Output CLLC Converter in On-Board Chargers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Isolated DC/DC converters are of importance for on-board chargers (OBCs) in rapidly developed electric vehicles. DC/DC converters with a CLLC resonant tank are widely adopted due to high power density, high efficiency, wide voltage gain, and bidirectional power transfer capability. And the phase-shift modulation is usually applied to increase output gain in some occasions, which make currents in the resonant tank increase as phase-shift angle increases. To cope with this challenge, a control strategy is proposed with three-degrees-of-freedom, i.e., regulation of the dc-bus voltage, frequency, and phase-shift angle for wide-voltage output CLLC converters. The circuit analysis and working principles are first elaborated, considering various operation stages. The proposed control strategy is introduced, including the control structure and loop configuration. The proposed control strategy is validated with simulations.

articleTitle: Open-Circuit Fault Diagnosis of More Electric Aircraft Static Inverter Based on Sliding Mode Observer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The three-phase four-leg static inverter is extensively utilized in More Electric Aircraft (MEA) due to its ability to handle unbalanced loads. However, since the four-leg inverter has an additional leg compared to the three-leg inverter, its fault diagnosis becomes more complicated, and there is a scarcity of researchers studying this area. To address this issue, this study proposes a fault diagnosis method based on an interval sliding mode observer (SMO) for detecting open-circuit faults in the three-phase four-leg static inverter used in MEA. The proposed method establishes a novel interval SMO, which accurately and quickly estimates the system state variables. The residual difference between the actual value and observed value of the state variable is then calculated for fault diagnosis and identification. Simulation and experimental results demonstrate that this method can rapidly and accurately detect open-circuit faults in the power switch of the three-phase four-leg static inverter.

articleTitle: Improving power factor of the SynRM using dual inverters with a floating capacitor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The synchronous reluctance motor (SynRM) has the advantages of low manufacturing cost, simple control method and high temperature resistance, but the power factor is a major drawback. In this paper, the topology of open-end dual inverters with floating capacitor is applied to feed the SynRM. The floating capacitor of the topology can provide reactive power compensation to achieve the unit power factor of the main inverter, along with the optimization of SynRM's current angle. Simulation results validate that adopting the floating capacitor topology and the proposed control strategy can effectively improve the power factor of the motor and keep almost unit power factor viewed from the main inverter side.

articleTitle: Open-circuit Fault Diagnosis Strategy Based on Current Reconstruction with A Single Current Sensor for Voltage Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The parameter difference and cost of multiple current sensors exist in the open circuit fault diagnosis of the inverter. This paper proposes an open-circuit fault diagnosis strategy based on current reconstruction with a single current sensor for the voltage source inverter. Through the parallelogram law analysis of the voltage vectors under different fault states, the phase angle of the voltage vector under the fault is obtained. At the same time, the reverse complementary vector is used to replace the zero vector to reconstruct the fault three-phase current in the current unsamplable area with a single current sensor. According to the fault voltage vector analysis and the reconstructed fault three-phase current, an open-circuit fault diagnose method is proposed based on average current vector. Simulation results verify the feasibility and reliability of the fault diagnosis strategy.

articleTitle: Temperature rise calculation of synchronous reluctance motors based on the LPTN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, synchronous reluctance motors (synRMs) have become a research boom with their own advantages. The heat generated by the motor operation makes the internal temperature rise too high, which affects the performance and reliable operation of the motor. In this paper, lumped-parameter thermal-network (LPTN) is used to analyze the temperature field of synRM and establish the thermal network model of 45 nodes, which truly reflects the temperature rise of each part of the motor. Finally, the correctness of this thermal network calculation model is proved by comparing with the analysis results of finite element method (FEM).

articleTitle: Fine-grained Calculation Method of Accepting Distributed Generation Capacity in Distribution Network for Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The fine-grained calculation method of accepting distributed generation capacity in distribution network for virtual power plant is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a distributed generation capacity model including photovoltaic power generation and wind power generation are established based on the collection of virtual power plant information. Secondly, distribution network power flow model on power grid side, and distributed power generation output model on power supply side including photovoltaic generation model and wind power generation model are established. Thirdly, the fine-grained safe operation constraints including power supply side and power grid side are set. Then, the optimal coordinated scheduling model of acceptability of new energy distributed generation with adjustable importance factor setting mode is proposed. Finally, output virtual power plant information through optimal coordinated scheduling, and reverse determine the actual photovoltaic and wind power installed capacity selection. The proposed model and method can provide theoretical guidance and reference for the fine modeling of distributed generation capacity accepted by the distribution network of virtual power plant, fine-grained computing application, actual installed capacity selection of distributed generation, multi-mode coordinated scheduling and so on.

articleTitle: Design of a Permanent Magnet Assistant Synchronous Machine with Torque Improvement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new permanent magnet assisted synchronous reluctance machine (PMaSynRM) with three-layer magnet arrangement is proposed for electrical vehicle applications. To confirm the merits of the presented PMaSynRM, the Nissan leaf 2012 interior permanent magnet machine (IPMM) is selected as a benchmark. The basic electromagnetic performances of the two machines are investigated and compared by finite element (FE) method. The simulations show that the proposed design exhibits a better flux weakening capability, higher torque density and lower torque ripple than Nissan leaf 2012 IPMM.

articleTitle: Static Characteristic Simulation for the 6500 V SiC MOSFET Chip Considering the Influence of the Interface Charges and Passivation Layer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The simulation of statistic characters plays an important role in the design of 4H-SiC chips. In this paper, a high-voltage silicon carbide chip simulation model with the termination structure and the passivation layer both considered is established. Compared with traditional silicon-based chips and low-voltage silicon carbide chips, the anisotropic parameter settings required for high-voltage silicon carbide chips simulation are added. Moreover, the static characteristic and the electric field distribution of the terminal area are researched. What's more, the changes of the static characteristics under different doping concentrations and different interface charges are analyzed in this work. This work can provide a reference for the simulation of subsequent high-voltage silicon carbide chips.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Optimization for Improving Transient Synchronization Stability of VSCs in Series-Compensated System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Voltage source converters (VSCs) play an important role in grid-connected renewable system. However, the synchronization stability of VSCs is affected by many factors, such as grid impedance, controller parameters, and system disturbance. It is found that system is prone to lose transient synchronization stability when large series compensation is deployed. The large frequency disturbance and reduction of stability region account for the synchronization instability. Traditional methods, such as redesigning PI parameters, and deploying band-pass filter, can improve synchronization stability, but they highly depend on system detailed models and usually sacrifice original control performance. This paper proposes a hybrid optimization method by combing PI controller and fuzzy controller to improve synchronization stability. The fuzzy controller is designed to limit transient frequency deviation and the PI controller is deployed to obtain better static performance. The simulation results have verified that the method can effectively improve system stability and with higher control performance than traditional methods.

articleTitle: Research on power grid alarm information analysis and auxiliary decision-making based on knowledge graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the system fails, a large amount of alarm information floods into the dispatching center in a short period of time, making it difficult to quickly diagnose and process alarm information. Dispatchers rely on a wealth of expertise, historical and real-time grid data to make optimal decisions based on changing conditions. Aiming at the complex power grid alarm information and high requirements for real-time judgment, this paper proposes a method for grid alarm information analysis and decision-making based on knowledge graph, which condenses the knowledge of power grid topology, operating procedures, disposal plans and other knowledge represented by a large number of texts into a knowledge graph that can be represented, operable and reasonable.

articleTitle: Multi-physics field simulation of oil-immersed transformers accounting for ambient temperature and load variations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Among the internal faults of transformers, the overheating fault accounts for 45%, which seriously threatens the safe operation of transformers. In order to study the influence of ambient temperature and dynamic load conditions on the transformer hot spot temperature, this paper establishes a three-dimensional magnetic-thermal-current multi-physical field simulation model based on S11-2000/10/0.4 oil-immersed transformer to analyze the transformer hot spot temperature change rule. In the simulation process, the influence of temperature on material properties is considered to accurately simulate the variation of transformer hot spot temperature. The results show that the effect of ambient temperature on the hot spot temperature of the transformer is not linear, and that the change in hot spot temperature is influenced by the two-way coupling between the surface temperature of the oil tank and the ambient temperature; the hot spot temperature and the load factor are positively correlated, and the rate of change of hot spot temperature increases with the increase of the load factor. On the basis of normal periodic daily load and long-term dynamic load considering seasonal load growth, the hot spot temperature of transformer meets the trend of descending, ascending and descending. Comparing the simulation results of two load conditions at the same time, the maximum difference of hot spot temperature can reach 37.1K; Considering the combined effect of load factor and ambient temperature, the change trend of hot spot temperature is the same as that under the separate action of both, but compared with the hot spot temperature under the separate action of seasonal dynamic daily load curve, under the joint action, the difference of hot spot temperature in winter and summer can reach 58.8K, which accelerates the insulation aging of transformer. The research results will provide reference for the design of large oil-immersed transformers in the future.

articleTitle: Distributed generation cluster partition method considering the flexible inertia supporting capability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the scale of distributed generations (DGs) connected to the power network increases, the system inertia significantly decreases, and bring threat to the system frequency stability. A reasonable cluster partition of DGs can give full play to its inertia support and frequency regulation ability. Therefore, this paper puts forward to a DG cluster partition method considering the system inertia supporting flexibility. Firstly, the inertia support ability of DG cluster is defined based on the supply-demand relationship of system inertia. Secondly, inertia supporting flexibility index and inertia response speed index are proposed, and a comprehensive index system of DG cluster partition is established combining the module degree index and power balance index. Then the adjacency matrix coding genetic algorithm (GA) is adopted to obtain the cluster partition results. Finally, the IEEE33 node system is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of the proposed cluster partition index and method in improving the system inertia supporting ability.

articleTitle: Effect of high-frequency non-sinusoidal excitation on the magnetic moment deflection angular velocity of nanocrystalline alloys under saturation magnetization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to establish a three-dimensional model of nanocrystalline alloy at the mesoscopic scale based on G.Herzer's random anisotropy theory, and apply two non-sinusoidal excitations to the model. The magnetic moment deflection angular velocity w is defined, and the motion of the magnetic moment and the response to the applied magnetic field during the saturation magnetization of the material are explored from the micro level. The results show that for <tex>$\omega$</tex>, under the excitation of triangular wave, increasing the amplitude of magnetic field and the frequency of alternating magnetic field can all accelerate the magnetic moment deflection and shorten the time of magnetization to saturation. While, for the square wave, the change of the magnetic field frequency does not affect w.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control and Inductance Parameter Identification of PMSM Based on Two-Orientation High-Fequency Square Wave Injection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The fundamental-model-based sensorless control method is sensitive to inductance parameters, and accurate electrical parameters are conducive to improving rotor position estimation accuracy. In addition, the accuracy of inductance parameters will also affect the control performance of the motor system. Based on high-frequency square wave voltage injection, the sensorless control and online parameter identification are studied in this paper. Firstly, the influence of inductance parameters on fundamental-model-based sensorless control is studied, and then the zero- and low-speed sensorless control and parameter identification strategy based on two-orientation high-frequency square wave voltage injection is proposed. Finally, the method is verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Frequency Regulation Method of Wind Turbine Generators in Flexible Interconnected Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Flexible interconnected distribution network (FIDN) is a better inclination to develop the new-type power system with large scale of renewable energy. With the continuously increasing penetration level of renewable energy generation e.g. wind power in FIDN, the system frequency stability issue becomes a non-neglect challenge caused by the randomness and variable features of wind generation. This paper addresses a frequency regulation method of wind turbine generators based on the droop control scheme. To this end, the various control gains are designed according to the storable energy capability and releasable energy capability instead of fixed control gain. Further, the control gain are determined for the over system frequency zone and under system frequency zone to improve the fluctuations-mitigating capability. Based on PSCAD simulator, simulation results with varying wind speed conditions indicate that the suggested droop control strategy is benefit for smoothing out the fluctuations of output power of the wind turbine generators and fluctuations of instantaneous system frequency.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of pulsed electric field sterilization system for high flow rate applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Pulsed electric field (PEF) sterilization is a new non-thermal sterilization technology with high sterilization efficiency, gentle treatment and wide application prospects. However, the exiting pulsed electric field sterilization device has some drawbacks, such as lower processing capacity and weak continuous processing capability, which impede its industrial application progress. In this paper, therefore, multiple groups of co-field type PEF processors were connected in series to treat the bacterial suspensions inoculated with S. aureus and E. coli at an experimental flow rate of 60L/h to obtain sterilization kinetic characteristics. It was discussed that the influence of the initial concentration of bacteria on the sterilization effect. The results shown that, at a flow rate of 60L/h, the PEF system can achieve ideal sterilization effect of 99.99% for both bacteria. With the initial concentration of bacteria gradually decreases, the sterilization efficiency decreases slightly, but remains above 99%. On the basis of this, the freshly squeezed grapefruit juice was further treated to obtain the sterilization effect and quality change law. The grapefruit juice after treated with PEF met the relevant national standards in microorganisms and nutrients. The results are helpful to improve the performance of the PEF system and lay foundation for its applications.

articleTitle: Research And Simulation of Hybrid ANPC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Active neutral point clamp (ANPC) is a three-level circuit suitable for high power applications. Using Cascode devices instead of Si devices can efficiently reduce the switching losses and improve the switching frequency. In this paper, a control strategy suitable for hybrid ANPC converter is proposed. By mixing different single control strategies, the power loss distribution become more uniform. This paper firstly analyzes the working principle of the hybrid ANPC converter. Then the thermal simulation of different types of ANPC circuits is carried out. Then, the efficiency of different types of ANPC circuits is compared by experiments, which confirms the superiority of the hybrid ANPC control strategy proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A High Performance Control Method for IPMSM Based on Lookup Tables Considering the System Nonlinearalities
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a high performance control method based on the Lookup Tables (LUT) for Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (IPMSM) in the Electric Vehicles (EV) application. The two-dimensional current LUTs are used to generate the current references according to the torque command and flux linkage limitation. The nonlinear IPMSM model based on the stator flux is established and the optimal operational regions are analyzed. Considering the nonlinearities of both motor parameters and controller characteristics, the detailed steps including experimental data collection and processing are presented. The linearity of the output torque and stability of the output voltage with the calculated current LUTs are experimentally verified using a 40kW IPMSM test platform.

articleTitle: Common-Mode Noise Modeling and Reduction for Multi-output dual-switch flyback converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Flyback converters are widely used in electronic products. At present, power electronics technology is developing in high frequency and miniaturization, arousing much attention on EMI issues. This paper uses an actual multi-output dual-switch flyback converter as an example to analyze its CM characteristic. Firstly, the displacement current expression of a transformer with both single-layer primary and secondary windings is derived, and the lumped model of a four-capacitance multi-winding transformer with two secondary grounds is further established. A CM noise cancellation capacitor is proposed to generate a reverse decimation current to cancel the CM noise current, which helps derive the cancellation capacitor expression. The experimental results verified the effectiveness of the CM model and CM noise reduction method of the flyback converter.

Author Keywords: electromagnetic interference (EMI);Common mode (CM) noise;flyback converter;Lumped Capacitance Model;EMI reduction

articleTitle: Deep Integration and Learning of Measurement Data in Active Distribution Power Networks for Load Flow Estimation Considering Incomplete Information
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To reach the goals of carbon peaking by 2030 and carbon neutrality by 2060 in China, a growing penetration of PV generation is integrated into the modern distribution power grid, causing challenges in operating the grid to meet security requirements due to the increased dynamics and stochastics. A deep neural network (DNN)-based method is proposed in this paper for estimating load flow solutions in active distribution power networks that typically suffer from incomplete measurements. Adaptive DNN models are trained from massive historical observations obtained from actual measurements or high-fidelity simulations, whose hyperparameters are tuned automatically. Comprehensive case studies are conducted on the IEEE 123-node feeder model with renewable generation considering various levels of missing information as inputs, which validate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Application scenario analysis of microgrid based on typical structure classification of microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As a bridge between the power distribution system and distributed energy, microgrid plays a crucial role in the access of renewable energy and the stable operation of the electric power system. The study of microgrid structure is the basis of microgrid construction, operation, control and protection. Firstly, a new classification method of microgrid is proposed according to its network structure characteristics. Secondly, the typical structure of microgrid is analyzed, including the operation mode, architecture scale, power supply reliability, micro source type and application scope of microgrid. Thirdly, several microgrid application scenarios are analyzed based on the classification of typical microgrid structures. Finally, Combined with microgrid engineering projects, It can be concluded that the typical microgrid structure summarized in this paper has some practical significance for future microgrid engineering construction.

articleTitle: Analysis on charging of electric vehicles in Europe and America
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The development of new energy is a strategic measure to address climate change and promote green development. The development momentum of new energy vehicles is strong. The new energy vehicles produced in China have been widely praised by the international market for their excellent performance and high cost performance. European and American charging standard architecture and China's charging standards are very different, can not directly achieve interconnection, this paper from the interpretation of the standard, analyze the difference between European and American charging standards and Chinese charging standards, summarize and show the actual charging test encountered in the abnormal situation, for export models to adapt to the European and American markets to provide reference ideas, reduce research and development costs, reduce detours.

articleTitle: Transient electric field dynamics of high-voltage power module packaging insulation at high temperatures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the promising application of high-voltage wide bandgap semiconductors-based (WBG) devices, much attention has been taken to the development of module packaging. Due to the relatively higher operating voltage and frequency, the packaging insulation materials suffered severe multi-stress and presented low reliability, which has limited the application of new-generation WBG power devices. Two critical problems lie in thermal control and electric field control, especially at the triple junction among the copper trace, encapsulation, and substrate. According to the Maxwell-Wagner theory, the electric field distribution is determined by both conductivity and permittivity of the insulating materials. It is interesting to note that the dielectric properties of insulation materials are affected by temperature and local electric field. This paper focused on the transient electric field distribution at the packaging insulation in high-voltage power modules considering non-linear dielectric properties at different temperatures. The conductivity and permittivity of two main packaging insulation, that is encapsulating silicone and substrate ceramic were investigated at various temperatures and applied electric fields. Then a half-bridge power module was simulated considering the non-linear model of dielectric properties coupled with electric field and temperature. The transient electric field dynamics were studied at several typical triple point positions with the application of unipolar square or DC voltages. The maximum magnitude of the electric field appeared at the position applied with unipolar square wave voltage. In addition, the faster relaxation process and higher quasi-steady state electric field strength were found at higher temperatures. The results are instructive for high-voltage power module packaging insulation reliability improvement.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Control of Three-Phase Four-Leg PMSM Servo Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Compared with the traditional permanent magnet motor, the non-sinusoidal back-EMF permanent magnet motor can improve the torque density but when the motor fails, the back-EMF harmonics will produce torque ripple during the fault tolerance process. In this paper, the mathematical model of non-sinusoidal back-EMF motor is given and the torque ripple before and after fault is deduced. Based on the three-phase four-leg topology, a fault-tolerant control strategy for the open-phase fault of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) with the introduction of the third and fifth harmonic back-EMF is proposed in order to weaken the torque ripple caused by the introduced back-EMF harmonics. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of different grounding modes of wind farm on over-voltage level
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Over-voltage level is a key parameter of AC transmission system in wind farm. This paper analyzes the characteristics of different neutral grounding modes, expounds the function and basic principle of Z-type grounding transformer, builds the Z-type grounding transformer model and wind field model in PSCAD, simulates and analyzes the impact of different grounding modes on system over-voltage, and provides a reference for the selection of wind farm grounding mode and stable operation.

articleTitle: Extraction of Vital Sign Based on Improved Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise for UWB radar
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In life search and rescue based on UWB radar, life signals are easy to be submerged by clutter and difficult to extract. To solve this problem, a UWB radar vital signs extraction method based on ICEEMDAN is proposed. The complexity of slow time series is calculated by PE, and the distance gate with strong vital signs is selected. Then, the selected slow time series is reconstructed and denoised by ICEEMDAN, and the frequency of the reconstructed signals is extracted by FFT. The results show that the average respiratory frequency error is 0.0127 Hz and the average heartbeat frequency error is 0.036Hz. The algorithm proposed in this paper can accurately extract the respiratory and heart rates.

Author Keywords: improved complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise

articleTitle: MTPA Control and Flux-Weakening Control for IPMSM Drives Based on High-frequency Signal Injection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Inner Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (IPMSM) has the characteristic of unequal inductance components of d and q axis. In order to make full use of the reluctance torque and improve the system efficiency, the maximum torque per ampere (MTPA) control algorithm is often used. At the same time, in order to broaden the speed range of IPMSM, the flux-weakening control algorithm is used when the speed is above the base speed or the terminal voltage exceeds the preset value. In this paper, the 120kW high-power permanent magnet synchronous motor platform is designed, and the rotor error signal is obtained by high-frequency signal injection method. The expression of rotor position estimation error is theoretically analyzed and derived, and the method is applied to the MTPA control and flux-weakening speed regulation of permanent magnet synchronous motor. On this basis, the experiments of adding and reducing large torque load are carried out. It is proved that the proposed scheme has good dynamic response ability and robustness when fast loading and unloading.

Author Keywords: high frequency pulse signal injection method

articleTitle: Joint Extraction of Entity Relations in Electric Power Industry Standard Based on GCN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The name, author, drafting unit, standard number and other entities of the power standard text can be extracted by the rules. Normative short sentences in the standard text need knowledge extraction to build a knowledge graph. The existing entity relationship joint extraction methods do not fully consider the complex structural characteristics of entity relationships in sentences. Therefore, a new entity relationship joint extraction method based on graph convolution neural network (GCN) is proposed. On the basis of bidirectional long short memory network to extract sequence features, an end-to-end Chinese entity relationship joint extraction model is constructed using the syntax structure information in the GCN encoding dependency analysis results and the improved entity annotation strategy. The experimental results show that the F1 value of this method can reach 72.3%, which is 2.7% higher than that of LSTM-CRF model. GCN can effectively encode the prior word relationship of text and improve the performance of entity relationship extraction.

articleTitle: Active Power Return Suppression Strategy of Three-Phase Cascaded Multilevel Photovoltaic Inverter Based on Harmonic Compensation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, the grid connection guidelines require large and medium-sized photovoltaic (PV) power stations to have certain low voltage ride through (LVRT) capability, that is, the inverter should actively support the grid voltage in case of grid failure. However, three-phase isolated cascaded H-bridge (CHB) PV inverter uses isolated DC-DC converter with unidirectional energy flow, so the active power return problem cannot be avoided. During asymmetric fault, the returned active power will accumulate at the DC side capacitor, so the capacitor voltage will pump up, eventually causing the inverter to trigger overvoltage protection and be off-grid, which does not meet LVRT standard. Especially, when inter-phase short circuit fault occurs, the active power return problem is particularly serious and prominent. To deal with this issue, this paper proposes a multi-harmonic compensation strategy based on adaptive zero-sequence voltage, which is able to reduce the overmodulation area, and further decrease the active return operation range of the three-phase common dc-bus CHB PV inverter under inter-phase short circuit fault condition. The effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed control strategy are verified by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Identification Modeling of Frequency-Coupling Admittance for Grid-Connected Inverter Under All Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The control structure and parameters of the grid-connected inverter in actual projects are usually unknown, which results in the “black-box” phenomenon. The traditional impedance modeling method is not suitable for the black-box. In this paper, a black-box identification method for the admittance of grid-connected inverters under all operating conditions considering frequency-coupling is proposed. Firstly, accurate discrete admittance data are acquired by the frequency-coupling admittance measurement. Then, the vector fitting (VF) is applied to identify the frequency-coupling admittance under a single operating condition. The black-box models identified by VF are combined with the weighting function to obtain the black-box admittance model of the grid-connected inverter under all operating conditions. Finally, the effectiveness and accuracy of the method are verified via MATLAB/Simulink.
