The results show that the method introduced in this paper not only can obtain the black-box admittance model under all operating conditions simply through several groups of admittance data, but also has the advantages of efficiency and high accuracy.

Author Keywords: admittance model under all operating conditions

articleTitle: Power Losses-Balancing Control Based on Variable PD-PWM Frequency for MMCs under SM Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The modular multilevel converter (MMC) gradually turns into one of the most appropriate topologies for high power applications due to its high modularity and low harmonic distortion. As submodule (SM) fails, the SM capacitor voltage average value in faulty arm will rise, which would cause unbalanced power losses distribution among six arms of the MMC and affects the reliability of the MMC. This paper proposed a variable phase-disposition pulsewidth modulation (PD-PWM) frequency control method, which can effectively realize balanced power losses distribution among six arms of the MMC through adjust PD-PWM frequency to modify switching loss in power devices in the MMC under the SM faults. The proposed control can effectively improve the reliability of the MMC with the balanced power losses distribution among the six arms in the MMC under SM faults. The proposed method is simulated with the PSCAD/EMTDC, the simulation result confirm the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Application of digital twin system in power transformer fault detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the daily maintenance, inspection and operation monitoring of transformers, inspection and monitoring personnel need to detect a large number of data, it is undoubtedly very difficult to accurately locate fault information from these data, and the combination of transformer digital twin system and deep learning algorithm provides a new idea to solve the problem of transformer running state detection and early fault diagnosis. This paper designs an intelligent system based on digital twin system, which is highly visualized and deeply combined with the characteristics of reality, real-time detection data, online rapid diagnosis, accurate alarm to assist transformer detection. Through the combination of digital twinning system and actual monitoring hardware, the data can be displayed directly, which is conducive to the quick inspection of transformer running state and the improvement of working efficiency.

articleTitle: Dynamic eccentric fault diagnosis method of permanent magnet synchronous motor based on VMD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a fault diagnosis method based on variational mode decomposition (VMD) is proposed to solve the problems of unstable current signal, difficult feature extraction and easy interference by noise signal in dynamic eccentric fault diagnosis of permanent magnet synchronous motor. Firstly, the stator air gap flux density of permanent magnet synchronous motor is analyzed theoretically, and the current characteristic frequency expression of the motor dynamic eccentricity is derived. Secondly, current signals are decomposed to obtain IMF components through variational mode decomposition (VMD), and signals of various characteristic frequencies can be obtained. Finally, the characteristic frequency and amplitude of the signal can be determined by the fast Fourier transform (FFT) of the decomposed signal. The fault state and fault degree of the motor can be accurately judged by the amplitude of signal characteristic frequency. The effectiveness of the fault detection method is verified by simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Common Mode Voltage Reduction Algorithm of Triple Three-Phase Motors Based on Phase Shift
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Multi-phase motors have been widely studied and applied in low-voltage and high-power applications. However, under pulse width modulation (PWM), the system inevitably generates common-mode voltage (CMV), which will harm the system. In particular, the odd set of three-phase motors cannot eliminate the CMV because of its odd bridge arms. In this paper, a common-mode voltage reduction (CMVR) algorithm based on triple three-phase motors (TTPM) is proposed. Through proper zero-sequence voltage injection and pulse phase shifting, the amplitude reduction and constant amplitude control of CMV can be achieved under different maximum modulation ratios. The algorithm can effectively reduce the common mode (CM) electromagnetic interference (EMI) of the system, and the algorithm can be easily realized by carrier-based pulse width modulation (CBPWM). Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is effective for reducing the common mode voltage of triple three-phase motors.

articleTitle: Application of Triple-spectrum-Line Interpolation Method of High-order Hanning Self-multiplication Window to On-line Monitoring of Zinc Oxide Arrester
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The detection and analysis of the leakage current of the arrester is the key method to judge the operation status of the arrester. In order to reduce the error caused by spectrum leakage and fence effect in the process of harmonic analysis, combined with the characteristics of the single-chip-microcomputer used in the portable arrester detector, this paper uses the high-order Hanning self-multiplication window triple-spectrum-line interpolation method to analyze the detected leakage current, so as to judge the running state of zinc oxide arrester. In addition, the accuracy of the method is also simulated and verified in this paper.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation investigation of the internal flow field for wind tunnel
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Numerical simulation was applied to study the flow field in the wind tunnel. Two different combinations for nozzles were analyzed, and the characteristic of flow filed for several different rectifier thicknesses (5mm, 10mm and 15mm) in the wind tunnel were also compared. The results show that, under the same inlet velocity, the velocity of airflow after the second rectifiers for adjacent opening nozzles is larger than those for diagonal opening nozzles. However, diagonal opening nozzles made the subsequent flow field more uniform and smooth. Furthermore, with the increase of rectifier thickness, the flow filed after the second rectifier appears much more even.

articleTitle: An Anomalous Data Identification Approach for PV Generation Based on Quadratic and Intra-group Variance Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to environmental factors and equipment failures, a certain amount of anomalous data will be mixed into the collected data, which leads to the subsequent power prediction work being more difficult. To solve this problem, a combined method is proposed based on the quadratic and the optimal interclass variance algorithm. Firstly, the analysis of the photovoltaic power dataset shows that photovoltaic power dataset contains both scattered and stacked anomalies.. Then, the anomalous data in the dataset can be identified as scattered anomalous data and stacked anomalous data in the dataset by using the quartile method and the optimal interclass variance algorithm respectively. To verify the feasibility of the proposed method, the anomalous data in the dataset are removed, and then the LSTM model is used to make predictions and the final prediction results are used to support the advantages and disadvantages of the method. The results show that compared with the quadratic method and the optimal intra-group variance method alone, the data processed by the combined method in this paper makes the LSTM model have higher prediction accuracy, thus indicating that the proposed method has better recognition effect.

articleTitle: Short-term Load Prediction of Integrated Energy System Based on MCNN-LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The high coupling characteristics between various energy of integrated energy system (IES) and the uncertainty of each link of power-grid-load make the dynamic process of IES more complex than that of the traditional single-load system, which brings great difficulties to the effective operation of IES. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a method for short term multivariate load prediction based on deep neural network. Firstly, the correlation between each single load is used to divide the categories, and the load data at the same time is reorganized into an image mode to maximize the use of correlation; then, the multi-channel convolutional neural networks (MCNN) are used to extract and fuse the features of the images, and the fused feature data is input into the long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network to realize the prediction of multi-load data from the time level; finally, the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by an actual example analysis.

articleTitle: Optimal Excitation Design of a 10 Mvar Superconducting Synchronous Condenser
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: From two perspectives, distribution of racetrack-type superconducting excitation coils and consumption of coil ends, the rotor excitation design of a 10 Mvar superconducting condenser is optimized. The optimal position of excitation coil distribution was obtained by comparison. A new description of evaluating magnetic pole leakage of superconducting excited machines with large airgap is proposed, which verified that reducing the consumption of coil ends can cut down leakage magnetic flux. Through optimization, the amount of superconducting tape can be appropriately reduced to improve economic efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Decision-making Layer Energy Management Strategy for Airborne Microgrid of MEA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, airborne HVDC power supply system has attracted much attention due to its advantages such as simple structure, easy parallel operation, effective suppression of feeder voltage drop and skin effect. However, the load characteristics of future aircraft will be more complex, requiring the on-board power network to have high power storage and pulse discharge capabilities. Therefore, the airborne hybrid power system based on generator-battery-energy storage capacitor not only retains the advantages of More-Electric Aircraft (MEA) for long endurance, but also reduces the great influence of large load pulse on the robustness of airborne power supply system, which has high engineering application value. This paper focuses on the architecture of MEA hybrid propulsion system and energy storage system, and studies the energy management strategies (EMS) of power network cooperative control layer and decision layer. The simulation results show that the designed airborne microgrid can effectively reduce the frequent fluctuations caused by load changes of generators, which provides a reference for the future research of airborne microgrid for MEA.

articleTitle: A Power Coordination Control for Grid-Connected Microgrid with Battery and Hydrogen Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A kind of power coordination control strategy is proposed for the grid-connected operation of Photovoltaic-Hydrogen-Battery microgrid in this paper. The combination of battery and hydrogen energy storage is adopted in order to utilize solar energy as much as possible during meeting the demand of electricity load. By controlling the energy storage system reasonably, the power exchanged with the grid can be much reduced. In the same time, the self-sufficiency of electrical energy in the microgrid can be realized. Based on the erected steady-state modeling in MATLAB/SIMULINK, the effectiveness of proposed control strategy is validated.

articleTitle: Research on high precision signal detection algorithm in the process of disconnector switching
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Disconnector switching test can effectively assess the electromagnetic compatibility of electronic transformers. In order to carry out the test smoothly and analyze the test results effectively, it is necessary to accurately detect the signal during the opening and closing process of the disconnector. In this paper, the high-precision transient signal detection method is studied. The improved HHT is used to effectively suppress the endpoint effect in EMD decomposition, and the accurate positioning and detection of transient signal parameters, signal fluctuation law and transient disturbance time are realized.

articleTitle: Vibration Analysis of High Frequency Transformer Winding and Iron Core
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the core equipment of multi-state energy system, multi-energy conversion equipment can realize efficient conversion, cooperative management and optimal operation among various energy sources. As the core physical module of multi-energy conversion equipment, high-frequency transformer can realize electrical isolation, power regulation and AC/DC flexible conversion, etc., which provides an effective solution for large-scale distributed energy reliable grid-connection and flexible transmission of different voltage levels. At present, the main diagnostic methods of transformer internal local discharge are pulse current method, ultrasonic method and oil chromatography. These traditional methods are easy to cause secondary damage to the transformer, and with the increase of excitation frequency, the increase of vibration noise is inevitable. High-frequency transformer vibration sound signal contains important information about the fault state, and can reflect the transformer internal office discharge fault to a certain extent. Therefore, it is necessary to consider and explore the sources of high-frequency transformer vibration signals and analyze vibration signals.

articleTitle: Research on Whole Process Quality Control Technology of Substation Construction Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, The State Grid has higher and higher requirements for the management and control of construction sites. For this reason, quality inspection and acceptance are arranged in the construction process of each substation project. However, such inspections cannot be arranged for enough time. Most of the inspections are mainly based on consulting documents and on-site human eye inspection, and the effect of quality control is not ideal. Therefore, this paper studies the whole process quality control technology of substation construction based on big data, and discusses the key parameters and equipment of data acquisition, data analysis and discrimination method. Based on this, the case analysis is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the quality control technology combining digital acquisition and BIM model technology.

articleTitle: Analysis on Temperature Rise Mechanism of Bridge Arm Reactor under Different AC-DC Superimposed Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Bridge arm reactor is an important power equipment in UHV transmission engineering. In order to study the temperature rise mechanism of bridge arm reactor, a two-dimensional and three-dimensional multi-physical field coupling model of bridge arm reactor is established based on the finite element method. The spatial magnetic field distribution of the bridge arm reactor is calculated in the two-dimensional field-circuit coupling model, and the resistance loss and eddy current loss of each envelope are calculated. Then, according to the actual operating conditions of the bridge arm reactor, the heat source density of each envelope of the bridge arm reactor is calculated. The enveloping loss of the bridge arm reactor is mainly from the resistance loss, and the resistance loss is related to the reactor structure and current amplitude. Eddy current loss ratio is very small, mainly depends on the magnetic field intensity and current frequency. In the three-dimensional flow field-temperature field coupling model, the calculated heat source density is used as the heat source of the reactor, and the maximum, minimum and average values of each envelope temperature of the bridge arm reactor are solved. Because the heat dissipation condition of the first envelope and the 14th envelope was better than that of the middle inner envelope, the minimum temperature is much lower than other envelopes, so the temperature difference between the maximum and minimum temperature is very large. The maximum temperature curves of each envelope under four working conditions are compared. Due to the different distribution rules of DC and AC currents, the maximum hot spot locations of DC and AC-DC superimposed conditions are different.

articleTitle: Frequency-Coupled Impedance Model of Grid-forming Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Grid-forming (GFM) converters are increasingly used in power systems for its advantage of self-synchronization without phase-locked loop. To analyze its small-signal stability, impedance model is required to be established. In this paper, frequency-coupled impedance model (FCIM) of the GFM converter is mathematically derived using harmonic linearization method. The developed FCIM takes full consideration of the power synchronization control, virtual control, and inner current control, and thus can provides sufficient accuracy for the evaluation of oscillatory stability. Further, the measured FCIM is obtained through perturbation injection method in the electromagnetic simulation software of PSCAD/EMTDC, and is compared with the theoretical FCIM to verify the consistence between them.

articleTitle: Research on New Wide-input LLC Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of narrow input voltage range of traditional LLC resonant converter, an LLC resonant converter with wide input voltage range is proposed in this paper. The converter can work in half - bridge mode, double - bridge mode and double - bridge superimposed mode. When the switching frequency is equal to the resonant frequency, the voltage gain ratio of the three operating modes is 1:2:3. In three operating modes, the main switch tube on the primary side can realize ZVS, and the diode on the secondary side can realize ZCS.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Supraharmonic Characteristics of VSR PWM Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of power electronic technologies, the high-frequency switching harmonics (commonly referred to as supraharmonics) derived from PWM converters are constantly advancing towards higher frequency in power distribution grid, which has caused many new power quality problems. In this paper, a typical single-phase half-bridge VSR converter and its several parallel modes are taken as examples to systematically analyze the supraharmonic features, considering such influence factors as sampling method, carrier phase shifting, dead zone and PWM control strategies, for the purpose of providing references for the relevant research on the propagation, measurement and suppression of supraharmonics. Through the mathematical modeling and simulation analysis, some primary conclusions of the supraharmonic distribution and variation characteristics are drawn under these factors above.

articleTitle: A Calculation Method of Dynamic Reflux Safety Parameters with Complex Underground Structure in Urban Rail Transit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, exorbitant reflux safety parameters (RSP) usually exist in urban rail transit. The structure of the reflux system is complex, and coupling effect of multiple reflux paths is obvious, which makes the dynamic simulation of RSP difficult. Based on mathematical method as well as simulation method with Current Distribution, Electromagnetic Fields, Grounding and Soil Structure Analysis (CDEGS), this paper proposes a method for calculating the RSP with presence of complex buried metal structures such as steel bars and pipelines. This method makes an accurate equivalent of the reflux system parameters based on the boundary constraint conditions, and makes up for the deficiency that traditional mathematical method cannot simulate the complex underground structure parameters. Based on the actual data of Wuxi Metro Line 2, the method is used to simulate and analyze the RSP under the condition of non-uniform insulation of rail. The simulation results show that this method can correct the idealized parameters acquired from the traditional mathematical method and improve the calculation accuracy.

articleTitle: A Multi-Inverter Coordination Optimization Method for Distribution Networks with High Penetration PV
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Distributed generation (DG) has an important impact on the voltage stability of the distribution network. Access to photovoltaic (PV) generation leads to voltage fluctuation in the distribution network. In this paper, a centralized droop optimization control (CDOC) method is proposed to tackle these issues. The PV inverters compensate the reactive power to regulate the voltage within the rated range after the node voltages have been evaluated using power flow calculation and sensitivity analysis. This way multi-inverters can mitigate voltage fluctuations in distribution networks. The proposed method is applied in the IEEE 33-bus system using Matlab software and its effectiveness is demonstrated through simulation results.

articleTitle: Techno-Economic Analysis of Hydrogen Transportation from Offshore Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Global offshore wind energy resources are abundant and have a vast market demand as renewable energy. Due to offshore wind power's randomness, intermittency and anti-peaking characteristics, there are still many challenges for its large-scale grid-connected consumption. Offshore wind power hydrogen production technology can effectively improve the utilization rate of wind power and has become a hot direction for offshore wind power development and research. Therefore, the transportation of hydrogen to shore is a crucial part, especially important in terms of safety and economy. This paper studies the technical solutions of pipeline and ship transportation for offshore wind power hydrogen production. The economic model of pipeline and ship transportation for offshore wind power hydrogen production is established by integrating the benefits of hydrogen sales, equipment investment, operation, maintenance and decommissioning dismantling costs. The economic comparison of offshore wind power hydrogen production and transportation schemes for different offshore distances, considering the costs varying of unit production, is also introduced in this pater. These results reveal that the economic benefits of the project can be significantly improved by improving the service life of the relevant equipment and reducing the construction cost, and pipeline transportation takes a financial advantage when the offshore distance is close, and ship transportation takes advantage when the offshore distance is far. The longer the operation time, the stronger the compensation effect on the project's investment cost.

articleTitle: Research on Pollution Flashover Characteristics of Hydrophilic Surface under Combined AC-DC Voltage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Pollution flashover is one of the major problems for transmission lines. The pollution flashover characteristics under pure AC is greatly different from pure DC. In this paper, the pollution flashover characteristics of hydrophilic surface under combined AC-DC voltage were studied. Flashover voltage of the insulator are mainly influenced by the pollution level. A high voltage test power source with AC-DC compound voltage was designed in this research. The effect of contaminants on flashover performance of glass panels under different types of voltages was studied by artificial pollution test and gap breakdown test. Different ratios of combined AC-DC voltage can be generated by the power source. It has been found that with the change of DC component, the breakdown voltage and flashover voltage vary. One theory is that flashover is mainly a process of electrical breakdown above the pollution layer. It has been found that flashover characteristics may be related to the breakdown characteristics and zero crossing point for voltage.

articleTitle: Research and on-site implementation of converter transformer load diagnostic test applying total loss current
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Load diagnosis test to fault converter transformer is an important method of fault diagnosis, which can effectively judge whether exits internal electric current-heated failure. This paper summarizes and analyzes load diagnosis test device, method, calculation, and on-site implementation of a fault converter transformer in the Gui-Guang HVDC Gaopo converter station. The load diagnosis test under total loss current was carried out for the first time, studied, and adopted a new method of taking filtering capacitor as a compensation capacitor tower, gave the total loss equivalent current load test methods and processes, and eventually found the cause of fault, and the test is successfully completed.

articleTitle: Sensing characteristics of black phosphorus on SF6 decomposition components based on the First-principle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: SF<inf>6</inf> is widely used as electrical insulating gas in power systems because of its strong insulating and arc extinguishing properties. However, due to partial discharges during actual operation, SF<inf>6</inf> reacts to produce a series of by-products, typically SO<inf>2</inf> and H<inf>2</inf>S, which can threaten the stability of equipment and even power systems, so it is necessary to monitor the decomposition of SF<inf>6</inf> in real-time. In this paper, the adsorption properties of the two-dimensional material black phosphorus on the typical SF<inf>6</inf> decomposition products SO<inf>2</inf> and H<inf>2</inf>S, including adsorption energy, charge transfer and density of states function, are calculated based on the First-principle. The results show that black phosphorus has a certain adsorption effect on both SO<inf>2</inf> and H<inf>2</inf>S, with more sensitivity to SO<inf>2</inf>, and has the potential to be used as a gas-sensitive material to prepare sensors for real-time monitoring of SF<inf>6</inf> decomposition.

articleTitle: Minimum Copper Loss Control of Three-Phase Four-Leg PMSM Servo Systems Considering High Resistance Connection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the high power density, the three-phase four-leg permanent-magnet synchronous machine (PMSM) system is considered to be competitive for aerospace servo applications. In this article, the copper loss under various impedance conditions is obviously reduced and the system operation is restored under the condition of high-resistance connection (HRC). Four closed-loop forms of three-phase voltage control are adopted to solve the problem of redundancy and ensure the consistency of performance in the pre-fault and post- fault operations.

articleTitle: Wind Speed Estimation for PMSG-Based WECS under Power Limit Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Availability of real-time wind speed information is important for the control of the wind energy conversion system (WECS). Conventionally, the wind speed estimation can be achieved by considering the motion equation of rotator of wind turbine. However, under the power limit control, the rotor speed easily reaches the maximum, making the wind speed estimation more difficult. In this paper, an effective estimation method of wind speed for the PMSG-based WECS under the power limit control is proposed, which approximates the nonlinear relation between the pitch angle and wind speed in the case of rotor speed reaching the maximum value. The proposed method adopts the polynomial function to describe the numerically solved relation between the pitch angle and wind speed, with considering different power limit references. As a result, the pitch angle is utilized to estimate the real wind speed when the rotor speed reaches the maximum. Finally, case studies are carried out to validate the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Fast Open-circuit Fault Diagnosis Strategy for Submodules of MMC Based on Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) consists of a large number of identical submodules(SM) cascaded, so the SM fault diagnosis is critical to the reliable operation of the MMC. A diagnostic method based on voltage estimation and correlation analysis is proposed for the characteristic that the capacitor voltage of the open-circuit fault SM will deviate from the normal state. Firstly, the Kalman filter (KF) algorithm is adopted to estimate SM voltage which reduces the number of voltage sensors and the robustness is improved by reducing noise. Then, for the abnormal voltage value of the fault SM capacitor caused by the absence of the discharge circuit of the SM capacitor during the open-circuit fault, correlation analysis is conducted on the estimated voltage value of the SM capacitor of the same bridge arm to locate the fault in real-time and fast, which improves the system reliability and reduces the cost and complexity. Finally, the proposed strategy is verified by PSCAD/EMTDC simulation to be correct and efficient.

articleTitle: Study on arc characteristics of electrified railway pantograph-catenary in lightning environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to find out the change law of the physical properties of the pantograph-catenary arc under lightning overvoltage, the physical analysis model of the pantograph-catenary arc under lightning environment is established based on the fluid dynamics theory and the COMSOL finite element simulation software. The arc characteristics under different overvoltage conditions are simulated and studied, and the change and development rules of the arc are obtained. The results show that the arc voltage, arc diameter and current density of pantograph and catenary are changed due to the effect of lightning impulse voltage; As the arc voltage continues to increase, the arc current density first increases and then decreases.

articleTitle: Research on Frequency Modulation Control Technology of Doubly-fed Wind Turbine Based on MPC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The ability of wind turbines to participate in the frequency regulation of the power system is the guarantee for the stability of the power system with a high proportion of wind power generation in the future. This paper studies the operating characteristics of DFIG in different intervals, optimizes the load shedding control strategy, designs a model predictive controller (MPC) and applies it to the DFIG to participate in the primary frequency regulation of the system, and improves the inertia of the DFIG Response and control the output of active power to ensure the safe and stable operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Study on Surface Treatment Technologies of Copper Contacts in High-Voltage Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-voltage switchgear is one of the core electrical equipment in distribution network. In actual operation, due to the limited sealing degree of the high-voltage switchgear, moisture from the external environment will inevitably infiltrate into the interior. When the metal surface is damp for a long time, in the complex electromagnetic environment of high electric field and high current, combined with oxygen and carbon dioxide in the air, various types of electrical and chemical corrosion will inevitably occur, resulting in switchgear failure. In this paper, different surface treatment technologies were used for the important contact parts in the high-voltage switchgear, and the corrosion resistance of the copper contacts after treatment was analyzed. The test results showed that after the metal coating and surface passivation treatment, the mass of patina on the copper contacts was significantly reduced, and the corrosion inhibition rate could reach about 85% at high humidity, which indicated that appropriate surface treatment technologies could greatly improve the corrosion resistance of copper contacts and reduce the failure rate of high-voltage switchgear in humid areas.

articleTitle: Design and Models Validation of the Multiphase Interleaved Boost Converter for Special Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The interleaved parallel technique has been widely investigated for its flexibility in extending the output power of DC-DC converters while effectively reducing the input and output ripple. This paper focuses on the research of high-power interleaved three-level boost converter topology with low ripple and high efficiency. Firstly, the application of the overall system, control strategy, modulation method are introduced, and its effect on output voltage ripple is verified and compared by simulation. It is planned to build a 20kW prototype platform for subsequent experiments. The results will build a technical foundation and provide a reference for the application of the interleaved parallel three-level boost converter topology to subsequent research in related fields.

articleTitle: An Junction Temperature Estimation Method in SiC MOSFET Modules Based on the Turn-off Delay Time and $v_{DS}$ Overshoot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An online junction temperature estimation method for silicon carbide (SiC) metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (MOSFETs) based on turn-off <tex>$v_{DS}$</tex> peak voltage is proposed. First, the electrical behavior of SiC MOSFETs during turn-off is investigated and the temperature dependence of delay time and voltage overshoot during turn-off is discussed. The results show that the turn-off delay time is linearly and positively dependent on temperature, while the turn-off voltage overshoot has a low temperature dependence and both temperature-sensitive parameters are affected by the load current nonlinearity. Then, switching experiments under different conditions are performed to verify the temperature and load current dependence of the two parameters. Finally, based on the analysis of the experimental data, the mathematical relationships among the turn-off delay time, turn-off voltage overshoot, and junction temperature are established, and a novel junction temperature estimation model without the measurement of load current is obtained.

articleTitle: Co-simulation Analysis of Current Density inside the Plates of the Coupler for CPT System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The coupler is an important part of the capacitive power transfer (CPT) system. The coupler of the CPT system has its unique advantages of light weight, low cost and variable shape. However, further research is needed to determine the relationship between coupling plate thickness and CPT system's performance and the influence of coupler parameters on the current density inside the plates. This paper proposes a co-simulation method based on Maxwell and Simplorer to analyze CPT systems and provides a co-simulation model of a CPT system with SP compensation. The co-simulation model is verified by comparison with the research results of previous studies. Based on the proposed co-simulation method, current density inside the plates of the parallel four plate coupler is analyzed. The effects of the plate thickness and the plate excitation point position on the plate current density are also discussed. The proposed co-simulation method is helpful for designing CPT system coupler parameters in future studies.

articleTitle: Vibration Signal Correlation Analysis and Its Application in Mechanical Instability Detection of UHV Converter Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, an on-line monitoring method of vibration signal correlation of HVDC converter transformer based on neural network is proposed for the lack of monitoring means of internal mechanical instability of HVDC converter transformer. Firstly, the converter transformer test platform is built to record the sensor data under various operating conditions, and the signal database of converter transformer sensor is established. On this basis, BP neural network system is constructed, and Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) algorithm is used to correct the weights and thresholds of neural network. Then, the correlation analysis method based on Pearson correlation coefficient is constructed, and the judgment standard of mechanical instability of converter transformer is formed. Finally, the proposed method is verified by using the constructed converter transformer test platform.

articleTitle: Signal noise reduction of clamp current Transformer used in distribution network based on EEMD-ICA-Wavelet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A new type of power system with new energy as the main body is constructed under the goal of ‘double carbon’. The integration of large-scale distributed energy into the distribution network will affect the stable operation of the power system. When the live calibration of the power transformer for distribution network is carried out, the output signal of the clamp current transformer contains a large amount of nonlinear noise and has strong randomness, and the output accuracy is easily affected by noise. Considering the advantages of EEMD, Wavelet and ICA, EEMD-Wavelet-ICA noise reduction model is established. Firstly, the low frequency and high frequency components of IMF are obtained by EEMD decomposition. And then through the Wavelet, ICA noise reduction processing, the noise reduction signal multi-scale reconstruction to obtain noise reduction signal. The noise reduction effect is evaluated by signal-to-noise ratio, mean square error, waveform similarity coefficient, signal energy and other indicators. The noise reduction results of simulation signal and experimental data show that : compared with ICA-Wavelet, FFT and DFT, the SNR, NCC and Ep are improved in different degrees, and the mean square error is reduced in different degrees.

articleTitle: Current Phase Lead Compensation Control Strategy for CCM Totem Pole Bridgeless PFC circuit based on Error Current Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Continuous conduction mode (CCM) Totem Pole bridgeless power factor correction (PFC) converters with the traditional average current control method cannot achieve unity power factor at light loads due to the limited gain of PI controller at low frequencies. In this paper, an error current analysis method is proposed, which divides the steady-state error between the reference current and the inductor current under PI control into two parts: tracking error and disturbance error. It shows that the disturbance error is the main reason why unity power factor cannot be achieved. The steady-state error is eliminated through the inductor voltage drop feedforward and the input voltage feedforward, and the capacitive current caused by the EMI filter is also compensated, so that unity power factor can still be maintained at ultra-light load. Finally, a simulation circuit of the Totem Pole bridgeless PFC is built to verify the correctness of the theory and the effectiveness of the control method.

articleTitle: An Overdischarge Fault Detection Method for Lithium-ion Battery Module Based on Vibration Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Lithium-ion battery (LIB) has been the primary energy storage system for electric vehicles (EVs) due to its outstanding performance in high energy density and long cycle life. But its fragile safety especially overdischarge fault is an intractable problem. By designing overdischarge experiment of LIB to obtain the characteristics of cell's vibration signal under normal and overdischarge conditions, the high frequency components of the vibration spectra are extracted when the LIB is overdischarged. The high frequency vibration signal can used as an indicator to detect the overdischarge fault. To validate the feasibility and reliability of the proposed scheme, vibration signal of the module consisting of 4 series connected LIBs with one cell overdischarged are further studied for practical application. The result shows that high frequency components of vibration signal can be detected on the surface of the module, which indicates that the proposed approach is effective and robust in detecting overdischarge fault.

articleTitle: Coordinated Energy Management Strategy of Onboard Energy Storage System in Urban Rail Transit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The wayside energy storage system has been widely used in the subway, but it cannot solve the “regeneration failure” problem. Therefore, an implement using onboard energy storage system to replace onboard braking resistor is proposed, which has the potential to eliminate the “regeneration failure” problem. This paper proposes a coordinated energy management strategy of onboard energy storage system. By receiving the charging threshold of the wayside energy storage system and the train power information, it has a better voltage stabilization effect and higher energy saving rate than the traditional energy management strategy. The feasibility and effectiveness of this strategy are verified by the simulation of actual subway lines.

articleTitle: A New Measurement of Online Junction Temperature Based on On-state Resistance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Junction temperature monitoring and detection is widely studied and of great importance for the healthy operation of SiC MOSFET. This article raises a new measurement method of online junction temperature, which is based on the on-state resistance calculated by on-state voltage and on-state current. The advantages of the proposed method including the avoidance of complex calculation, on-board measurement and compatible with other functions.

articleTitle: Research on hydraulic turbine speed regulation System based on improved weed invasion algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the shortcomings of traditional PID controllers in the current market, this paper combines the weed invasion optimization algorithm with the core idea of clustering, and proposes a clustering weed invasion optimization algorithm, which is applied to the PID parameter optimization of turbine governor. The simulation results show that the PID controller based on the clustering weed algorithm is significantly shorter than the traditional PID controller, the overshoot is significantly reduced, and the control performance of the system is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Investigation of Voltage Harmonics of Dual-Armature Flux-Switching Permanent Magnet Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper investigates the voltage harmonics of dual-armature flux-switching permanent magnet (DA-FSPM) machines under load condition, with particular emphasis on the influence of stator and rotor armature reactions. Firstly, the mechanisms of the generation of even and fractional order coil voltage harmonics are investigated. It reveals that the alternate-SP-wound winding, alternate-RT-wound winding, stator winding distribution factor smaller than 1, and rotor winding distribution factor smaller than 1 cause asymmetrical armature reaction flux distributions in the DA-FSPM machines, thus additional harmonics are generated in the stator and rotor coil voltages under load condition. Furthermore, the elimination of even and fractional order harmonics in phase voltages are realized by means of selecting proper numbers of SP and RT and changing the stator and rotor coil connections. It shows that the torque ripple of the machines are reduced thanks to the reduction of voltage harmonics.

articleTitle: Fault traveling wave acquisition module based on line fiber differential protection device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As a channel for transmitting electric energy, the safe and stable operation of power lines will directly affect the power supply reliability of the entire power system. When the power line fails, it can quickly and accurately find out the fault location, repair the line in time and restore the power supply, which can reduce the economic losses caused by power outage. It has significant importance for the safe and stable operation of the entire power system. Developing a fast and accurate fault location system has become an urgent need for the power system department, and it is also a subject that motivate the majority of scientific researchers at home and abroad continue to study. This paper proposed a hardware and software implementation scheme of traveling wave acquisition based on FPGA. The PCB board is drawn by Altium designer software, Use Altium Designer software to complete the work of the hardware circuit design and PCB board layout. and the physical drawing of the traveling wave location module is completed. The experimental platform is set up and the fault location experiment is carried out, and the location result is less than 30 m.

articleTitle: Differential Evolutionary Algorithm-Based Load Optimization Method for Ultra-Supercritical Units
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the context of the vigorous development of new energy sources, the simple economic optimization of thermal power plant load allocation can no longer meet the current demand, and the unit load allocation needs to take into account the important role of frequency regulation capacity in thermal power plant peaking. In order to make the thermal power plant operate economically while maintaining a certain peak regulation margin, a load optimization allocation model considering primary frequency regulation capability is proposed for ultra-supercritical units. The optimal combined mutation strategy is obtained through the test function evaluation. Compared with other optimized differential evolution (DE) algorithms, the performance is better. Applying the combining mutation strategy and parameter adaptive differential evolution algorithm (CoPADE) to the above model, satisfactory solutions can be obtained.

articleTitle: Method of DLC Deposition on Alumina Powders: Cantilever Beam-type Vibrating Dual-frequency Plasma Fluidized Bed
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the constraints of deposition rate requirements, ion kinetic energy conditions, and treatment uniformity, diamond-like carbon (DLC) surface modification technology for alumina powders has not been mastered. This paper reported a cantilever beam-type vibrating dual-frequency plasma fluidized method for DLC deposition on alumina, and the high-density plasma source and high-energy ion region favoring DLC deposition were obtained by examining the discharge morphology. The surface features of modified alumina powders were analyzed by surface morphology, elemental distribution and Raman spectroscopy. The results show that DLC films were uniformly deposited on the powder surface, and the I(D)/J(G) in Raman spectra reached 0.8, corresponding to a sp3 fraction of 35%. This study provided a novel strategy for surface modification to optimize the interface of alumina-filled polymer composites.

articleTitle: Temperature rise distribution characteristics of C3F7CN/CO2 gas-insulated transmission pipeline considering heat source variation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The traditional insulating gas SF<inf>6</inf> is listed as a greenhouse-gas in the Kyoto protocol, and regulatory measures for the use of <tex>$\mathbf{SF}_6$</tex> have been implemented in a variety of industries. <tex>$\mathbf{SF}_{6}/\mathbf{N}_{2}$</tex> and <tex>$\mathbf{C}_{3}\mathbf{F}_{7}\mathbf{CN}/\mathbf{CO}_{2}$</tex> gas mixtures are environmentally friendly gas insulation partial replacement and complete replacement solutions with good application prospects, but they have higher operating temperature rise compared to GIL equipment with <tex>$\mathbf{SF}_6$</tex> gas, which can affect the design of the equipment's current capacity and operational safety. In this paper, high current temperature rise experiments were conducted using genuine GIL to obtain the temperature rise of key locations inside the GIL under <tex>$\mathbf{SF}_6$</tex> gas, <tex>$\mathbf{SF}_{6}/\mathbf{N}_{2}$</tex> and <tex>$\mathbf{C}_{3}\mathbf{F}_{7}\mathbf{CN}/\mathbf{CO}_{2}$</tex>. It is found that the highest temperature rise inside the GIL is at the conductive spring, and is greatest when the gas is <tex>$\mathbf{C}_{3}\mathbf{F}_{7}\mathbf{CN}/\mathbf{CO}_{2}$</tex>, reaching 60.77°C. In addition, considering the non-uniform axial distribution of temperature rise caused by the variation of heat source due to different internal structure of GIL, the temperature distribution of high-voltage conductor and conductive spring cross-section is simulated and calculated, and the comparison with experimental results is verified. The results of this study provide a reference for the engineering application of environmentally friendly hybrid insulating gases <tex>$\mathbf{SF}_{6}/\mathbf{N}_{2}$</tex> and <tex>$\mathbf{C}_{3}\mathbf{F}_{7}\mathbf{CN}/\mathbf{CO}_{2}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Seismic Performance of Mechanical DC Circuit Breaker Based on Time History Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Mechanical DC circuit breakers are prone to failure under the action of earthquakes, and their seismic performance needs to be studied in depth. In this paper, 160kV mechanical DC circuit breaker is used as the research object, and the time history analysis method is used to study its seismic performance under 9.0 fortification intensity earthquake. Firstly, according to the seismic design specifications of power facilities, three kinds of seismic waves were selected, and then the seismic performance of mechanical DC circuit breakers under three different seismic wave inputs was simulated and calculated, and the stress cloud map of mechanical DC circuit breakers was obtained. The results show that the existing design of 160kV mechanical DC circuit breaker meets the seismic strength requirements under the seismic excitation of 9 magnitude fortification intensity. Compared with EI-Centro seismic wave, Wenchuan wave has greater damage to circuit breaker structure.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation of Substation Construction Based on Lightweight GIM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: According to the requirements of the State Grid Corporation for the application of 3D digital design in the process of power grid engineering infrastructure, the 3D GIM results based on the digital design stage of power grid engineering substations can be applied to construction progress simulation, construction process simulation, and other construction processes, so as to improve the construction and management of power grid substations. In this paper, through the lightweight processing of the GIM model of substation engineering, the original 3D model is compressed to improve the efficiency of model browsing and operation on the basis of ensuring the integrity and accuracy of the model data. The substation engineering construction is conducted based on the lightweight model. The simulation platform realizes the visualization of the construction process and the construction progress based on the 3D model and provides an efficient and convenient solution for the formulation and modification of the construction plan.

articleTitle: Repetitive Control of Solar Eletric Vehicle Inverter Based on Mismatched Disturbance Observer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the solar electric vehicle, the photovoltaic cell charges the battery through a unidirectional converter and the battery supplies power to the load through the inverter circuit. When the load changes suddenly, the charging and discharging of the battery will change suddenly, which will seriously affect the service life of the battery and even be irreparable until it is scrapped. In addition, the load mutation is regarded as mismatched disturbance in the solar vehicle electric inverter, and the inhibition effect of the traditional control method is not ideal. In this brief, a repetitive control based on mismatched disturbance observer (RC-MDO) is proposed. The mismatched disturbance observer is used to estimate the mismatched disturbance and construct a new disturbance compensation gain to eliminate the influence of the load mutation from the output voltage channel. Meanwhile, the repetitive control also has inhibition effect on the disturbance, so that the dual inhibition of the disturbance can be realized. Compared with the traditional PI control and repetitive control, it can effectively reduce the fluctuation of output voltage, suppress voltage drop and improve the stability of the system.

articleTitle: A novel method for quality analysis of power flow samples
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This article presents a series of quality analysis methods for power flow samples to support artificial intelligence learning algorithms. These mechanisms extract adequate physical quantities from a large amount of flow physical information, simplifying the complexity of sample quality analysis. The proposed method can effectively evaluate the redundancy of power flow samples and suggests a practical design for generating representative flow samples. The complete mechanism includes quality analysis, physical information selection, and power flow sample dataset re-integration, which helps data-dependent AI algorithms to be more convenient and efficient in the application to power systems.

articleTitle: Design of Torque Observer Based on Improved Elman Neural Network for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: PMSM generally has problems such as complex algorithm, difficult identification of motor parameters, and difficult accurate estimation of electromagnetic torque by mathematical model, which leads to the decrease of motor control precision and overall performance of drive system. In direct torque control, torque inaccuracy will affect motor performance. Therefore, for PMSM system, it is very important to improve the accuracy of torque estimation. In this paper, an improved Elman neural network electromagnetic torque observer is designed. The simulation results are verified and compared with the traditional Elman neural network. The results show that compared with the traditional Elman neural network estimation method, the improved torque observer has high precision torque output performance, higher control precision and accuracy.

articleTitle: Location and Protection method of Single-phase ground fault in Low-voltage Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The low-voltage microgrid adopts a neutral point directly ground formula. For security, the low-voltage micro-grid single-connected ground failure needs to be isolated immediately. In the face of single-phase and high-resistance grounds, the two-way trend of low-voltage microgrids and operations from the network will cause difficulties in the protection of microgrid lists. In order to solve this problem, this article studies the single-phase grounding fault protection of low-voltage micro-power grids question. Aiming at the characteristics of many distributed power supply equipment in the microgrid, the simplified chart and the directional model of the microgrid were established. The remaining current of the phase line and the neutral line is not zero as a starting judgment of a single-phase and high-resistance ground failure, and then proposed the remaining current protection method of the direction, and its protection positioning algorithm was established based on the microgrid diagram model. Based on the residual current protection of the direction, a network-based microgrid listing protection system is established, and the implementation process is described. Finally, the effectiveness of the fault protection of the network of the micro-power grid is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Design of real-time control harmonic generator based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of large volume and poor portability of traditional signal generators, this paper uses Xilinx AX7050 FPGA(Field Programmable Gate Array) and AN108 AD/DA converter to design a signal generator that can be controlled in real time. The generator can operate independently from PC(Personal Computer) terminal, and can generate arbitrary waveform with adjustable amplitude, frequency and phase. After comparison with matlab simulation waveform, the output waveform of the signal generator has the advantages of stable frequency and high precision.

articleTitle: A Method for Tracing the Partial Discharge of Switchgear Based on Distributed Transient Earth Voltage Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Transient earth voltage (TEV) detection is one of the common methods for detecting partial discharge of switchgear. However, due to the layout of grounding system and other reasons, TEV signal has interference frequently between equipment, which brings difficulties to the location of the discharge. For this problem, this paper created the electromagnetic simulation model of switchgear and the abreast switchgear of the substation. Explored the best measurement position of the TEV signal of the single switchgear, as well as the discharge location method when abreast switchgear share the earthing system. The results show that it is the best to take the measurement at the lower center of the front of the switchgear. For abreast switchgear, the TEV amplitude for the same discharge pulse of each switchgear decreases significantly with the increase of its distance from the discharge source. Therefore, it is advised to build a distributed sensor network to locate the discharge source. Carrying out actual measurement in a substation, the location method based on distributed transient earth voltage shows high efficiency, providing reference for the application of TEV measurement.

articleTitle: Experimental study on sensitivity detection technology of series arc fault with complex loads
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the arc fault occurs in the power supply system, the overcurrent and leakage current protection are not enough to detect the arc fault. AFDD (Arc Fault Detection Device) has not been popularized in China, and the protection is only for specific load, or the use of a single place, resulting in uneven product quality. In this paper, the core detection tests of the mainstream AFDD in the market were carried out in the standard content, and the sensitive performance of the test products was compared and analyzed through the response time and perspective current of the test products. In the case of complex loads and loops, the influence of load complexity and arc fault location on the performance of AFDD detection was explored, and some improvement methods and suggestions were put forward for the existing standard detection test contents.

articleTitle: Active Capacitor Design Based on Differential Frequency Reactive Power Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the problems of short life and poor environmental adaptability of electrolytic capacitors, which lead to limited life of the whole machine and high system failure rate,this paper presents an active capacitor converter(ACC) which can be widely used in high power applications. On basis of that the electrical tolerance and capacity of capacitor and inductor limit the further improvement of the active capacitance capacity under the condition of fixed operating frequency, a theory of improving the operating frequency of the system and using the high frequency power to synthesize low frequency power, realizing the conversion of different frequency power and greatly improving the reactive power absorption of passive devices was proposed. Based on this theory, the topology structure of active capacitor was designed. In order to verify the performance of the active capacitor, the active capacitor is parallelled to the input port of the single-phase inverter to suppress the double frequency voltage on the DC side. The working principle of the topology is analyzed with the differential frequency reactive power theory, and the control strategy is designed to accurately control the active capacitor. The simulation platform is built, and the test results show that the active capacitor can effectively buffer the double frequency voltage pulsation.

articleTitle: Transient Modeling and Stability Analysis of DFIG-based Wind Turbine with Demagnetization Control during Severe Grid Fault
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: During severe grid fault, doubly fed induction generator (DFIG)-based wind turbines (WTs) demand switching to transient controls (e.g., demagnetization control) to suppress fault current. However, the transient stability considering LVRT control under weak grid fault has not been explored. To fill the gap, this paper firstly established the transient model of DFIG- based WT during severe grid fault, taking demagnetization control into account. Based on it, the stability of DFIG-based WT is evaluated by the Lyapunov's energy function and inverse trajectory method. It discovered that improper demagnetization control could lead to new transient instability issue. Moreover, the implications of diverse elements (i.e., the grid condition, grid impedance, demagnetization coefficient, PLL control parameters) on the transient stability are revealed, and some control design guideline is provided for DFIG-based WT during severe grid fault. Eventually, the analysis is verified via experiments.

articleTitle: Performance study of nano-BaTiO3/epoxy resin composite system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The dielectric materials of capacitors are the key research content, but the mechanical and thermal properties of the composites are less studied. In order to study the comprehensive performance of nano-BaTiO<inf>3</inf>/epoxy composites, this paper prepares nano-BaTiO<inf>3</inf>/epoxy resin samples with different filling amounts and tests their dielectric, mechanical and thermal properties. The research shows that the impact strength, tensile strength and bending strength of nano-BaTiO<inf>3</inf>/epoxy resin samples increase and then decrease with the increase of nano-BaTiO<inf>3</inf> filling amount, the maximum peak value is reached at 40% filling amount. The glass transition temperature of the composite also increased from 133.4 °C at 10% to 138.3 °C at 50% filling.
